name: C4 Starburst Cherry
msl:
Ahhh. We end the year going back to the beginning. The first Energy Drink me and NF had together. When we were still a little uncertain of how deep we wanted to take this whole thing.

C4 Starburst Cherry has stood at the top of our rankings since the very beginning. As I remember it, it was a huge punch in the face full of flavor. Ultra strong, and instantly made us think we had to do more. We’ve had this flavor since, but it’s been months and months and months since then. Does it still stack up as our #1? I’m not sure. But we’re gonna find out. It’s a clear drink. Nice smell.

Honestly, still strong but not as PUNCH ME IN THE FACE as I remember. Still - SO GOOD and very strong. OK - maybe it is still punch me in the face, as I find myself pursing my lips each time at the flavor. It’s just really good. I don’t know what else to say about it. I still think I, personally, may prefer the Strawberry Watermelon Ice, but I looove this flavor, and feel confident that it should remain in the tip top tier. Double thumbs up. Fond feelings about it.
nf:
Where it all began, folks! We wanted a guaranteed great drink to end the year, and what better way than with the first drink we had that has gone wire-to-wire as #1?

Ah yep. Yep yep yep yep. That’s the good shit. Beautiful candy cherry flavor with just the right amount of sweet and sour. I think we have become a bit accustomed to the flavor profiles of these drinks, so while the drink is still quite tart, it’s not quite knocking me back like the first time we had it. But it’s enough that it’s absolutely noticeable above the pretender class. One day I’d eventually like to try the top 5 and decide the true best flavor, but this is no paper tiger. It deserves its inner circle ranking.

name: C4 Starburst Strawberry
msl: This is supposed to be the pink starburst flavor - which is my favorite.  The flavor is not nearly as strong as Cherry.  Delicious though.
nf: 04/07/2024 - This is the second time I had one and I think I like it less now. Frozen Bombsicle might be the better flavor imo

name: C4 Strawberry Watermelon Ice
msl: I can’t really tell what this smells like but it’s a mystery to me and not NF.  Let’s try it.  WOW Ok that was a really strong flavor - stronger than a lot of what I’m used to.  Strawberry Watermelon???  I guess I can taste the Strawberry and the Watermelon.  Maybe.  I don’t know.  But let me tell you - this is fucking GOOD.  Second taste - sloshed in my mouth a little, unlike some other C4’s i’m not getting that overwhelming flavor.  I feel like I type this in 75% if not 80% of the things I write about.  This is just strong and flavorful.  Yeah, wow.  I like this one a lot.  I have nothing bad to say about it.  It’s strong, but not TOO strong that it feels like I’m being punched in the face.  It’s reminding me of how some of those Orange Cream drinks barely have any flavor and it PISSES ME OFF.  I LOVE this one.  Honestly - top tier.  There is a very real chance this is my new #1.
nf: Interested to see how this tastes. I am not a huge watermelon guy, but I do like strawberry. First sip and it tastes more like strawberry than watermelon. Almost more of a “berry” flavor than either one, which I’m fine with. Nice and sweet and the “ice” that may indicate a summer drink (or not, who the hell knows what it indicates) is on the nose. A really tasty sweet drink. Reminds me of Starburst Strawberry, if you can believe it. The taste is strong, but not overpowering. Likely a top 10 contender imo.

name: C4 Frozen Bombsicle
msl: Not as good as the Starburst ones.  Need to try again to remember how it tasted - but I did really like it.
nf: Very good. Mostly blue raspberry but there are hints of the Bomb Pop flavoring in there.

name: GHOST Energy Sour Patch Kids Redberry
msl: Definitely a sourpatch smell… I can’t say I’ve ever actually had sourpatch kids before this but I am sure this is exactly what they taste like.  I was always scared by sour candies!!!  But this isn’t very sour.  It’s just pretty darn delicious.  All the red berry drinks have been home runs, imo.
nf: Oh this tastes like liquid fuckin Sour Patch Kids baby. And I dig it!!!! It’s like a slightly smoother, less punchy C4 Starburst Cherry. There is a weird kinda upper taste to it I can’t identify, probably the bullshit energy drink stuff that takes it down a little bit, but this is top tier imo

name: Reign TBF Razzleberry
msl:
I dunno what razzleberry is but it’s VERY citrusy smelling. WOW TASTES VERY BERRY on the first sip. REAL GOOD. Let’s see if it holds up or is overwhelmed by the energy flavor. Apparently the flavor is blue raspberry. I don’t eat a lot of blue raspberries so I can’t judge. It’s a strong flavor - Soury taste as you sip. This one is going down really well, and I feel like might end up placing very high on the list. Or at least in the upper half. THUMBS UP. WOULD drink this again. BIG final sip was amazing. Great stuff.

REVISITED 6/3/2024 - One of the rare drinks we liked so much we got it twice. It’s just as good as I remember. Just great stuff. Very much a “This is a top 5 drink!” feel even though at this point we’ve got it ranked at 6.
nf: Smells very blue raspberry to me, which makes sense as a flavor that sounds like it will be blue raspberry-ish…I quite like that. Has a very strong blue raspberry taste without any of the typical energy drink downsides like bitterness or weird chemical taste. On second sip, there is a little of that shit but the taste is so good and strong that you don’t really notice it. This is great!

name: Gorilla Mind Strawberry Candy
nf:
PUNGENT! Smells good! Smells strong! I am ready for some damn strong flavor. WOW that’s flavorful. Holy moly. I really like it. It absolutely tastes exactly like what it’s called. Strawberry and Candy. But it’s also REFRESHING - which is something that I don’t think the first Alani was. That was candy great, but not like, refreshing drink great. This immediately feels like the best of both worlds. Sloshing it around the mouth - yep that’s just more of it. You do not get any straining ENERGY DRINK flavor with this. It’s just tasty. This is the second Gorilla we have tried and I think both of them have blown us away with the flavor, and neither of us expected it. Last gulp, I will say slightly more metallic at the end, I wish these things weren’t bad for you because damn did that taste good. S Tier Flavor. - MSL NOTE: On an empty stomach, this put me into a STATE after drinking it.

Another faintly piss-colored drink. Smells strong. It was the “red” choice. Think I have a good idea about what it might be…that tastes a whole lot like Strawberry Starburst and it is GOOD. Sweet but not too sweet, sour but not too sour, light but not too light. This is a fucking winner, folks. That gorilla has done it again. I don’t know if it will unseat the top dogs, but I think it belongs in the top. We’ll see where it ends up in the rankings.

name: Reign TBF REIGNbow Sherbet
msl: Today it’s a mystery for me.  Clear drink.  Sniff test: I’m thinking this might be something… Soury.  I’m thinking maybe Sour Gummy Worm.  WOW That’s tasty!  Very strong!  It wasn’t sour gummy worm at all - but REIGNbow Sherbet!  Holy cow, I did not expect this outta this flavor.  Honestly, the more I think about it, I don’t even really know what Rainbow Sherbet is.  But this is incredibly tasty as I take more and more sips.  It has like a creamy maybe orange flavor - reminding me of the Creamsicles almost.  I feel like if you were to tell me this was “Orange Dream” - I would fully believe you.  Just a very flavorful - heavy mouthfeel when you slosh it around.  Like melted ice cream almost.  Just a great drink.  Worth the insane Caffeine hit.  I’m sad I’m already done with my half.
nf: Interesting sniff, albeit from the can that is half empty.  Oh! That is quite nice! Strong flavor with a bit of the Sour Stuff we like. Even manages to kinda taste like a frozen treat somehow. It’s bizarre but this ROCKS. It reminds me a bit of how Swedish Fish had the flavor sensation of Swedish Fish and not “Swedish Fish.” The Reign site says orange, raspberry, and lime, which matches the colors on the can. Regardless, it just tastes Good As Fuck and gets a high recommendation.

name: RYSE Fuel Pink Splash
msl:
Clear drink with a pink tint. I have chosen this one. It is a mystery for NF. A deliciously sweet smell.

That is a strawberry flavor but with some extra SOMETHIN in there. I don’t know if it’s trying to be a specific candy or what, but it’s sweet and VERY tasty. I can see having points where a drink like this might just be a little too sweet for me, but as of this moment this is just delightful. Goes down easy, and the exact flavor I like. Not as PUNCH YOU IN THE FACE with flavor as something like Gorilla Mind’s candy flavor, but it’s more refreshing if that makes sense. Really great job from RYSE here. Fantastic flavor. Easily finishing.
nf:
Smells very sweet. I’m gonna throw a guess of Pink Splash out there.

The drink with the can covered in strawberries is indeed the drink that tastes like strawberries. This shit is delicious. Basically a Starburst Strawberry dupe. It might even be…better? Perhaps, perhaps not. But I think it trades blows with the best drinks we’ve had. It’s very sweet, but juuuuuuust enough. It’s like a candy drink, a nice little treat for good boys and girls. This shit rocks. Good! Very good!!! Ooga booga!!!!

name: GHOST Energy Cherry Limeade
msl: Not a strong smell for me.  Clear drink.  I think I’m gonna guess that it’s…Cherry Limeade?  I don’t know.  I really don’t notice any smell.  Oh that’s pretty tasty.  Wow this is real tasty actually.  It’s been a while since we had a Ghost and it has hit strong.  It’s not an OVERWHELMING flavor but it is a refreshing one.  I think the Cherry really takes over the lime taste, but that doesn’t hinder my enjoyment of this one at all.  Sloshing it around the mouth, and I can definitely get MORE of the Lime flavor when I do.  But this is just…straight pleasant.  I’m only halfway through, and I’m a little groggy from my ICONIC POST WORK NAP, but this seems like it is trending in the upper echelon of drinks for me.  This is one of those flavors that I would get again easily.  It reminds me of the excitement of when I had the Strawberry Watermelon Ice or w/e from C4.  Tasty tasty tasty.  We were avoiding this one for a very very long time, but somehow this is Top 10 worthy as of this date.  I apologize, GHOST Cherry Limeade.
nf: I have the can and imo it DOES have a strong smell that gives up the ghost about the flavor. Smells good! Unsure about the combo but we’ll see…Heyyyy that’s some good shit. Very sweet. Very cherry. Lime though? Mmmmm…don’t really taste much lime. Maybe a little as a kind of citrusy feeling on the tip of my tongue, but if you gave this to me without telling me what it is I’d just assume it’s just cherry. OK the sip I just took definitely had more lime, so it’s definitely there. Big fan of this drink.

name: RYSE Fuel Rainbow Sherbet
msl:
I feel like this HAS to be Bubblegum. Slight pinkish tint. VERY sweet smell. I’m looking forward to this one! FINALLY! I CAN DRINK GUM! Now that I think about it, it more smells like Cotton Candy.

Oh my gosh it tastes just like a Pink Starburst. Holy shit. IT is LIQUID PINK STARBURST. IT IS AMAZING. This was not the bubblegum flavor! Which isn’t even Bubblegum, I’m just now learning. But Rainbow Sherbet! OK. Well. Let me get back to the taste. It tastes very light going down, but I definitely get the vibe of a starburst when it is in the midst of your mouth. There is a bit of an aftertaste hanging at the roof of my mouth after the fact, but it isn’t an unpleasant one. The more I drink it, the more I think the flavor is starting to float away a bit, at least that’s what I thought was happening until I got to the last sip. It’s just really really good. Sweet, but not too sweet. One of those drinks where I would definitely have another one if offered to me. This is my kind of flavor. Not overwhelming. But strong enough. Might prefer just a slight bit more punch to it, but only a pinch more. This is going in the upper tiers.
nf:
My choice today. I took a whiff when I opened the can and it is smelling VERY sweet. Looking forward to it!

Oh, that’s really nice. It tastes a lot like the other one named as such. This tastes almost exactly like Reignbow Sherbet, which might sound stupid at first, “durrr flavors taste the same” but most brands running the same flavors usually taste quite a bit different from each other! With that said, this does seem to have an almost cotton candy-like flavor alongside the rest of it which I could see as being very polarizing. I believe Ryse does have a Cotton Candy flavored drink which I’ve long been unsure of, but now tasting this I expect it’d probably be a fun gimmick that I’d never want again. Anyway, this drink is really good! I think I’d take Reignbow Sherbet due to this being a little too sweet and having the aforementioned cotton candy taste that is a bit distracting.

name: C4 Ultimate WWE Berry Powerbomb
msl: Our first drink with actual color.  A good flavor.  Not nearly as strong a mouthfeel as the other C4 drinks, but that isn’t necessarily a bad thing.
nf: Fuck Paul Levesque. This was good.

name: C4 Hawaiian Punch Fruit Juice Red
msl: So I think this has to be the C4 just based on the amount of liquid in the glass and the fact that it do smell like Punch. Yep - that is in fact, FRUIT PUNCH.  Honestly, I think this hits the strong flavor a lot more than some of the other punch flavors on the first sip.  It’s been a long time since I’ve had an HP.  I remember when I went to a Beach Club that the vending machines would have cans of them, and I was always interested.  But I never, like, asked my parents to ever get me some either.  Honestly, I think this is pretty tasty.  Carbonated Fruit Punch still just comes off as weird to me, but there is nothing really wrong with this drink.  It’s got the Fruit Punch taste.  It doesn’t really have any shitty aftertaste.  You can *kind of* get that C4 energy drink flavor in this, but not really.  It’s pretty good.  I like it, and I’m gonna give it a thumbs up. Would I get it AGAIN…?  I don’t think I’d go out of my way for it.  But it’s in that “If it’s the only thing available, I would not be upset!” tier.
nf: So Matt thinks this is the C4. Interesting strategy. Interesting whiff…Yes that is indeed Hawaiian Punch. “A nice Hawaiian Punch” as the ads say. Bonus: doesn’t leave that shitty feeling on my teeth like regular HP does, presumably due to a lack of High Fructose Corn Syrup in this. I think this might be my favorite punch we’ve had, but I’ll have to look over our previous reviews. We’ve had mixed experiences with punch flavored drinks anyway. Either way, if you want Hawaiian Punch, but an energy drink, this is the way to go. At worst the second best way to go.

name: C4 Ultimate Fruit Punch
msl: I’M EXCITED FOR THE RED DRINK BUT IT’S CLEAR???  It smells very much like fruit punch.  I’m excited.  The first sip… I’m really getting a LOT of that C4 “energy drink” flavor - but with a small fruit punch hint added to it.  I enjoy the C4 Energy Drink flavor though, so this is fine.  Second sip - a bit more of the same.  Nothing notably different.  It’s a pretty good drink actually and if it was the kind of thing I would see in the cooler at my local pizza place or bagel store or whatever I would probably grab another one.  As I finished up honestly though it was more fruity.  Not my favorite - but very good. Tasty to the end.
nf: This already has me skeptical due to FELONY FRAUD allegations. The bottle is shiny red but the drink? The liquid? The SUBSTANCE? Clear as day. Lawsuit? Perhaps…That is some fruit punch ass fruit punch. With a little of the kick we got in the Starburst varieties we like so much. There’s definitely some of that energy drink metallicness in the background, but way less than some of the other recent drinks. This is the good stuff. I think the bottle is smaller than the can, so it’s the kind of drink I would actually like if I needed a pick me up but wanted to be able to reseal it and not have as much as they put in the damn tallboys. Also, it’s non-carbonated which helps make the resemblance to actual fruit punch stronger

name: GHOST Energy Swedish Fish
msl: I like Swedish fish.  I don’t think they’re exactly the most flavorful gummy in the world but they’re fine?  No idea why the drink is yellow.  Smells like the fish though!  That’s a very strong flavor!  Way stronger than I think the last few we’ve had and I actually like it a lot.  I dunno what fruit i’d compare it to?  Cherry?  Strawberry?  I dunno.  It’s a very RED flavor.  You know what?  A few more sips in - I like this A LOT!!!!!!!  This is really good.  I still have no idea why the fuck it is a yellow drink though.  That’s so weird.  And unappealing.  This is the third drink in a row where  NF has responded “eugh” at the first sip.
nf: Looks like piss, smells like fish - Swedish Fish, that is. I generally do not like the candy this is styled after, but moreso because of the texture and toughness and not the flavor. My first sip tastes almost like it has alcohol in it. The flavor is definitely 100% there though, to the point I almost feel like I have gummy in my mouth. There’s a very strong medicinal bitterness on first glance that goes away after you swallow it, continuing a trend from the last few drinks we have had. Might be a me thing? Taking another sip where I don’t let it sit and I just swallow it makes it a bit better. Subsequent sips are the same, so my final thoughts are very good. I probably need to stop letting it sit like I’m sampling fine wines or some shit

name: Rockstar PUNCHED
msl:
“This is REGULAR Rockstar Punched. It has SUGAR….(checks) A LOT OF SUGAR actually…!!! HOLY FUCK”

Alright, let’s give it a shot. I remember being kind of unimpressed with the first one so let’s see….That tastes VERY sugary. I like it a lot at first, but let’s see if the same thing happens as the ZERO when I keep drinking it. Nope, still retaining that flavor. Still retaining that taste. Not feeling like it’s actively getting worse each time. I’ve got about ⅓ to go though so lets see…Yeah that was just an extremely sugary Fruit Punch drink. A lot better than the last one. A LOT.
nf: This better taste a lot fucking better than the Pure Zero version given that it has SIXTY ONE GRAMS of sugar in a single can…Well it certainly does taste a lot better! I have some Minute Maid Fruit Punch in the fridge and it tastes very similar to that. On pure taste it’s excellent, but I almost feel like it’s cheating a bit by brute forcing it with sugar. The top tier drinks have great flavor AND zero sugar, although I will likely get cancer or hypertension from some other chemical in those drinks that we don’t currently know is deadly. Good drink.

name: GHOST Energy Sour Patch Kids Blue Raspberry
msl: This smells sour patchy and I am excited to taste it.  All I have to compare this to is the last sour patch flavor that we tried - and it’s got that hint.  Though maybe a little more watered down.  A little more of that sourness?  I don’t know.  I don’t feel like pursing my lips or anything so it ain’t THAT sour.  This isn’t really a bad flavor, I just don’t think it’s amazing or anything like that.  It’s tasty.  OK.  That’s all. EDIT: actually as I drink more and more of it i’m noticing more flavor and sourness.  It’s REAL good.
nf: First smell: Not great. Second: Better. Redberry was good and I’m a big Blue Raspberry Guy so I hope this rocks. Tastes like Sour Patch Kids. Does it taste specifically like Blue Raspberry? I don’t think so, although I can detect a hint of it. It tastes like some sort of half and half SPK that’s like half red and half blue. I think it’s quite good, but not Blue Raspberry enough for what I was hoping it would be.

name: Alani Nu Pink Slush
msl: Much like yesterday, this has a nice smell - not too strong, though I don’t think I would have any idea what it was based on just that.  Oh that’s sweet!  Much stronger than the smell!  This is actually pretty delicious.  Exactly what I wish yesterdays would have been like. I’m trying to figure out how I can possible explain this flavor, because honestly I don’t really know what Pink Slush is.  It does kind of remind me of candy.  Doing a little lookup - and I see someone said Nerds is what they almost taste like, and I can see that.  It’s not super sour but it does have that punch to it.  Yeah - it’s both refreshing and very tasty.  I wish the Alani’s were the size of the C4’s because I really want more.  There is no crazy energy drink taste at all.  It’s just sweet.  Hearing that this is a LIMITED EDITION PARIS HILTON COLLAB flavor?  Which is unfortunate because I think this is such a winner.  I think it’ll be closing in on the top spots.
nf: I think I know what this is but there’s two others on the list that it could possibly be. But I am sticking with my choice of Sour Watermelon Candy…That is very nice. Nice and sweet. Almost like candy. OK so it turns out it was Pink Slush which WAS one of my alternates, but I did plant my flag. This is very good, it reminds me of the Gorilla Mind Strawberry Candy drink, which I suppose makes sense given this is supposed to be a strawberry slurpee or whatever. There’s maybe a hint of sourness, could be my brain, but it’s a really excellent sweet strawberry drink. Recommended.

name: Fusion Energy Rockin' Rainbow
msl:
After a few mysteries for NF, this one is a mystery for me. This one is REAL pungent. Clear with a slight piss tint. If I had to guess right now, I’m thinking maybe Black Cherry Ginger or the Iced Vanilla Berry. Because I have no idea what it is.

This one has like a Candy taste to it. I’m pretty surprised. Holy moly this is Rockin’ Rainbow, and that just seems very appropriate now that I’ve tasted it. This is legit like liquid candy. Very sweet. Second sip maybe not as sweet as the first, but it still hits. There’s like a tartness or citrus like hit here and then it just has this liquid sugary taste on the way down. I don’t really know what candy flavor it is they’re going for, but I thought “rainbow” was appropriate because it reminded me of a rainbow candy, which I guess now I realize is probably Skittles lol. Yeah this is good. I’m really surprised honestly, because I was just kinda “eh” on this one from the name and PR photo with the can sitting next to a sliced orange and raspberry. Thumbs up here. Easy finish. If you want a candy drink, check this one out.
nf:
Yellow tint on this one, smells like [REDACTED].

Ooooooooh lordy that’s good. Reminds me of candy, rainbow sherbet, the like. Just like what I thought it smelled like. It’s really tasty, in fact it might be a better Skittles than C4 Skittles. It’s very sweet, but it isn’t so much that I’m puckering my mouth and trying to expunge the feeling from my tongue. I think there’s a hint of a sour note in there too, but it could be my brain. Just a great little rainbow-flavored drink. Recommended.

BUM WEEK

name: bang Energy Any Means Orange
msl:
Today it’s a mystery for NF. All I can say without giving it away is that it’s not the smell that I was hoping for with this one. Also a drop of it got in my eye somehow and it sort of burns lol. The drink is clear.

Oh wow that’s ultra sweet. Not at all what I expected from the smell - but it hits you like a creamsicle. And we love ourselves a good creamsicle. Before I take a second sip - I can tell you it was a pleasant sweet, not like a “Eugh!!!” sweet. It hit just right. Taking a big swig and yeah, this is just kind of delicious. Actually tastes a bit worse with the slosh test, so don’t slosh this one around your mouth. I think everything about this one is nice except the way it smells, something about the way it smells just isn’t sitting right with me. But taste wise, it’s a nice orange creamsicle flavor. No crazy aftertaste. Thumbs up. Will finish this easily.
nf:
Matt unfortunately passed away as a result of getting a small amount of drink in his eye. It’s a clear drink today and I’m not 100% confident on the smell but I’m going to guess Peaches. Subsequent smells have me questioning that but I’ll just go with it even if it’s like 15% confidence.

The immediate taste I get is vanilla, which made me think this was BUCKED UP Orange Cream, but it is actually Any Means Orange. It’s very good. The orange is a nice orange taste that straddles the line between artificial and the real thing, and the vanilla is quite strong and pairs very nicely with this. I thought I remembered seeing that “Any Means” was some sort of eSports collective like Faze Clan from the Ghost drinks, but now I can’t find anything regarding that. Scratch that, now I see it. Kai Cenat and Duke Dennis are two names I recognize. I also thought this would be more of a pure orange drink, so the vanilla (and it being strong) was a very pleasant surprise. Definitely recommended, high marks for the Bangers.

name: 3D Energy Watermelon Grape
msl:
NF has brought me another mystery drink. I have no idea what it could be. It’s clear. Oh, I took a whiff and now I think it’s Green Apple/Crisp Apple. But only after I type that does he write down 2 more flavors on our list of “on deck” drinks…shoot. I’m sticking with my guns.

WOW INTENSE. It’s grape!!! WATERMELON Grape. Holy moly this may be the most intense Grape flavoring we’ve had in a while. I don’t know how much of “watermelon” I’m actually getting here, but wow the grape is punching me in my mouth. Sloshing it around the mouth and wow yes, that’s super strong. I’m nodding in excitement, This is our first 3D energy and they have given me exactly what I wanted out of a grape drink. It’s bold. You know how some of these grape drinks are more on the “wine” end or whatever? Not this one. Sugar rush. Sugar grape. The Welch’s grape tasted just like the grape juice/soda, this tastes like a level beyond. Intense and I dig it. Again, not sure where the watermelon is. But I dug this a whole lot. An easy finish, and in my opinion one of the most delicious grape drinks we’ve had yet.

POST RANKING: OK now that we’ve ranked it and I’m not overwhelmed anymore: I gotta say this was shocking to me. I really thought this was gonna suck, and as the flavor started hitting my cheeks it was like SUPER OVERWHELMING and i wasl ike “do I like this???” and then when I swallowed it was like “yes”. No shitty aftertaste at all. It was just an ultra strong drink. Big fan. Two thumbs up.
nf:
I told Matt to stay the fuck in his seat so I could bring him this drink. It smells like what the name is.

Very strong flavor here. Very sweet, very bold. I can detect both watermelon and grape, although the watermelon is definitely the dominant flavor here. [MSL NOTE: what the fuck] I’m generally not a huge artificial watermelon guy, but this is doing it for me. Maybe the slight grape addition helps diversify it from other straight up watermelon drinks, and on another sip I think that is the case. It’s a combo that I wasn’t sure would compliment each other, but it’s working for me. I’d kinda overlooked 3D Energy because the extremely minimal packaging gave off discount junk, but this is a very good start for them. We’ll see if they can keep it up. Shockingly, highly recommended.

name: GHOST Energy Raspberry Cream
msl:
IT’S BEEN OVER A MONTH SINCE WE LAST HAD A DRINK. It’s my fault. I’m sorry. I felt like I needed a bit of an energy cleansing. But we are back!

The one that I was just given is in a clear glass, and it smells like CANDY. Sour candy??? So I’m going to assume this is BUCKED UP Sour Bucks. Let’s see if time away has made me smarter.

WOW that is some FLAVOR. That is REALLY GOOD. Raspberry Cream!!! I don’t know if it’s that I haven’t had a drink with this amount of flavor in so long that it’s hitting me hard, but I’m having a REACTION right now. I CLAPPED. I’m like that old guy on tiktok who picks up the brisket and as it falls off hte bone he gets up and starts moving before pointing at his plate. THIS IS GOOD. It’s red berry flavor mixed with vanilla, and it just hits. I wish I had more to say here, but I’m not sure what to say. Raspberries aren’t usually my flavor of choice, but this is sweet and it’s delicious. I would 1000% buy this again. I feel like kicking myself for waiting this long to drink it. 2 thumbs up. This will rank highly. I am very, very, happy with this one.
nf:
This thing on? We’ve been a mix of busy and lazy and have taken our eye off the ball. Matt WILL be committing ritual seppuku at the conclusion of this review as an apology.

What we have here is a clear drink that smells quite sweet. Matt said it smelled like candy, which I misheard as Andy. What kind of men is he sniffing?

That’s a good fuckin sip, I tell you what. Strong flavor that tastes just like what it says on the can: Raspberry Cream. It’s a robust, sweet, raspberry flavor with a bit of vanilla flavor. The vanilla isn’t overpowering like some drinks where it’s like they spilled the stuff they douse vanilla-scented air fresheners in. It’s a nice sidecar to the raspberry, a Robin to its Batman. I will say that I prefer the blue variety of raspberry (I’m aware it doesn’t really exist, please contact Matt if you are mad), so it being regular raspberry does hold it back from being a full 5 star or 10/10 for me. But this is a great drink regardless that I’d recommend to anyone. Even raspberry haters.

name: C4 Skittles Original/Cosmic Rainbow
msl: ORIGINAL - March 2024Reminds me a lot of the Starburst Cherry but way less PUNCH YOU IN THE FACE with it. It’s very good - but I also wouldn’t bother drinking this one knowing the Starburst one exists. - MSL RE-REVIEW - May 2024We needed to go back to this. We both felt as if it was placed inappropriately on the list and we rated it based on what we felt about the Starburst. With that said - on first drink, I was initially thinking “Hmmm… maybe it shouldn’t be as much higher as we initially ranked it -” but then again, I also do think it’s better than where it is ranked. It’s a damn good drink. A good C4. I would in fact go out of my way to get one if the Starburst Cherry wasn’t around. SKITTLES vs COSMIC RAINBOW - June 2025HERE WE GO. C4 has lost the licensing to Skittles. And the flavor has been renamed COSMIC RAINBOW. This changes things. Is the flavor different? Did they have to alter anything? We don’t know! So what we have here is 2 cans. One of the original Skittles, and one of Cosmic Rainbow. We’re going to try them back to back and compare. Let’s get to it. So we’ve got two glasses here. Wider ones are the ORIGINAL. Curved ones are COSMIC RAINBOW. I can say that while they smell similar, the Cosmic Rainbow smell is a lot stronger. Could that be because it’s more fresh? Both drinks are clear. I guess what we’re gonna do is sip one, than sip the other. Let’s see how it goes. Alright so both of these taste the same, but one definitely feels more flavorful than the other. Neither can is expired, but the Cosmic Rainbow definitely has a bit more punch to it. Not sure if that’s just because how it is, or if the Skittles is just a little flatter. When I slosh it around the mouth, I definitely get the feeling of “you just shoved a bunch of skittles in here and ate them.” As I’m taking a sip of it though it honestly feels more like a sour apple flavoring. Maybe it’s just been a long time since I’ve had skittles. Either way, I feel like the Cosmic Rainbow can is better. It just tastes fresher, but both flavors are pretty much exactly the same. It’s not bad! I like it. I did finish, and am wondering how my body is going to react to having a FULL CAN of this though on an empty stomach. Thumbs…up.
nf: RE-REVIEW - May 2024WE HAVE TO GO BACK - that one’s for the millennials. Anyway this tasted like I remembered it: much better than its ranking, but not as good as the best. It’s a weaker flavor in both cherry and kick than Starburst Cherry, but it is probably better than the NINE(!!) drinks in front of it. Good stuff. SKITTLES vs COSMIC RAINBOW - June 2025We have been tinkering with the idea of trying some of our earliest ones again, although we already did this with Skittles, this is moreso an offshoot to see if there’s any difference between the Skittles-branded drink and the drink that has been released without the license that is ALLEGEDLY identical. We have taken some sips of both and there is a difference there. The newer one tastes a bit lighter and a little sweeter. But ultimately it’s hard to say whether the formula is different or if it’s just a fresher can. The Skittles-branded one isn’t close to its sell by date, but it was likely canned well in advance of the newer one. But if they did change the formula, it tastes very similar to the point I wouldn’t make any grand declarations about it being superior or not. Two good drinks!

name: RYSE Fuel Sour Punch Sour Blue Raspberry
msl: I like the smell of this one.  And I hope it hits.  Clear drink.  Oh that’s tasty!  I like it!  It’s got that sour hint in there but it’s not an overwhelming sour.  And the blue raspberry flavor is nice.  Not too strong, but also not too weak.  If I slosh the liquid around the mouth you really feel like you’re having a bit of sour candy, but this is just a very pleasant flavor.  While I’m not exactly certain that this blue drink lives up to the standard of one of our Top 10’s, I also don’t exactly think it’s extremely far off either.  It’s very tasty.  And it better be with this type of caffeine hit, jiminy freaking christmas.  Final gulp… yep that’s nice.  That’s two winners in two days.  This one I think is headed in the upper 25%.
nf: Can’t really get a grasp on what this might be. Some kind of fruit flavor, like that narrows it down at all…OK that’s some kind of sour berry, maybe sour blue raspberry? ‘Tis, as Matt has revealed. What can you say about blue raspberry we haven’t already? It’s a good ass flavor. This in particular is a good little blue raspberry drink. It has a nice sour flavor, as the name of this drink indicates not once, but twice. It’s quite sweet, but not too much. It’s sour enough without it being bitter or causing a gross aftertaste. There’s also no hint of any chemical taste. This might not be the best blue raspberry drink we’ve had, but it’s definitely one of the better ones.

name: C4 Popsicle Cherry
msl: I just got home and am sweating my ass off and this drink is poured for me.  Smelling it, I have no idea what it can be.  I’m gonna guess FAZE POP.  Maybe like, one of those US Rocket Pops or whatever?  The red white and blue ones?  I’ve been told that’s not what it is.  Popsicle Cherry.  That makes more sense.  POPSICLE OH HOOOO..  This is actually really tasty from the first one.  Is this just a melted popsicle?  Second taste - yeah it’s a popsicle alright.  It doesn’t have that fizzy ultra ENERGY DRINK patented taste that I’ve come to know from some of these drinks, which I don’t dislike - but I think when it overwhelms it can be bad, especially when ranking flavors.  So this is pretty good!  Final sip - this was a really pleasant refreshing drink.  Part of me wishes the flavor was stronger, but for what it was it was really good!
nf: POPSICLE HUO HO!!! Anyway, this tastes like a cherry drink. It’s quite tasty and doesn’t have much of the energy drink stank. However, it also doesn’t have much carbonation or bite. Which does make sense since it’s Popsicle Cherry, although I guess I don’t really associate Starburst Cherry with a sour kick and that had a sour kick so good it kicked me in the jaw. So what the fuck. Anyway, would recommend, even if it isn’t in the top tier. If you aren’t in the mood for a kick, though, this might be the tops. Great drink for the summer.

name: GHOST Faze Pop
msl: Fazing up with some faze pop.  Smells like what I described first with yesterdays drink.  I am ready to try this.  I don’t exactly remember these rocket pops being full of FLAVOR so I don’t know how high something like this can rank, but maybe it’ll surprise me.  Oh yeah.  Oh yeah that’s some flavor.  This is our first GHOST in a while and there is this weird little energy drink taste mixed in, but flavor is for sure there. The more I drink, honestly the less I’m liking it, and the more the flavor seems to be overwhelmed with what I assume is GHOST FORMULA.  Last big gulp: Yeah, it’s good!  But it’s not incredible.  Would not pass up one if offered, but would probably ask what other flavors were available lol.
nf: FAZE CLAN YO WE ESPORTS YOUTUBERS WE GAVE 18 PEOPLE A CHOICE OF A NEW FERRARI OR SKIBIDI TOILET!!! Matt doesn’t remember bomb pops/Firecrackers being full of flavor but that’s either because he never had one, he forgot anything pre-COVID, or a little of both. Oh I like that. I like that quite a bit despite the cringe sponsorship to appeal to children. You can taste a little of everything with one sip, but the blue raspberry is definitely the strongest part. In fact this is probably a stronger blue raspberry taste than GHOST Sour Patch Kids Blue Raspberry if you can believe that. Really good, and recommended! USA! USA! USA! Like, comment, subscribe!!!

name: RYSE Fuel Sunny D
msl: Alright.  Even if I didn’t know what this was and it was given to me, the smell is distinct enough that I think we both know what it is.  Clear drink.  I am very scared of this one.  But let’s try it.  Gulp Gulp Gulp Gulp - I was waiting for the flavor to really hit me as I was drinking but it kinda wasn’t, so my first sip was multiple gulps.  It isn’t…very strong when you just do that.  But it doesn’t taste bad.  Really sloshing it around the mouth, it’s weird it almost tastes more like an Orange Cream than a Sunny D to me.  It’s definitely refreshing.  Not as much of that CARBONATION flavor that you would really expect.  Yeah, this is honestly surprising.  The way I’m having fun drinking this one is letting it sit in my mouth and letting the flavor hit me before it rolls down the throat.  You get that orange flavor, and when it all disappears it leaves no gross aftertaste or anything like that.  It’s pleasant.  I like it.  If you handed me this, and told me it was a Sunny D - I would wonder why it’s clear, but I would believe you maybe because it’s been so long since I had one.  It’s OJ!  Not that OJ.  The Juice.  Not that juice though.  Very nice!
nf:
I think I know what this is based off the smell, but golly have I been wrong before. Smells like orange juice. OK, I was right, Sunny D. Used to chug one in 30 seconds in first grade with my friend Brandon. Do kids even know what the D stands for? Anyway, that’s a nice refreshing orange drink imo. Tastes like a lightly carbonated Sunny D. Shocking, right? Reminds me of a Stewart’s Orange Cream without the vanilla. I like this quite a bit. If you like orange drink, go for this.

“Sometimes you get a flavor and it kicks your ass, but other times there’s enough flavor but not too much - it’s just right!”

name: Alani Nu Cosmic Stardust
msl: This is PINK.  It’s got a strong smell also!  Didn’t even have to pick it up.  Hopefully is as flavorful as it smells.  I assume this is either the Sour Pink or maybe the Gorilla?  Shit.  Now that I think of it I dunno.  OK well wow that is a SOUR flavor and it is kinda strong!  I don’t know if this is my favorite FLAVOR - but it does pack a kick.  I don’t know if it’s GRAPE - Sour Grape?  Like a warhead?  I dunno.  I’m kinda saying the same thing over and over but it’s really hard to described.  Sour Grape Soda where the Sour Candy really hits ya.  I don’t know how I’m going to rate something like this because I think it’s very unique - and I even think it’s good - and I can see people who love sour candy LOVING this.  It’s not personally MY favorite flavor, but I do appreciate it.  One final big gulp and slosh around the mouth: OH YEAH.  SOUR.  Ok.  I’m done saying the same thing over and over.  Would I try it again? ….Honestly yes!  But I also think this is something I would never drink if I was like, SUPER THIRSTY.  It’s more of a tasty treat.
nf: I thought the drink was purple but I also can’t see shit. I have the can and know what flavor this is, so the drink is farther from my nose than Matt’s, so I can only smell it so much. OK that tastes good but I cannot put my finger on what the flavoring is. It’s like candy. Research says grape, with one review comparing it to candy like me. It’s probably grape plus other stuff, but I’d say it’s almost like a grape Nerds soda or something. I think this is really good! The only downside frankly is that the can is Celsius-sized and not the size of C4 and the like, probably because it’s positioned more as a lifestyle drink and not a fuck up the gym pre-workout energy drink (for men but we won’t say it). Give it a try.

name: Alani Nu Dream Float
msl: It may actually be Dream Float.  I’m going with that as of now.  That is definitely dream float.  It has the smell and it has the creamsicle taste, though I will say it isn’t… my favorite Creamsicle one.  I don’t quite know how to describe the sensation I’m feeling when I’m drinking this.  You know CREAMSICLE flavor.  When you take the sip I think maybe you’re getting a little orange - though not STRONG orange, but as it starts to settle in your mouth you’re really getting hit more with the vanilla.  If I slosh it around the mouth, I feel like I’m getting definitely, a lot more orange flavor, but again, after swallowing, and after letting my tastebuds work - it’s all Vanilla.  It’s kinda interesting.  I find myself sloshing it around the mouth on the next few sips.  It’s fun.  I wasn’t crazy about this on the first sip, or at least not super crazy about it, but as I keep going to the end, I’m liking this a lot more.  Very positive thoughts!
nf: Got a good whiff of this when pouring it. Got a tinge of orange…I like that quite a bit. The orange is definitely stronger than the vanilla, but you can actually taste the vanilla unlike some others we’ve had. It’s a good orange creamsicle drink, maybe not a great one but I think it’s quality. Probably the best orange cream energy drink we’ve had. Reminds me of the Dave’s Orange Dream at Wendy’s. Recommended if it’s your thing.

name: C4 Ultimate Orange Cream
msl: This is an emergency situation where I need energy NOW!!!!  So we are doing this early.  It smells a little orangey but I’ve been fairly disappointed by Orange Creams and how light they are in flavor.  This says it’s ULTIMATE… so I guess we’ll see.  Also it’s dyed orange.  LET’S GO.  Ok wow that’s flavorful.  It definitely has that creamy orange taste you’d expect - but maybe when I see Orange Cream I just think of the Stewarts, because the flavor itself doesn’t hit me the way I’m expecting every time.  It is stronger than most of the previous OC entries I think in terms of FLAVOR.  I don’t dislike it one bit.  Actually kinda good.  But I’m not going hog wild over it either.  Maybe if it jolts me awake with this ULTIMATE energy…. I will think more favorably!!!  Ohohoho.
nf: Smells very orangey. It’s got an orange color, which must be how you know it’s ULTIMATE. Very sigma. So far we have been fairly let down by orange cream flavors outside of Reign, so hopefully C4 bounces back. Alright, that is good. Maybe it could use a little more vanilla/cream flavoring, but you can definitely detect it, at least. Not sure it’s better than Reign, but it’s for sure better than C4 Creamsicle and Ghost Orange Cream. Subsequent sips have me thinking similar thoughts: it does actually taste like orange cream, but probably not as much as I’d like compared to some of the other flavors that really nail what they’re going for like some of the blue raspberry drinks we’ve had. Recommended despite all that, though.

name: GHOST Energy Sour Pink Lemonade
msl: This is another I think we’ve avoided for a bit.  Fairly strong smell - not as strong as yesterdays.  OK well that is sour.  After all - this is SOUR PINK LEMONADE.  I don’t think I really get a lemonade flavor out of this, as much as I get a SOUR flavor out of it.  What is “pink” lemonade anyway?  Isn’t it just like pink food coloring?  This has no color.  It’s white.   I think that maybe there is a hint of strawberry flavoring here, but I’m really not sure. I’m struggling to figure it out.  But as for the taste - it isn’t bad at all.  It reminds me of yesterday's sweet treat, but this one tastes more like a drink that can refresh you, if that makes sense?  I like this one quite a bit the more I take sips of it.  The flavoring is strong but not punch you in the face strong.  The sour bit stays on your tongue for a while.  It isn’t filled with that overwhelming ENERGY DRINK CARBONATION flavor.  It’s just tasty.  Sloshing it around the mouth — ok.  Not gonna do that anymore.  Very sour!  And one final gulp - that was good.  Can see a kid loving this.  However it is intended for people old enough to make really bad decisions like me.  So eat that, children.  Also this doesn’t taste like Pink Lemonade at all.  Not sure why it’s named that.
nf: This is vaguely piss colored and I think I have some sort of idea about which one it is. We’ll see though!!! That is not bad at all. Now that I know the flavor, I will say I don’t really taste lemonade? It’s fruity, certainly. It tastes good, yes. It’s got a little sour, yes. But it’s colored like faded regular lemonade when pink lemonade is just fucking pink colored lemonade! It honestly tastes closer to something like a faint bomb pop maybe? I really can’t put my finger on it. It’s good, but the fact they missed the mark on what this is supposed to be really brings it down for me. Execution matters! It’s a good drink but a bad sour pink lemonade.

name: Gorilla Mind Black Cherry Vanilla
msl: This looks like pee and smells like something tangy.  No idea.  Going to drink.  Ok so I’m thinking that was very refreshing and am guessing it’s …Cherry Limea-NOOOO IT’S G-RILLA!!!  Black Cherry!  That makes sense.  I got the cherry right, but not the other flavor.  This is our first G-RILLA flavor and I don’t really notice any of that…lingering ENERGY flavor.  I feel like the vanilla is overwhelming the BLACK CHERRY portion but I do taste a little bit of cherry with each sip.  It kind of reminds me of some vanilla pepsi type variant flavor.  Those weren’t my favorite or anything, but this is very tasty and I think I like it more than those.  One last big chug for the finish:  Yeah that’s good.  Would have it again!  A very good start from Gorilla.
nf: This smells about like what it says on the can. Interested to see what Matt thinks before I tell him what it is…I think that tastes quite nice. To me it smells heavily like black cherry, but when you take a sip it’s mostly vanilla. Not sure how they managed that. I think this is really good, surprisingly so. Subsequent sips reveal the cherry flavoring. This does not have the famous Kick we like in the best drinks, but it’s absolutely in the next tier of great drinks for when you want a drink that’s a little less intense. That gorilla can make a good ass energy drink!

name: Reign TBF Orange Dreamsicle
msl: This time I know what it is and NF doesn’t.  LET’S GO.  I can smell the flavor immediately.  Now this is some orange dreamsicle flavor, let me tell you.  First sip it immediately blue the Ghost Orange Cream out of the way.  On second sip - I think you may just get a whole lot more of the creamsicle flavor than the actual energy drink flavor itself.  It just tastes like a damn creamsicle.  There is a little hint to it on another sip that is a bit off but the flavor is strong and it’s not bad at all.  Would I get again if I saw it?  Over like - a Stewarts?  Probably not.  But it is tasty.
nf: Matt told me I’d know what this is based on the smell and he is wrong. It’s possible I have COVID but more likely he is WRONG! OK I couldn’t put my finger on it but once Matthew put the flavor I was like oh hell yeah. This is what I hoped Ghost Orange Cream would taste like. Is it as flavorful and orange creamy as, say, a Stewart’s Orange Cream? Well, no. But for an orange cream energy drink it definitely hits the mark. It’s got a little of that energy drink stuff in the back, but not enough to ruin it. Good stuff.

name: bang Energy Purple Haze
msl: I feel like there is absolutely no denying what this can be but NF does not seem to know.  It is a clear color liquid but the smell is like - yes.  I know what this is.  Honestly - not as overwhelming as I thought it would be.  But this is, in fact, grape.  It’s got the smell.  It’s got the taste.  Slosh it around the mouth - yes.  That is indeed grape.  I feel like I’ve typed that exact sentence with a different fruit/flavor multiple times now.  It’s been a while since we tried our grape flavor drinks, and I think this one is better than the Popsicle, but I’m trying to jog my memory about Grape Frost.  Either way, this is a tasty grape.  It doesn’t really punch you in the face or anything.  But it is in fact, GRAPE SODA flavor.  I really like Grape Soda flavor.  Probably moreso than NF, so I dunno where this is gonna rank.  Yeah.  This is good.  Would have again.
nf: This has a strong smell. I have a guess, but I won’t say. 🤭Damn, that’s strong. Strong grape. It’s definitely going on the Grape List. I think it might be my favorite of the grape dranks we have had so far, although that is fairly faint praise given the placement of the other two grape flavors. I think it’s pretty good, but I’m a bit unsure of where this will place on the rankings, whereas a lot of times I’m like “yeah that’s going in that range.” We will have to see where The Science takes us, but if you like grape I would go for this over the C4 flavors..

name: Monster Energy Juice Rio Punch
msl:
Another mystery for NF. This drink is Orange/Reddish. It’s got kind of a tangy citrus smell.

That is a juicy taste, and honestly a bit of a relief for me because I thought there was no hope for MONSTER Energy for a bit. It’s tasty - but once again I can’t really put my finger on just what the hell the flavor of this is at all outside of “tropical”. I don’t mean to just stick to generic terms like it’s “flavorful” and “delicious” but those are the words that enter my mind when I take a sip of it. It’s sweet, which is what I’d expect given the insane amount of sugar in this thing.

I think I’m just gonna say “GOOD MOUTH FEEL. GOOD TASTE.” Not AMAZING or earth shattering or anything, but this is a quality Fruit Punch type drink that like so many other flavors, I would probably drink again if this wasn’t insanely bad for me. I’m pretty confident in saying that this may be the best Monster Energy we’ve had yet.
nf:
This drink looks like some kind of punch. It smells a bit like punch. I’m gonna say this is either Ruby Red or Guava Paradise. Or I guess Rio Punch given I said punch so much.

That ain’t bad. Very smooth, not a ton of carbonation, but I think it works in its favor. I am finding the words hard to come by. I found a Reddit thread on it with a comment that says “Yeah can't describe the flavor other than "it tastes good" lol.” Looking it up, the flavor is “Sweet papaya, vanilla ice cream, hint of black currant” and yeah, I think I can taste the vanilla. Sucks I’m not some flowery food critic with knowledge of flavors, but this is what you get with a schlub sometimes. “It tastes good.” This has 33g of sugar which I think makes this by far the most sugary of all the drinks we’ve had. It does feel a smidge like cheating, but taste is taste and if this is what Monster needs to make a good drink then so be it.

name: Gorilla Mind Bombsicle
msl: This one has a delicious smell.  Slightly tinted liquid, not completely clear.  Knowing what this is beforehand, I think it smells exactly like what it’s going for.  NF doesn’t know though.  We’ll see if he can figure it out. This is GORILLA Bombsicle, and it has a strong bomb pop flavor.  Maybe actually a bit more sour than I would really expect from something like this, but Gorilla continues to have flavors that actually hit you pretty hard when you drink it.  I think I’m getting more BLUE flavor than I am getting RED here, but I think it does the job of tasting like a bomb pomp.  Giving it the mouth slosh test, yeah.  That’s good.  No flavor that just immediately dissipates and tastes metallic.  This is a tasty drink.  Not much else to say.  Good flavor!  Good size.  Probably a good ranking.
nf: Vaguely sour berry smell. Could it be…it is another bomb pop flavor! And a good one. Has the sour, the blue raspberry, the hint of lemon. Don’t know if I detect cherry or not. It’s not as strong as some of the others, but it’s extremely pleasant. A crowd pleaser. Might be too sour for some, actually. But it’s very good! Not sure if it’s top tier but it’s tasty.

name: Alani Nu Cherry Slush
msl: Not a lot of room for confusion on this one I feel like.  It’s a mystery for NF. Red drink.  Strong smell.  Looking forward to this one.  Let’s go!  That’s pretty tasty, though I will say I don’t think it immediately hit the way I was hoping on the first sip.  NF figured out the flavor!  On my second sip I thought it hit a little better.  The cherry flavor is for sure there.  I just don’t think it packs as much of a tasty punch in the way that the smell does.  I do get the sense of SLUSH like a slushie drink - maybe melted?  With each sip the whole thing gets a lot tastier to me.  This is just a satisfying flavor and I think the best Alani Nu we’ve had of all of the ones we’ve tried thus far.  Would try again!
nf: I can smell this without even bringing the glass to my nose. WHEW! Tastes like a red drink. I’d say strawberry more than cherry, despite the fact I think it says cherry on the can. Matt has confirmed it’s cherry slush. And it does taste good! Again though, not sure I get cherry from this. Maybe artificial cherry, which I suppose the “slush”  naming indicates. It’s not a real cherry flavor, it’s artificial and damn proud of it. I would say it’s a little too sweet without any sour counterbalance, so while it is good, I likely wouldn’t pick it over the 10-20 best drinks.

name: GHOST Energy Welch's Grape
msl:
I picked this one as a mystery but the smell is undeniable. Clear drink - but the smell of GRAPE SODA fills the sinuses the second you crack the can. I don’t know why, but I was more expecting like, GRAPE JELLY for some reason.

That’s grape flavor - more like GRAPE JUICE. Wow. It’s carbonated Welch’s Grape Juice with other fun chemicals. No shitty aftertaste here. They nailed it. At least I think they did - it’s been a long long time since I willingly drank some Welch’s Grape Juice, and I feel like 95% of the time I did, it was because it was what they were serving at Hebrew School. It reminds me of the flavor I would seek when I was getting ready for my Bar Mitzvah and they were like “Hey, drink this, it’s grape juice” but it ended up being WINE and I was DISGUSTED. But I digress. This is a really good drink. I really kinda wish that I had the foresight to buy actual Welch’s grape juice just to compare it to, but I didn’t. Make no mistake though, this is two thumbs up from me. I really enjoy this and am happy with it. This will be an easy finish. A great flavor from GHOST.
nf:
This is Welch’s Grape. Matt basically told me as much and the smell is, as Matt puts it, “undeniable.”

Well that’s grape. Grape grape grape. Squeezed right from a grape ape. Tastes somewhere between a grape popsicle and grape juice. I like it, not sure if it’s a love, but they nailed the taste. No sour kick, not much carbonation, but it doesn’t need either. Might ruin it. As much as I liked yesterday’s Ryse Cotton Candy, it is nice to have a drink focused on singular, simple, classic drink flavor like this and the recent Starburst Orange. Matt is going on some anecdotal tangent at the moment. Anyway this is a very good grape energy drink, although I think I like Cosmic Stardust better. Might prefer Purple Haze, too. They seemed to have a bit more character to them. Will see where the final placement ends up.

name: Gorilla Mind Arctic White
msl: Kind of a tint to this but it smells like ORANGE.  So I think this has to be Celsius.  NF told me he gave me maybe more - so he REALLY Doesn’t wanna try this if it’s the celsius can!!! It’s the Gorilla Arctic White!  I did not hate that sip but I also can’t place the flavor.  I’m wondering if it’s like a pineapple thing, but I really don’t know.  It’s very citrusy, very tasty, and it’s pleasantly surprising to me because I feel like a lot of the Citrus flavors haven’t hit me this much. I feel like this is another hit from Gorilla, even if I can’t place the flavor itself.  It just tastes good.  We are kind of doing a thing right now where I think we’re going back and forth on if we’ve enjoyed bang or Gorilla flavors more, and I think they’re just really close.  They’ve been real quality drinks.  While I don’t know if this would be the flavor I go for, I would absolutely have this again no questions asked if handed to me.  Very refreshing.
nf: This has a hazy look to it. Has a citrus-y smell to it as Matt says. Tasty first sip, although I can’t immediately put my finger on what the flavor is. Quick research says the flavor is…”arctic.” Or “white” or “freeze” or “white Monster.” So it’s This Kind Of Drink, whatever that is. It’s a pleasant drink no matter what combo of citrus flavors they threw in here. Not S tier, but definitely good and another winner from Gorilla Mind.

name: Gorilla Mind Exotic Kiwi
msl:
This drink is a mystery to me. Clear with a slight color tint. Smells like Green Apple to me, but I don’t really think we have any apple flavors left. Either C4 Jolly Rancher Watermelon or GOAT Watermelon is my guess.

This is EXOTIC KIWI and it tastes FUCKING GOOD. Our first Gorilla Mind in a month and a half and it fucking kicks ass at the first sip . It’s been a while since I had some kiwis, so I could just not remember what they taste like, but this was not what I expected. This is just fruity and delicious. It’s not one of the previous flavors where they truly punch you in the face and overwhelm you with the flavor, but it’s still strong and you feel like you got just what you wanted out of it. A very refreshing, tropical drink, and an easy finish. I’m glad we found this one. Two thumbs up.
nf:
I did not really get much of a whiff of anything with this drink. Very light. But that’s happened before and I’ve been walloped.

Oh wow that’s a lot better than I thought it’d be. I didn’t know what to expect, but I was anticipating mediocrity. This is definitely not mediocre. It’s quite sweet and has a tartness that reminds me of watermelon. Very fruity. Stronger than yesterday, but not overwhelming. Not much else to say, it’s just good. Not top tier, but definitely solid and wayyyyy better than I expected. I just had a quick nap so I’m a bit out of sorts and not very wordsy, but even if I were fully alert I dunno if I’d have more to say. Good job by the gorilla!

name: RYSE Fuel Kool-Aid Grape
msl:
Clear drink. BIG GRAPE SMELL. I believe this one will taste very good. I believe this brand can RYSE to the occasion, ohohoho. Kill me.

Oh yeah that’s grape. Strong grape. I haven’t had Kool Aid Grape literally ever, so I can’t tell you if this tastes like Kool Aid grape - but it tastes like Grape fuckin Soda. This is pretty much the flavor I would have expected, and I’m immediately happy with it. A lot of drinks we have get a little too cute with the grape flavor. They go for a bolder, wine taste or something like that. NOT THIS. This is CARBONATED GRAPE. I’m digging it a lot. It’s not like, “oh hell yeah I wanna drink this every day” - but I’m nodding my head while sipping, and if you offered me it, I would be like “Oh hell yeah”. This is an easy finish for me, and an easy thumbs up. Not a bad thing to say here.
nf:
This was a mutual decision that was mostly decided on because I emphatically said “let’s do that one.” Grape has been very interesting as it’s been all over the place in the drinks we’ve had. Much like orange cream, it’s a usually good flavor that is tough to nail as an energy drink flavor for whatever reason.

If you told me that this flavor was “C4 Jolly Rancher Grape” I’d have believed you. Of course you’d have to spend a long time convincing me it’s a flavor that was stealthily released because I now follow energy drink news like a dork but I think you could do it. It tastes like liquid grape Jolly Rancher. It’s not too sweet like a real grape, and has a slight tartness to it. It’s very Grape™, the artificial flavor you get in candies and popsicles, and I think it works here. It certainly works better than C4 Popsicle Grape, which I expected to taste more like this. I do want to try that one again sometime, though. Anyway, this is a lot of meandering to say it’s a very good if not great drink, and probably among the best grape-flavored drinks we’ve had.

name: Gorilla Mind Wild Grape
msl:
When NF found this one he told me he had a surprise drink. Never would have thought he would have found the two GORILLA MIND flavors we were missing. Well, one of them we still haven’t tried - but I think it was discontinued. Either way, this is the one GORILLA MIND I was extremely in on tasting. And we are going to be comparing it to yesterdays very strong Grape Drink. So I’m pretty excited for this one. GMIND is known for having some intense flavors, but could it possibly be more intense than AMIN.O? I don’t know.

Clear drink with a slight piss tint. Smells like grape. Let’s go. You know what’s crazy? It reminds me of the Welch’s Grape. That’s immediately the flavor that comes to mind when I drink it. It tastes exactly like that. I think it’s immediately better than yesterdays drink. It’s strong, but not TOO STRONG that part of me feels like it might be too much. It’s enough that it has that refreshing feel. But at the same time, it does remind me remarkably of the Ghost Welch’s flavor. It has that dark grape flavor to it, if that makes sense? That concord grape flavor, maybe? I’m not sure how to describe it. It’s bolder, that’s for sure. But as stated before, light enough that it doesn’t taste OVERWHELMING.

This is an easy thumbs up, and an easy finish. I was excited for this one but part of me was scared it wasn’t gonna hit, because I think somewhere on my vibes-list this is one of my top tier brands, hah. Very good!
nf:
Well here’s our third grape in a relatively short period of time. Can’t promise this won’t end up with a “it’s like the other ones” review. It’s got a very strong grape scent but looks like champagne.

Yep, a good ass grape drink. Probably better than Amin.O, but I dunno if it’s better than Ryse or Welch’s. Would likely need to do a blind test to determine, but there’s no real downside here. It’s a strong, sweet candy grape taste without any bitterness or weird flavoring. I think it’s a bit too strong to be in the cream of the crop, but this certainly hangs with the excellent grape drinks we’ve had. The only downside is how hard it was to find until recently. Good shit!!!!!

name: Amin.O Energy Juicy Strawberry
msl:
It smells sweet and fruity. Clear drink. We actually have 8 drinks in the log right now (including this one) so NF might not be able to immediately solve this mystery drink I picked for him.

WOW that is a STRAWBERRY CANDY FLAVOR. Holy moly. I was not expecting sweet candy on this sip, but that’s what I got. This is our first Amino Energy, and I was expecting something super light, like a Celsius or a Bloom, but this has nice punch to it that has immediately surprised me.

I’m pretty thrilled with this one. It’s got, what I think, is a slight, *slight* aftertaste. It’s definitely one of the most “disgustingly sweet” drinks we’ve had, so if a SWEET candy type drink isn’t for you - you probably won’t like this. But I’m digging this a lot. The immediate comparison drink in my mind is the Gorilla Mind Strawberry Candy — but this isn’t that. It’s not exactly way way way worse though, either. Just two thumbs up from me. Easy finish.
nf:
Smells very sweet. It’s clear. Hard to say what it is definitively, so I’ll have to dive in blind.

So this is our first Amino Energy, which I had no idea what to make of. It had a very plain, unassuming design on the can, and a name that sounds like any old thing you’d find at GNC. But this is really great, basically a candy strawberry flavor. It’s very sweet with a little tart to it, and evokes strawberry Starburst and the like. It’s just on the precipice of being too sweet, but I think it straddles the line nicely. Definitely an upper tier flavor, I’m very surprised by the high quality of this drink. I give this one a BOOM! Great debut for Amin.O Energy.

name: BUM Energy Hard to Kill
msl:
It’s a mystery drink for me! Completely clear. I do not know what kind it is but it smells quite sweet. There’s not a lot of liquid in here, so I’m thinking it might be a BUM. But I can also see it being the 3D Energy Liberty Pop - in fact that’s what I think it smells like. I just have no idea how big those cans are.

OK this is really good but I should have stuck with BUM because that’s what it is. Super good.. A true thirst quencher. It’s got sweet berry flavor - I think it would be perfect if just slightly sweeter. You get a nice light strawberry taste, and if you let it settle in your mouth/slosh it a bit you can get more of the lemons. I’d say it’s something like 80% Strawberry, 20% Lemon. Maybe actually stronger on the lemon if you really slosh it - you get that sour feeling in your gums.

This is just an immediate two thumbs up drink. There is no shite aftertaste. It’s not a punch you in the face strong flavor, but it’s light and it’s refreshing and I’m very excited to rank this one because it feels like a strong one. GREAT JOB from BUM. My FAVORITE BUM (THAT IS LIQUID)??? I don’t know. We’ll find out in a bit when we rank. Easy finish, wish I had more.
nf:
This is a clear drink that smells pretty good! Nothing much else to say, let’s get into it.

Oh that hits the spot. That’s really good. It’s very sweet with a strong strawberry taste. The can on HARD TO KILL indicates that it is not some badass death-defying combo, but rather strawberry lemonade, the kind you might see some child selling at a poorly constructed stand. Now I say “strawberry lemonade” is on the can and you may have noticed that I said it has a strong strawberry taste. That’s because I don’t really detect a ton of lemonade in there at all. A little bit for sure, but it’s 90% strawberry flavor, and it’s a good one too. There’s no flavor disappearance or bitterness, and I don’t think this would be improved with either carbonation or tartness. This should place highly in the rankings. My only complaint is that I had a terse review closer had this been a bad drink that I can’t use. “Hard to Finish,” if you were wondering. So it goes. I’ll happily take the good drink instead.

name: RYSE Fuel Sour Punch Sour Green Apple
msl:
Fairly certain the both of us aren’t too enthused about this one, but this is all for SCIENCE…SO…

Clear drink. Smells like Sour Apple candy I think. Oof. Oh yeah. Tart apple flavor. Pretty intense, I’d say, but also extremely flavorful and I think nails what it’s going for. It’s REALLY JUICY honestly, and the more sips I take of it the more I’m surprised how much I really like it. I’m a little floored given I was not looking forward to this one going in. But this is just really tasty. Would I want to drink a FULL CAN OF IT? No - I don’t think I really would honestly. Feels like a little too much of THIS flavor. But I can’t tell you that this is bad by any metric. I apologize to RYSE FUEL, the people there did something good here. Highly rec if you like Sour Apple Candy. Thumbs up. Will finish.
nf:
PRANKAPPLE!!!! I tried to smell this but my fingers smell like frosting because I just ate a donut. So it goes.

That’s a lot more pleasant than the Warheads. It’s honestly not very sour at all, it’s mostly just apple-flavored. Which is good! I like apples. I just had an apple juice earlier today! Second sip was bigger and I sloshed it around a bit. There’s definitely some sourness in there, but not a ton. It’s mostly just a sourish green apple drink that tastes good. No bitterness, not too sweet. Reminds me a bit of a hard cider without the hard part. Our first really good apple drink!

name: C4 Jolly Rancher Green Apple
msl:
It’s time for a C4 Jolly Rancher. Jolly Ranchers are not my favoritest candies. This one smells like a sour apple jolly rancher. I trust C4 to make a good one of these.

Yeah that’s a sour apple flavor and it’s not that bad. It may have been over 10 years since I’ve sucked on a Jolly Rancher. Maybe they’re not so bad after all? I dunno. It makes me think of a Granny Smith when I slosh it around my mouth a bit - which is not my favorite apple, but hey I guess it nails it. A tart juicy flavor for sure. While this isn’t anything close to my favorite flavor, it’s not bad and has done what it has set out to do. Another good one from C4. Not much else to say. Will finish.
nf:
It’s fall, baby. The leaves are changing, the weather’s a bit cool, and we’ve gone apple picking. And by apple picking I mean buying a beverage from a Vitamin Shoppe. Matt doesn’t like Jolly Rancher for some reason. Grape Jolly Ranchers are good, they’re just lollipops without a stick

Mmm! Nice apple drink. It’s got a little sour in there, a bit of tartness, but not too much of either like the disappointing Warheads. Quite sweet, too. That’s a quality apple drink right there. Not a lot of carbonation, but enough to notice it and not wonder where it is. I have really no complaints. It’s a great green apple energy drink. Probably about as good as the Ryse Fuel one. C4 the win, baby!!!

name: C4 Starburst Orange
msl:
This drink is CRYSTAL CLEAR. A mystery for NF. I am both worried and excited for this one. Smells like what it is, though it’s not very strong so NF prob won’t have any idea until sipping.

Yesssss. This is Starburst orange. Very flavorful. I’m almost getting a “Orange Soda” vibe but when it hits certain corners of my mouth I do get that Starburst…is it soury??? feel to it. For years I’ve said that I think the Orange Starbursts are my favorites, but I think overtime that’s more evolved to the Pink ones. I don’t know what really to say other than the C4 Starburst flavors have all hit, and this one is no different. I don’t know if it’s as good as the entries that stand at the top of our rankings - but this is a sweet, sugary (zero sugar) tasting orange drink, and I enjoy it very much.

For transparency: I discovered these flavors existed when searching for some flavors that we may have missed. Sent C4 an e-mail and they very kindly sent us 12 packs of both this, and the Lemon flavor that I was under the impression was discontinued. No charge. Very kind of them. That will not affect this review, but THIS IS VERY GOOD.
nf:
Can’t really detect what the scent is. Very faint.

Very fruity. Very tasty. C4 is back in the hiz-ouse. I wanna say this is sweeter and more candy-like than other orange drinks that we’ve had, but I’d truly have to have them back to back to really tell. But that is my short, pithy takeaway: A very sweet and tasty orange energy drink. One of the better ones, too.

name: BUCKED UP x Conor McGregor Notorious Buck Irish Apple
msl:
Conor McGregor is a rapist but we are going to drink his Bucked Up drink. The drink is clear, very fizzy, and smells like Apple! Strong smell, but I am honestly looking forward to this? I like a good Apple Drink.

Yeah that’s Apple. Wow it really starts to hit you as you let it settle - kind of like a Granny Smith - but not as extreme in the sour department? It doesn’t really taste sour at all. Sloshing it around the mouth and yeah, it’s actually pretty pleasant. A tad bit harder and I think this would be a “oh I’m gonna have to think about this” level drink, because this is just good to me. Unfortunately - I liked this A LOT, and would absolutely drink another one. Easy finish. Ditch the guy it’s branded after so I can feel less guilty about it - BUCKED UP. FUCK. IT’S REALLY GOOD. No shitty aftertaste for me btw. Just the lingering feeling of biting into a crisp apple.
nf:
We are a family publication and staunchly anti-sexual assault and pro-immigration, so it goes without saying we will be FROWNING this entire time. I don’t know the actual name of this, as the site and can have 8 different permutations so I just went with the stupidest combo for a profoundly stupid and shitty man. Apparently there is an Orange version of this and I may have passed it up a few times without knowing but you know I think we’re ok there.

This smelled a bit like hard cider but it definitely doesn’t taste like it. The first swig seemed to come in three steps: sweet, sweeter, bitter. There’s maybe a hint of sour there, but I think it’s mostly from the recreation of apple flavoring. It’s kind of a mid point between apple juice and apple cider with some bullshit thrown in. Like Viking Berry, it’s more of a twang than the truly bitter and drink-ruining Energy Drink Bullshit, but here I think it does more of a disservice to the drink than it did with Viking Berry. We have not had many apple-flavored energy drinks, and I’m a pretty big apple juice and cider fan. I would take some apple juice or cider before this, but I’d take this over hard cider any day. A problematic fave? No, but a problematic “yeah that’s not bad.”

name: Alani Nu Retro Rainbow
msl: Oooooo that smell! I’m pumped for this one.  Now that is an interesting flavor.  A tasty flavor.  But I can’t quite put my finger on just what the flavor is. There’s a hint of sour to it. NF mentioned “Sweet Tarts” and I immediately started thinking of SMARTIES.  Liquid smarties…  kind of fits really well actually.  I like Smarties.  I would never buy smarties willingly, and only ever ate them when given to me on Halloween, but I like them.  This isn’t bad.  But I can tell you right now it’s not really a top tier drink.  Tasty, but probably something along the B and C tier.  Distinct.  Different than what I’m really used to.  Overall positive experience.  Would I get one again?  Nah probably not.  But positive.
nf: Ooh that’s a nice sweet little smell. Candyish/sweet sugary drink smell. It’s gonna be one of two but I’m leaning towards it being C4 Hawaiian Punch…Pretty, pretty tasty. Quite sweet, a bit of sour. Proooooobably not top tier material but definitely up there. It’s definitely got a sourish rainbow candy taste nailed down pretty well whether that’s Sweet Tarts, Skittles, or Smarties. I would say it leans more towards cherry and strawberry but there’s definitely some sort of other flavors in there. I would definitely choose this over a lot of what we have had thus far.

name: Alani Nu Orange Kiss
msl:
This one smells nice. Not sure if it’s…Orange…Rocket Pop…or Punch? Those are my immediate guesses. I’m leaning Orange but we will see.

Somehow this is the Alani Nu - the one drink I thought it wasn’t because of the sheer amount of liquid in my glass. I think NF gave me too much. It has the quality of that Creamsicle…sort of maybe? No. I don’t really get that creamy flavor. It’s actually kinda hard for me to decipher, because there are so many fucked up little flavors these things do. But I think it just leans a little more towards an Orange Juice and/or soda. And I mean, hey. If that’s what they’re going for - this isn’t bad at all. This is a tasty little orange flavored Energy drink. It is not overwhelming with flavor to the point it makes you scrunch up a bit. It’s just a nice, refreshing amount. Yeah I mean, this is just pretty good. I like it. Tangy orange flavored drink. Would have it again. Do I think it’s the BEST ORANGE DRINK we’ve had since starting? I don’t THINK so…but I’ll have to really go over what we’ve done. I think this will land pretty easily in our upper half. This one gets a thumbs up from me.
nf:
I think the smell of this is quite obvious, but that is the advantage of knowing what the drink is. I know all about the psychological effects of the unknown, so the “fuck you” from Matt for typing that is not appreciated.

Smells like orange. Tastes like orange. The can has oranges and flamingos on it, and I’m guessing they did not add flamingo to the flavoring. Folks…this might be orange flavored. You are not going to believe this, but it tastes like their Dream Float flavor without the vanilla. It’s a refreshing orange taste that is a bit in between a juice and a soda flavor. It doesn’t have any particular kick, but that’s fine because I don’t really associate orange with sour. I do wonder if that would work, though. I think it’s very tasty, although I’d personally prefer some vanilla flavoring in it. A high quality orange drank.

name: RYSE Fuel Cotton Candy
msl:
I picked this one. Completely clear drink, with a strong smell, that I feel may make you think “Tropical!” But I know what it really is. SWEET.

Wow yeah. That tastes like Cotton Candy. My first sip was several gulps, and I feel like as it was entering my mouth the flavor was like “Yeah! This is it! Cotton Candy!” and then the flavor dissipated immediately. Not COMPLETELY - but like, a noticeable difference in the flavor from when it first enters your mouth and when it’s settling in your mouth. There’s a little bit of an aftertaste with this one that isn’t really too bad at all, but after sloshing it in my mouth a bit it’s taking a bit to go away.

With all that said, the initial flavor is a home run. They got it. Good drink. I do think the more that I drink of it, the less flavorful the sips are, but they nailed what they were going for, and I just think it’s good. So a thumbs up from me. I was definitely a little shaky on trying this one, and I’m glad it proved me wrong. Very easy to finish!
nf:
This is Cotton Candy. Matt has confirmed this. It smells sweet as fuck.

Interesting. There is definitely a “cotton candy” taste, but it also just tastes kinda sweet and sour berry-ish. I’m guessing much of the sweetener used here is also used in other berry flavors, so that makes sense, but “cotton candy” is not the overwhelming taste I get here. With that said, I really like this. It’s tasty! It’s not sweet to the point I feel like my tongue is shriveling, and sweet enough that you get that feeling that you are consuming something you probably shouldn’t be - kinda like eating cotton candy. I was expecting something ironically enjoyable, something to laugh at with M. But this is just a legitimately good drink. Ryse did a great job here.

name: RYSE Fuel Kool-Aid Tropical Punch
msl:
8 pairs of shoes, 9 bb belts… and 10 sips of creatine. RED DRINK. I know the drink and NF does not. If I didn’t know the drink though, I’d be confused between like 3 of them. It smells like what it is though.

It is KOOL AID!!! Tropical Punch! And I have to be honest, had we not already been doing this project for several months, and NF just gave me this as a drink? I would just think it is straight Kool Aid. Because I never have really had Kool Aid outside of a couple sips at parties. I think I’ve had hawaiian punch more than Kool Aid. And I can maybe count the number of times I’ve had a HP on 1 hand. So because of that, I can’t tell you how ACCURATE the flavor is to a Kool Aid Tropical Punch.
