But what I can tell you is: it’s pretty good. No disgusting aftertaste. Nice and sweet. I have to be honest - I lost the plot for a second and just drank the whole damn thing. I was thirsty and needed a refreshment, and this was a refreshing drink. In that sense - I think this is a W drink. My bad everyone. Delicious. Would have again, sure.
nf:
Today is Labor Day, and our drink is as red as the blood our comrades have spilled in sacrifice of worker’s rights. Scent is berry. Could go a lot of places.

OH YEAH! This is Kool-Aid Tropical Punch! And uh…it tastes more like Fruit Punch than Tropical Punch. But that’s a good thing, OH YEAHHHHH!!!! It tastes like you’d expect a Kool-Aid Fruit Punch to taste: a taste so strong - perhaps too strong, in defiance of God’s will - that it could run through a wall. There’s a little Energy Drink flavor at the tail end, but the Kool-Aid flavor is so strong that you barely notice it. Very good, but we will have to see where it places as it gets points for taste, but possible deductions for advertising the wrong style of punch.

name: BUM Energy Cherry Frost
msl:
This one smells nice. Clear drink. I just made Sausage and Peppers and had a sandwich so I chose this flavor based on the fact that I think I can handle it right now, lol.

Ahhhh that hits the spot. I actually think it has a bit of a weird aftertaste maybe? Huh. I’m not sure if it’s because of the sandwich I just had, or the flavor itself. It tastes like a nice refreshing cherry cola! Every CHERRY flavored drink basically needs to be compared to the first drink we ever had, "so": It’s not nearly as overpowering as C4 Starburst Cherry. It does not punch you in the face full of flavor. But it still tastes really nice. These cans of BUM are pretty small so it’s unfortunate that I finished mine in only a few sips. If I had another can in the fridge I think I would pop another one open just to have more. So that’s a thumbs up. Good work, from BUM.
nf:
This one smells nice. Clear drink. I wanna say it has a cherry smell.

Bum’s the word. In the brand, not the drink. The drink is cherry and not much else. And I like it. It’s a sweet, tart cherry that doesn’t overstay its welcome or max out sweetness. Bum comes in 12 oz cans, so this is actually one I could see myself drinking to completion, as opposed to the other brands that seem to solely sell tall boys (Alani Nu excepted, who sells some flavors in 12 oz varieties). It does not get to the heights of the absolute best cherry, but I’m guessing this will be in the top 3-5 of cherry drinks we’ve had. Cherry bomb? No…cherry peace.

name: Alani Nu Strawberry Sunrise
msl:
Folks it’s been a while again, but I swear I have a great excuse.  I am on the GLP-1 and the carbonation from sodas makes me a burping machine!!!  And it tastes nasty!!!  But I’m down 23 pounds since we last did a drink and I feel like I can do one this sunny afternoon saturday.  Is it even sunny outside?  Oh the forecast says rain oops.  OK well let’s have our first drink in months!  STRAWBERRY SUNRISE!  I hope it hits. 

Clear drink.  A little smokey.  Smells DELIGHTFUL.  Bottoms up!!!  Ooo that is good.  There’s a little bit of a bitter aftertaste as it starts to trail off, but for the most part that first sip was great.  Yeah, it’s a really nice strawberry candy flavor where the very end of it kind of feels like more of you just biting into an orange.  Which that’s exactly what this is advertising itself as - so that’s a home run.  When I slosh it around the strawberry is definitely the more intense flavor.  This just kind of rocks.  Easy thumbs up.  Really glad this is the first drink we did in the last few months because I think it’ll encourage us to get on top of our backlog that has some drinks that have been in the fridge for…a very long time.  Great stuff from Alani Nu.  Easy finish
nf:
Well jesus christ it’s been a bit. We have a fridge full of drinks that have largely gone untouched (not for a lack of trying on my part…) for a few months now. Thankfully they’re all artificial as fuck so they’re nowhere near expiration but WHEW. Got a whole ass website up since our last review and everything. We decided on this flavor together, so we know what is up going in. Ideally this will be restarting things on a good note. At least that is the idea of going with this flavor. It smells very much like artificial strawberry flavor. Good start.

It also tastes very much like artificial strawberry flavor. Heavy on the artificial, as there’s no hint of an actual strawberry taste here. Go get a smoothie if you want that. This is liquid strawberry candy all the way down. The can and description suggest it has orange flavor, something I only detect the slightest hints of. So it loses points there. I don’t think it loses that many, though, because it isn’t like “Straw-orange” or something, it’s Strawberry. It tastes like that. I dunno about having this at sunrise, though. A bit too strong for an adult palate at that hour. Recommended.

name: 3D Energy Liberty Pop
msl:
It’s a mystery drink for NF today! It smells weird. Completely clear. Not sure if he’ll get this one. Hope it’s good!

It’s strong! Strong but tasty. Like a melty bomb pop, but actually much stronger than the ice cream itself. I said it was strong in my first message, but when giving it a little slosh I actually find it overwhelming. It hits you with the Cherry/Blue Raspberry mix but I feel almost the bitter/sour feeling in my cheeks after it settles. This week the GUYS podcast did a episode on energy drinks - and they mentioned at one point people who are in it for the BUZZ. I don’t really give a shit about that, and if you are reading this, I think you know that at this point what I want when we have one of these. And that’s what this is. It’s flavorful, packs a punch, and tasty. Just a little too strong for my tastes, but I’d say an easy thumbs up. This was an easy finish.
nf:
We got ourselves one a them see throughs. Glass Bottom Drinks. The scent is very weak but I can detect something…blue. Whether that is Blueberry Mist, Liberty Pop, or me being completely wrong is something we are about to find out.

“Mmmmmmmmm!!!” was what came out of my mouth when I sipped this. A very strong sweet/tart hybrid that is a trademark of bomb pop drinks, as this one is. There are hallmarks of all three flavors at once, although I’d say the cherry and blue raspberry seem to be the strongest. The lemon is like an accent. Or an umlaut. I don’t think this is as good as the best bomb pop flavor Frozen Bombsicle, but it’s certainly in the conversation with the next tier. My only complaint is that it is a little too strong by the time I’m done with drinking my half of the can. It’s probably best served if available in the tiny little shots that Five Hour Energy is known for. 3D Energy has been a huge surprise thus far. While this is not as good as Watermelon Grape, this should do well when we rank it..

name: Bloom Sparkling Energy Strawberry Watermelon
msl:
Based on the piss yellow color, and the smell, I’m assuming this is going to be Bloom Sparkling Energy. It COULD be Cotton Candy - it smells SWEET - but I don’t think BANG would do this color.

Woah. OK. I don’t know how to explain the first sip - very tart at first, but then I got hit with the wave of watermelon and it actually was pretty good. Yeah - a bigger sip that time, and this is good. This is a rare Strawberry/Watermelon where I actually think the Watermelon is stealing the show. The watermelon definitely takes over on the way down, but you get the juicier bits of the strawberry when it’s sloshing in the mouth. For the first second, I thought this one was not going to be enjoyable, but I like this one a lot. The flavor is strong, and both flavors I enjoy. There is no real aftertaste to it at all. It’s kind of hitting on all cylinders here. If this was a carton of juice and not loaded to the brim with caffeine, I could see this being something I would want ALL THE TIME as a kid. Very tasty. Easy finish. Double thumbs up. A big turnaround from the last flavor we had, which didn’t seem to have ENOUGH flavor.
nf:
We got another pissah drink. Golden just like piss.

Another Bloom drink, another tasty first sip. We’ll see if it lasts or not. Second sip is good too. Strong strawberry flavor, albeit not as good as yesterday’s drink. You can definitely taste the watermelon, though. It has those sweet high notes. Not detecting any energy drink/chemical flavoring as of yet, which definitely makes this better than the first Bloom we had. Yeah, this is a quality drink, nothing really bad to say about it, although it is missing that je ne sais quoi to really boost it up the charts. Drink up, ladies!

name: Alani Nu Cherry Twist
msl:
Most of the drinks we have are very clear, but not this one. This one says FUCK THAT and is super pink. It has a nice sweet smell to it, and I think it’s either gotta be the Cherry Twist or the Ruby Red from Monster. I’m leaning towards Monster just based on the volume of liquid I have in my glass. Also because I think I know where NF picked it out of the fridge and it was the only one on the middle shelf. I think.

Oh. That’s…interesting. Wow it is Cherry Twist. NF has tricked me completely. TART is I think the right word for it, as that sharp flavor hits on the first sip, though it doesn’t seem nearly as intense on the next few sip. I was really confused for a moment because I was thinking “this isn’t SUPER cherry” but then I realized it’s Cherry and Lime, and now it makes a lot more sense.

OK so this is a pleasant flavor, and now that I know what it’s going for I think it’s done a great job. I’m imagining a literal lime, but cherry, and biting into it. You get that bitter feeling of the lime, but it’s just cherry flavored. Yes. That’s how I’d describe it. That little tingle on your tongue mixed with juicy red cherry. When you take a much bigger swig of it, it actually kinda hits you pretty hard. Very bold. Not as bold as say, a C4 Starburst Cherry, but it packs a punch. This is another winner from Alani Nu I think. Tasty and great execution. Among my favorites? I’m not so sure. But definitely a “YES!” if offered at any time.
nf:
This may be the pinkest drink we have had yet. Very sweet smell to match.

Tart! That has a tart flavor. Not super sour, but you can definitely get a sensation of it. This is another cherry limeade flavor based on the can, and it definitely tastes like a fusion of the two flavors. We have a lot of mixed flavors where you can primarily taste one flavor over the other, but this seems to strike a real balance. So this absolutely gets points there. WITH THAT SAID…I probably would have preferred a little more cherry. It’s tasty but seems to hit a sweetness ceiling below where I’d like. It’s a quality cherry limeade, but I’d go for the GHOST Energy one over this due to the improved sweetness. If you are someone that is looking for something more balanced and more…eh, mature, I suppose…this is the one to get.

name: Alani Nu Sherbet Swirl
msl:
No mystery for either of us this time. It’s Sherbet Swirl! It’s a foggy drink. When I cracked open the can I didn’t really smell anything but I also made bacon earlier so the kitchen still has this lingering smell. In the glass and in my room, I get a nice… I guess SHERBET smell. I’m looking forward to this one. Hopefully it’s good!

Heyyy that’s pretty nice. Not as overwhelmingly flavorful as I hoped it was going to be when we first purchased it. But you’ve got that mixed fruit sweet flavor in this, and I like it! Sloshing this thing around my mouth and yeah, it’s pretty light. No lingering aftertaste, but as I take more and more sips, this drink actually kinda leaves me wanting more. It’s like a fruit mix where all the fruit is *just* not ripe enough? Maybe not. The flavor is there. I just want it to be stronger. With that said, this was a very easy finish and I give it a thumbs up. I just wish it was more.
nf:
We both know what this is going in, thanks to it being the last of the batch. Despite being cleareyed about the flavor, things are still a bit hazy…because that’s what the drink looks like. It’s hazy, not clear or colorful. Interesting choice. Rainbow flavors have traditionally done very well, and the two previous drinks with “sherbet” in the name have been excellent, so this is coming in with some lofty expectations.

That’s pretty good. Pretty good. Not great. I’ll say immediately it’s not as good as the other two sherbet drinks we’ve had. But it’s very good. It has the sweet soft mix flavor that was so good in the other drinks, but there’s something just slightly off about it compared to the other two that I can’t quite put my finger on. It might be that it’s not sweet enough, or it’s got some other counterbalance flavor thrown in, but it’s merely good and not capital-G Great like the other two. But with that said, I’m comparing it to a couple of near giants, and being merely the third best rainbow sherbet flavor is no dishonor. A great drink for a summer day and another good effort from Alani Nu.

name: REDCON1 Prime Time Punch
msl:
Almost lost the plot on this one and started drinking it before we were ready to blind review. Clear drink. Very fruit punch smell.

That’s fruit punch, that gave me a little kick in the chin at the end. But that is indeed, delicious Fruit Punch. If you handed me this and just said it was carbonated fruit punch, I would absolutely believe you. There’s a little tingling feeling I get in my tongue with this one. Not really sure how to describe it. No fucking gross aftertaste or anything though. It’s just Fruit Punch, and that’s a thumbs up from me. Review over.
nf:
Hopefully this will be more successful than the Colorado Buffaloes.

Mmmmmmmmmmmmmmmm…that’s fruit punch. Fruit punch that’s just a hair too sweet, but fruit punch. It smells like standard punch and tastes just a leeeeeeeeeeetle bit off from what I’d expect, but I would still says “tastes good.” If you’re looking for deeper thoughts, I’m sorry to disappoint, but that’s all I can give you. It isn’t bitter, it isn’t sour, there’s no carbonation. It’s just fruit punch! Das it!

name: Lucky F*ck Red Ryder Punch
msl: Right before this I went into a gagging fit.  Anyway - it looks like Punch.  It smells like Punch.  I feel like I haven’t been crazy about the fruit punches, but maybe this one will be different.  That is…fruit punchy.  I don’t think I’ve had a hawaiian punch in like over a decade but for some reason my brain wants to compare it to that.  Next few sips - this feels like maybe one of the better fruit punches.  It has a somewhat strong flavor.  It’s not PUNCH YOU IN THE FACE like Starburst Cherry or anything.  Slosh it around the mouth, you get more of that carbonated taste but yeah, this is a tasty, carbonated fruit punch drink.  Last big chug:  Yeah, just real good.  Honestly, I wasn’t looking forward to going to another Fruit Punch but I think LUCKY F*CK did a great job here.  Also - the cans are fucking BIG. I will say - there is a little unpleasant aftertaste when finished that I want to wash away with water.
nf: Matt keeps hacking and coughing and I keep saying OH DID YOU TAKE A SIP???? Hopefully this is better than that. It looks like red Jello but liquid. Cough syrupy. Tastes like fruit punch, but also…not. Hard to describe. It’s like 90% fruit punch and then there’s 10% of ???. Kinda reminds me of Hawaiian Punch, actually. Not bad at all, but I don’t think I’d ever buy this again. It kinda sits in your mouth afterwards unpleasantly.

name: GHOST Energy Orange Cream
msl: More orange-y than orange creamy.  You get a hint of the cream taste you want - but I feel like not enough.  Just very ORANGE with that carbonation flavor.  Not bad, would prefer a Stewarts though.

name: Gorilla Mind Blackberry Lemonade
msl: Hahaaaa.  Ooookay.  Another mystery for NF.  This one is almost completely clear, just barely a tint of color.  Strong smell.  Doesn’t smell unpleasant.  I gotta be honest, I wasn’t super hyped for this one, but that wasn’t a bad first sip at all.  NF correctly predicted it on his first guess.  Anyway, I’m not really a blackberry guy, and I’m not really a lemonade guy either.  I would wager I’ve had more lemonade than I’ve had blackberry though, and I don’t know if this *really* tastes like Lemonade?  Like, I will say that I do taste a little bit of lemon flavor in here.  Nothing ULTRA STRONG like the Lemon Drink we had from Gorilla Mind before this.  But it’s there.  The drink as a whole is… a little sweet?  A little tart?  More sweet than tart, I’d say.  I’m actually pleasantly surprised how much I’m enjoying it.  A lot of Gorilla Minds are packed to the brim with flavor that it can feel overwhelming, but this one is just straight up refreshing.  I don’t think it’s my favorite flavor or anything, or really anything close, but I also would say: THIS IS GOOD.  I like it.  If it had less chemicals in it that are probably incredibly bad for me, would I have another?  Sure!  But I also wouldn’t be buying it myself again.
nf:
Hahaaaa. Oookay. Another mystery for Nicky Boy. This is a hazy clear. Smells like some sort of berry. Shocking, given that most of these are berry flavored. Also has some floating specks.

I think that tasted pretty good. Not top tier good, but top half good. Not sure if I really detect much, if any lemonade, but it’s a solid drink. Matt’s been dreading this, but I’ve been curious. I have to be completely honest: I have no idea what blackberry actually tastes like, so I cannot actually say if this nails a blackberry taste either. It does not make me want to type on a phone with a tiny keyboard. So this is going to be a bit of a dull review because it just tastes good but I can’t really explain why. Shit just happens sometimes, and drinks taste good for no explainable reason from people who aren’t doing this professionally!

name: REDCON1 Vice City
msl:
If you like strawberry pina coladaaaaas. Then this drink should hopefully suffice. Tommy Vercetti gives us REDCON1 VICE CITY. I like Strawberry, I like Pineapple, and I like Coconut. So this in essence should be a winner. But will all these flavors be ASS together in a REDCON1? Let’s find out. Clear drink. Nice strawberry/coconut smell.

The Coconut definitely is the dominant flavor in that first sip. I do like myself some coconut, but I was hoping for the Strawberry/Pineapple to be a bit stronger. Somehow NF and I have the exact opposite take here. It’s interesting, because I don’t think I really get any of the PINEAPPLE that’s supposed to be in here the more I sip. But then again it’s been ages since I’ve had a Pina Colada proper and I might have just kind of forgotten what it tastes like. It’s very much the Coconut with a hint of Strawberry that I’m capturing.

I’m just now being reminded that a Miami Vice is a real drink. I have even had them multiple times before. But it’s been like 15 years. Silly me. Anyway: it’s refreshing. Not bad. Not blow-my-mind good that I want to go back and get some more. One of those flavors that I can see myself having again, but not actively seeking out. A definite thumbs up or Thumbs in the Middle Leaning Up. Seek out if you enjoy Coconut.
nf:
Our second Miami adjacent themed drink, with this particular one being quite a bite more bold with their naming, even if it is technically an existing cocktail. Smells like strawberry.

Nice. Tastes like a mix of strawberry and coconut. I don’t hate it. It’s actually quite good. I’d say the strawberry is the most dominant flavor, but you get a hint of coconut in the background to make things interesting. I just came back from a walk, so maybe it’s coming off as extra refreshing as a result, but this is really hitting the spot. Thankfully I do not really taste any pineapple or pina colada, which is probably unfortunate for M. But it’s good fo me, baby! Recommended.

name: BUM Energy Grape
msl:
BACK TO BACK DRINK DAYS. This time I have taken out a mystery drink for NF. It’s clear, and the smell I don’t think is very strong so he will probably have trouble deciphering what it is, though since I know what it is: yes, it’s that flavor. Funny thing - in our old place we used to be in rooms right next to each other, so we would just do a countdown out loud before we drank. Now - since we are so far and a giant room separates us, I have to facetime him lmfao.

Immediately nodded my head, that is a delicious Grape energy drink. Before I even do a slosh or a big swig, this is a winner. A thumbs up. It’s a grape soda and exactly what I want from a grape flavor. Would I prefer it be a little bit stronger? Mmmm, probably. But for where it is I have no real complaints. it has no shitty aftertaste, it’s just the Grape Soda flavor that you think of. Does that make it uninspiring? Does that take away points? I don’t know. But this is going to be an easy finish. If you want 100+ mg of caffeine with a grape flavor, this is the way to go. Not sure where it will rank, as I think I decidedly like this flavor a lot more than NF, but I like it.
nf:
Safe to say we are back in the saddle. My first mystery drink in god knows how long. It’s clear - poison? Everclear? - and smells anonymously sweet/fruity as you’d expect with the drinks we have on tap. Shot in the dark: GOAT Blueberry Lemonade.

Tastesgoodman, but I can’t put my finger on what the taste is. That’s…grape? It’s grape. It’s a nice grape, a subtle grape, even. Not too subtle - obviously I could taste something - but subtle enough that I couldn’t nail it when asked what I thought it was. But it’s tasty and something I think I could probably drink quite often thanks to it not being too overpowering, which is a funny idea. I wouldn’t rank this in the upper echelon, but I would drink this more frequently than I would some of those. Kinda like how I’d eat turkey sandwiches more than great BBQ but man I would rank that BBQ higher than the turkey sandwich any day. Anyway, compared to some other of Bums entries - Champion Mentality, I’m looking at you here - it’s definitely on the higher end. Grape Expectations have been met. Last gulp actually was a little too subtle on flavor but it won’t be docked much for it.

name: Fusion Energy Cosmic Cherry
msl:
There’s an ever-so-slight PS3-is-brown tint to this clear drink. Very hazy. Smells delightful. Going in, this is a mystery for NF.

That’s a very Cherry drink, with a very Cherry smell. It’s honestly really JUICY was my first impression, though now that I take another sip it feels like there is just something else added to this cherry. Maybe a different type of berry, but I’m really not sure which. With that being the case - I do think it’s a nice taste and a nice first impression from 7-11.

Yeah otherwise, I don’t know what else to say about this one. It’s real flavorful, it’s pleasant, it’s juicy, and I think it hits. A thumbs up.
nf:
This is a hazy drink. Like a contaminated water supply. Good thing it’s not! It smells like cherry. Gonna say Fusion Energy.

HM. Hm. That’s interesting. It’s almost like a black cherry rather than a straight up cherry. Or maybe cherry the fruit and not Cherry™. Much like yesterday, there is not much else to say. It tastes like a cherry drink. There’s something ever so slightly off that I can’t identify and doesn’t take much away from it. It does have a little bit of a sourness to it, but I think that is from the inherent slight sourness in cherry flavoring. No extra sour or carbonation to speak of. 7-11 done good here. Now with that said, I think it could use a little vanilla to counterbalance the very sweet fruit taste.

name: Bloom Sparkling Energy Crisp Apple
msl:
Piss Yellow drink! I saw a lady drinking this on tiktok today so I figured we had to go with it. It smells like what it is advertised as. Let’s give it a whirl.

Heyyy I like it! It’s a good apple drink. I don’t know if it’s as deep in flavor as our problematic irishman apple drink, but this isn’t bad. We have a bunch of apple juice variants in the fridge that we just got from Wegman’s, and I gotta say I like the flavor of this Bloom a lot more. It definitely nails the “you are biting into a juicy apple” flavor. It’s refreshing. There’s no crazy aftertaste. It’s just good. I’m giving this one a double thumbs up. And I honestly don’t have much else to say! I did finish.

Actually I do have something a little extra, NF was totally bamboozled by this flavor. It’s crazy how our fucking brains and tastebuds will trick us when we have no idea what it is we’re actually drinking. I always say I’d be confident doing like a Coke/Pepsi/Other Cola test and getting all of them right, but having mystery energy drinks has definitely fucked with my perception and made me think it’s possible I wouldn’t be as good at it as I think.
nf:
Ooh we got dark piss today. Piss that’s been corrupted by evil forces. It smells like Energy Drink. Guessing 3D Energy Citrus Mist.

OK, my brain was in ci-TRUS mode but it’s actually ci-DER. Like apple cider. It’s like Cider: Zero Sugar, and that’s…ok. It is as Matt says better than the ciders we got from Wegman’s, but not as good as Stew Leonard’s. Depending on where you live that sentence may make either partial or no sense at all. It’s hard to really say more, it’s a fine apple cider-like drink. I’m not super wowed by it and I think we’ve had a few apple drinks that I’d take over it, but it’s a high floor drink for fall. Perhaps I should have waited a month until a single leaf has fallen. Eh cider’s good year round, fuck excuses!!!!

name: Amin.O Energy Grape
msl:
This clear drink has got THE SMELL. A fairly obvious grape smell. It’s a mystery for NF but he will know it immediately. We’ve got 2 grape drinks in the fridge, so he’ll have to guess which one it is. Anyway, let’s get going.

That’s a strong grape flavor, but it almost has a hint of sour to it. It’s like, HEAVY grape flavoring. Like imagine you went to a snow cone machine and put on TOO MUCH of the flavoring. That’s kind of the vibe I got on this first sip. I kinda like it. It’s a little overwhelming in some ways, but I appreciate a heavy amount of flavor vs. no flavor at all. I’d say it’s a thumbs in the middle leaning upward. I like it, but it almost seems like TOO MUCH for me. Tastes a little weird going down, even. Still, if I was offered a sip of this in the future, I wouldn’t turn it down. Will finish.
nf:
Well it’s a grape drink. Which grape drink we’ll see, but it’s one of them. Is it the gorilla or the non-gorilla?

Strong grape smell, strong grape flavor. It’s the general artificial grape popsicle/candy flavor and not trying to emulate actual grapes. My thoughts are pretty short. This is a slightly worse Kool-Aid Grape. Take everything I said about that, make it just slightly worse due to some weird minor taste difference, and that’s about all I have to say. It’s grape! It’s good! Not the best, but good! Maybe a little too much on the flavoring. But, yum!

name: 3D Energy Blueberry Mist
msl:
We are back in the mystery zone. The drink has not been brought to me yet but it’s coming. NF has waddled into the room nearly spilling this drink EEEEVERYWHERE because there is a lot of it in my glass. It’s completely clear. The smell is strong and it immediately makes me think it must be the BUCKED UP sour one. But as we’ve seen time and time again, when I’m not 100% on it I’m generally way off. Anyway let’s give this a go

This isn’t sour bucks, but it is blueberry mist! So my reign of constantly being way off probably continues. I had to still ask if this was Sour Bucks upon drinking though, because this doesn’t so much taste like those deep blueberry flavors at all. It tastes more like a sweet and sour blue raspberry candy. And hey - it’s tasty. 3D Energy has very much impressed me as a brand. It’s one of those names that I thought would just completely suck but a lot of the drinks have just been very refreshing. And this is no different. It loses some points for the flavor name being off, but I don’t really have much bad to say about the actual flavor itself. It’s not a KNOCK YOUR SOCKS OFF HOLY SHIT THIS IS GREAT flavor, but it’s good. Above C rank is my immediate thought. I definitely think I’d be happy having one of these again. No shitty aftertaste, it’s just pretty good. Easy finish. Thumbs up? Yeah.
nf:
I let Matt choose from 3 drinks that I mentally deemed Ehhhh, Eh, and Has Potential. I will reveal which one he chose after our first sips. It’s clear as a nice spring sky, and smells of possibly sour berry.

Matt chose the Has Potential drink, and potential it indeed fulfilled. This is a very good drink. Now, I’ll say here right off the bat that they screwed up somewhere between the formula and/or the name, because this is not Blueberry at all - it’s Blue Raspberry. But it’s a good Blue Raspberry! It hits most of the right notes that you’d expect from the non-existent fruit flavor, from the right sweetness and the right amount of sour. There’s no “what the fuck is this” here, this is straight up fake ass blue raspberry flavor. There is a bit of odd taste that borders on bitterness that my mind’s eye has placed at the center and is strongest on swallowing the drink, but it’s not a dealbreaker. Blue Raspberry is a championship flavor with high ranking contenders that this doesn’t sniff. But if Frozen Bombsicle is Willie Mays, Blueberry Mist is a perfectly cromulent Andrew McCutchen.

name: Monster Energy Zero Ultra White
msl:
While MONSTER hasn’t really been one of our favorite brands thus far, we have yet to try this one. I’d heard in the past that the WHITE MONSTER is the best one. And after recently seeing a list of best sales on I think amazon being THIS flavor, it became clear that we need to try this one. So, let’s get this out of the way. The White Monster. Phrasing.

I have no clue what the flavor of White Monster is supposed to be. It has a slight citrus smell to it, though not a strong one. NF said he thought it was a lemon ice thing or something while we were pouring this. Let’s see if that’s confirmed.

“That’s Lemon. Yeah. That’s Lemon.” was the words the left my mouth after that. It’s not bad! Not amazing. But not bad! Oh, doing the ol SLOSH TEST actually makes it a hell of a lot better. That’s a good lemon flavor. It’s not ultra intense, it’s not super sour, but there is a hint of it. It’s just real nice. I can tell you right away that while I don’t think this is going to be an S tier drink or anything, I can see why so many people like it. It’s just a good flavor. Great mouthfeel. No shitty aftertaste. Thumbs up. Two of them, even. This will rank well. Easy finish. I liked it more and more with each sip.
nf:
This is apparently the best selling energy drink on Amazon, probably in the US in general. I see it mentioned all the time. “The white Monster.” Well, my theory is that it’ll probably be pretty mid since most of the top sellers kinda stink, but I’ve been surprised by Monster before. Quite recently, in fact. Reign White Haze was supposedly a competitor of this, and IIRC that was kinda like lemon ice, so that is my expectation for this. Oh I just spilled a bunch of it. Eiwqje0hwpqerd qwp9dnhwqdf. OK it’s cleaned.

Well that is lemon ice. And unfortunately for the Monster haters, I do, in fact, have to hand it to them again. This isn’t bad. It’s like a melted lemon italian ice. It’s not too sweet, so you don’t feel like you’re getting punched in the face with flavor, but it’s still got flavor to spare, especially for an allegedly zero sugar drink. With that said, I do think this could use quite a bit more sourness or tartness, as it’s just sweet lemon without any counter balance or “second step” if you will. So while I understand why it’s so popular, it’s not going to be #1 or close to it with us.

name: GHOST Energy Sour Strips Rainbow
msl:
I know what this one is. NF does not. It is not the one I would have chosen. But it is the one NF picked when he gave me the number 37. Clear with a slight piss tint. Pungent! Very strong smell.

The first sip was very nice. I was bracing myself for the sour, and it is there, but it’s not an INTENSE sour. My lips and tastebuds can handle this one. It almost tastes like a fruit punch with the feeling of SOUR thrown in. Which, I guess that’s what it’s kind of going for? The can has a rainbow sour candy strip - and I’m only just now being informed that “sour strips” is an actual candy, and this isn’t like a multicolored sour airhead or anything like that. Knowing that, I can’t really tell you, the reader, how much this flavor resembles an actual SOUR STRIP, but what I can tell you is it’s a delicious fruity flavor with that lingering sour feeling that you’d be seeking. It isn’t intense. Light enough to be a pretty refreshing drink really, but the feeling lingers minutes after you take your sip.

When I slosh it around my mouth a little more I almost want to say there is a citrusy flavor that hits, before the sourness takes over - but I really can’t identify what it is. So I’m just going to stick to the cowards “fruit punch”. I like this drink a lot, and I knew I was going to enjoy it. GHOST doesn’t disappoint here. A thumbs up from me, for sure.
nf:
Another one of these: Smells kinda tropical, looks kinda like piss.

Nice sip. Tropical, but has some sort of very sweet and sour flavoring on top of it that makes up for the bitterness of the tropical and energy drink mixtures. I am trying to nail the flavor but can’t quite. The branding doesn’t specify a flavor, but I am guessing it is trying to be Rainbow, which one would assume is “throw a bunch of shit in a vat.” And it is very much that. It is definitely sour, but not debilitatingly. It tastes like extremely sweet candy in a can. So mission accomplished there. I dunno if I love this, though. Typically “super sweet and sour” really hits for me, but here the taste is so undefinable that I’m not really all aboard with it. If they had chosen a flavor and really went hard - their site has flavors like “Strawbango” and Green Apple, for example - it may have been better. I guess it may have been worse too. This is above average, but if you want a candy-branded drink, there’s many others that are better choices with stronger flavor decisions.

name: Alani Nu Witch's Brew
msl:
When I popped open this can, the immediate smell I got was… Apple? That’s what I thought. Color is a cream soda like color.

What is that? Is it like a candy apple? Caramel like? That’s the vibe I’m getting from this. Biting into a caramel apple. So if that’s what they were going for, I think they nailed it. Though, I gotta tell you it is an ODD flavor. Imagine you smashed a granny smith into pure liquid and squirt in some caramel. They nailed that. For what it is, I think it’s kinda tasty actually. Weird, but tasty. I think they also get some points for fitting the Halloween spirit. Only a witch would give someone a fucking APPLE on Halloween.

This isn’t perfect in the sense that I’m not gushing like OH WOW THAT’S GREAT. But it’s tasty. I would probably have another one if offered, but this isn’t one of those I would really seek out like OH I NEED THAT FLAVOR AGAIN. Still, my overall vibes of this one are positive. You get a lingering caramel aftertaste that makes me happy. Thumbs up.
nf:
We got some piss here, folks. I was thinking Starburst Lemon, but maybe Witch’s Brew? Or as Homestar Runner would say, Witch’s Bwew.

It’s apple. Definitely apple with something else. Alani Nu’s marketing copy says “Aura of apple. Essence of caramel” and uh I guess there may be a little caramel in there? But it’s basically apple juice with some sourness and carbonation. And I love apple juice! I don’t love this like I love apple juice, but it’s a fine little apple drink for the spooky season. Could have used more caramel flavor. The apple on the can is DRIPPING with caramel, whereas this is more like an apple with a tiny little speck of caramel on top that you barely notice.

name: BUCKED UP Rocket Pop
msl:
A clear drink! I have a system to roll which random drink we’ll have and when it landed on this the first time, I was like “nah” and rerolled. And it landed on it again! So this is fate. It’s a clear drink, and a nice smell.

Well. This is much better than the last BUCKED UP. Extremely flavorful ROCKET POP flavor. Wow. I’m honestly a little impressed given how flat the flavor on the last drink we had from these guys was. This legitimately tastes like, to me at least, if you melted a rocket pop and poured it straight into my mouth. It’s tasty. A lingering aftertaste but it’s not “shitty energy drink” aftertaste, but “rocket pop” aftertaste. So that’s nice. (Well…maybe the slightest hint…but barely noticeable). This is wildly appealing to my tastebuds. I honestly may even want a little more. I think it’s one of the better Rocket Pop flavors we’ve had to this point, for sure. A great job from BUCKED UP - has restored my faith in them. Would have this again if it wasn’t overflowing with chemicals that are most assuredly bad for me.
nf:
This is clear albeit a little cloudy. It has the smell of something VERY sweet…either cotton candy or blue raspberry, I think. Leaning towards a berry.

OK as I kinda thought, this is Bucked Up Rocket Pop. It’s decidedly better than the last Bucked Up we had, although I’m not sure they really nailed the rocket pop taste. Remember way back in sentence two when I mentioned cotton candy? This kinda tastes like a mix of cherry, blue raspberry, and a hint of cotton candy. It’s very sweet tasting, but not enough to really send a shock to the system. It tastes fine, even fun. You pass these out at a summer party and it’d fit. But in the pantheon of our scientific ratings of rocket pop-flavored energy drinks, it is probably in the middle. This is missing the sour kick and cohesiveness of Frozen Bombsicle, and just doesn’t taste as good as other higher ranking versions. Still - a very good drink.

name: GHOST Energy Peaches
msl:
This is a mystery drink for me but NF as he was walking in with the glass said “Yeah I think you’re gonna know what this is”. One sniff and I went “OOHHH. PEACHES.” It’s a clear drink with just the sliiightest tint in color. The smell is as stated, STRONG.

Yeah that’s peaches. Carbonated peaches. Strong flavor, and you can taste that carbonation baby. Actually kind of hard for me to immediately say anything else about this, because it is what it says it is. Peach flavored drink. Slosh it around the mouth: Peaches. Take a big swig: Peaches. If you’re in the mood for a Peach drink, this is a thumbs up. If Peach is your flavor, this is a thumbs up. I happen to like it very much. I wouldn’t say it’s blown me away compared to the other strong Peach flavors, but I can’t really find anything wrong with this one either. It’s just Peaches. It’s a peaches fucking drink. It’s peach. PEACH. The Princess Toadstool of Drinks. (Peach).

No shitty aftertaste. It’s just Peach. Thumbs up. Did finish.

BUCKED UP Lightly Carbonated Protein Orange Cream

This drink is a mystery for NF. It’s foggy as hell. Smell wasn’t super strong cracking the can, and it’s even less strong in the glass. I predict this one will be…OK.

And what do you know, I was right! This tastes a whole lot more ORANGE than a Creamsicle - but a hint of creamsicle vanilla flavor IS definitely there. It’s just a whole lot more subtle in comparison to the Orange flavor. First impressions kind of feels like I’m drinking an Orange Soda after taking a bite of a Creamsicle, if that makes sense. SLOSHING IT AROUND: The vanilla flavoring is starting to hit stronger than on the first sip. In fact, the aftertaste that is being left over is just the vanilla taste.

I gotta say, this isn’t really bad. It’s actually pretty good and I seem to be enjoying it more and more with each sip. Is it my favorite Orange Cream flavor? I don’t think so. But I would be happy to have one of these again. Finished it pretty easily. Thumbs in the….no. Thumbs Up. I’ll say Thumbs Up.
nf:
“Peaches come from a can” - The Presidents of the United States of America. Indeed. This smells like the name. Maybe like an exponential amount of the name.

It’s a peach drink. Whaddya want me to say?

OK, well I’ll say that I think they upped the sweetness in this, so it’s not just Peaches. It’s Peaches with the sweetness turned up a bit so it has something else to offer because otherwise there’s a lot of competition, not limited to but including straight up peach juice. Not much else to say, but one of the better peach drinks we’ve had, coming from a well-established “not a peach guy.”

This thing is foggier than Derry, ME. The smell is very faint. But I think I am picking up a slight orange cream scent. We’ll see.

Lightly carbonated? You betcha. Orange cream? Ummmm, a bit. In fact I don’t think there’s much carbonation in there either. Matt says he tastes more orange, which is funny because I think I taste more vanilla in there…at least at first. It’s not a particularly memorable vanilla, and the orange is barely there. The lack of carbonation hurts it, but again if you’re a person that is very adverse to carbonation then I guess this is an OK option? The only thing it does particularly well is not being carbonated. Otherwise it’s just a middling orange cream with too much orange or too much cream depending on sip. I’ll close saying there’s a slight bitterness to the vanilla on top of everything else, but it’s not there every sip.

name: C4 Jolly Rancher Blue Raspberry
msl:
NF will never guess what this mystery drink is. It's clear. It smells great. And I'm ready to be ENERGIZED.

This is the Jolly Rancher flavor I've been looking forward to the most. And on the first sip - yeah, that's that nice BLUE taste that I've been looking for. A hint of Jolly Rancher flavoring at the very end of it. It's kind of like, while you're drinking it you don't really know it's JOLLY RANCHER BLUE, but once you swallow it you really feel the aftertaste of it lingering in your mouth. There's a sour hint to all of this but it's not enough to truly make my face scrunch up or anything. When you do the slosh test, it feels a lot more sour but funnily enough, not more like Jolly Rancher.

My immediate thought about this was it has to be the best Jolly Rancher flavor we've tried, but thinking back and after a little discussion - the Green Apple definitely WOW'd me in a way I did not expect. This one is good. I like it a lot. But there are so many better BLUE flavored drinks that you kinda wonder what this one specifically is bringing to the table.

I think it's an easy "Thumbs Up" drink. I think it's good. I don't think it's great. Would I have one again? Yes. Would I BUY one again though?

Don't think so.

A good job from C4, nonetheless.
nf:
Well I have to assume this is Jolly Rancher Blue Raspberry. Either that or Kool-Aid Grape, but I’m like 99% sure it’s JRBR. Smells sour, and there’s a LOT of it, which would eliminate the NOOBs and the Celsius. Plus this was just kinda logically next up. Unless he bought a mystery one I didn’t see, this should be JRBR.

Oh yeah that is some blue raspberry. C4 is no stranger to good blue raspberry flavors, and this is one of them, but they didn’t just pour in some Frozen Bombsicle and call it a day. Although maybe that would have been better, given that’s an S-tier flavor and this won’t be. Oh, it’s still good, don’t get me wrong. It’s more sour than some of the others we’ve had, and while not as sweet as some is still quite sweet. It’s also not too mild like Bang’s entry was. Maybe I’ve just had enough of these where anything short of “WOW” will at minimum slightly underwhelm, because while I like this, it also just feels like it’s been done.

name: RYSE Fuel Strawberry Squeeze
msl:
NF is choosing the drink today and I am fairly certain he is going to choose BUCKED UP ROCKET POP, before he even hands me the glass. Clear drink, nice smell, though a little too feint to really discern what it is.

What the hell was that? That was no rocket pop, but I’m being told it’s a STRAWBERRY SQUEEZE - which, yeah I think I can see that. Feels a bit ooey gooey on the first sip and definitely fruity. The flavor is… something. When the liquid is hitting your mouth you can kind of sense the STRAWBERRY flavor, but the second it really settles that flavor is washed away with something much more, I don’t know, light? I don’t really know how to describe it. It tastes like some sort of tropical fruit that I’ve never tried before, but the two fruits on the can are a Strawberry and a Lemon.

It’s definitely a refreshing, light feeling on the way down. I think it’s pretty tasty, though I think I would prefer a bolder strawberry flavor in the strawberry squeeze. It feels like it is overwhelmed by what I guess is the lemon, and makes it taste like something entirely different. For what it is though, there is no disgusting energy drink aftertaste, it smells nice, it tastes nice. Not really my favorite flavor or anything, not sure I would go out of my way for another, but this is cool. Not what I hoped, but not anything bad either. Thumbs in the middle leaning slightly upwards.
nf:
Matt thinks he’s slick and has guessed what I’ve chosen. I…will not comment. He’s a smart cookie in general, though. This drink, by the way, smells good.

Tasty little sip, that was. I have been looking forward to this drink for a bit, and it did not disappoint. It starts with the very sweet artificial strawberry flavor that evokes C4 Strawberry, before going down a bit into a citrussy taste. Like going down a slide. I’d rather it just be the strawberry, but I’m not going to really dock it much for the come down, which imo is delayed just enough for you to enjoy the strawberry flavor. Very tasty!

name: Gorilla Mind Mango Peach
msl:
I’m on Day 3 of a diet where I’m taking in significantly less calories so whatever this mystery flavor is is probably going to give me some type of reaction. Slightly piss tint to this glass that was given to me, and filled to the brim. Smells like Mango Peach, assuming that’s what it has to be.

Yeah that’s peachy. Honestly felt kind of pulpy for a second even. On the second and third sips I was just silently nodding my head, like “Yes. This is peach. And it is good.” Mangos, as I’m sure I’ve said before on here, are not a fruit I really have a lot, so I don’t know how similar it should taste to Peach, but this is just VERY peachy. These types of flavors have been fairly divisive especially with NF but I think this one is actually pretty damn good. There are so many other flavors that I go to more, but this actually tastes fresh, juicy, and delicious enough that I think I’d want another one if these cans weren’t filled to the brim with caffeine. Yeah, just really good. I can absolutely finish this easily, though I think to save myself from having a reaction like I did with STRAWBERRY CANDY , I’m gonna cut myself off about 2/3rds of the way.

NOTE: I did not do that. I chugged it. It was that good. Thumbs up. Easy finish.
nf:
Faintly piss colored, strong scent. Let’s go.

That’s peachy in all senses of the word. It’s a quality peach drink that’s nice and sweet. Peach is not really in my wheelhouse, but this is probably the best peach drink we’ve had. It’s less tropical than the other combos we’ve had, and tastes more like a peach candy. It tastes exactly what you’d expect a peach drink to taste like. I cannot go very high, as a great version of something I don’t love is only gonna go so far, but Peachamaniacs should head for this before any other energy drink.

name: Monster Energy Juice Viking Berry
msl:
After 3 years south of where we used to live……it was time to go home. It has been exactly 1 month since our last review. The both of us went through a trial in moving, and we needed weeks to recover. But we are back. And funnily enough, we are back in the place we used to live in. Same floor. Same hallway. And we like it very much. I have a window that can be actually used for the first time in 6 years. I’m so pumped.

This drink is kind of like a blood orange color. As stated many times, I’m kind of terrible at identifying smells, but this Viking Berry kinda smells a little peachy? Is it mango? Maybe it’s a little bit of Apple? I don’t know. I swear I need to sit down and really just try a bunch of fruits so I can be better at this.

This definitely has the flavor of some mixed berries, but it’s not particularly strong. I don’t dislike it, but as someone who likes a sweeter, stronger flavor - it’s not my thing. It is a lot closer to those bold red bull type of drinks than my sweet fun candy drinks. Doing the slosh test, it actually has a pleasant, refreshing feeling in my mouth, and I feel a lot more favorable towards it than I did when I typed my last sentence. Yeah, the more I drink, the more I actually kinda respect this one. I’d like if it packed a bit more of a punch, but I’m gonna give it a thumbs up actually. An aftertaste lingers, but I don’t hate it. A good job from Monster, as I finished my half easily.
nf:
We have been doing this for a year, but we missed the anniversary because of a hectic move. Oops! We are Settled now and back in the swing of things. I ranked the drinks we have from most to least interested, although that did not indicate that I think they’ll taste good as much as I think they’ll be an interesting swig. I could be wrong and this will be the equivalent of paint drying. It smells peachy.

Very berry. Mixed berry, very berry, whatever. It’s berries with the Monster twang. Not quite Energy Drink Bullshit, because it doesn’t make me scrunch my face, but it’s in the ballpark. Energy Drink Malarkey, perhaps. It kinda reminds me of regular Mountain Dew. This actually doesn’t taste too bad, but the twang kinda kills the vibe a bit, so it’s just kind of a weird sip. The can says “Like nothing you’ve ever tasted” which makes me want to give it an auto F for audacity, but ultimately I like the drink enough to spare it from a Blood Eagle. With all of that said, I am going to say: Not bad, perhaps the best Monster to date! Huss!

Edit after looking at the list: OK I forgot there was a top 50 Monster so ignore that line about it being the best.

name: BUM Energy Iced Tea Lemonade
msl:
It’s been a bit but it’s time for a drink. We are BACK on the wagon this afternoon with a mystery drink for CC. It is kind of a orangey brown drink. Not clear at all. The smell isn’t strong but it does smell exactly like what the flavor is supposed to be. Let’s give this a shot.

Heyyy this is Crystal Light with 112mg of Caffeine. At least I think that’s what it tastes like, it’s been a really, REALLY long time, like over a decade, since I’ve had the crystal light that my mom used to make in the water pitcher. Tastes like what I remember though. Maybe the flavor isn’t as STRONG but my brain is just convincing me that it is a 1:1 comparison I like this. I don’t know if it’s one where i’m like “ohhh!! We gotta get it again!!!”. If anything, it just makes me want to get the Crystal Light packets again. So uhhh… not the success they wanted?

But it’s a thumbs up flavor to me. There is nothing wrong with this. I guess if you were hoping for more lemonade than iced tea flavoring, you’d be disappointed, but when I think of Iced Tea, this is the type of flavor I think. Easy finish for me. Not GAGA over it but happy with it. THIRST QUENCHED.
nf:
Alriiiiiiiiiight, it’s been a little bit. We have an appropriate for the Halloween season drink here, with it being orange. I’m guessing we have an iced tea here, but WITCH iced tea is it?? Dunno. We’ll find out. Maybe I’m totally wrong.

Yeah that’s iced tea. Iced Tea Lemonade in this instance, as it turns out. I will say this is probably closer to an Arizona Arnold Palmer than the Ghost Iced Tea Lemonade that we had, although it’s still not all the way there. The first sip I had was a little on the bitter side, but subsequent ones have had the sweetness break through. You can taste the lemon flavor without it being overwhelming. The bitterness is pretty much gone so that may have just been a mental thing. I think this is pretty good. It’s not a stone cold classic, and I’d rather have a real Arnold Palmer if given the choice, but this is a decent little alternative if you want something close enough with a shitload of caffeine in it. It sinks the ball on par.

name: Lucky F*ck Son of a Peach
msl:
IT’S MY BIRTHDAY!!! And I have chosen the mystery drink for NF. Clear-ish drink, has a slight tint to it, PUNGENT!!!!! It smells like what it is.

This is honestly fine. We aren’t the biggest fans of LUCKY FUCK but this is a completely fine peach drink on the first sip. Slosh test is also very inoffensive - just very peachy! No crazy medicinal aftertaste. Yeah, honestly - much like yesterdays, this just pretty darn good. It’s strong & flavorful, it tastes exactly like it is marketed as, and I think it’s a thumbs up. Kind of a boring review, but that’s all I can really think of to say. Is it one of my FAVORITES? Probably not. But as I take this final sip I can say it was an easy finish, and if you’re MAD about Peaches, you should give this one a shot.
nf:
Matt is no longer a lucky man, as today he has aged out of his lucky number.

Audience: Awwwwwww.

Mmhm. Yeah, that’s right, very sad. Matt’s very old now. Matt’s so old he owned slaves! I kid, I kid. Or do I?

What isn’t sad is he gets to choose today’s flavor, a mystery to myself and myself only as you will have already seen the name of the flavor. What a treat!

I can smell the drink from where I sit. It smells…tropical. Maybe peachy. Peaches? From Georgia? Or our kitchen?

First sip evaluation: Not terrible! As expected it’s a peach flavor, and it’s not bad. We’ve had peach flavors that I haven’t liked due to being too…peachy? I guess? Kinda too close to the real thing and not a nice good old fashioned artificial Peach™. This is like if Crush had a Peach flavor. Google says that they apparently do, as does Sunkist so…I bet those taste similar! Good drink, great improvement from the norm for the Lucky Fuckers.

name: bang Energy Radical Skadattle
msl:
A shocker. NF has chosen this one, but only I know what it is. It has a very nice smell to it, smells kind of like that blue raspberry? Grape I can also see. Completely clear.

WOAH it kinda tastes like a Nerds when it’s entering your mouth but then the entire flavor leaves you when you swallow. When I slosh it around in my mouth, it is pretty sour! The immediate thought was “NERDS!” when I drank it. I’m honestly really surprised, I was so sure that this was going to be a Blue Raspberry flavor when I picked it up, which is why I was convinced with the smell that’s what it was. But this is like a sour candy energy drink. I actually really, really dig it. It’s overwhelming if you let it sit in your mouth, but it’s insane how quickly that feeling just LEAVES once you swallow. Having seen NF mention Jolly Ranchers, I can actually see that maybe being more of the flavor than “nerds” - but Nerds was just the first thing I thought because of the heavy sour hit. I will say, the more sips I take, I am doing the face scrunch! So I don’t know if this is really something that I’m going to like, pick up and drink on a hot summer day to cool off or anything. Which, as I continue to type about these things, I’m realizing that’s probably not exactly what Energy Drinks are really *going* for. But that’s how I’ve been reviewing them baby. This is about taste. It’s a pleasant, fun flavor. And I think it’s worth checking out. I think this is a W from BANG. Though maybe not as STRONG as some of our other “sour candy” flavors.
nf:
Smells like grape. I am going to guess this is grape.

“What the fuck?” is what I said on the first sip. Second sip to recalibrate definitely gives a watermelon flavor. Not a strong one - the name of this to me suggests an attempt at Skittles, so there’s probably some sort of attempt at multiple fruity flavors here. But the predominant flavor to me is slightly sour watermelon. Kinda evokes a Jolly Rancher, to be honest. So I may just say this is “watermelon Jolly Rancher” even if that isn’t the intention. I dig it in there here and now, but I’m not a huge watermelon guy so I can’t say I’d go back to it.

name: GHOST Energy Bubblicious Strawberry Splash
msl: This one's a mystery for NF. There is a bit of a tint to this drink.  Not completely clear.  It has a nice smell.  I know what it is, and I think it matches it.  Oh my goodness.  This is liquid Bubblegum. I can not tell you the last time I had a pack of gum that was labeled “BUBBLICIOUS” but it felt like a wave of nostalgia and familiarity swept over me as I swallowed the first sip.  I will say, while the first sip had that bit of magic, and shock, and I DID enjoy it (and still am), each sip I am having afterwards has me thinking “This is SWEET… but would I ever GO FOR THIS again…?”  And I think my answer to that question is… I don’t know.  It’s good.  I like it.  But this feels like one of those drinks that is more fun of an experiment than one I will go out of my way for.  With that said, I do find it pretty tasty.  I said I hadn’t had Bubblicious in a while, but I feel like they absolutely hit the nail on the head with the flavoring here.  They got it right.  I hadn’t really thought about it before taking a drink, but this is kind of exactly how this should have tasted.  It’s enjoyable.  A bit too sweet maybe.  But it did what it wanted to do, and I have immense respect for that.
nf:
This has a very strong artificial strawberry smell. If it isn’t Bubblicious I will be very surprised.

That drink has a very strong artificial strawberry taste as well. It 100% reminds me of the flavor of strawberry Bubblicious. Does that work in a drink though? I say “yes, but…” It’s got the hallmarks of a tasty drink, but I think it’s just a little TOO sweet in a way that works for something like Bubblicious but goes overboard in liquid form. Gum flavor generally only lasts for a few chews, and the rest is just there to absorb your anxiety chews, so the extreme flavoring can work. Here, a sip fills your entire mouth and lingers. It’s certainly not bad, they definitely nailed the flavor, but it’s just too much of a good thing. Rein it in, and give this a generic non-branded name, Ghost!

PS: One of the pieces of trivia on the Bubblicious Wikipedia page is as follows: “In June 2013, former New England Patriots Tight End Aaron Hernandez was linked to a murder by his purchase of Blue Cotton Candy Bubblicious.”

name: GHOST Energy Strawbango
msl:
Clear drink with a slight tint. Mystery for NF. Smells like Mangos more than it does strawberries. I hope it does not disappoint!

Yeah I can confirm that is more of a mango flavor, but I like it! The slightest hint of strawberries which makes it taste a little different. A refreshing juicy flavor. Citrussy. Bold. I’m not sure if this is exactly the same as the “Strawbango Margarita” cans of the past, because I’m not someone who drinks margs sorry. But this is the kind of flavor I look for in an energy drink. Mango’s not my ABSOLUTE FAVORITE but I do like strawberries and I dunno what else to say on this one. THumbs up. I enjoyed. Easy finish.
nf:
Old story: clear drink, smells fruity. Gonna guess Strawbango.

Well that’s an odd duck. It’s got the slight taste of strawberry and then the mango hits you with some sort of sharpness that overpowers it. I dunno if I’d say “bitter” but it’s approaching it without ever being so, if that makes sense. I am struggling to find the words to describe it. I don’t hate it, in fact there’s parts I really do like. Particularly the first and last thirds of drinking a sip. The middle part where the mango flavor really maximizes is my least favorite. I like it the more I drink it, but there’s a cap on how much enjoyment I get. I think if they’d just made a straight up strawberry drink I’d rate it much more favorably, but the mango weighs it down a bit. Straw-meh-ngo!

name: bang Energy Delish Strawberry Kiss
msl:
The first drink of 2025! This one is a mystery for NF. It’s a clear drink that smells very sweet. Smells like something we’ve had before, honestly. We have a lot of drinks in the fridge we are suspecting will be BAD, and only a few that we think will prob be very good. This one…may be somewhere in either direction. I dunno.

That’s utra sweet! With a hint of strawberry candy. I took a tiny sip as my first one though, so let’s go a bit deeper and see if it’s too much: A bigger gulp, it honestly tastes a little watered down, which I’m not sure if that’s because of how it’s supposed to taste, or if it’s because the date on this can says 2023. It doesn’t say SUPER CREATINE though… so. Who knows. Doing the slosh test in my mouth: A little chemically, but honestly not all that offensive. It’s just a light strawberry candy drink. Not really something I’d probably want to go out of my way to drink again, but I do think if I wanted to finish this thing, I could pretty easily. One more sip for the road: yeah. It’s a complete thumbs in the middle drink.
nf:
Happy New Year, everyone. I have confirmation that this is NOT a Huel drink, which is cause for celebration. There are still some landmines in there, so it’s not a complete pass. The smell is slightly fruity. My guess is one of the BANGs, but we’ll see.

Delish! Feels like I just got kissed. And wouldn’t you know, it’s the (possibly long discontinued) bang Energy Delish Strawberry Kiss. Despite a years old best by date, this is still pretty dang good. The strawberry flavor is tasty without being too strong. I have no idea if that is the intention or if it simply wore off after being manufactured and canned in like 2022. But good taste is good taste, and this is a quality strawberry drink. It’s definitely artificial strawberry, on the candy side vs. trying to recreate the actual fruit. It’s nowhere near Starburst, but I think it’ll end up ranking surprisingly high. A good start.

name: Bloom Sparkling Energy Glacier Crush
msl:
OK so I know what this drink is but NF does not.  It is translucent but also, not piss colored, DEW colored. Despite knowing what the flavor is, I have no idea how to describe the smell, nor do I know what to expect from the flavor itself.  Anyway, let’s give this thing a try. 

OK so now I need to try and discern what this thing is. This kind of has a popsicle flavor maybe?  On extra sips, yeah, I think it may just be a blue popsicle, given the can itself is blue.  It’s tasty.  Kinda fruity.  No gross aftertaste.  I like it!  I don’t really know what else I can say about it though.  Just tastes like a blue popsicle that melted in my mouth.  BLOOM doesn’t give you a ton per can so this was a very easy finish and I have no more sips left to try.  So uh…Thumbs up?  We’ve had a lot of popsicle variety drinks.  I wouldn’t say this one is at the top, but I like it.  That’s all.  Bye.
nf:
If I didn’t know any better, I’d assume that Matt just gave me a glass of Mountain Dew or at least some variety. Perhaps a store brand ripoff like Peak Dewey or Misty Mountain Hop. Cannot really identify anything when I smell it.

My first thought was, well ok maybe this is supposed to be a Mountain Dew ripoff because it evokes citrus flavor while being neon green. But as it is apparently Bloom Glacier Crush, now I’m not sure if that’s the intent. The packaging has a mountain with blue highlights, indicating something like blue raspberry or lemon or something. I suppose with that foreknowledge I can detect that. I would say this is closer to seltzer with a flavor pack, though. Which may interest some as getting punched in the mouth/dick with flavor may be a bit intense for some. We call these people Cowards, but no offense is intended. If you’re a Coward looking for a blue raspberry-ish, citrus-ish flavor, you could do worse. You should probably just get good and build your tongue up to get a real drink like C4 Frozen Bombsicle or GHOST Energy (formerly Sour Patch Kids) Blue Raspberry, though.

name: GHOST Energy Warheads Sour Black Cherry
msl:
Nooo my birthday MONTH is over…. Nooo…. But that also means school is almost out for summer over here. Anyway it’s time for some Sour Black Cherry. This one is not a mystery. Black Cherry is one of my absolute favorite soda flavors. Not really excited for this to be a SOUR version of that. But hopefully it’ll be good.

This is a clear drink. It has just the FAINTEST smell of Black Cherry Soda. Here’s hoping the flavor is more intense than the smell.

OK Interesting. I don’t so much get the sour feeling in my mouth when I drink this, but there’s this distinct aftertaste of eating sour candies mixed with the black cherry. I type this sentence as if this flavor isn’t supposed to be WARHEADS. I’m so dumb. But yeah - there’s no actual sour tingling feeling, just flavor. Sloshing it around the mouth and it’s a little stronger underneath the gums, but not intense at all. Flavor wise it’s a little bolder than what I like from my usual Black Cherry Sodas. I’m chalking that up to the sour warhead flavor, I think it’s an unpleasant addition to an already delicious soda flavor. I don’t think it makes it better. But it’s not BAD. It just replaces that sweet syruppy goodness that I like.

An aftertaste lingers for a few seconds after a swig but it doesn’t stick around too long. I DID FINISH this, though honestly I don’t think I will ever get it again. Thumbs in the middle.
nf:
The color they have used to symbolize the Sour Black Cherry is a very offputting maroon. It reminds me of the dark blood you see when people cough it up. Anyway, I hope it’s tasty!

I think it is tasty. It’s actually a pretty sweet black cherry flavor. Maybe even more regular cherry. Now that I think about it…there’s not much sour there, especially for something with Warheads branding. I get that for a mass market release you don’t want to make people feel bad, but I also think that anyone buying a Warheads-branded drink know what they’re getting into. Someone ordering the Ghost Pepper Diablo Asshole Killer at some wing place is probably not going to be surprised that their wings are spicy. So in a vacuum, this is a really nice cherry drink, but for a “Warheads Sour Black Cherry” it’s actually pretty poor. There’s a lot of cherry options out there and this could have been a real alternative if it did what it said on the can.

name: GHOST Energy Faze Up
msl:
It’s gonna be 7-UP the Energy Drink. A lemon and a lime are on the can. It kinda has that smell to it. I’m expecting 7-UP. Also I was in the hospital last night, and I’m having an energy drink 13 hours later. Let’s gooo? FOR THE FANS. This is called “Faze Up” and I associate that phrase with someone from “Faze clan” rage quitting a very popular GTA RP server when he was getting arrested. So this could be a flop. Let’s find out. (Clear drink. Citrusy, not overwhelming smell.)

What is this, Sierra Mist? Not the 7-Up flavor I was expecting. Not even sprite. But it is some sort of Lemon/Lime combo. Where I feel like the Lemon is kinda winning. I’m not a Dew drinker so I can’t really compare, so maybe it’s on that side of the tracks. But this is…fine. There is a bit of an aftertaste that lingers, not what I would call medicinal like some other drinks. Lemon with a taste of chemicals, maybe. I think as a citrus soda drink, this is fine, but much like the “Sparking Cola” we had recently, I think you could have much better options for a caffeinated Lemon/Lime drink. This one doesn’t taste offensive at all like the Sparkling Cola did though. It’s good. It’s just unremarkable and I can’t help but think about all the popular brands of caffeinated soda that I would drink over it.

As far as flavor, I think they did a pretty good job. I’m glad we found this one, because it took a while for us to find it being sold anywhere, and I was worried it would be one of those things I’d have to buy off ebay. But It’s just fine. That’s all. One thumb up. Will finish.
nf:
Probably could have used this drink this morning when I was falling asleep at my desk. As to WHY I was falling asleep at my desk…you can ask M. This is a lemon lime drink. I base that on the fact the logo is the FAZE logo with a lemon and a lime. I assume “Up” means it’s like 7-Up. In fact, the Ghost press release says it’s “an exciting new flavor inspired by the nostalgic citrus soda that captivated millennials' taste buds during childhood,“ which, shut the fuck up. It has the look reminiscent of ginger ale. It smells citrussy.

Well I wouldn’t say this tastes like 7-Up or even Sprite, but it’s a nice little citrus drink. It’s just a little sweet, with just a hint of carbonation. I would say this is actually closer to Diet Mountain Dew, which maybe is the actual “citrus soda” that they were referring to. This is a considerably better version of Ghost’s Citrus flavor, which had way less flavor and even less carbonation. Now with all that said, it’s also not wowing me either. It’s a perfectly fine drink, but the mild flavor is just too unassuming for me to place it among the greats. I would burn out on those more than this, but someone once said that it’s better to burn out than to fade away. Faze Up and Away? No, we won’t say that. But what if…? No. Anyway, it’s a drink worth checking out.

name: Alani Nu Juicy Peach
msl:
Another mystery drink for NF. This one is almost clear, but not? Hazy, and I can’t see through it.. Smell wasn’t very strong in the can, but I can smell it more in the glass.

Yeah that tastes like Peach. A juicy peach. And honestly, while I don’t really go crazy for the Peach flavored drinks, this one is quite nice. There’s a boldness to it that I did not expect. I think most of the PEACH flavored drinks we have had, I don’t know if they’re too light in the flavor, or if they’re mixed with another fruit that makes me like them less, but this one is just hitting in a way that the ones we’ve had in the past have not. I’m find it hard to come up with the words to say more about this one, it just tastes like a good peach drink. Probably one of the better ones we’ve had up to this point. It’s not my favorite flavor or anything - but this is good. There’s no shitty aftertaste. It’s just nice. Thumbs up from me.
nf:
This is a very hazy drink. Gonna take a wild guess and say Juicy Peach.

Haven’t been looking forward to this one, but I gotta say it ain’t bad. We’ve only had a couple of peach drinks before and they’ve ended up in the bottom half of our list, but this may break the curse. It doesn’t kick your teeth in with sweetness, but it’s also got enough to be tasty. No anonymity here. I would say it’s more of a candy peach taste than resembling the actual fruit, which does help quite a bit. It’s very pleasing, but I will say there is an artificial-ness to it that does cap it. Decent drink from Alani Nu.

POST RANKING NOTE: We started thinking this was gonna be somewhere in the Mid 70’s and spent a good 5+ minutes watching it climb all the way to 59.

name: C4 Jolly Rancher Peach
msl:
We are back to C4!  And this one smells CHEMICALLY PEACHY.  I generally like peach drinks more than NF but for some reason I see Jolly Rancher and I’m just kinda like “Eh!”  Let’s see how this goes.  Clear drink, as most C4’s are.   

Hmmm ok.  As I’m drinking this you get hit with that wave of peachy flavor but it tapers off into something that I just don’t quite like all that much.  Let me try another sip: OK yeah, that one was a little better but it just doesn’t taste as refreshingly peachy when you’re swallowing.  The Jolly Rancher flavor IS there, but I dunno.  

Drinks like this call for the SLOSH TEST: and hey wow it’s actually a lot better when I do that.  Significantly so.  The flavor of peach was a bit stronger.  But hey,most people don’t drink like that.  So yeah, if you drink this like a freak you’ll probably like it more. I was able to finish. No post drink shitty aftertaste, which is nice!

Vibes here are in the middle, leaning up. Though I probably wouldn’t get this again.
nf:
A dual decision today, we went with one of the “let’s just get this one fuckin over with eh” choices. Peach has not been a flavor either of us favor, me dramatically less so than Matt. C4 did not bother with giving the liquid a shade, and a sneaky drink thief might take a swig thinking it’s Sprite or sparkling water. How your petard has been hoisted, Mr. or Mrs. Thief! As Princess “Toadstool” Peach would say, Dear Mario. Also: here we go!

So that wasn’t so bad! Not bad at all! What a shock, right? All this bluster about how I don’t like peach and then I go and like this. Well.

The thing is this doesn’t taste like peach much at all. Maybe right at the start when it hits your taste buds, but then it turns into a general sweet, candy flavor. It’s very pleasing! But if you’ve read some reviews by us, you’ll know that there’s many factors in a drink. While taste pleasantness is obviously weighed very heavily, taste accuracy is a factor as well. If not, well, C4 could have filled these cans with Skittles or Starburst Cherry flavors and just called it Peach, right? What’s the point if it doesn’t taste like what it says on the can? They were clearly trying to get a peach candy flavor, but went too far in the candy direction. So I end up keen on this, but not particularly peachy.

name: Mountain Dew Kickstart Fruit Punch
msl: Smelled it before knowing what it was.  Knew it was fruit punch.  But FIVE PERCENT JUICE?!  What could this possibly taste like?  First sip seems like a very carbonated fruit punch.  Swirling it around the mouth…yes. That’s a carbonated fruit punch.  It’s definitely not bad, but not really packed with a strong flavor that has me thinking I would drink another one.  Last taste - which is my big swig:  Hey.  It’s just kinda ok!  If this was the only possible thing I could drink at some point - I would not be unhappy.
nf:
The can advertises it has 5% juice. What that means for taste…I suppose we’ll see. Pretty good first sip. Not the best fruit punch I’ve ever had, but decent. For an energy drink I think it’s actually pretty good. It is not sugar free, but a full can has 19g of sugar which is practically sugar free compared to Rockstar Punched, which did not taste much better imo. Good drink, if unspectacular. Could use a little sour flavor to it.

“It’s like a match that gets cutoff once it starts getting really really good.”

- The Mystery Man known as NF

name: Alani Nu Blue Slush
msl: I have chosen this drink, and I am fairly confident both NF and I will enjoy this one.  First sniff - the smell matches.  Not the strongest and it dissipated in the last couple of minutes.  I’m excited to taste!  It has a slight sour hint to it, which is interesting, because this is BLUE SLUSH. I’ve been craving some blue flavors recently, and while this doesn’t hit strong, that BLUE flavor is there.  It’s a pleasant taste, and it honestly is kind of leaving me wanting just a bit more.  Just like the cans of Alani’s.  Sloshing it around the mouth, the sourness isn’t exactly STRONG, but it just has that sour candy taste.  I like this drink, I would drink it again, but I don’t think it is strong enough for me personally.  If you’re looking for something light though, and blue flavored?  This is completely fine.  It’s tasty.  It’s refreshing.  It just lacks in the heavy flavoring department.  Final sip, a big gulp: Yes.  That’s good.  Real good.  NOTE: I’m digging the aftertaste.
nf: Smells sour. Cannot put my finger on the flavor other than sour berry. Either Bombsicle or Blue Slush is my guess and Blue Slush it is. Definitely has blue raspberry flavor as I thought but wasn’t 100% sure of. It’s not the best I’ve had, and there’s even some weird gooey aftertaste to it. But it has a high floor because of the good (not great) first 80% or so of the flavor. The sourness hits the tastebuds immediately but then fades away pretty quickly until all that is left are the possibly cancerous chemicals in the drink. Not bad, and a good blue raspberry will always hit, but probably on the bottom third of blue raspberry drinks we have had.

name: bang Energy Blue Razz
msl: I know what it is, but NF does not.  Here we go.  The smell is not strong, which makes me wonder about the impact the flavor will have.  It’s clear!  SUPER MYSTERIOUS!  Ok let’s go.  On first sip I can definitely taste the Blue Raspberry but it is NOT strong in the slightest.  I am not feeling the BANG at all.  Sloshing it around my mouth the second time like it’s some sort of wine, I get more of it - but this definitely is not the strongest.  I’m not even getting the intense “energy drink” flavor either.  It’s just light.  I’ll say, I like this, but knowing it’s a spooky energy drink, and only has THIS much flavor makes me think I probably wouldn’t get it again. I will say after finishing it - I do feel more positive than I thought while actually drinking it lol.
nf: Matt has poured a mystery flavor. I cannot grok what it is from the first sniff, maybe the gummy bear flavor. Let’s take a sip and see…well it tastes good. I’m told it’s BANG Blue Razz, which makes sense. Definitely has the hallmarks of a good blue raspberry flavor. Frozen Bombsicle and Faze Pop probably clear thanks to the flavor of this being a lot more subtle. It’s not bad at all, but it’s missing the oomph of the best and frankly of a drink called “Bang.” I think if you’re looking for a blue raspberry flavor that isn’t strong this would hit really well.

name: BUM Energy Blue Snow Cone
msl:
I think this has a very distinct, nice, blue raspberry smell. Clear drink. Mystery to NF.

OK. So this is interesting. On the first sip, I expected a refreshing wave of Blue Raspberry flavor, and the Blue IS THERE - but I'm not getting "refreshing" - I'm getting "Sour Blue Candy". It's a super intense sour flavor that hits your taste buds the second it hits your mouth, and then kinda trails off instantly when you swallow. There's a slight hint of aftertaste - but not an extreme amount. When I do a little slosh test in my mouth - that sour candy feeling really isn't going away until I swallow, so the flavoring on this whole thing just leaves me a little bit confused. This is actually really tasty. I like it. But I would describe this whole drink as: BLUE FLAVOR? Nailed it. SNOW CONE FLAVOR? Non-existent. I'm actually left with a very disappointed feeling of the flavor overall because of this. If this was renamed something like "Sour Blue Candy" - I think I'd be more enthusiastic and like "Yeah, they nailed it!"

Either way - this is our first BUM Energy flavor. And even though I'm disappointed in the lack of a refreshing snow cone taste - this leaves me excited to try the other flavors in the future.
nf:
This smells a bit like blue raspberry. I think it’s blue raspberry.

I think it tastes like it too? Not sure. It’s very sweet and sour and then kinda trails off. I like it, but there’s something about it that’s just kinda weird. You get this intense flavor right at the start that dies down. It’s hard to really say anything else. It’s a decent blue raspberry that doesn’t quite thrill me but is fine. A little too much of everything that doesn’t last long enough.

name: BUCKED UP Breezy Blast
msl:
If you like Pinaaa Colaaadas. I like them very much. But will I like a BUCKED UP version of it? Who can say. It’s a clear drink and it smells like a lot of pineapple. I assume the Coconut is there also, but this is pure pineapple smell.

Yeah that’s pineapple alright. Interestingly enough though, it’s really smooth.
