When you take a bite of a juicy pineapple you can sometimes feel it biting back at the roof of your mouth - you’re not really getting that here though. It just goes down easy. Doing a little slosh test with it to see if that pineapple BITE gets me - and no. It’s just a really nice refreshing little pineapple drink. I guess what’s balancing it out here is a coconut flavoring, though I personally can’t really taste the coconut all that much. It’s basically just pure Pineapple without the acid that kind of stings at you. And that’s pretty nice.

With that said, and as big a fan as I am of pineapple, I don’t know If I’d say this one is really STELLAR. I’m pleased with it, but it’s not getting some major double thumbs up from me. It’s good, but not THAT good. I think this one qualifies as another PLUS for the BUCKED UP brand. I will finish this pretty easily.
nf:
Based on the packaging, this looks like it’s a pina colada flavor. It’s something like that, given the name and coconut cup on the can. Oh btw this smells awful

Tastes alright though. Fruity and sweet, not candy-like. Matt is punching the keys, damn. Research confirms this is a “pineapple cocktail flavor” and I would say it’s one of the better pineapple drinks we have had. Outside of the smell - which is quite bad! - it’s got no real downsides other than it not being one of my preferred flavors. No energy drink medicinal flavoring, no bitterness. There’s also no carbonation or sourness to really note, but that’s not really a downside here. Some drinks really need those, but I don’t think this would benefit that much from either. I will say that the coconut is pretty faint and the pineapple is a bit artificial tasting. Yes, I know, ALL of these are artificial, but we have noted in the past when drinks nail what they are going for, and this doesn’t totally stick the landing. Pretty good drink. .

name: BUCKED UP Lightly Carbonated Protein Orange Cream
msl:
This drink is a mystery for NF. It’s foggy as hell. Smell wasn’t super strong cracking the can, and it’s even less strong in the glass. I predict this one will be…OK.

And what do you know, I was right! This tastes a whole lot more ORANGE than a Creamsicle - but a hint of creamsicle vanilla flavor IS definitely there. It’s just a whole lot more subtle in comparison to the Orange flavor. First impressions kind of feels like I’m drinking an Orange Soda after taking a bite of a Creamsicle, if that makes sense. SLOSHING IT AROUND: The vanilla flavoring is starting to hit stronger than on the first sip. In fact, the aftertaste that is being left over is just the vanilla taste.

I gotta say, this isn’t really bad. It’s actually pretty good and I seem to be enjoying it more and more with each sip. Is it my favorite Orange Cream flavor? I don’t think so. But I would be happy to have one of these again. Finished it pretty easily. Thumbs in the….no. Thumbs Up. I’ll say Thumbs Up.
nf:
This thing is foggier than Derry, ME. The smell is very faint. But I think I am picking up a slight orange cream scent. We’ll see.

Lightly carbonated? You betcha. Orange cream? Ummmm, a bit. In fact I don’t think there’s much carbonation in there either. Matt says he tastes more orange, which is funny because I think I taste more vanilla in there…at least at first. It’s not a particularly memorable vanilla, and the orange is barely there. The lack of carbonation hurts it, but again if you’re a person that is very adverse to carbonation then I guess this is an OK option? The only thing it does particularly well is not being carbonated. Otherwise it’s just a middling orange cream with too much orange or too much cream depending on sip. I’ll close saying there’s a slight bitterness to the vanilla on top of everything else, but it’s not there every sip.

name: Gorilla Mind Orange Rush
msl:
This smells like what it is baby. Though I do get what NF says about the “CHEMICAL” smell. Clear drink with a slight tint.

OOO. What is that? I don’t know what that is. When I’m gulping it down it is tasting just like an orange soda, but if you let it sit anywhere else in your mouth other than immediately going down your throat? What is that? Experimenting a little bit more, and I hate to say it, but this tastes straight like Orange Soda with a dosage of extra chemicals. They couldn’t mask the smell for NF, and I don’t think the flavor of the drink masks it either. Some Gorilla Mind flavors are so strong that it completely eclipses that ENERGY DRINK flavor - but this feels like you spilled some orange soda in my energy drink!

As I continue to drink, the more I’m getting used to it and I don’t think it’s really bad, but ultimately there are much better Orange flavored drinks than this one. I think if that aftertaste and ENERGY flavor was masked a bit more? This might honestly be a top tier drink. The orange really hits you strong. But there is a weird unpleasant….hmmm

You know what, now that I think about it, I wonder if that’s like a Lemon or a Lime addition? And I’m just an asshole saying “chemicals”? I dunno. The official label of ORANGE RUSH says “Juicy…Bold….Refreshing….”. And I guess it’s those things. But I’d like that weird extra taste gone from it.

TLDR: I went from “EH?” To “Ehhhh….” To “Hmmmm…” to “It’s good actually.”

102 of these drinks…and i feel like a hack…!
nf:
Have an idear about what this might be, although it has a chemical smell. Piss-colored.

OK, thought this was Country Time upon looking at it, but it’s definitely an orange drink from the monkey drink. This tastes like a lighter orange soda. It’s good we’ve recently had an orange drink to directly compare this to, because while I think this tastes good, I think Alani Nu Orange Kiss is a much stronger version of this, and that isn’t even the best orange drink on our list. This just tastes a little too fake, with a little too much chemical flavoring they couldn’t mask with the orange taste. Gorilla Mind has done worse, but this just ain’t really doing it for me.

name: Beaver Buzz Energy Root Beer
msl:
ROOT BEER. It smell like root beer. It look like root beer. Will it taste like root beer? We’ll find out. This one has lots of bubbles. CARBONATION???

OK so first sip it does taste a bit like root beer. It tapers off as you are swallowing it and definitely could use some more carbonation - but the flavor is there. You let it sit in your mouth and slosh it around, it’s… is it like a Diet Root Beer? It’s like a less PUNCHy root beer so I’m gonna say it’s kinda like that. This is definitely one of the better Beaver Buzz drinks we’ve had, though I will say it’s not like… SPECIAL. But it’s a fine root beer drink and if you want to drink ONE root beer with a shitton of caffeine, this might be good enough for you.

I’d prefer a Sprechers though.

I did finish. Thumbs in the middle leaning up?
nf:
And so our dalliance with Beaver Buzz Energy comes to a close today. This is the flavor I was looking forward to the most when I saw the batch. Despite the mostly middling results of BBE, I am still intrigued at the prospect. This appears to be carbonated, so they didn’t fuck that up, at least.

Alright, that’s not so bad! Not bad at all. Now, I do think it could be MORE carbonated, but what is here will suffice. It has a nice root beer taste, helped greatly (at least I imagine) by the inclusion of cane sugar. With that said, it doesn’t have the punch a regular root beer will have and is closer to the taste of a diet root beer. But diet root beer is good because root beer’s flavor is so strong that it can withstand being watered down. So there is a bit of a conundrum here where you’re getting a diet taste but still getting the sugar. But given the lack of competition for root beer energy drinks, it’s probably the best you can get at the moment if you want caffeinated root beer. A good close for Beaver Buzz.

name: The Winter Edition: Fuji Apple & Ginger
msl:
I’m full of white castle and now it’s time to energize. I didn’t think this was going to be a mystery but it is for me now. It’s a translucent mystery piss colored drink. But it smells nice and fruity. Let’s goooo!!! It reminds me of a green apple smell. So I’m gonna guess Wild Orchard.

Ahhh it is Apple!!! And it’s a RED BULL? This is right away probably my favorite red bull drink. Let’s give it another sip. OK, so I definitely can get more of that Red Bull base flavor now that I know what it is. Which, funny how our brain and taste buds work. I don’t know if I really get the “ginger” from this on the next couple of sips… is it ginger-ale? I don’t know. The delicious apple taste takes over here. Nice and sweet. I enjoy it! WIth that said, I don’t think I’d say this is my favorite Apple flavored drink. It’s in that zone of “I would drink again” but it wouldn’t be my first choice. This was a very easy finish for me, and an easy thumbs up. Good stuff, Red Bull.
nf:
We got ourselves a classic Piss Drink today, a champagne-adjacent looking drink that could be mistaken for a big glass of genuine piss. It smells fruity and sweet.

That is definitely a Red Bull, but it’s probably the sweetest Red Bull we have. If you told me this was a non-alcoholic Angry Orchard…I’d probably side eye you, but would ultimately believe you. I’d then ask “Are you ribbing me right now?” and you’d hem and haw while I switch my view between you and the drink, lest things become increasingly awkward. I’d note that there’s a definite apple flavor here, not quite apple juice strong, but if this were, say, a Red Bull, it might as well be The Incredible Hulk. There’s a bit of bitterness as you’d expect in an alcoholic drink. But since this is non-alcoholic, it is a little weird! Much more expected in something like a Red Bull. Where most of the Red Bulls we have tried were dramatically weighed down by the bitter energy drink bullshit, this is a nice counterbalance to the very sweet apple taste. I did not personally detect any of the “warming kick of ginger spice” that is mentioned past a slight tingle on my tastebuds. “What does that mean,” you’d ask about my tortured comparison and odd mentions of Red Bull. Has this bit broken my friend Nick’s brain? Don’t worry about it, I say, as I stare vacantly into the distance. A good Red Bull, but one I’d probably skip over at the store.

name: Alani Nu Cotton Candy
msl:
Cloudy drink that smells exactly like Cotton Candy. It can only be one thing. A true mystery for NF. Seriously though - smells exactly like you’d expect cotton candy to smell. Will it taste the same?

Well it’s super sweet. It is COTTON CANDY FLAVORING. And it’s good to me. Slosh test: yes that’s a more intense cotton candy flavor. Swigging - yes, that is good also. If you want a sweet treat of a drink this is completely fine. Honestly a little too sweet for me but the drink is just straight up as advertised. It leaves a bit of an aftertaste given how intense the flavor is, but I don’t think it’s bad. I’m realizing now that it’s been ages since i’ve had Cotton Candy proper, and I’m now second guessing if cotton candy flavoring is significantly different than cotton candy itself. NF often brings up that something is the “artificial candy version” of a flavor, more than the actual flavor itself. Is that what this is? I don’t know!

But anyway, I like it. Thumbs up really. It is exactly what you think it is, and it is exactly as advertised, and I think it’s overall tasty. I did finish.
nf:
Matt gave this to me, this chalky, hazy drink, while giggling. He told me to smell, knowing that it would give the game up immediately. Unless this is the weirdest smelling pineapple-flavored drink of all time, this is cotton candy.

So it smells like cotton candy, we’ve established that. But does it taste like it? Reader, it does. It very much does. It’s pretty good for what it is, too. It’s very sweet, maybe a hair too sweet, but right on the line. It tastes like liquid cotton candy without any weird tastes before, during, or after. And yet! There’s something missing here. I think it could have used some carbonation. Sparkling Cotton Candy, perhaps. It’s so sweet but it seems flat. The fizziness of carbonation could have added some spark and character to this, because it is so sweet it seems to be raising the parts of my tastebuds and brain that something like Coke or Pepsi would. Without the carbonation, it’s a bit like drinking cotton candy flavoring. It’s enjoyable as a little gimmick (“Hey ma, I’m drinkin’ cotton candy!”), and without checking the reviews I’d probably take it over the bang and GHOST varieties. RYSE is still the only company to make a cotton candy drink that I’d buy more than one ticket to ride.

name: 3D Energy Citrus Mist
msl:
Another drink and another mystery for me. Before he even gives me the glass I’m gonna assume it’s 3D Liberty Pop. But now that he’s brought the drink in, not only has he given me an insane amount of liquid, but I now think it must be Citrus Mist. This drink is Dew colored. And it has that citrus smell. I’d be stunned if it wasn’t.

Yeah you know that’s about what I’d expect. I’m sure we’ve had drinks like this, maybe even recently, but I used to drink Dew/Sierra Mist in High School and I kinda just stopped after that, so the flavor of what it’s SUPPOSED to taste like is somewhat unfamiliar to me. This wasn’t a bad first sip. Not a bad second either. It’s refreshing. The dew flavor is lingering for a bit after drinking but the aftertaste isn’t bad. I was going to say that I feel like I can kinda taste the sugar but there is apparently no sugar in this thing. I think it’s a thumbs up! I like it. Not gaga over it but I did finish and if you offered me one again, I’d definitely take it. Maybe I need to drink a normal/diet dew next just to compare. IDK.
nf:
We got ourselves a greenish yellow drink today, and despite it being a bit MISTY….it’s clear what this is. No reason to hide it from Matt.

They call it Citrus Mist and it sure tastes like it. Five words that sum it up: Off-brand Diet Mountain Dew. I love me some Diet Dew and sometimes I wonder if I hadn’t liked it for years if I’d like it if I tried it for the first time today. My guess is no, but we’ll never know. I say this because since I am a big Diet Dew guy, you’d think I’d be gaga over this. I do think it tastes good, but good is as far as I’ll go. It’s just off-brand Diet Dew. A worse Diet Dew. It’s got citrus, it’s got the color, but there’s nothing else here to give it any character. I guess you don’t really want to stray from the goal, but maybe some extra twang or carbonation would have helped here and really made it special. As it is, a solid but unspectacular drink.

name: REDCON1 Orange Cream
msl: There’s a lot of avenues I can go with this one…we bought red bulls for the first time the other day.  Could that be what this is?!  Well, it doesn’t smell like it.  But also, I know what it is.  Now that, is an orange creamy drink.  I will say, off the bat, I do notice a bit of an almost medicinal taste on the way down… on the second one not so much.  As I keep drinking it feels like they are getting the creamsicle kinda vibe, but I don’t know if there is enough ORANGE flavor to it?  It’s hard.  Every Orange Cream drink I have I compare to a stewarts.  But you do get hints of orange.  You do get the creamsicle hit.  It is flavorful, but I think it’s just a little bit too light on the flavor they’re going for.  I think if you’re gonna do an orange cream drink that I actually wanna go out and get again, it’s gotta feel stronger than this. But this isn’t bad!  It’s completely fine.  But there are much better options out there.  When I give it the slosh test, there is definitely a bit of an aftertaste that takes a bit to go away, but the aftertaste also doesn’t taste like complete shit.  Fizzy chemicals for sure, but it’s not terrible.  Anyway, I drank the whole thing.  That says something.  Completely OK drink.  Would have it again if offered, would not actively seek out again.
nf: No thoughts on the whiff test. I had a feeling it was an orange cream drink. The flavor of this is VERY faint to me. The smell might be stronger. This tastes more like a sparkling drink than an in your face kind of energy drink. It’s like seltzer with a hint of orange cream on top. Wouldn’t offend the most insulated church mom. I like what flavor exists, it definitely IDs as orange cream, but there’s just so little of it! There’s stronger options out there I’d recommend over this.

name: Gorilla Mind Orange Ice Dream
msl: Not the STRONGEST smell from this one.  Not sure how this one is gonna be… has a slight tint to it but is clear.  Smell has dissipated as I brought it to my room also!  Oh that’s sweet!  Definitely a stronger Orange Creamsicle flavor than some of our previous entries, but also maybe not the strongest.  I think that’s been a common problem with all the Orange Dreamsicle flavors.  You’re getting like, the orangey-creamy taste, but it can’t substitute taking a fuckin big bite out of a creamsicle.  With that said, this is a tasty little drink. It’s pleasant.  Not my favorite Gorilla Mind though.  All in all, if you want a Orange Dream/Creamsicle flavor, you may just want to really go with STEWARTS, because that's the best soda there is.  This is one I drank all the way though, and thought was pleasant.  If you want to put things in your body to give you energy, and want an Orange Cream flavor - sure.  Take this one.  I just wish it was stronger.
nf: Unsure about the smell, have an inkling of what it might be but not enough to make a declaration…Tastes sweet. OK, this is one I did not know we had. The orange creamsicle taste is definitely there, but still too subtle for me. I don’t think I’ve had an orange creamsicle drink that really nails a strong flavor, but this isn’t by any means bad. The orange taste is strong with a hint of vanilla, so the flavor combo is THERE, but not really what you want. There just might not be a way to really nail orange creamsicle in energy drink form and if you really want the taste you’ll just have to go for a Stewart’s or something.

name: C4 Cherry Limeade
msl: The sniff test…barely any sniff!!! The first sip was quite refreshing, though I was expecting the cherry to take over, and it kinda didn’t win out over the C4 ENERGY flavor.  It’s weird.  On second sip - you can TASTE that cherry.  The cherry is there.  I still think the ENERGY flavor wins out though.  The Lime - I don’t know.  I dunno what LIMEADE really is.  3rd sip - Yeah, I think this is a tasty drink.  I like it a lot.  Buuuutttt…. It’s not one of my crazy favorites or anything.  It’s just good!
nf: Sniff test reveals nothing. This is a mystery drink for me. Let’s go…I thought this was Breezeberry, but it’s Cherry Limeade! I can taste the cherry, don’t know if I can taste the lime much. I think I might taste it in subsequent sips? It’s a very pleasant taste, though, whatever the fuck is happening my mouth. Not one of the best, but a nice drink.

name: BUCKED UP Cherry Candy
msl:
Smells like Cherry. Clear drink. I think it’s BUCKED UP. Also context clues from NF saying “Not Huel” and “This has been here a while.”

That’s a powerful hit of flavor that quickly dissipates as it goes down your throat. There is BOLD CHERRY and there is more of a LIGHT CHERRY flavor when it comes to some of these drinks, and I don’t really think this is what I’d describe as “bold” cherry. It’s more on the light end, but that light flavoring is STRONG? I dunno if I’m really describing this correctly. It’s got a heavy candy flavor to it, and I gotta tell you I think it’s pretty damn good. When you slosh it around in your mouth a bit you get more of this, almost sour hit that isn’t really prevalent when you’re just sipping it. I’ve been nodding my head for practically the last 60 seconds just to signify to myself “Yeah, this is pretty damn good.” I like this a lot.

There’s a bit of an aftertaste but it’s also not so much a bad one that feels full of a chemical. The good candy flavor just lingers there. Smells nice, hefty amount, tastes good. Two thumbs up from me. Perhaps one of my favorite BUCKED UP we’ve ever had? Guess we’ll find out when it’s time to rank. Easy finish.

A few minutes later, the aftertaste still lingering. Not as nice as it was 5 minutes ago. But not terrible.
nf:
We had to take yesterday off in honor of the brave souls that defended our freedom on January 6, 2021.

I chose this and thought for a bit about getting a Huel out of the way, but I decided I was in no mood for dogshit.

That is very, very sweet. Definitely emblematic of its name, it’s absolutely candy cherry flavored no ifs, ands, or buts. Well here’s one but: BUT…I’d say it might be closer to cough syrup than a candy drink. It’s very thick and syrupy tasting, and the sweetness goes too far past the bar so it’s not so much sweet like candy but simply too sweet. It’s like they’re trying to cover up something, such as a gross energy drink flavor or Prozac powder. This sounds like a bad review, and while this isn’t a great drink it’s also not making me make ugly facial expressions. There’s much better cherry flavors out there, so I’d say to skip this one.

name: GOAT Fuel Pineapple Cream Soda
msl:
PHEW. OK. PISS YELLOW DRINK. PSYCHING MYSELF UP FOR THIS ONE BABY. WOO. It has a fresh Pineapple smell. And while the piss yellow isn’t speaking to me, the smell sure is. Makes me confident this might not be as rough as I was expecting.

OK well - the CREAM flavor is absolutely overwhelming the Pineapple flavor. The pineapple flavor is there, but it’s not as strong as you would think. You’re not really getting any of that extreme cirtusy goodness that is trying to eat the roof of your mouth. It tastes like if I poured you a glass with the flavoring of like 90% cream, 10% pineapple. Maybe less pineapple. Watered down pineapple.

But with all of that said, this isn’t something I am disliking. It’s not something I’d go out of my way to drink again, but it’s not bad! Needs a stronger pineapple flavor. That’s pretty much all I got to say. Thumbs in the middle.
nf:
M is being very mean, so I dunno. He brings me a cup of piss and then has a mean tone. How am I supposed to work in these conditions? I’m gonna guess it’s White Gummy Deer.

Not terrible. Seems like citrus. Ah but it’s pineapple so not quite citrus. I am generally not a pineapple guy, but this actually isn’t bad. The vanilla flavoring seems to be counteracting a lot of what I dislike about pineapple. Bizarrely, it ends up kinda tasting like a Diet Mountain Dew variant. “Attention Dew Nation: Diet Dew Pineapple Frost, now available at CVS!” Yeah, that sounds right. There is a slightly unpleasant note at the very end, but it’s not enough to ruin the drink. With all that praise aside, it is on the fainter side of flavor. There is a possibility that it would be worse if it were more flavorful, but as it is it’s missing some fireworks or oomph to be really memorable. Good drink, but definitely not the GOAT.

name: BUM Energy Root Beer
msl:
I feel like I haven’t slept in 2 days and it’s time to spike myself with some insane caffeine. I am not a root beer person, really. But maybe BUM Root Beer will be good. Let’s try it. The drink is completely clear. STRONG ROOT BEER SMELL. How will this compare to the only root beer I will take a sip of: Sprechers?

It’s like Root Beer but with a more refreshing gulp. I feel like sometimes when I swallow root beer I can feel that… strong flavor all the way down. But the second it hits my throat it evaporates into a nice refreshing sip. At least, that’s how my first sip was. Yeah, you know what? This honestly isn’t so bad. As a non-Root Beer drinker, I often find that the flavor on the roof of my mouth is just too strong and the aftertaste lingers. I’m not getting that at all here. It hits you, and then it dissipates. Which, maybe that’s not your thing if you’re an AVID Root Beer liker. And when I think about it, would I really go out of my way to get this again? Mmmm. Hard to say really. But of all the BUM Energy’s, this is the one I was kinda dreading and it has pleasantly surprised me. I would finish this whole thing but I just think that’s a bad idea. I mean - it might keep me up and prevent me from killing my sleep schedule…but….nah.

This would be an easy finish. Thumbs in the middle leaning up.
nf:
I love root beer, but I am dreading this one a bit. Our soda energy drink experiences have been quite shitty thus far. This smells closer to black licorice than root beer.

Actually? Not bad! Tastes a lot like diet root beer. Worse than regular root beer? Yes, absolutely. But all diet root beer generally is, and that tastes fine. This is WAY better than the diabolical cola drinks we have had. If you poured this out and covered the glass (because it’s clear) and said this was Diet Barq’s, I would probably believe you. Hot diggity, what a surprise. Subsequent sips don’t reveal any nastiness that I initially missed either. NOW, with all that said (including the fact that I’m a root beer guy), this is more an admirable recreation than a great energy drink. I would take a lot of the flavors we’ve had over this. But between this and a Diet Barq’s? I might pinch the BUM.

A Shocking Surprise!

name: Reign TBF Melon Mania
msl: This smells like what it is named.  I was so happy with yesterdays drink I needed more MELON in my life.  This is not as good as that on the first taste - but it is a strong flavor.  It has this weird TANG hit in it, that I think I like.  Kind of sour.  But definitely not living up to yesterdays masterpiece.  WITH THAT SAID - it doesn’t feel like some heavy “i am going to die if I drink too much of this” drink either.  On the third sip - yeah I think I like this a lot.  Now the big one:  BOY it is kinda weird when ya slosh it around in your mouth.  But my overall vibes from this one are positive.  Another fun one from REIGN.
nf: Mystery drink for me. My guess from my sniff is Freedom Ice but we’ll see…Ok that’s definitely watermelon and closer to the flavor I expected yesterday. It’s not bad, but it’s not great. I’m not a huge watermelon guy in the first place, but that isn’t really so much the issue. It’s hard to describe, but in my mind’s eye I see a watermelon flavor surrounded by a moat of our old friend Energy Drink Flavor in my mind’s eye. You get the melon in the middle of the flavor profile surrounded by that energy drunkenness. It’s also just not a strong watermelon flavor in most senses of the word. Certainly not a bad drink, but to me it’s probably a back half of the list-drink.

name: GHOST Energy Original
msl:
This drink is a mystery to me.  Clear but also pretty cloudy.  It smells pleasantly sweet, like candy sweet.  Don’t think we have every single drink in the fridge listed, so I can’t even hazard a guess to what it is.  But if it tastes as good as it smells, I’ll be happy.  

OK well I was way off on this being a candy one, because this is GHOST ORIGINAL.  I assumed ORIGINAL would be just “our take on the Red Bull base” but that’s not what this is. I feel like it’s got a vanilla citrus flavoring but it is also kind of sour?  It’s hard to tell.  I kinda dig it, but I also am not like “WOW THIS IS GOOD.”  It’s a little too sweet for my palette, I feel like I need something stronger to counter whatever it is that I think might be vanilla.  But I liked this enough that I was able to down my entire glass.  So that says something.

I don’t know if I would willingly get this again, but it is by no means unpleasant.  It’s just not the flavor for me!  Thumbs in the middle.
nf:
Our drink today is clear with some cloudiness to it. It has a sweet smell, and if I didn’t know what it was I would be stumped.

That’s a plain, sour drink. Very appropriate for “Original” which in fact is not a Red Bull/Nos/Amp-style gasoline-adjacent thing, but moreso the white Monster. The label is very evocative of that, and it seems to exist to both poach the kinds of people that worship at the altar of that product, but also be used as a base. Sure enough, the copy on the website says “this event, festival, and bar exclusive flavor speaks for itself and is crushable for any occasion. Rock it with your favorite mixer or enjoy solo.“ Well, ok, I think I got it at a gas station, which I suppose with today’s prices is an event. With that context, it definitely is capital-F Fine, but definitely seems like it is missing something. This is almost certainly on purpose so it doesn’t fuck with the alcohol or club drugs it is supposed to go with. I would sum this up as a perfectly cromulent citrus-type drink that leans a little towards lemon, and unless you are at some EDM thing where you can crush Ritalin into it, you can find better citrus drinks at your local events, bars, festivals, and gas stations. 

By the way, naming the like, 30th released drink “Original” is like a band self-titling their 8th album.

name: Gorilla Mind Berry Burst
msl: This one has a bit of a tint to it, and has a VERY pleasant smell.  If I had to predict, I think I might say Strawberry Splash.  It smells RED.  But we’ll see.  It has a delicious berry taste!  A bit sour on the first sip.  I’m trying to figure out what the flavor exactly is, but I’m struggling.  It tastes really nice though.  I dunno if it’s just a mix of berries like Blue and Black or what.  I don’t really eat either of them so I just can’t put my finger on it.  As I continue to take sips, the immediate tarty/sour flavor that I tasted on the first sip is being replaced by something more sweet and refreshing.  I don’t know if I think this is an AMAZING flavor or anything like that, but it definitely is what I would call “tasty!”  Basically, just another strong flavored drink from Gorilla Mind.  This one is leaving a bit of a tingling underneath my tongue and an aftertaste that is taking a bit to go away…but it’s not medicinal.  So that’s good.  One final big gulp - yeah.  It’s pretty good.  Not my favorite.  But not bad.
nf:
This was supposed to be a mystery for Matt, but I think he saw the can. OH WELL! He claims he didn’t but I know better.

First sips reveal a nice, tart flavor with a bit of sour. I’d say blue raspberry, but this is definitely not only blue raspberry. It has what looks like blueberries on the can, which I guess I could see. I’d say it’s a bit of a mixed berry taste. I would say it’s not as good as many of the other blue drinks we’ve had, as the taste seems to land as blue raspberry at first, but the sour taste doesn’t “climb” like the better ones do, it seems to wear off quite quickly. I think you could do better looking for a blue drink.

name: Fusion Energy Galactic Citrus
msl:
Light piss tint in a clear drink is back. Smells somewhat citrus-y. But not overwhelmingly so. This is a mystery to NF.

This is weird bc if I had no reference for what this was called, I would struggle to figure out what it is. There’s a small tint of citrus here. Not ultra tangy. Very mellow. I don’t really know what type of fruit it is they chose, but I’m assuming like - Oranges. When I look at the actual PR photo of this drink being released, it is sitting next to cut Lemon and Lime. So I guess it’s trying to be a SPRITE/7-UP. Which, now that I see that, I can absolutely TASTE it also. Criminy, that’s what this is, isn’t it? Even the can is Green. I’m a dope. Comparing it to a Lemon/Lime soda, I would say it did a great job hitting that flavor. Much more so than the ripoff Coke energy drinks we’ve had. Though I would also say you would probably do better with just a can of Sprite.

As I continued to drink this, I felt it was tasty. If you offered me another I’d have one. Would ask if I could just have one of the regular sodas, though. Easy finish.
nf:
We got a pisser!!! A slight pisser. Like somebody that’s consumed a bunch of water but not quite enough. Gonna guess White Gummy Deer.

Nice sip. Very much a citrus drink. I can’t really place what KIND of citrus - it’s definitely got some hints of lemon, maybe some lime in there, perhaps some orange - but it’s good. The taste is pretty slight, but it’s enough to not be completely forgettable. It’s the kind of drink that I could mindlessly sip on while at a computer, but not something I’d be excited about grabbing. Perfectly fine!

name: BUM Energy Blueberry Lemonade
msl:
We are in the month of December, and I think this is a grape flavor. I think it’s Amin.O Grape to throw me off the scent of NF asking me to add the Gorilla Minds to the list. But I would not be surprised if it’s like, Mango Peach. I dunno. I can’t tell what it is, the smell isn’t ultra strong. It’s nice though. Clear drink. Lots of liquid. Now that I think about it, no way this is Amin.O because of the amount of drink in my glass.

I have taken a drink and I can’t decipher it at all. I can not believe this is Blueberry Lemonade, I was way the fuck off. On second sip, OK. I taste the lemon. It’s crazy how your brain works when you’re expecting something to taste like one thing but it doesn’t taste like it at all but you’re still trying to convince yourself it can’t be that flavor….ok I’m all over the place.

I can taste the Lemon, but it’s not a particularly strong lemony taste. As far as the Blueberry goes, I guess it’s maybe being watered down with that flavor - but in reality it just kinda tastes like a flat lemon drink instead. Flat-ish. It’s really not bad. It’s just kinda like, shrug, this is OK? I don’t want to just be an echo for what NF is saying, but I do think he’s right about the Sprite flavor. Though I don’t know if I’d say it doesn’t feel carbonated, it just seems like it’s missing something and isn’t as strong.

This is something I can easily finish. It’s inoffensive, but nothing about it is truly great or even all that good. It’s just an OK energy drink. I wouldn’t get this one again. Thumbs purely in the middle for me.
nf:
Strong scent on today’s drink. I like it. Will it translate to taste???????????? We’ll find out in a matter of a paragraph break.

Ah that ain’t bad. It’s definitely a much stronger lemon taste than blueberry. Kinda tastes like Sprite without the carbonation. Not like a flat Sprite, though, it’s like if they had the formula from the start without carbonation. I will say that there is a sour note that kinda spikes while drinking it that I’m not a huge fan of, but otherwise this is a nice little drink from BUM. Probably somewhere in low B/high C, although I personally think the smaller can size may give it extra points, as this is a drink I’d be fine with in this smaller batch vs. the usual tall boy size most energy drinks come in. Solid!

name: Oxyshred Ultra Energy Bahama Breeze
msl:
This is another mystery for me. Doesn’t seem like a HUEL, the smell isn’t that strong. Oxyshred is also generally a strong smell, so I don’t think it’s that. I’m assuming this is Wylin Watermelon, even though it’s not super strong smelling, and I get no hint of Watermelon in it..

This is an Oxyshred! I’m floored! Bahama breeze. And I can tell you immediately that this is easily the best one we’ve ever had. It does still have that somewhat medicinal taste to it, but I do get a nice hint of pineapple and coconut. There is definitely something else in here though. Don’t have any fucking clue what it is, and I’m not sure if that’s just “oxyshred flavor”. It’s a little funky, and bold. I kind of like it? Looking it up, apparently it might be cranberry? Who knows. This feels like an Oxyshred I can finish. It’s just pretty darn tasty.

A very strong showing from a brand that was previously our least favorite. They are definitely making a move to distinguish themselves from HUEL. Thumbs…up?
nf:
I am declining to tell Matt whether or not today’s drink is the last Huel, but he believes it isn’t. We shall see.

Hey, not bad! Not bad at all. One sip and this is EASILY the best Oxyshred we’ve had. It’s a semi-strong pina colada flavor without any of the usual Oxyshred bullshit. No funky tastes or smells. Incredible. S-tier Oxyshred, at the very least. Here I was, all ready to call this Bahama Bust or Bahama Bullshit or something, and Oxyshred actually gets their shit together on a drink. I think there are better pina colada drinks we’ve had, but I’m so shocked that this is good. I may be overrating it in the moment, but I think it’s legitimately decent.. So while I’d recommend other drinks over this, I have to give Oxyshred props. “Their flowers,” if you may.

name: Gorilla Mind White Gummy Bear
msl:
This is yet another mystery drink for me and I think it is either Gorilla White Gummy Bear or Rockstar PUNCHED Pineapple. I’m sure it’ll be another example of how fucked my sense of smell is when I don’t know what something is. Clear drink with a slight piss tint.

OK so this is White Gummy Bear and boy is this first impression really weird. Like most White Gummy Bear flavors, it leans towards a pineapple/citrus flavor. After I swallow I get this tingly sugar sensation on the back of my tongue. OK wait on the next few sips I think that's just "tangy" flavor. Hah. This one is really hard to describe because my feelings of it are so all over the place. It's like... it FEELS chemically, but generally when I say that I mean "fucking garbage" - but this is NOT that. On one hand, I don't think it's my favorite Gorilla Mind flavor but I am also racing for more and more sips and think I really like it? The more I sip the more I think it's a High C tier. I apologize for this review being all over the place and not very succinct in my end, but it's just a tough one. I'm gonna just say NO SHITTY AFTERTASTE - DID FINISH - THUMBS IN THE MIDDLE.... LEANING UP???
nf:
Tinted By The Fruit of Another is how I’d describe the look of this drink. Because there’s only so many ways to say yellowish clear. Smells like fruit, if you can imagine.

I gotta confess if I haven’t already - I don’t really remember what white gummy bears taste like. I know what white gummy bear energy drinks taste like and it’s….about this. It’s a sweet pineapple-ish flavor that’s closer to candy or a popsicle than the real thing. I will say I think I like this more than the other WGBs, but it might just be I’m prepared for the taste by now. But ultimately I think they just loaded this up with chemicals that approximate sweetness to make it pleasant. There is a spot in the middle when it’s in your mouth where it creates this odd sensation that I can’t describe, almost like it’s peaking in sweetness and becoming too sweet. Odd’s the word for this. It’s good, but only so good. Probably among the best of the White Gummy Bears we’ve had imo though.

name: BUCKED UP Miami
msl:
A couple days off, but we’re back, and I’m having NF choose the mystery drink for me today. In my hands now - clear drink. VERY strong Peach smell. Maybe this is the Pineapple cream? I don’t KNOW.

It’s BUCKED UP MIAMI. NOT the flavor I would have expected for one of these. Very fruity. Mango or Peach - I dunno - probably some pineapple in there. Not sure. But it’s a tropical juice flavored drink. And honestly? Not so bad. These haven’t really been our favorites but I think I enjoy them more than NF, and I think this one is pretty refreshing. Kinda feels like this should have some alcohol in it on a nice Friday Afternoon, I dunno.

This is a completely fine tropical drink flavor. A thumbs up from me. Don’t really have anything bad to say about it other than it’s just not my personal favorite flavors. But I can also see myself having this specific one again. So a good job from BUCKED UP imo.

PS: No shitty aftertaste or gross acidic mouthfeel.
nf:
My thoughts upon smelling this drink: “Oh, another one of THESE.” Smells tropical.

Yeah, it’s another one of those. You can taste the pineapple, a bit of strawberry? It’s not terrible, but these generally aren’t really my thing, but I will concede that this is one of the better ones. Opinions on the flavor seem all over the place online, but the official copy from Walmart says “strawberry, mango, and pineapple” which yeah, I can see. I really don’t dig pineapple, as it has this kinda bleh stinger when you sip it, but I think the strawberry is helping out here a bit. A perfectly fine One of Those.

name: Reign TBF Cherry Limeade
msl:
So I am just waking up from my iconic post work nap. I’m a bit tired. This is a clear mystery drink. This smells like either Cherry Limeade or it’s one of the Jolly Rancher ones, I think. Let’s find out.

This one is interesting. I’ve had a few Cherry Limeade flavors by this point, and something about this one just isn’t hitting the mark. I think in a lot of the CHERRY LIMEADE flavors we’ve had before, the Cherry kind of overwhelms the Lime. The Lime in this drink though seems to be trying to meet the Cherry 50/50, and while that might be ideal and “correct” for a flavor like this, I just kind of like Cherry significantly more than I like Lime. So it’s not hitting me like I’d hope. It’s certainly not even close to what Ghost Cherry Limeade felt like.

Having let it sit for a bit before taking my next sip, it definitely isn’t a bad drink or flavor. There is a lime-aftertaste though that I’m just not down with. Despite my words probably leading you to think the opposite, I think in my mind, this a THUMBS IN THE MIDDLE LEANING UP drink. It’s really not bad. Just not at all what I was hyping it up to be in my mind.
nf:
I have chosen the drink today, and it smells mostly like what I’d expect. It is clear.

Tastes like artificial cherry flavor. Wow, right? We’ve had so many drinks that taste more like authentic cherry lately and…I think I might like that better? At least better than the execution here. It’s just a little too sickly sweet. There isn’t really any sour or tartness to counter balance it, and I can’t say I really detect much, if any, lime. That seems to be the downfall of a lot of cherry limeade flavors, where they just taste like an OK cherry drink without much else going for it. I’m guessing I’d probably prefer this to the worst cherry limeade, as it isn’t a bad drink, but it’s unmemorable in a sea of superior options both of the straight up cherry and cherry limeade varieties. Interesting that C4 and Reign - our two top ranked brands - seem to have both missed the mark on cherry limeade. Nobody’s invincible!

name: RYSE Fuel Baja Cooler
msl:
It’s a mystery for me today. Clear drink. My first sniff immediately smells like Sprite, or a citrus soda. So I’m assuming it’s kinda like Dew. And i’m assuming that’s kinda like Baja Blast. So I’m assuming this is RYSE FUEL Baja Cooler. That is my prediction.

Tastes like Lime. And I was correct! It’s a good Lime Flavor but not an overwhelming amount of it. I don’t think any lemons are in this, but it tastes like a Sprite that is missing an ingredient. I’m not really crazy about JUST LIME flavor but this is actually pretty good and pretty refreshing. You get just enough of the flavor you are looking for. It’s not punching you in the face, but you feel like you’re getting exactly what you want. Maybe this is just a review of my own personal tolerance of LIME FLAVOR. If this is just what SPRITE tasted like, yeah I could see myself drinking a lot of it when I was a kid. I could see myself grabbing more cans of this. But this is not SPRITE and we are not in that universe. This is all a roundabout way of saying THUMBS IN THE MIDDLE LEANING UP. I like it. It’s good. Easy finish. But not fantastic.
nf: Smells and tastes like lime, just as the can advertises. It tastes about what you’d expect, kinda like a mix between off-brand Sprite and off-brand Mountain Dew. Off-brand ain’t necessarily a bad thing (we’ve had drinks in the A tier and above that you could apply that label to), but I’d rather have one of those instead. This isn’t bad, but it is a bit one note. It’s just LIME. Sweet lime. That’s really all it is. Some flavors can’t survive on their own, particularly if they’re a mix of sweet and sour, but this just goes the sweet route and settles on it. It does the concept well, but there’s only so much I can say about a drink that’s just lime.

name: Gorilla Mind Lychee Bomb
msl:
This got that like “this is mango or some shit” smell. Tropical. Which makes me think this is like… Lychee Bomb? Maybe? I don’t know. It’s a mystery to me. Slight tint. EXTREMELY strong smell.

This tastes interesting. Strong flavor, though I’m not totally sure what. It’s juicy. Honestly, I actually think I kind of like it. I’m just learning that “Lychee” is an actual fruit, so this is I assume LYCHEE flavored. I’m having a hard time describing a fruit that I’ve never had before, but the more I drink it, I will say the more I’m actually really enjoying it. It goes down very smooth, there is no crazy aftertaste, and it’s just…refreshing. No bitter flavors here. No sour. Maybe a bit tangy? It just tastes like “Tropical Juice”. I don’t know how it compares to the actual fruit, I think I’ve made that clear, but I think this is a winner in my eyes and I think I absolutely would have one of these again. It’s interesting, and I like it. That’s all I can really say.
nf:
Smells like pineapple/tropical. I’m guessing that is on the mark but frankly I’m not sure.

Tastes…odd. Like tropical punch but if you deleted some of the flavor. Which I guess makes sense, as punch is a MIXTURE and this presumably is just one fruit I’ve never had before. As such, this could be 100% nailing the flavor in a way we have not experienced before and I have no clue. As it is as a drink…it kinda reminds me of Red Bull, maybe with a hint of apple. As such, I’m not really a fan but I don’t have pitchforks out. It’s just a drink I’d rather not have again.

name: C4 Midnight Cherry
msl: MIDNIGHT.  Ok let’s go.  That’s a cherry drink.  I like it.  Feels more energy drinky than cherry flavor.  But it’s good.  It’s really, really hard for us to rank any cherry drinks at this point because the first thing we ever drank was the Starburst Cherry - and the amount of flavor that one had was insane.  But this is pretty damn good, and I like it a lot.
nf: “Ooh. I like that.” - my first sip. It’s definitely not as good as the top ones, but it’s still something I’d drink if offered to me. It’s got a very good cherry flavor that isn’t too strong - might even be a smidge weak - but still hits the right notes. It’s missing the sour punch that the best have, but I like it. It’s almost like a Diet or Lite version of Starburst Cherry for people who think the latter is too strong.

name: Full Throttle Original Citrus
msl:
Heyyy NF just got home and just cracked open a drink and brought me it. It is YELLOW. And it smells like Citrus. Not exactly sure what we still have in there outside of like 3 drinks so maybe it’s “Wild Orchard” but IDK. Let’s find out!!!

Woah that’s strong. It has a pineapple feeling on my mouth but also i might get some peach? Or maybe it’s just an extra citrus-y dew, I don’t know. There’s nothing really wrong with it, but I can tell you right away that this isn’t the type of flavor I go for. After a few more sips I think I am gonna double down on it kind of has the feeling of a juicy pineapple, but not the taste at all. Which I don’t know if I really like all that much.

There’s a lingering citrus taste that lasts after. It’s fine. I dunno, it’s not all that great to me. I think this would be one that I could finish, had I not downed a whole thing of apple cider beforehand. I am gonna cut myself off. This is just…thumbs in the middle. Did not finish, but could. .

POST DRINK NOTE - Now that I know the history I would probably have said “oh full throttle is my fav” when it comes to energy drinks if I did this in like 2004
nf:
Gettin back in the swang of thangs!!!! Yeah!!! WOO!!!! Rhythm!

What we have here is a neon green/yellow liquid. It smells fruity.

This looks like Mountain Dew and…it does kinda taste like it. Owing to its full government name, “Full Throttle Original Citrus,” this is indeed a citrus drink. It’s quite strong as well, but it’s kind of an odd duck.The flavor goes in and out like a sine wave. One second you’re getting full, strong juicy citrus, and then one second you’re tasting that Energy Drink Twang. Full Throttle is one of the forefathers of energy drinks in America, debuting all the way in the year of Lost, Nintendo DS, Team America, and the unfortunately canceled World Series, whatever happened there. So you expect the bullshit, especially with something called “Full Throttle.” I wouldn’t have been surprised if this was literal gasoline (petrol for our international friends). The fact that it actually tastes decent a good ⅔ of the time is a shocker. Probably in the upper echelon of “wouldn’t go out of my way for it but would take if offered” for me. Vroom vroom!

name: Reign TBF Sour Gummy Worm
msl: Lately I’m the one giving NF all the mysteries… this is a clear drink.  It’s got a smell that matches the flavor to me.  Though I’m not sure how this will taste.  Oh that’s strong!  Sour, though somehow also not as sour as some of our recent SOUR drinks. I’m gonna be honest, if I was biting into a sour gummy worm, I’m not really sold on this being what the taste would feel like in liquid form.  I kind of get the taste of that…outer portion with all the sour dust.  But that’s about it.  This isn’t bad at all.  Is it refreshing?  Somewhat.  The idea of sour candy drinks are interesting to me in general, because this isn’t for kids.  It’s not a flavor I’d rush to for a refresher.  Is it just “i wanna get pumped up to do some energy, with my candy drink???”  I dunno.  Thinking a bit too hard about it tbh.  It’s tasty.  I like it.  If it was the only thing in the fridge, I’d drink it no problem.  That’s about what I can say.
nf: I have a guess or two based on the smell but I’m not 100% confident. OK it is one of the two I thought it might be, but I’m not sure I get “sour gummy worm” from it at all. Or sour, really. Sweet and tasty? Yes. Sour? Not really. This is a tough grade because I think it tastes good, but I think it’s also unremarkable and doesn’t really match the flavor pitch. I feel like when you’re doing such a gimmick flavor it really has to nail the essence of what you are going for even if it is good. We have orange creams and bomb pop drinks that taste fine that rank lower than the taste would indicate because they don’t nail the gimmick. If it were given to me, I’d drink it, but I wouldn’t go out of my way for it because I wouldn’t get the sour gummy worm flavor I’d be after.

name: bang Energy Star Blast
msl: This smells really nice.  NF knows it’s a BANG but not which one.  Oh wait yes he does.  He predicted very easily.  WOW.  This has WAY MORE flavor than I thought it would have - but also not the exact ***flavor*** i thought it was going to be.  I dunno if I was expecting something close to Razzleberry or what.  I don’t really know WHAT this flavor is, but it is strong.  I feel like maybe I get a hint of strawberry here.  It somewhat reminds me of the Gorilla, just very sweet and candy ish.  I wouldn’t say it’s as tasty as that, but it certainly is as STRONG.  I feel like it has to be strawberry mixed with something.  But I don’t know what that other flavor is.  Kiwi maybe?  It’s been too long since I had a kiwi.  Either way, I was expecting more BLUE flavor, not Red.  This is a pleasant drink.  Not my favorite in the flavor department, but I can respect it a lot.  Would I have it again?  …Yes.  Though I think I’d prefer just strawberry.
nf: Smells sweet. I guessed correctly. Well it’s sweet, very flavorful, some tartness. Can’t really put my finger on what the flavor is, and I don’t LOVE it. It’s not bad though. The packaging suggested a bomb pop kind of thing and it decidedly is not that. There’s a strawberry flavor in there that’s good but not as good as Gorilla Mind or C4. A bit of energy drink bitterness at the end. “Star Blast” kinda makes it sound like they’re going for Starburst but don’t sue us bro kind of thing, so my guess is they are going for Strawberry Starburst, which as our rankings go is shooting very high. They didn’t totally nail it, but an honorable effort.

name: C4 Ultimate WWE Ruthless Raspberry
msl: A very strong smell and a pretty strong taste!  Definitely more flavor and punch than the WWE Berry Powerbomb - but not as much as our Starburst Cherry.  Nothing has beaten that.  The flavor is nice, has a hint of sour to it but I still like it.  Not sure if I like the *flavor* more than some previous entries though.
nf: The packaging for this is blue, so I expected blue raspberry. But as it turns out, it is actually just raspberry ass raspberry and not a fake variety. It does have a slight sour kick that Popsicle Grape lacks. Not as strong as Starburst Cherry’s, but it’s there. I’m not a huge raspberry guy, but I could really see someone that is liking this. As it is, it’s just ok. Fuck Bruce Pritchard

name: Reign TBF White Gummy Bear
msl: OK.  This smells ultra citrusy.  I'm guessing before I know what it is that it's the Limeade.  Let's try it.  THAT'S STRONG!  I can't immediately place the flavor, but I am being told it's the White Gummy Bear and yes - I can instantly taste that now that it's been said to me.  I'm also told that that's Pineapple - and yes.  I can instantly taste that now that it's been said to me.  It's tasty!  I like it.  It definitely has a bit of that ENERGY flavor on the first sip, but as I kept drinking I didn't notice it as much.  I like Pineapple a lot, so it's no surprise I like this, but carbonated Pineapple drink just feels weird to me.  I think I would honestly drink this one again.  It's strong.  But I dunno if I'm gonna be seeking it out.  A nice pineapple drink.  But definitely not my fav.
nf: Not sure what to expect with this one. I have my ideas, but I’m not confident in them. Well I don’t dislike it but even knowing what the branded flavor is…I can’t really tell what it is? I’m not really a gummy bear aficionado, so I assume it’s like lemon? A Google search indicates it is in fact pineapple. I suppose I can see that, or rather taste it. It’s by no means a bad flavor, I do like it a bit, but it’s pretty unremarkable. The last pineapple drink we had, C4 Popsicle Hawaiian Pineapple, had a really ugly metallic taste that this lacks. It’s definitely an improvement but imo nothing special.

name: BUCKED UP White Gummy Deer
msl:
Today is a mystery for NF because I’m impatient. This one smells like what it is, but I know for a fact I wouldn’t know which it was if NF chose it. Clear drink.

Has a sort of maybe pineapple like taste but it also tastes kinda POWDERY… That texture is immediately what I notice as I start to swallow. Like, that cool refreshing gulp has a mix of just swallowing a sweet tart or something like that. I can tell you right off the bat I don’t think this one is as good as the REIGN version of this drink, but it’s also really not that bad. It is though, however, like I’ve said about many other drinks, not much to write home about. Inoffensive. Could go with it, could go without it. Might just prefer some Pineapple juice.
nf:
M thinks I should be able to guess what this is, but it smells very fruity and could be a number of drinks. I am going to guess Jolly Rancher Watermelon.

OK, that is NOT watermelon, and if the branding is watermelon someone fucked up. But it turns out it was my first guess that I eschewed, White Gummy Deer. I assume it contains no actual deer, but I don’t have the can in front of me. It doesn’t taste bad, quite good, but it’s also kind of anonymous. It’s just Sweet Fruity Flavor. That works in a vacuum, but in something like this it will only get so far. The positives are that there’s no bitterness, it’s quite refreshing, very smooth. I dunno if I’d call this pineapple. I think I like this better than Reign’s attempt, but not dramatically so. We’ll see in the rankings. Fine work.

name: bang Energy Rainbow Unicorn
msl:
Oh this smells disgustingly sweet. Tropical, and I wonder if this is MONSTER RIO PUNCH or SOUR WATERMELON. Not sure.

Honestly that’s not so bad. Juicy. APPARENTLY THIS IS…RAINBOW UNICORN? When the drink was handed to me part of me thought “oh sweet, must be that” but when NF said “tropical” i instantly sensed it and thought there was no way. I don’t really know what exactly RAINBOW UNICORN is trying to go for, to the point that I need to do a search and see if this is just an insane mislabeled flavor.

As it is, I do get a hint of Watermelon smell/flavor. I have no idea what they threw in with the Watermelon, but it’s there. It’s a pleasant sip, a sweet taste, there’s a little - TINY TINY TINY bit of bitterness on the roof of my mouth as well. I actually think it’s quite refreshing. Like, if there was a giant pitcher of this, and it wasn’t full of CREATINE or whatever, I could see myself being like “Yes! More!” when it empties out. This is actually…one of my favorite BANG’s I think? I wish it was slightly bolder, and gave me a bit more PUNCH in every sip, but as it is this is just tasty. They did a good job with this one, though I think the name “Rainbow Unicorn” does not inspire the thought of THIS being the flavor at all. When I think RAINBOW UNICORN - I think fucking BIRTHDAY CAKE type frosting, you know? Not WATERMELON. Why the fuck is this called RAINBOW UNICORN? “bang” doesn’t really give us a description on its website of exactly what it was going for outside of “Delicious Fruity Flavors”. Well. OK. I guess it was fruity. But the name is still stupid for something like this.

One of the most mismatched/misleading names for a flavor we’ve ever had, but a good drink.
nf:
This smells quite tropical, which I did not expect in the slightest.

Not bad, but definitely tastes like tropical punch of some kind. Less of the strawberry/cherry and more of the pineapple-y flavor. Maybe some watermelon? Not exactly what I expected from “Rainbow Unicorn,” which definitely sounded more like it’d be a super sweet kinda thing. It is certainly sweet, but more “adult” sweet and less of the “kids rotting their teeth out” variety. I assume this is just one of those scenarios where they shoved a ton of flavors into a vat and instead of it ending up “like a rainbow” it ended up closer to dirty snow. It isn’t awful. It’s inoffensive, truly, but to me this is a disappointment and not what was expected based on the name.

name: GOAT Fuel Watermelon Fruit Punch
msl:
GOAT FUEL has 3 flavors that I know of. Two of them sound incredibly unappetizing. This one though? This is fine. I like Watermelon and I like Fruit Punch. This one isn’t clear, has a tint to it that reminds me of iced tea. Smells like Fruit Punch. The previous GOAT surprised me. I hope this one is just as surprisingly tasty.

Yeah that’s a fruit punch…with a bit of a medicinal kick after it settles. Second sip not as bad. But I can tell you that first impressions with this one for me aren’t too hot. 3rd bigger sip with a slosh test is pretty good. The Fruit Punch flavor wins out over the Watermelon. But I dunno. This whole thing just tastes like a NOT AS GOOD Fruit Punch. As I continue to drink this, I like it a little more, but it’s just kind of an “Eh!” for me. Unfortunately, not as tasty as the last GOAT. Finished pretty easily though.
nf:
GOAT Fuel is an interesting company because their flavors are at least kinda unconventional combinations. With that said, Watermelon Fruit Punch is easily the most conventional combo of the three we’ve bought, so I’m not expecting anything wild here. It’s got an orange color and smells like what it says on the can.

Yeah that shit just tastes like fruit punch lmao. Barely any watermelon flavoring is noticeable. It’s there somewhere, but you really have to focus. It tastes good, but there’s SO many good fruit punch energy drinks out there that you would have hoped the watermelon could have helped differentiate this, but it’s not really there at all. It’s just a fine little fruit punch that doesn’t do anything new. Not baaaaaaaaaa-d

name: Gorilla Mind Patty's Iced Tea
msl: Holy hell it’s been 3 months. I think I was getting the heebie jeebies about my health a few months back and we hadn’t touched an energy drink since. My fault! But I am feeling better now and I am ready to have some fucking tasty chemicals baby. Let’s gooo!!! We both chose this drink, so no mystery here. Smells like iced tea. Tastes like Iced Tea. I feel like I would prefer it if it was sweeter. It’s not particularly strong, but I think if you handed me this and were just like “Hey man, have some iced tea”, I wouldn’t at all question if you were telling the truth. Though I’d think it needed more punch and probably think “wait why is this extremely clear and slightly yellow?” This is pretty good, but I can’t say it’s really much more than that. Probably won’t ever have it again. Thumbs in the middle. Leaning up? Sure. Nothing’s wrong with it, just not doing anything crazy for me. I did finish.
nf: It’s been 87 years since our last review. More accurately, 3 months. We got this can about 5 months ago if my message history is right. Woof! Abdication of duty. There’s no mystery here at all. It’s called Patty’s Iced Tea. It’s iced tea with an endorsement from that one Patty girl that’s a buff gym influencer. Don’t remember the full name, won’t look it up. Tastes! Like! Iced! TEAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Can you believe it? It wears off after a few seconds, but what is there tastes like your standard lemon iced tea. The lemon is not super strong, and being that this isn’t being called Sweet Tea, I shant ding them for a lack of sweetness. It’s Iced Tea approved for gym bros and girlies. I’m more of an Arnold Palmer kind of guy rather than a full on iced tea guy, but we’ve had tea/lemonade mix energy drinks that are way worse than this. Totally unremarkable, but we’ve had a lot of drinks that fall well below that. Good drink for iced tea fans or those not looking for a flavor explosion. We haven’t had any straight Iced Teas, so if you want a similar taste with more flavor I’d recommend BUM Energy Iced Tea Lemonade.

name: BUM Energy Citrus Blast
msl:
WELCOME TO BUM WEEK. WHERE MONDAY THROUGH FRIDAY WE ARE GOING THROUGH ALL 5 BUM ENERGY’S WE HAVE IN THE FRIDGE. Today we are starting with XYZ and I gotta tell ya, this nice clear lookin’ drink smells just like that.

This is Sprite with 5x the calories. Not an exact carbon copy of Sprite, but if you handed me and told me that’s what it was…….well. I guess I would second guess it. It’s not nearly as flavorful as a Sprite. I might ask if it’s Diet or a dif brand. In the midst of drinking this, NF started reading the description of this drink from the website - and the voice reminded me of the YJ Stinger ads. So the both of us just started talking about YJ Stinger and how we will never be able to try one. Unfortunate.

Anyway. This is a Lemon/Lime drink. A lesser Sprite. Very, very, very, very similar to Fusion Galactic Citrus, though I would say definitely worse. Kind of a meh aftertaste when you take a big swig. Easy finish.
nf:
I cannot tell what today’s flavor is, to M’s shock and horror. It just don’t smell like nothin’!

I guessed Citrus Blast and that’s what this is, a lemon lime drink. The colors on the can clearly indicate this is going for Sprite and it definitely tastes similar, albeit with less carbonation. I would say it is something like a Sprite Zero, given its sugar free formula, so it’s missing the bite that traditional Sprite has. As it is, it’s a decent but unmemorable citrus drink that doesn’t do much for me. Bummer!

name: BUM Energy Orange Sunrise
msl:
This one is a mystery for NF. Clear drink. Orangey smell. As we start to hit the end of our backlog of drinks, we seem to be approaching a BUM WEEK where all we have left is BUM ENERGY. And what better way to celebrate BUM WEEK than by having a BUM ENERGY before BUM WEEK. (Bum Week not officially discussed or planned).

Hey! That’s Orange Soda! Tastes pretty good. I dunno if I’d say it’s better than your average CRUSH/SUNKIST Orange Soda but, it’s Orange Soda. When it comes to some of the other COLA drinks I think NF & I have been harsh on them, because it feels like they have no reason to exist. I think Orange Soda flavor is still good…but we’re cutting it close!!! Because I don’t really know exactly what it is what I can say about this other than “it tastes like Orange Soda.” I’d like if maybe this one packed a bit more OOMPH in the flavor but other than that… this is just an easy finish. Thumbs…up?
nf:
Can’t tell what exactly the smell is so we’ll just have to dive in and see.

Yeah, still no idea what that is. Was about to say “maybe orange?” because that is the closest thing I could taste. This kinda reminds me of something like Orangina. A very light orange flavor with some carbonation. This is the kind of light touch I would expect more from Celsius, but maybe Bum is going for a softer touch in general? We don’t really have enough evidence due to only having three of the flavors thus far, with one being a lighter flavor and the other being suitable. So we’ll have to see! Anyway, meh.

“That was the worst BUM we’ve ever had. That was a shitty bum!!!”

name: Monster Energy Ultra Fantasy Ruby Red
msl:
I chose this one. Mystery to NF - but I think it’s fairly obvious. Very pink. L.O.L (Lots of Liquid). Smell is honestly not what I would hope for and makes me think “eeech….”

Honestly, it tastes more CITRUS than anything else, which is surprising to me. It kinda has a grapefruit smell/vibe to it, which is really not what I was expecting when I grabbed this can. Grapefruit isn’t really a flavor I ever have (I know, I feel like this is becoming a pattern), so I don’t really have many strong feelings about this one other than “This is alright!”. There is no offensive aftertaste. The flavor isn’t STRONG but i’d say it’s refreshing and pleasant. But it’s also not really making me feel any strong emotions at all. Like - this is a perfectly fine juicy drink with whatever chemicals added to it that you search for in your energy drinks. Not bad. Not great. Just kinda meh.
nf:
Pink Drink. Three candidates for this one, but I can’t really smell anything.

Kinda tastes like lemonade? Definitely citrus. Ruby red is a kind of grapefruit, so I assume that is what they are going for, but the website doesn’t mention grapefruit at all, so maybe they don’t even realize it’s a grapefruit. It’s sweet and tart, but also kinda boring tbh. There’s nothing here that is terrible, but it’s also missing anything interesting. No zing, no pop, no wowie zowie. Perfectly mediocre.

name: C4 Ultimate Freedom Ice
msl: This one smells like freedom.  Also it’s pink.   Instantly hit with a strong bit of flavor.  Tastes like someone melted one of those rocket pops and poured it right into my mouth.  Maybe not as cold though.  It definitely has a good taste, but something about it almost tastes metallic to me.  I don’t know if that’s a proper phrase tbh.  Maybe it’s because I’m taking a drink of this right after I just did a bunch of work - but it just doesn’t seem as…REFRESHING.  But it isn’t bad either.  As I take more sips I’m wondering if that METALLIC flavor I described is just ENERGY DRINK.  I don’t know.  Good, but probably not something I’ll go out of my way to try again unless some dang fireworks are going off and I’m feeling festive.
nf: This is another Troops drink, with the appropriate red white and blue that Mango Foxtrot  I had been thinking it’s Rocket Pop flavored. But now I’m not so sure between the smell and the pinkish hue of the drink (DO ask, DO tell, folks!) OK yeah it tastes like a rocket pop. It’s another One of Those, which I like, but it’s weaker than Frozen Bombsicle, the gold standard of rocket pop drinks. If it’s your first bomb pop energy drink, you’ll probably really dig it. As it is, I like it but don’t love it. A little too subtle, not enough kick, and there’s sips I’m not even sure the flavor is rocket pop.

name: C4 Grape Frost
msl: I feel like instantly that this one is probably better than the C4 Popsicle Grape - though I gotta say I’m not exactly sure just HOW MUCH better I really think it is.  It also just has that Grape Soda feel.  Nothing too crazy intense.  Just Grape Soda.  And for that I feel like it will be directly OVER the Popsicle Grape in our rankings, though not much further than that.  Tasty though!
nf: Yeah it’s basically a better Grape Popsicle but that’s about it. The first sip I was like “oh this is what Grape Popsicle should be” with a little kick to it that the flat ass Popsicle was missing. But then I kept sipping and it was like “well ok this is a little unremarkable.” Some sips I could barely taste anything. So: A better Grape Popsicle and nothing more.

name: Reign TBF White Haze
msl:
Things are dire here for NF and I as we have learned that the movers we planned on hiring over a week ago did not have us down to move during the window our new place will allow. So we’re frustrated. And it’s time for a drink. This is a foggy drink. I’ve poured the drink for NF so hopefully it’s a good one to help his (warranted) SOUR mood!!!

This tastes very citrus. Which I guess may be what it’s going for. I assumed this was going to be White Gummy Bear / Pineapple, and I guess it is KINDA like that? But at the same time it doesn’t taste as flavorful as the white gummy drinks we’ve had before this. As I do the slosh test…..This is actually kinda crazy - It’s like you’re putting the flavor of CITRUS in your mouth, but it’s citrus mixed with NOTHING? Like you don’t get the wonders of biting into a juicy orange or pineapple. You get the flavor of “This is citrus” - but like nothing else. It’s not bad! It’s just…very unremarkable and leaves me wanting more flavor.
nf:
This drink is as foggy as my current situation and my head. Let’s down this bad boy. Guessing White Haze.

Well that’s largely nothing. Some pleasant citrus taste in the background, but it mostly tasted like nothing. The Reddit energy drink posters suggest this is a dupe of the famed Monster Zero Energy but with twice the caffeine. I guess I can see why that’s such a popular drink and why it’s being ripped off. It’s inoffensive, slightly sweet, slightly sour. It’s a crowd pleaser that only rocks the tastebud boat just so much. But I’m not some low info Zoomer, I’m a connoisseur of energy drinks approaching middle age. I think this is boring. When C4, Gorilla Mind, and yes, Reign are out there kicking ass with bold flavors, this feels just too safe.

name: C4 Ultimate Frost Bitten Citrus
msl:
This has a sweet smell to it. Clear drink. Good amount in my glass so I can cross off one of the drinks on our list. I can’t really gauge what flavor the smell is, but I’m just guessing it’s the BUCKED UP we have because I have no other leads to go on. Obviously, this drink is a mystery to me.

Wow that’s a big punch of flavor. Frost Bitten Citrus!!! I expected this one to have more of a sour or tart flavor, but this isn’t bad at all. The other 2 new C4 drinks really didn’t light our world on fire, but this one seems like the best of that bunch by leaps and bounds. With that said, I don’t know if this is a must have or anything. It’s just not a crushing disappointment.

You definitely get a hint or orange flavor here, not your usual ORANGE SODA or ORANGE JUICE flavoring. It leaves something of an aftertaste on the roof of your mouth, though not an unpleasant one. I don’t have too much really to say - it’s not bad - but I do think we’ve had scores of better orange flavored drinks from other brands before. Even C4. I think this is one I can easily finish and enjoy, but at the same time I’m a little skeeved out by 300 MG of Caffeine in this one, so I’m gonna stop myself.

This is a solid thumbs in the middle. Could, but did not finish.

EDIT: This is a rare instance where I was able to compare this drink to another Orange C4 drink. Thanks to C4 comping us with a pack, we have 11 cans of C4 ORANGE STARBURST just sitting outside the fridge. I cracked one open just to make sure this wasn’t like - a relabeled version of a drink we like a lot more. It was not! The Orange Starburst was superior in every way, even at room temperature. Glad to see I am not crazy.
nf:
Well I just paid something like \$600 to TurboTax and my taxes so I’m in a chipper fucking mood. Hope this is good.

Very flavorful. Very citrus. Good? Yes. Great? No.

OK, I’ll elaborate. It’s got a very nice flavor to it, but it does have a bit of a bitter layer on top that kicks it down a few notches. I would say it’s got a strong orange taste with some other citrus notes. This seems like it could be a really great drink, but the bitterness really does a number. The worst of it is particularly at the end, where the citrus flavor fades but the bitter one doesn’t, like the awkward silence after a bad joke. It just lingers. And keeps lingering. Everyone looks at each other waiting for it to end. Someone finally moves on. But the damage to the mood has been done and it will never come back.

This is the best of the newer C4 Ultimates, but it’s still not amazing and I think the entire batch is beneath C4’s usual output.

name: GHOST Energy Bubblicious Cotton Candy
msl:
It’s another mystery for me! Twice in a row. My immediate thought on this one without even smelling it is that it’s the Bubblicious Cotton Candy. But we will see. It’s a clear drink with just the slightest tint and it… does SMELL sweet. But as we’ve well established by now our brains really don’t work correctly when we don’t know what this stuff is and we convince ourselves it’s something it’s not. Unless it’s very obvious.

Yep! That’s sweet! And then it really kicks in as it’s going down! It definitely is the bubblicious, and I actually really like it. It’s not disgustingly sweet to me, but I can absolutely see this being a little bit intense for someone. But I like my garbage sugar water, and that’s what this is. It’s been a long time since I’ve had bubblicious gum, but when I slosh it along my tongue I definitely get somewhat of that flavoring. But the cotton candy really overwhelms it. I’m now realizing “cotton candy” is probably a flavor of bubblicious - so unfortunately I can’t really compare this to how that itself tastes, but I mean. Ghost tends to nail it with some of these.

Would I say it’s a stellar flavor? Probably not. Do I think I would go out of my way to get another one? Probably not. Do I think this is bad/would I deny it if it was just sitting there, available to me again? No. I think it’s honestly kinda good. Tentative thumbs up even. I finished it. A nice sweet treat. Never felt overwhelming to my tastebuds.

Also because I do this on all drinks now: no shite aftertaste.
nf:
What better way to celebrate America’s Independence and our bodies feeling sore after walking all over the West and East Villages yesterday than with this drink? It smells odd and it has a yellowish tint, as if it’s stale. Hope it tastes better than appearances!

Very sweet. VERY sweet. Too sweet. And not in the good way, like some wrestlers from 10 years ago. I can definitely taste an idea of cotton candy in there. I can see the folks at GHOST taking a sip and being like “Brah we’ve freakin nailed it” because I assume everyone that works at energy drinks are coked out frat boys. But we’ve had some cotton candy drinks - three to be exact - and I know what works. The three we’ve had fit nicely into a Three Bears kinda situation. One is bad, one was meh, one was juuuuuuust riiiiiiight. This fourth one is not quite as wretched as the Oxyshred and likely close to the bang Energy Cotton Candy, which going back to the review indicates I also thought was Too Sweet. Now this being branded with Bubblicious does kinda throw a small wrench into things, because I haven’t had that in awhile and for all I know this absolutely nails the flavor of the gum if not cotton candy itself. But all I can do is just evaluate what I think and I think this is mediocre.

name: Celsius Retro Vibe
msl:
I was pretty certain that this was going to be RED BULL SUGAR FREE but the smell is awfully sweet. Candy like. If I was told this was our Cosmic Rainbow I’d probably think it was that. It’s a light yellow color. I’m salivating here, excited to try it.

It’s another rainbow sherbet drink, and I’m told that this is RETRO VIBE. On the first sip, I gotta tell you I was waiting for the flavoring to overwhelm, but like most celsius drinks we’ve had, that punch of flavor doesn’t really come. You get the lightest bit, and in the blink of an eye, or I guess in this case, when you swallow - it’s just gone. Let it sit and slosh in your cheeks for a bit and the flavor is much stronger. And it’s tasty. It just leaves you wanting more, unfortunately. And I feel like this one is even less than the Sherbet Swirl from Alani Nu we had a couple of days ago.

It’s not a bad drink. This is an easy finish. It may be up there in terms of Celsius flavors, really. They just aren’t ever strong enough for me. Thumbs up? Thumbs in the middle leaning up? I don’t know. If you gave me another one of these I feel like I would be fine having it again. It’s not bad. It’s tasty. I just want more though.

Did finish.
nf:
We are waiting on Matt’s Switch to charge from 0% so we can “transfer” data to the Switch 2. Simply signing into his account and downloading the games is out of the question in 2025, apparently. Anyway we got a drink that I chose today. It resembles Mountain Dew in looks and smells very sweet.

So that tasted like an mediocre attempt to make a rainbow sherbet and to nobody’s surprise it’s the company that markets liquid mediocrity itself behind it. Celsius can’t seem to make any drink without tripping over their dick, even a slam dunk like rainbow sherbet. It smells like rainbow sherbet. At first it tastes like it too. Then you realize “this is way too sweet, even for rainbow sherbet” and then some bitterness kicks in. Celsius is boxing with giants here and they’re forfeiting at the weigh-in. This is a retro vibe in the way we used to have spinning hard drives and dial-up internet.

name: Red Bull The Pink Edition: Wild Berries
msl:
This is our 10th Red Bull, and it is THE PINK EDITION. Despite being PINK it is a very RUBY RED looking drink. The smell was nonexistent from the can but in the glass it does indeed smell like berries. Hope it’s good!

Yeah so I think it’s established by now that the BASE Red Bull flavor isn’t something the both of us are crazy about, but the berries do add something nice to it. It’s sweeter. Light. Not very bold but I think just right. For my tastes, I’m just kinda on the “eh” side for this one, but it is completely fine sloshing around the mouth or chugging. No shitty aftertaste. This is an easy finish. I can’t believe it’s taken me over 200 of these drinks to figure out that instead of calling it “energy drink” flavor that it’s really just “base [brand] flavor”. Thumbs in the middle, but one of the better Red Bulls we have had I’d say.
nf:
We’ve come so far with Red Bull. We avoided the brand for so long and…well, the results haven’t been spectacular, but there have been some that have been surprisingly fine. Wild Berries sounds like it could be ok, but “wild berries” in, say, a C4 is a lot different than the “wild berries” of a Red Bull.

You know what, that kinda tastes a little like wine. A LITTLE. It EVOKES wine. But it really just tastes like Red Bull with some sweet berry flavor on top. And you know what? That’s ok. That’s fine! It’s fine. Everything’s fine. It’s got a little of the energy drink bullshit bitterness in there on top, and the berry taste isn’t fantastic, but nothing here is offensive.
