The sweetness is edging towards the too swee(eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee)t side, but I’m giving it a pass here for covering up the deficiencies of Red Bull. This is definitely one of the two best Red Bulls we have had, although that’s not saying a ton because I think they’re all in the middle of the pack or worse on our list. An average, maybe slightly above average energy drink. ¡Olé!.

name: bang Energy Cotton Candy
msl:
Clear drink. This one immediately nails the smell test. Smells exactly like what it is. Cotton Candy. Will it taste like Liquid Cotton Candy though? I don’t know. The colors on the can remind me of Birthday Cake Bash which have me a little sus. But this can of Cotton Candy does not in fact say SUPER CREATINE on it. I’ve learned a lot about BANG since the last time we had a drink from them, and while I will try to not let it cloud my judgement of this drink before I take a swig, I gotta tell ya - the things I heard about the guy who ran it before MONSTER took it over are fucking wild.

Anyway. Let’s give this a shot.

Yeah that’s ultra sweet. I don’t know how it tastes in comparison to the Birthday Cake - I don’t remember personally - but it’s honestly too sweet for me. I just finished a very salty meal, which I’m wondering if it contributes to this not tasting so great to me, but… yeah. Disgustingly sweet. Wouldn’t say it tastes so much like COTTON CANDY as much as it tastes like PURE FUCKING SUGAR. Doing the slosh test, so I can give it the old college try - and yeah. It’s just SWEET. Not what I want out of a refreshing drink. But if you need your taste buds to be overloaded with the sweet sensation of sugar, this is definitely the drink for you. Took one more big gulp - and I don’t think I will finish this, and I know I’ve been hard on it via what I’ve typed so far: but this isn’t like, revolting F tier or anything like that. It’s just really not for me. And I will not finish.
nf:
WHEW boy. That smells like cotton candy ass cotton candy. The Ryse Fuel Cotton Candy turned out to be a shockingly great drink. I’m not sure I expect the same out of Bang, who have had some stinkers in the past. But the smell is damn accurate.

Yeah that tastes fine. Good, even. It tastes like liquid cotton candy. Super sweet. No sour, no carbonation. Just like if you managed to get cotton candy wet without it disintegrating and wrung it out. I can’t say this is as good as Ryse’s entry, which was a real stunner, as I don’t think I’d ever want this again. But it’s not bad and it gets major, major points for accuracy. Would make for a fine drink at a carnival, I suppose.

name: REDCON1 Sour Gummy Blast
msl:
Another mystery drink for NF today. It smells like Sour Grape. Clear drink.

Honestly, sour is there. But the drink itself tastes kind of flat. On a second sip - yeah I feel like this is more liquid sour, than liquid delicious flavor. It got the sour right, but did not get any actual heavy delicious flavor in there. You get that tingly sour aftertaste, not INTENSELY but you do get it. I can’t say I totally hate this or anything, but I also don’t really think I like it either. I guess it does kinda hit the “Sour Gummy” that it might be going for - but not the gummy that I would be going for that’s for damn sure. I’d be skipping this for the red ones.

Kinda disappointed especially based on the smell. Don’t think I’ll finish it. This is a thumbs in the middle, just slightly leaning downward for me. Oh well!
nf:
This smells sour. Could be the Redcon! Could be something else!

Yessir that is sour. Not extremely, but definitely more sour than the av-er-age bear. Or energy drink. It’s……………….fine. It doesn’t taste bad, it’s decent. But we’ve had lots and lots and lots of sour drinks and this just doesn’t really do anything unique or special. It’s very average all the way through. Average sweetness, average sourness (for this kind of thing), no distinctive flavor. It is decidedly in the “would take if offered” area, but it doesn’t have what it takes to hang with the best. I dig the purple and green aesthetic of the can, though.

name: Fusion Energy Paradise Pulse
msl:
I dunno if I like this smell. Assuming it’s…I dunno dude. One of the GOATs? We’ll find out. Slight piss tint to this clear drink

It’s citrusy. I don’t really immediately know the flavor - and apparently it’s PARADISE PULSE. I guess it’s some type of fruity mix but the dominating flavor is for sure a citrus. I find this one pretty refreshing, it’s not a big PUNCH YOU IN THE FACE of flavor, but it goes down real easy and is just kinda pleasant. I’ve been spending a lot of time just trying to identify what the actual flavor is in between my sentences here, and it’s unfortunate but I just can’t identify what it is Part of me thinks there might actually be a little green apple in here, as I’m hit with a slight tart flavor at the end of my sips. I do think this is a nice one to try, and if you need a shot of insane caffeine, this is worth checking out. It’s not something I’m going crazy to drink more of, but it’s good. Middle of the road drink. Thumbs up.
nf: Ah, it’s fine. I think this is a tropical punch, which isn’t usually my thing, but it tastes better than most of the ones we’ve had. That actually does make me suspect this might not be purely tropical. I can definitely detect some mango/pineapple in there, but it’s more subtle and not as strong as other ones, which is a big plus. I might even hazard to say I kinda like it. FOR WHAT IT IS, of course. I expect to like the other Fusions we haven’t tried a bit more than this, but I wouldn’t be shocked if this ends up #2 in the Fusion pantheon. Not bad! Not great, but not bad!

name: Monster Energy Ultra Blue Hawaiian
msl:
This has gotta be GOAT Blueberry Lemonade. I haven’t even smelled it but it’s BRIGHT BLUE. Also this glass is filled to the brim. Sheesh.

Giving it a smell, it’s not…really a strong scent. I guess it could be what I think it is, but I truly can’t tell. So, only one thing to do from here. Bottoms up.

OK so the flavor is a whole lot stronger than the smell, WOW. It gives you a slap in the cheeks with citrus, but I don’t really think I can compare it to one singular fruit. It’s gotta be some sort of blend. I’ve been told this is ULTRA BLUE HAWAIIAN so I guess it is maybe a blend of hawaiian fruits. Looking around because I was curious, this is apparently supposed to be Blue Raspberry, and I guess I can see that. It’s a lot more of a bold flavor though than what I would normally like. Maybe that’s the MONSTER flavor. I don’t know. We haven’t exactly had a lot of these.

Either way, let’s talk about what I actually think of it: It’s not bad! It’s not as sweet as I would normally like, but it’s pretty good. It passes the swig test it passes the slosh test there isn’t a shitty medicinal aftertaste and it’s got a nice bold mature fruity flavor. Would I get it again? I don’t know. But there is absolutely nothing wrong with this, and I’m kind of thumbs in the middle leaning up. A good job from MONSTER who has not been very high on my vibe charts since we started doing this. I finished my DEFINITELY MORE THAN HALF THE CAN glass.
nf:
I ah…poured a wee bit too much in Matt’s glass so he’s probably got like ¾ or more of the can lmao. Anyway this is a BLUE drink. It smells like an energy drink? I guess? Can’t say what it’ll taste like.

Another drink that’s very citrussy. I think I detect some blue raspberry in there, but it’s nowhere near as strong or good as other blue raspberries. But for some that might be a plus, there’s a lot of very tart, sour, and sweet blue raspberry flavors that we have reviewed that are too much of those things. But the blue raspberry flavor comes and goes depending on sip, so it ultimately averages out to “a citrus Monster.” Oneadose. It’s perfectly fine, but it’s got no identity once you look past the fun can. If you are drinking this out of a blank can - or like Matt a glass - it’s just a fruity drink that comes and goes. Meh-halo.

name: GOAT Fuel Jerry Rice Tropical Berry
msl:
This is one SLIMER looking drink, but I gotta tell ya it smells really good. A yellowish-green drink. My immediate guess is that it’s a GOAT Fuel Tropical Berry, but I don’t know. If I knew the flavor I might think different, but I’m actually kind of excited for this one.

It does not taste as appetizing as it smelled, unfortunately. I think i’m leaning towards “bitter” as a way to describe it. A bitter flavor. Doing the slosh test, oh yeah. It’s definitely bitter. There is a citrusy, tropical flavor here, but the kick is kind of overwhelming to me. Taking a few smaller sips in succession - I actually don’t think I dislike this, but I don’t really love it either. The flavor is pretty intense, but not what I personally want in a drink. But then again - is this what taking on JERRY RICE is like? Do I have to taste BITTER DEFEAT? I dunno.

Thumbs in the middle. Don’t have much else to say about the actual flavor. It’s not bad. I will finish.

No medicinal aftertaste, but it does have aftertaste.
nf:
This looks like Mountain Dew but does not smell like it. It smells tropical-ish.

It tastes tropical too. Medium to light-strong citrus flavor. I like most of the first probably ⅞ of the experience. I say that because it does trail off with a bit of bitterness at the end that doesn’t quite ruin it but caps the enjoyment and takes it down a peg. This is one of those drinks that’s tough to evaluate and likely will fall squarely in the middle of the pack because it’s simply fine overall. Jerry Rice was a much better ballplayer than this is a drink.

name: C4 Ultimate Tropical Tundra Frost
msl:
This drink is a mystery to me. A big clear drink with a smell that has me a little confused. I can’t identify it at all. I assume this might be a brand new C4 based on how much of it is there, but I really can’t identify what the flavor is.

Took a sip, couldn’t really identify it. Was told it was TROPICAL TUNDRA FROST. Took a few more, and I’m thinking it might be a mix of Kiwi and something else. It’s not a strong kiwi flavor though. And after doing a little bit of looking up - it seems like it might be PEAR and that makes sense. It’s why I didn’t identify the fruit smell either, I just don’t have a lot of pears. OK. Now that I know, I feel a little better.

This ain’t bad. I think it matches pretty well with the flavor, though there is this tiny little aftertaste that I’m not really accustomed to with C4’s. There’s some tangyness there. Yeah - I dunno. I think I like it though! Not one of my top 10 C4’s, but not a bad one either. Thumbs in the middle leaning up. Will finish.
nf:
OK, back after a bit of an unintentional break. One day led to another and…yeah. This is NOT Huel and I am unsure we will ever get to the last Huel. I have half a mind to throw it the fuck out.

First sip and…Ehhh. That’s a weird one. It tastes sweet and pleasant at first, but then some bitterness pops up and takes hold. It’s funky in a bad way. There’s a bad taste I can’t put my finger on here that ruins what is otherwise a good taste. The can says it’s a mix of kiwi and pear, so maybe it’s the pear? I dunno. Not terrible, but certainly not one I’d ever be excited to try again. Rough stuff from C4.

name: Alani Nu Tropsicle
msl: It’s almost like a… pinkish tint.  Has a nice smell to it, albeit not very strong in a glass.  I gotta say that just tastes nice and refreshing.  A nice fruity little flavor.  I’m not really sure what a “Tropsicle” is supposed to be, now that I think about it.  The can has a popsicle on it.  I don’t know if they are really orange slices or pineapple?  I’m thinking it’s Pineapple because that’s actually what I taste.  There is no medicinal aftertaste, it’s just very light with a pleasant flavor. Pineapple drinks can sometimes be a little too strong, but this isn’t really that at all. Like you ever have that weird feeling at the roof of your mouth after biting into a pineapple?  Yeah you’re not getting that.  It’s light enough to avoid it.  But you’re still getting somewhat of the flavor of one.  As a pineapple fan, I dig this quite a bit.  I don’t know if it’s an outstanding drink or anything, but I can see myself as a kid wanting  some juice or whatever, and going for this kind of flavor multiple times a day.  It’s just nice.  Yet another ALANI NU drink where I’m frustrated by the size of it in comparison to all the others, because I would really like more.  Good vibes from this one.  Would get again.
nf:
The way this drink was hitting the light when Matt handed it to me made it look like dirty mop water. It in fact looks more pink and orange-ish. I would call that a substantial vibe upgrade.

“Tropsicle” A manmade, Frankenstein’s monster of a name. Alani Nu is playing God here and…well it’s probably going to go better than the green guy did. But that’s about where I stop with the praise. Sipping this gives you an immediate fruity flavor. A fine one, albeit a somewhat uninteresting one. Looking up the info on this seems to indicate it’s almost completely pineapple. There’s a hint of sour in there…I think. Might be my brain. What isn’t just my brain and is 100% reality despite what Matt says is that after a second of the fruit flavor, a wave of bitter taste washes through that really kills this for me. Not a fan.

name: C4 Ultimate Cherry Bomb Frost
msl:
I picked this one out and it’s a mystery drink for NF. Not the strongest smell from this clear drink. Hopefully the flavor is a lot stronger than the smell. It’s def got a candy smell going.

Ohhh that’s got a sweet and sour in it. The sweet taste of cherry but the tingly little feeling in your cheeks when you have a sour candy. The Cherry flavoring is also there, but it’s not a particularly STRONG one I feel like. It’s a light cherry flavor, not anywhere in the same universe as say, the C4 Starburst Cherry. It’s not bad at all - but I also don’t know if I find it particularly all that impressive either. There is no ultra strong sour kick, and there is no ultra strong cherry flavor. Not what I expected from the ULTIMATE BLACK BRAND with BOMB in the title. It’s just kind of OK. I’ll finish this, but I gotta tell ya - don’t think I’d really be racing to grab another one of these ever again either. It’s a thumbs in the middle.
nf:
Sssssweet smelling drink we have here. I cannot put my finger on what it is exactly,

Ch-ch-ch-ch CHERRY BOMB! This is definitely a cherry flavor, but “Cherry Bomb Frost” feels like it’s not the right name here. It’s definitely more sour than sweet. It might even be bordering on medicinal. It’s just not really sweet enough. You take a sip and you get somewhat of a cherry flavor, but it’s overwhelmed a bit by the sourness and additional flavoring. First sip was ok, subsequent sips were worse. Don’t really have much else to say, another disappointing entry from C4. Hopefully the last Frost is better.

name: C4 Jolly Rancher Watermelon
msl:
We got ourselves a nice clear drink. A mystery for NF though I think he can figure this out. Smells pretty much like what it is.

Wow. Woof. That was an overwhelming first sip when the flavor hit my throat. An intense, strong, sourrrr…?ness that dissipates when you swallow. Jolly Ranchers as stated before are not really my thing. My first thought is this one isn’t nearly as pleasant as the last one we have had. There’s this weird feeling I get when I’m swallowing, it’s like there is this…I don’t know. Powdery texture? Maybe not that. It just doesn’t feel right.

Anyway, this flavor is very strong. C4 kinda nailed the Watermelon Jolly Rancher flavor, but I’m not really digging it so much. Just doesn’t feel very tasty when it settles in my mouth. Unfortunate, but they do get points for nailing it, I guess. One more sip, but I don’t think I’m gonna finish this one.
nf:
I think this is watermelon but we’ll see.

That’s some watermelon. It is a strong watermelon flavor, but I’ve had significantly stronger watermelon flavors before, so it’s not overwhelming to me. It tastes like a strong candy watermelon flavor, almost like…if you melted down some watermelon Jolly Ranchers. It really does nail that well. Now, watermelon would certainly not be my first choice of drink or Jolly Rancher flavor to make into a drink, but I’m not exactly a watermelon hater either. I think it’s just a bit overexposed. For example, if I can divert into a rant, why the fuck does Starburst FaveReds have a fucking watermelon flavor in it? The flavors of Starburst people like are pink (strawberry) and red (cherry). FaveReds adds fruit punch (whatever) and watermelon. The watermelon also has too strong of a fucking flavor!!! Who the fuck wants that?! It wastes space that could go to pink and red, but you MOTHERFUCKERS had to add fucking WATERMELON for some goddamned reason?!

Anyway this is good, I like it.

name: Monster Energy Reserve Watermelon
msl:
This one is a mystery for NF but he seems pretty confident that he knows what it is. It’s a dark red watermelon color and it smells like Watermelon. Which you know what? Is a much better first impression than some of the other watermelon drinks we’ve tried.

NF immediately made me laugh on the first sip so I didn’t get the best first impression but it tasted a lot more like Watermelon Candy. Let’s try again: Hmmm. Yeah there’s a hint of watermelon in here but I think the MONSTER ENERGY formula takes over more. I’d say it tastes more like a jolly rancher watermelon than an actual watermelon. Which isn’t bad, but I wish it was a little bit stronger. Giving it the SLOSH TEST: yeah more of the same. No crazy lasting aftertaste. It’s not that bad honestly, but it’s not the kind of flavor I’m hoping for with my Watermelon drinks. I could finish this one, but I don’t think I’m going to. This is a thumbs in the middle. It nails the Watermelon flavor it’s going for, but just isn’t my thing.
nf:
This one is a “mystery” for me but I’m 99% sure this is Monster Energy Watermelon between the dark red color and the watermelon color. Matt has confirmed this.

Tastes like watermelon. It’s actually a bit light on flavor, all things considered. It tastes like a watered-down watermelon Jolly Rancher in liquid form, like a diet version. That is funny given that I don’t think this is a zero sugar flavor. A quick Google confirms that. It also seems to confirm this has been discontinued so uh…yeah. I like this as much as I’m going to like a purely watermelon drink as someone that enjoys the fruit but is otherwise uninterested in artificial candy watermelon flavoring. If you're a watermelon enthusiast and want to try this, I’d grab it if you can find it. Otherwise you’ll be plenty served by Jolly Rancher Watermelon, which is close to the same drink minus some slight Monster Energy Funk

name: Beaver Buzz Energy Saskatoon Berry
msl:
I’m ova here now!!! We spun the wheel and it landed on SASKATOON! I was kinda holding my breath expecting this one might smell like Red Bull also. It does not. Very little smell at all, honestly. Maybe a faint little bit of berry? What kind of berry, who knows. (EDIT: I am being informed Saskatoon Berry is a real berry). The can is blue, but the drink is a deep red. Almost brown. Guess we’ll find out what this tastes like in a moment.

Oh! It’s a little sour. Despite the lack of smell I do get the hint of that red bull base flavoring, so I guess maybe this stuff really is just Red Bull like. I’m no expert, but I don’t know if the flavor it’s trying to capture here is truly a saskatoon berry. I think it’s just a light blueberry flavor added and that’s it. It’s honestly not all that stellar or really anything to rave about. I kind of wish I could try it back to back with the Juneberry Red Bull. The flavor lingers in my mouth for a bit, but it’s not shite. I’m thoroughly unimpressed. Did I actually like OG more than this? It’s possible.

Finished it though. Thumbs in the middle.
nf:
The Beaver Wheel/The BUZZSAW (I like the latter more but the former has Beaver in the name) has spoken, and we will be drinking Saskatoon Berry today. It has a blueish/purpleish hue, but has close to no scent. Why aren’t the others named after places? Research says that Saskatoon Berry is another name for a juneberry so that explains that. We will have to see if this is better than Red Bull Juneberry and if it tastes any different than a Red Bull with flavoring.

Oh yeah that is definitely like Red Bull plus flavor. Kinda interesting that Beaver Buzz is That Kind of Drink when it has flavors like Root Beer and (Not) Dr. Pepper. Perhaps they pivoted. Anyway this tastes less like a rockin’ energy drink for the kids and cool dudes and more like the aforementioned Red Bull or Celsius. A caffeinated, flavored drink for a more civilized consumer, one that goes on 5Ks, goes on camping trips, is probably rich, etc. It’s not bad, but if it isn’t clear by now we are more on the side of being uncultured sickos that love bold artificial flavors and chemicals. It has a just more than subtle berry taste that doesn’t overstay its welcome. There’s a bit of tartness in there, but only as a slight twist and not meant to challenge you. I think their use of actual sugar and not dealing in sugar free shenanigans helps quite a bit. This is not a drink I’d blast open and chug down On The Reg, but I appreciate what its going for. It’s an odd combination with a beverage that is decidedly For Adults with the name and packaging of “Beaver Buzz Energy,” but dramatic irony has so far been missing in the energy drink space. I dig it.

name: Amin.O Mango Pineapple Limeade
msl:
Holy FUCK the smell here is strong. I can only assume it’s Amino Energy Mango Pineapple, because I don’t get a wave of flavor that is anything like something else we have. The drink is several feet away from me and I can smell it. PUNGENT. Is it a bad smell? I don’t know if I’d go that far, but it’s S T R O N G. This drink is completely clear.

I mean it tastes fruity. Mango-y. Honestly, pretty tasty. From how strong this smell was I was expecting something gooey and gross, but this isn’t that. The flavors here all blend together into something nice. Almost has that pulpy feeling of an actual fruit in your mouth. Pleasant. Refreshing. No medicinal aftertaste, though there definitely is one here. Just a delightful little drink, with a pretty strong flavor. I think the Mango kind of overwhelms the Pineapple here, but it’s not bad! This is an easy thumbs up for me, though I will say in terms of personal favorite FLAVORS, this probably isn’t going to be anywhere near the top. But I do like it! An easy drink to finish.

30 MINUTES LATER: I can still taste it in my mouth, even after having some water. Kinda crazy. It’s not bad, but just surprised it hasn’t gone away yet.
nf:
So this is Christmas (Eve). And what have we here? Another pungent drink, whose color is clear.

It’s not bad. It’s quite tropical, but we’ve had tropical drinks that I’ve really disliked. I don’t think I’ll ever love a tropical flavor, but this is probably among the better ones. It’s more sweet than citrus, likely due to the mango. I will say that the smell of the can when I bring it to my face is pretty, pretty bad, but it’s brief enough that I won’t ding it in the rankings. There is a little bit of a funk to it, probably whatever is causing that stank that I will ding it for. Not much else to say, a decent little combo in a category that generally tops out at “decent.” Oh and I just had a small burp and it was that funky taste again. Bad ending!

name: Rockstar PUNCHED Pineapple
msl: Here we go folks it’s another drink.  I have one more day of work before a marvelous 2 week vacation.  LFG.  Anyway this drink is ORANGE and opaque. Let’s give this a try.  It smells cirt-russy.  And it tastes… somewhat like Pineapple!  Like, a mellowed out version of pineapple that isn’t trying to eat the roof of your mouth.  It just doesn’t have that INTENSE acidic feeling that pineapple does. Like if you gave me this I would think “what did you do to this pineapple juice?  Has it been sitting out for a while?”  When you slosh it around the mouth you definitely get a little more of that, and a chemical feeling, but there really isn’t anything wrong with this drink to me.  But would I take it over say, a regular drink of Pineapple juice?  Don’t think so.  But my thirst is quenched, and I’m actually pleasantly surprised with this one.  I thought it would be more shitty base energy flavor with a hint of pineapple added to it.  This just kinda…nails the pineapple flavor somewhat.  I’ll say I’m not as ultra enthusiastic on it as the paragraph probably read, but I can give it a thumbs up.
nf:
Well folks it appears I have a nice tall glass of PISS on my desk. Going to assume this is Rockstar Punched Pineapple, but stranger things have happened in our energy drink travels.

That was some kind of ride, that first sip there. It’s definitely sweet at first - not very, but sweet. And I don’t think it really tastes like PINEAPPLE, more so just generic citrus. Perhaps that’s where the PUNCHED comes in. Then it starts to trail off but stops to introduce some kind of…not quite bitterness although it is a little bitter. It’s like a twang? Hard to describe. Mountain Dew has the same kind of thing, which is why I prefer Diet over it. I’m not a professional taste guy so, this is what you get. The taste that is lingering in my mouth isn’t pleasant but I’m not rushing to get a chaser to get rid of it. Nothing to write home about. I’m already starting to forget about it like I went back in time and killed the creator and it’s fading away like in Back to the Future.

name: GHOST Energy Iced Tea Lemonade
msl:
This is a mystery drink for me and this one has me all kinda fucked up bc we have so many flavors in the fridge but don’t have them typed out on our “on deck” list of drinks. So I can’t even really guess what it is. The drink is clear with the slightest tint to it. A little foggy. Not a very strong smell. Could be one of the ROCKSTAR’s that I bought last night when our fire alarm went off at 1:30 AM and while waiting we just walked to the nearest gas station. Who knows. Anyway, let’s give this a shot.

That is… interesting. I don’t dislike it. But I don’t know what it is. It’s Iced Tea Lemonade! And after being told what it is, I instantly can make the connection and the flavor makes sense. It to me, straight up tastes like the Crystal Light my mom used to put in pitchers in the fridge except maybe with a lemon added. So I guess… that’s what they’re going for??? I would say for me, I think I would probably just enjoy regular ol iced tea or a regular ol lemonade than these mixed together, but it isn’t *bad*. I just don’t know if the flavors are complimenting each other as much as you’d hope. This is completely fine. Like I can say pretty strongly this is a C tier. And— OH MY GOODNESS i thought NF gave me a dirty glass for a second but it turns out I put the glass on a crumb and it stuck to the bottom of the glass. Phew.

This is a thumbs in the middle drink. No shite aftertaste. P. refreshing. I did finish.
nf:
Clear drink, full heart, can’t lose. Right? Well no, clear drinks have disappointed plenty. But I hope this one is good as I hope all our beautiful children/drinks are good. Smell is…odd. Hard to describe. Unappealing.

WELL that gets the classic “Interesting.” I am a pretty big Arizona Arnold Palmer fan (it tastes best coming from the 128 oz jug). This isn’t that. This reminds me of when I have mixed lemonade and iced tea in the past and it just came out as a semi-sweet liquid something. It’s got hints of both lemonade and iced tea. I think the iced tea flavor is stronger, but there are some sips where the lemonade breaks through. That is to say that instead of harmoniously fusing into a flavor sensation, it’s more like you get each jockeying for dominance. It’s more like a coin flip of flavor than the classic Arnold Palmer. I don’t hate this, and I imagine that making a good Arnold Palmer is tough when trying to dance around Arizona’s formula so I’m not going to razz on them too much for not executing. But what’s here is here and ultimately it’s just not what I want in this kind of drink.

name: G FUEL Miami Nights
msl:
I know what this one is, but NF does not. Smells like a Pina Colada. Clear drink. Looking forward to it, honestly.

So the taste is there, but it is not nearly as intense as you would hope for a flavor like this. When you smell it, you get that overwhelming Coconut/Pineapple smell, but when you taste it, neither of it is really there or punching you in the face. It’s not so much BAD but I feel like for a flavor like this you need both of those flavors to be stronger in some way. I feel like in some of these drinks, the Coconut or Pineapple or whatever extra flavor they’re throwing at you is apparent, but here… kind of nothing is. Doing the slosh test - you get just enough to feel that flavor at the roof of your mouth, but it leaves so quickly. And I can’t help but find that disappointing. Also, there’s a slight aftertaste in this one.

With that said, it’s not bad. It’s just kinda mediocre. Thumbs squarely in the middle. Though it was an easy finish.
nf:
Smell is all over the place on this one. Gonna guess one of the combos like Miami Nights or Candy Shop. It’s mostly clear. Maybe Mango Pineapple Lime?

That’s definitely pina colada and thus it is MIAMI NIGHTS. And it ain’t bad. Do I feel like I’m zooming through the beachside in a Countach with synthy pop and a hot permed blonde? No. I am still a big schlub drinking an energy drink at my desk. But the energy drink is pretty good. The coconut is definitely in the background, but just enough to give it some identity. The pineapple is better than some others we’ve had, but maybe just a hair too sweet. I’m not sure I’d take this over REDCON1’s entry in the Miami Vice City Nights flavor, as it has a little bit of an aftertaste to it, but it’s a solid entry from G FUEL, whose only other drink on our list was the awful Power Pellet..

name: BUM Energy Pink Lemonade
msl:
It’s the end of BUM WEEK and it went by so fast. This is not our final BUM flavor we will ever have, I think - but it’s the last one of the flavors we found. Carbonated Pink Lemonade… I don’t know how I’m gonna feel about that. But Lemon in my soda isn’t something I don’t like. Sooo… Let’s give this a go. Clear/Faded drink. Smells like candy.

Yeah that’s something. As it’s hitting the roof of my mouth the instant reaction I have is to purse my lips like it’s sour, but then that feeling evaporates pretty quickly. I’m not really sure what the PINK is in this PINK lemonade, and I’ve already reached the end of my glass just kind of contemplating on what it is. This isn’t so bad. It’s not exactly amazing or anything. It’s refreshing. I just kind of like, wish I knew what the hell the flavor was that was mixed with the lemon. Has me feeling a bit perplexed. But yeah - there’s bits of sour, there’s bits of sweet, and I overall enjoy this - not sure I’d ever go out of my way for it again though. Thumbs in the middle. Leaning up because it tastes good I guess? But just kinda eh at the same time! Final sip was very lemony and good, so yes, I’ll go with leaning up.
nf:
This is our final Bum, and we’ll have had every flavor they offer but one in Blueberry Lemonade. We’ll see if we come across that one, because I’m not interested in buying a 12-pack on TikTok.

This one is kind all over the place. There’s parts that taste just like a lemon drink, and then it tastes more like a sweeter lemon drink, then it goes back to lemon. At no point does it ever hit the sheer sweetness or sourness that pink lemonade hits. There’s a sour sensation there, and it’s probably stronger than the sweetness, but neither really nail what I’d look for in pink lemonade, which usually makes you wanna pucker up from both how sweet and sour it is. As it is, it’s just a slightly better Lucky Lemon. A big ol’ meh to close out Bum Week.

name: 3D Energy Lemonade
msl:
We got ourselves a foggy ass drink. White and foggy. Faint smell but it smells exactly like what you would think it is. Mystery for NF. Let’s gooo.

Thaaat’s lemonade! Yeah this is a very lemon heavy drink. It’s very bitter. Too bitter for me really, but not terrible. Not something I really look for with my caffeinated drinks or would go out of my way to get again either. But hey, it’s as advertised, I guess?

As I continue to drink I can say that - Yeah, the bitterness is just too heavy for my liking. I think I will cut myself off at the very end here and not finish this one. I needed something sweet mixed with this. If you are absolutely GAGA for lemonade and lemon flavored drinks, this is one to try. For a guy who just kinda likes lemons as an addition to his coke? Shrug. Low energy for this one! I blame the nap I just woke up from before doing this.

Thumbs in the middle, leaning down??? Maybe leaning down is too mean. But I did not finish.
nf:
Today we have a cloudy drink on a cloudy day, the second day of Autumn 2025. I believe the two 3D Energy drinks are the oldest ones in the fridge, perhaps along with the BUM Cola, but I can’t recall and I’m too lazy to look up the edit history. So let’s just say the two 3D Energy flavors are our candidates. Lemonade traditionally has had a hazy look to it when it isn’t colored yellow. I am not sure this is predictive, as all sorts of flavors have had this look, but it’s the best lead I have. Also kinda smells like lemon, which I suppose also contributes.

Mind. Blown. THAT just happened. Wow, just wow. OK, I’m out of old cringe cliches. I was right, as is the case 99.9% of the time in life. 3D Energy Lemonade. And I have mostly good thoughts. This is a decent drink. It’s a nice, fairly sweet lemon drink that goes down smoothly. Now, with that said, lemme get into a weird ramble here. This is called lemonade. And when I drink lemonade, it’s usually very sweet. VERY sweet. There’s a sharpness to it that punches you a bit. This does not have that, in fact, it goes a bit in the other direction. It goes low, almost like it’s got a little bit of liquor in it. ALMOST. Do not buy this expecting a Mike’s Hard Lemonade non-alcoholic dupe. I think if this were branded as purely Lemon then I would have liked it more, because it’s WAY better than the purely lemon drinks we’ve had before, because those were trying to be just lemon. But by branding it Lemonade, it suggests a level of sweetness that it does not have. Part of that, I imagine, is these energy drink brands wanting zero sugar to try and appear vaguely healthyish. As such, you’re never gonna get as sweet as an actual sugar bomb lemonade. But they could have gotten sweeter and thus it’s a bit of a letdown. Expectations matter! Anyway, like I said, it’s fine! Just could have been better.

name: Alani Nu Kimade
msl:
Ohhhhhh my goooooddddddd~ we are about to move, and i just got done moving some stuff, and i need a pick me up and NF brings me this mysterious cloudy drink. I hope it tastes good. I’m assuming it’s a MONSTER. Can’t for the life of me decipher what the smell is, so this is truly going in blind.

It hits the mouth and it feels like it’s gonna be OK, but then it’s overwhelmed with some type of sweet or tart flavoring. I’m not exactly sure what the flavor is supposed to be but it’s maybe lemon-y? I’ve been told this is KIMADE so it’s probably supposed to be a Pink Lemonade. Makes sense. At least I got the flavor right. It’s…it’s OK. It’s nothing really special. I gave it a slosh test, I gave it a big swig, and it’s just kind of a mediocre lemon drink. There’s definitely a bit of punch in the sour/tang department but flavor wise it’s just nothing to write home about. You can find better lemonade drinks. I can finish this, but I will not. Thumbs squarely in the middle. It’s just kinda middling.

Positives: no crazy aftertaste.
nf:
So. When trying to decide which drink to choose, I decided “let’s look at which of these has the earliest Best By date. My guess was that at least one was past or even well past the date. It was a little hairy because I could not really grok what the codes on the bottom of the Monsters were, and Reign didn’t seem to have anything at all. There was one that may have been Best By 2024. This was “BB” last July. So this may not exactly be representative of its flavor at full strength. But maybe it’s better! Who knows. That’s life in retail.

A sweet, inoffensive drink with a flavor that is as faint as the faint pink coloring of the liquid itself. Again, this might be wildly different from a fresh can, but it just kinda tastes like diet lemonade. Which is basically what it is. I wouldn’t be shocked if they turned down the sweetness even more for a drink targeted at female fans of Kim Kardashian, who are probably more interested in sparkling flavored water than energy drinks. Looking up Reddit reviews, it seems like people were mixed with either some agreeing with me and others being over the moon for it. There is also a post from 2 months ago saying the drinks have been discontinued for “a minute,” so that gives you an idea of how old this probably is. Anyway, like I said it’s inoffensive but it doesn’t move me. Much better lemonade and lemon drinks out there. This ain’t breaking the internet.

name: Red Bull The Sea Blue Edition: Juneberry
msl:
Will this drink be a wonderful 101? It’s dyed dark red/purplish so when I see that, I assume it’s gotta be a Red Bull. I really can’t decipher what the smell is, so I’m just sticking to predicting it’s Juneberry.

It is indeed Juneberry. And i’m not sure how much different this is from the Blueberry one. I wonder if this is just the Blueberry Flavor but maybe with some added grape in it? The taste of RED BULL kind of overwhelms the palette for me and if it’s just a mix of fruity berries, I just can’t really decipher them.

I wonder if I’m developing a slight taste for that Red Bull flavor though because I’m not scrunching up and crazy disappointed by this flavor or anything. It’s just kinda… not rocking my world either. When it comes to other brands BLUE flavored drinks I expect something very sweet. That isn’t what this is, but it’s not really disappointing. It tastes… mature almost. Ugh. I feel pretentious typing that.

I dunno if this is my favorite Red Bull or second favorite. They all aren’t ranked high on our lists as of right now, so it’s not GLOWING praise. It’s OK. If it was the only drink I could have for a while, I would drink it. But I will never go out of my way for another one of these again.

After doing the slosh test and drinking more of it: fuck it it’s my fav of the few we’ve had so far lol. This isn’t bad.
nf:
Purple Haze! Well, not purple haze, that’s a bang drink. This is just colored purple. Smells kinda grape-ish.

This reminds me quite a bit of the Red Bull Blue Edition. In fact, if you told me it was the same I’d believe you. It’s Red Bull plus a hint of flavor. The flavor is so faint you kind of have to smell it while sipping to really envelop the senses. It’s refreshing and smooth, but ultimately kinda bland, which I suppose in many environments can work in its favor. I could see myself drinking this at work where I’m not really paying attention to the flavor as much as trying to get any kind of dopamine going. I cannot see myself going “oh boy, Juneberry is back!” and getting one at a gas station convenience store. On that note, Red Bull has this weird thing going where they’re trying to be almost a luxury energy drink (I mean come on, look at the name of this flavor) but it’s in every dirty ass gas station, grocery store, and deli you can think of.

name: Celsius Sparkling Astro Vibe
msl: FOR A PISS YELLOW DRINK THIS SURE SMELLS BLUE.  But you’d hope it smells blue because it’s a Blue Razz.  This is our first venture into CELSIUS so I hope it tastes good.  Ok that is a very blue taste.  It actually reminds me of a rocket pop.  But more refreshing than some of the other rocket pop flavors we had?  I didn’t dislike that first bit.  When you’re first taking a sip it doesn’t really FEEL like Blue Raspberry but as it melds in your mouth it really hits you with it.  Hard to describe.  Sloshing it around the mouth a bit, yeah that’s blue raspberry.  I actually like this a whole lot.  It’s not the BEST of the Blue Raspberry flavors we’ve had, but it’s not bad either.  A sigh of relief also - ever since we both tried OxyShred I think we’re both a little tense when we try a dif brand.
nf: Looks like Mountain Dew. Smells like a mixture of blue raspberry and…turpentine? Something like that. Tastes like blue raspberry. Hard to describe, it almost feels like it has separate…compartments? I see it in my mind but can’t explain it. It feels like there’s layers. A blue raspberry flavoring layer and then the rest of the ingredients. It’s not bad but unremarkable and the blue raspberry taste is fainter than the others we’ve tried. It also tastes more artificial than the others as well.’ This will do if you are in Celsius’ target market of “I want an energy drink but not an Energy Drink” types that shop at Whole Foods or drive crossovers.

name: Reign TBF Tropical Storm
msl: Feel like we were avoiding this one for a bit.  It has a nice smell to it though, and smells exactly like what the flavor is to me.  Interesting first taste.  The flavor hit me as I was pouring it into my mouth but didn’t so much follow as I was swallowing. I get that hint of pineapple - definitely.  Sloshing it around my mouth and I just more get some…fizzy energy drink flavor.  Not really the actual fruit.  But if you are just drinking it straight down I guess you don’t notice that.  I don’t really know if I notice the ORANGE - because I think Orange is also a part of this.  Just energy drink fizz and pineapple.  That’s all.  This isn’t bad.  I think I like it more than some of the other pineapple flavored drinks, but it also isn’t really my favorite.  This is one of those “I’d drink it again IF nothing else was available - but I wouldn’t actively seek it out”.  It’s OK!  And given how long I think we were avoiding it, I think it over delivered kinda haha.
nf: Smells fruity. It is called TROPICAL STORM. I would say it’s more like a tropical drizzle. There is certainly some tropical-ish flavor there, but it kind of disappears behind some weird aftertaste. It seems to depend on how much of it you drink. A little sip will give you the disappearing flavor act, while a nice gulp makes the flavor stay around a little while longer. If you’re a tropical juice nut…well I’d say there’s probably a better version out there, but past the Celsius we have yet to try I’m actually not sure if there is. But I’m guessing there is a better tropical energy drink out there.

name: GYM Weed Candy Shop
msl:
I gotta tell ya, this is a mystery drink to NF. And I don’t really wanna try it. But we’re gonna have it. The drink has a cloudy piss tint.

When you first smell it it has that sweet candy smell. When you taste it - it’s definitely SWEET but I just don’t like how it feels on the way down. I dunno. It’s a very sharp flavor, but I can’t really tell you what kind of candy it is going for. There’s almost a tiny bit of sourness on my tongue when I do the slosh test, but this just feels all over the place. It’s not a flavor that I personally find very pleasant. I’ve done 3 slosh tests now to try and figure out just what it is, and I’m failing. I’m sorry all, I just don’t think I like this one. Just a thumbs down. Not my fav. Will not finish.
nf:
Very sweet, candy-like smell for this cloudy looking beverage. I was going to initially guess EBOOST Blue Raspberry, but M’s hesitance is making me reconsider my guess to GYM WEED.

Tastes odd. A very citrus flavor, to the point where I thought this may be Mango Pineapple Lime. But is indeed GYM WEED, and…ehhh? It doesn’t taste bad by any means, and “Candy Shop” does imply some sort of “throw all the flavors in one” Frankenstein drink, but even by those standards it’s not what I’d expect. It’s very unclear in both the looks and taste what this is. It’s generically fruity, but not super sweet. There’s a small bit of tartness, but not enough to really add any character. It really does taste more like something I’d expect out of something called Mango Blast or Tropical Stew or whatever the hell. Fine in a vacuum, but totally whiffs on the candy aspect.

name: bang Energy Peach Mango
msl: At times we must purge things from this world because they should not exist.  Even if it means losing someone that you love.  And I fear I may lose NF today… as we are braving another Peach Mango drink.  I smell the Peach pretty clearly.  I feel like I can take a bite out of this.  But, the Peach drinks just have not hit historically so far.  Let’s get this over with.  Honestly that’s not so bad.  It actually tastes very strongly like a Peach.  It has no disgusting aftertaste.  Second sip - I’m actually stunned.  I think I was expecting the dirt worst type of flavor here, and it just didn’t happen.  I don’t know if I taste the Mango - but I’m also not exactly privy to what a Mango should taste like.  I do taste lots of Peach.  This is crazy.  Each sip I think I kinda like this more and more?  Yeah this is actually kinda stunning.  If you really like Peach this is for you.  It reminds me of like…I dunno…a Snapple?  It’s kinda tasty.  Shockingly, this one might be a W - even if I don’t think it’s going to be anywhere close to what we’ve had the last few days, which have all placed within our Top 25 when we placed them.  So yeah!  Good Peach Drink! EXTRA NOTE: Last Sip was the best.
nf: I got this for two reasons: 1. Out of duty to The Science and 2. There was a BOGO on bang Energy cans at the store. It smells VERY peachy. Not entirely looking forward to it, but I’m keeping my mind open…OK well I don’t hate it, but I’m not in love either. It’s a strong peach taste that is a crowd pleaser. No sour to really be found, no bitterness. I’m not a peach guy, so I don’t really enjoy it, but it did not generate an Infamous Face Scrunch like the worst ones have. If you really like peach flavor, this will probably rock your world. As it is, I’m a “respect what they’re going for, even if I don’t love it.”

name: BUM Energy Peach Mango
msl:
It’s occurring to me that I didn’t actually look at the flavor of this mystery drink for NF- but the smell makes it very easy to tell what it is. This is Peach Mango. And I am sure this one is going to be kinda “eh!”. But Peach has surprised me before. So who knows.

You remember getting peaches from the school cafeteria and they just kinda had this sharp taste to them, where they’re cold but like not fully ripe? That’s like, the liquid version of this. It reminds me of taking a bite out of a peach that just isn’t ready yet. It’s not bad, but it’s not an amazing flavor either. I’d say it’s making me *~*nostalgic*~* but no fuck that I work at a school. Keep those not ripe peaches away from me!!! Anyway, this is completely fine. But I’m not crazy about it. Thumbs solidly in the middle. Could honestly finish very easily, but I don’t want the caffeine hit tonight.
nf:
Well if this ain’t Peach Mango I’ll be stunned. The remaining Bum flavors are all pretty distinctive, and this pretty distinctively peach scented.

Well it’s peach mango. That’s what it tastes like. Peach mango. Not my thing, generally. There’s not much else to say. It isn’t a terrible drink, there’s nothing making me gag or scrunch my face, but it’s just A Peach Mango Drink. We’ve had these before, I’m almost always unenthused with the “well if this is your thing” caveat, and I move on. So it goes. In terms of one of these, this is probably slightly better than the rest just because BUM comes in a smaller can, so you don’t have to go through an entire tall boy to get a peach mango fix.

name: Alani Nu Winter Wonderland
msl:
This is an interesting smell. I really don’t know what it’s going for. The drink isn’t really clear, has a heavy tint to it. I think it kinda smells like a Coconut? I guess we’ll find out.

That definitely has a coconut flavoring to it. But the thing that’s so crazy is I don’t expect Coconut with WINTER WONDERLAND. This is not bad. Immediately my thoughts race to the TIGER BLOOD drinks, and I think “this is better than that”. The flavor is light and refreshing, but at the same time, it isn’t really anything that I’m going gaga over. It also makes me think of RAINBOW UNICORN where it’s kind of like “Why is it named this? This is not at all the flavor I would expect!!!”

This drink is fine. I don’t have a ton to say about it. It’s tasty, but nothing special. If you like coconut, give it a shot. Thumbs in the middle, leaning up. Easy finish.
nf:
This smells…not terrible, but not ideal. It’s got a hazy look. My guess is Mango Pineapple Lime but we’ll see

Hard to pinpoint. It’s sour. Blue Raspberry? Coconut? OK so it’s Winter Wonderland. Uhhhhhhhhhhhhh…no. I’m gonna override this and say this is not Winter Wonderland, because it tastes fucking tropical! I was expecting like, peppermint or candy cane or something. This is just a mid little tropical drink with a weird film taste on top. Did they have delays on “Baha Beach Party” and just decide to make it a winter holiday theme instead? Weird ass flavor. Not even great for a tropical drink, CERTAINLY not good as “Winter Wonderland.” I had no idea what to expect and still managed to end up disappointed.

name: Monster Energy Ultra Strawberry Dreams
msl: It’s another Pinky drink!  LET’S GIVE OUR FIRST MONSTER A TRY.  Smells pretty good.  Aaand…it’s fine.  I think it’s pretty good on the first sip.  Now I’m gonna take a few more to see if it does the same thing as yesterdays drink.  The “energy drink” flavor isn’t as strong on this one as yesterdays.  But it also doesn’t really taste overwhelmingly fruity either.  Which for something called ULTRA Strawberry - I dunno.  I was thinking something a little more.  I don’t know if I’d say it’s “flat” but I think i would say that it reminds me of the Ghost Orange Cream from a few weeks back - in that the flavor you want just kind of isn’t strong enough.  Would I take this again if someone gave it to me?  Yes.  Would I go out of my way for another?  No.  I do appreciate that what flavor it has does not get completely overwhelmed by “energy drink” like yesterdays ROCKSTAR - though.
nf:
Looks like pink lemonade. Would be surprised if it tasted like it too, given the name. I do not have good memories of Monster, so let’s see…

Well it doesn’t taste like pink lemonade, but it’s not very punchy. Punchy as in super flavorful, not fruit punch. It’s a flattish strawberry taste with some hints of sourness. It tastes way more like an actual strawberry than I expected. I like strawberries a lot, but generally I expect artificial fruit drinks not not aimed at kids to taste more like “Strawberry™” than strawberry. I figured the “ultra” meant some sort of ingredient or formula change, so I didn’t expect some sort of gimmick. I would definitely drink this again, but not go out of my way for it.

name: Monster Energy Ultra Sunrise
msl: The can is orange, the drink is orange, and it smells like orange freaking ORANGE.  No mystery today.  Carbonated Orange sounds fucking weird so let’s try it.  Hm.  It has a hint of orange taste, but it’s not very strong on the first sip.  Almost like a Diet Orange Soda.  Second sip - yeah I think I’m confirming that’s what it is.  It has more of an ORANGE JUICE flavor though.  Not Soda.  3rd big sip - I think I'm just kinda like EH.  Just imagine if you got some Orange Juice and it wasn’t as strong as Orange Juice.  That’s what I’m thinking here.  I don’t hate it but it isn’t remarkable at all.
nf: Looks and smells like OJ. Let’s see what we get here. Tastes like orange soda tbh. Honestly pretty good if, say it with me now, unspectacular. Reminds me of probably Fanta which resembles the actual fruit with carbonation instead of something like Sunkist which has that classic artificial Orange™  flavor. I think I like this quite a bit but also don’t think it’s among the best.

name: Rockstar Original
msl:
I’ve got the sneezes today. Not really looking forward to this one. It’s dark piss yellow and it’s got the SMELL of ENERGY. Let’s give it a shot. It’s a mystery for NF, though he might know deep down what it really is.

Is this more-tasty gasoline? Nooo it’s not that bad. Feels like a bold fruit going in and then explodes into something else while it’s going down your throat. I can’t quite put my finger on just what type of flavor this is, but there’s a sweetness to it that I didn’t expect. I try not to do this but I did a little looking up and see “a balanced blend of fantasy fruit, bubblegum, and vanilla” - and maybe I’m just being influenced by what the google AI is telling me but I think I can somewhat make out a bubblegum flavor here. I thought I was going to dislike this one a lot, but I can’t say I really do. It’s a unique flavor that isn’t as rough as some of the other base flavored drinks we’ve had. It’s not the most pleasant flavor in the world but I earnestly think I may like this better than the base redbull. It’s just fine. But not what I’m personally looking for when I want a nice refreshing drink.

Thumbs in the middle. No shitty aftertaste. I did finish.*

*I only poured us about ¾ of the can lol
nf:
Matt chose today’s drink, and his attitude about it resembles if he were walking to the gallows. Therefore my guess is that this is Rockstar Original, with a distant second being the Amber Edition Red Bull.

That right there’s an odd puppy. In the first millisecond or so, there’s no taste whatsoever. It’s as if I took a sip of water. Then, BAM! The absolute slightest bit of flavor! It’s not strong at all, but it is surprisingly fruity for an Original-type energy drink. These things usually have a much stronger twang that evokes gasoline, which pairs with the look of the yellowish liquid that is the hallmark of every one of them. Some Googling reveals a couple of Rockstar faithful thinking that this is a shell of its former self, as most fans of food are these days (I just saw a TikTok of a guy complaining about Pringles not being Pringles anymore). For guys like us, though, maybe that ain’t such a bad thing. It’s possible this used to taste like dogshit and they eased up on it, to the chagrin of WOW players and Best Buy employees everywhere. Either way, this is probably the best “Original” flavor we’ve had, although that’s a bit of a backhanded compliment. It’s only so good and you can and should do better when shopping for energy drinks.

name: BUCKED UP Big Game Cotton Candy
msl:
HERE WE GO WE GOT A DENTED DOLLAR TREE CAN ON THE BOTTOM AND ON THE TOP. It’s a mystery for NF but he instantly figured it out. Really no other thing it could be. I’m not looking forward to this one tbh just based on the state the can was in and I think it may be disgustingly sweet. But hey, I can be surprised!

It’s a clear drink with a bit of a tint. It SMELLS sweet. Anyway, let’s go: You know what, that is definitely sweet. Probably too sweet for my palette but not disgustingly so. At least it will be until I do the SLOSH TEST: actually no, not that crazy. Definitely feel a tinging in my mouth though. What can I say? This isn’t really bad. I don’t know if it’s really nailing the taste of COTTON candy, but it is nailing a taste of some sort of candy. If I was on a sweet kick, maybe this would suffice - but I’m not right now. And it’s just kind of “eh!” to me. Not bad, but not what I’m looking for. Thumbs in the middle. Haven’t decided if I’m leaning down with it or not. I took one more sip for the old college try, but I will not finish this one. NOTE: definitely an aftertaste though not a major one.
nf:
Matt asked me if we should do a drink I think we’d like or a drink I think we wouldn’t like. I chose the latter to get it out of the way. But now that I’m looking at the list of what we have, there’s nothing that really screams like we won’t like it…except one major wild card. I feel like there is no way this can be anything but “Bucked Up Big Game Cotton Candy.” The drink is clear, and smelling it provides no extra clues, but I’m sticking with my prediction.

OK well that’s just…hm. How do I say this. It’s sweet. Very sweet. I suppose you could call this cotton candy. It’s even a little fruity. Ultimately it’s just sweet. I don’t hate it, it’s not even too sweet like Blue Bomber was. But it’s just there. It’s like some anonymous nine to fiver that goes to work, doesn’t talk to anyone, goes home, then goes to sleep. Nobody really thinks about them. They don’t even really think about themselves.. Just a guy. Just a drink. There’s no real cotton candy identity here for better or worse. There’s been shockingly good ones we’ve had, and shockingly bad ones. This one is…just one of them. It is a product that exists and you should pass by it if you ever see it, just like that guy.

name: BUCKED UP Lightly Carbonated Protein Rainbow Candy
msl:
This is a mystery drink for me and it has a ghostly little fade. The smell isn’t strong but I’m assuming it’s the GHOST because of that and because I think I’m identifying a candy type smell, but I guess that could also just be the BUCKED UP. Watch it be something like Ali Gummy Bear.

You know what, this is definitely a candy taste. A light pinch of that sour feeling, and I guess it’s LIGHTLY CARBONATED AS WELL. This is the Bucked Up. I don’t know what makes the candy “rainbow”. It doesn’t really taste like skittles or anything. Nerds? Smarties? Maybe. It doesn’t really pack the same punch as that though, you just get the flavor, and it kind of leaves you wishing it gave you a bit more. Even sloshing it around the mouth, the flavor just dissipates from your taste buds a little bit too quick - though I will say that the little tingling feeling stays around your gums for quite a bit. It’s sweet, but just doesn’t have enough punch. I don’t dislike it, but it’s not lighting my world on fire either. It’s fine, could have been more. I was able to finish this one. Thumbs in the middle.

Rare review from me where I feel like I was able to get all my feelings out here pretty concisely.
nf:
What we have here. Is a failure. To completely see through the drink. Because it’s opaque, very hazy. I know what the drink is and couldn’t tell you what the fuck it smells like.

Well that is very sweet. And lightly carbonated. It’s fine for a second and then you get a minor jab - not quite a full sucker punch - of some bitterness. And I emphasize fine, because it is shakily and unconfidently walking a line between “sickeningly too sweet” and “tolerably very sweet.” We’ve had so many drinks that can be classified as a “rainbow” flavor like Skittles, the sherbet drinks, Rockin’ Rainbow, Sour Strips, etc. It’s a very, very competitive field and this falls well short of those drinks. When I bought this I did not notice the Lightly Carbonated label, and honestly that didn’t really affect my review at all. The carbonation is honestly fine. The taste just isn’t great.

name: GHOST Energy Warheads Sour Watermelon
msl:
NF got this one. Drink is clear with a slight piss tint to it. Took a whiff, and I’m pretty certain this is the Sour Watermelon. Watermelon isn’t something I’ve been looking forward to after the Gorilla Mind Watermelon. But maybe this one will be better.

Yeah this is a sour watermelon flavor. It is not utterly disgusting like the Watermelon Candy we had from Gorilla Mind, so in that regard, this is a success. It also pretty much tastes exactly like my faint memory of what a Sour Watermelon Warhead tastes like. Is it pretty good? Yeah. I’d say it’s pretty good. Am I loving it? Def not. I appreciate this for what it is, and I will say I do have a lot of fun with the sour drinks, sloshing them around my mouth, and feeling extremely tingly for the next several minutes. I think it’s a good gimmick, but also like, the opposite of a refreshing drink for me.

No super shitty ENERGY DRINK flavor aftertaste with this one is also a plus. I feel bad! I’m just not super enthusiastic about this one. Prob won’t finish, prob won’t have again - but I do think that people who LOVE SOUR WARHEAD WATERMELONS would love it.

ENERGY DRINK THOUGHTS GAIDEN: Coca‑Cola Oreo Zero Sugar

I’ve been wanting to try this for weeks now. Was very excited to see it in the fridge when getting home from work. Let’s freaking gooo!!! OREO COKE ZERO!!!

So first things, smells just like Oreo. Second things - it tastes…odd. NF’s immediate thought of “vanilla” sounds right, though I do get the hint of COOKIE flavoring as it’s going down my throat. I almost psyched myself into thinking it was actual oreo cookie crumbs in here for a second. There’s a sweet taste, but it’s not really that sweet. It just kinda tastes a bit like a watered down coke. Sloshing it around the mouth I get much more of a “cookie is in my mouth” feeling, but when most people are drinking a soda they generally aren’t sloshing it around the mouth. This is fine. This isn’t UTTERLY DISGUSTING like I thought it might be when I first saw it announced. I’m glad I tried it. Prob won’t get it again though. Fun little gimmick.
nf:
SMELLS LIKE WATERMELON!! We’ve had some watermelon drinks before, but this smells the most watermelon-y. Maybe artificial watermelon-y, but it’s 100% that.

That is indeed SOUR WATERMELON! Surprise, bitch. It doesn’t so much taste like Sour Watermelon as much as it tastes like watermelon…and then after a second the sour kicks in. It’s quite sour for an energy drink, but not Warheads sour. So I guess relatively it is, but nobody short of the most insulated British person is gonna be puckering up after this one. I will say it does just border on unpleasant, though. I am admittedly not a huge watermelon guy, but this is fine. It’s absolutely got that fake ass candy watermelon taste you get in stuff like Starburst watermelon where you go “oh yeah that’s a strong watermelon. But wait a tic…” because you realize it’s not REALLY watermelon, y’know? I think they nailed what they were going for here as well as the Sour Green Apple variant, but the taste is leagues better than that dismal drink. It’s solid for what it is, but I won’t be indulging again in it.

Well I found this at Walgreens, but my attempts to also find Mountain Dew VooDew came up empty. I have heard mixed things for this bizarre mix. I will see if I can find the cookies as well.

Kinda tastes like vanilla Coke Zero. Maybe a little different, but that’s basically the flavor I’m getting. It’s enjoyable - especially since you can’t find vanilla Coke Zero outside of the Freestyle fountains or 12 packs - but not exactly all that different. It’s probably a different formula, but would I be shocked if they slapped the Oreo name on some Vanilla Coke Z to juke some gimmick sales? No. No I wouldn’t.

name: bang Energy Sour Ropes
msl:
We are back after a long period. This is a clear drink. Lots of it. A mystery for NF. It got that candy smell I think. Let’s goooo.

That’s an interesting flavor. I have to be honest with you, it is not at all what I expected. I expected a sour candy explosion, but instead I just kind of am getting…a sour candy flavor without any sour punch AT ALL. Like, there is legitimately no sour punch to this. Nothing about it makes me wanna pucker my lips or makes me wince. But it also kind of has that FLAVOR of a sour candy.

As far as flavoring goes, it’s not really that bad. But it feels like it is missing SOMETHING that makes me feel like “Oh this is great”. I had to ask NF what he thought the flavor was. He said “Peach” and I could instantly see it, but it’s not a very strong peach flavor. Weird.

Thumbs in the middle. Kinda leaning down maybe? Certainly not up.

Not my favorite. Just kind of “Meh”. Did not finish, it’s that meh.
nf:
This thing on? It’s been nearly a month since we’ve had a drink for a variety of uninteresting reasons. We’re back in the saddle today with a Matt Mystery Mdrink. It smells like sourish citrus. We’ve added some others recently but I’m gonna guess this is Frost Bitten Citrus.

Tastes like peach. Really the only thing I detect here. Peach. Not Sour Ropes, not rainbow, just peach. There’s a little sourness in there, but this tastes like a decent, unspectacular peach drink. I wasn’t expecting Sour Ropes to be a killer drink, but even by those standards this disappoints in badly missing the target taste. There’s better peach drinks and MANY better sour drinks out there.

name: bang Energy Wylin Watermelon
msl:
There is an old lady at work who will occasionally give me some FIVE GUM and this smells exactly like the flavor that she gives me. The flavor of drink also matches the flavor of gum, so I know what I’m expecting for flavor here.

Clear drink. You know it has kind of a watered down watermelon candy flavor. It makes me think it’s because of how this drink may be old and not really expired but close to it? There’s a flat-ness to it. With that said, I get the watermelon candy, and it’s not really all that unpleasant. It’s completely fine. I suspect I would have liked it more if the flavor was a lot more bold. But this isn’t bad. We’ve had better watermelon flavored drinks though, and thus, this one just kinda feels like an “Eh!” Inoffensive. I gave this drink the SLOSH TEST and there is no overwhelming aftertaste fillin in my cheeks or anything, just watermelon. So that’s good. I think I’m willing to say this is a thumbs in the middle leaning up.

I can finish this pretty easily, but on this day, and because it is BANG, i will not. But still: overall positive!
nf:
This has the smell of a sourish berry, I’m gonna guess either Cherry Bomb Frost or Frosted Grape. My mind said the former, but I realized it may be misled by not knowing the flavor.

So this is Wylin Watermelon after all. I can kinda detect the watermelon taste, but the biggest thing I notice is the lack of carbonation which makes this both figuratively and literally kinda flat. The flavor isn’t very strong either. Now this IS an older drink whose best by date is from like 2022 or something, so that could and likely does certainly play a part. But I can only judge what hits my tastebuds, and this is just middling. It’s not bad, but there’s just not enough flavor here at all. Less wylin and more weak ass watermelon. Better options are available.

name: GOAT Fuel Blueberry Lemonade
msl:
We both had long-ass commutes home. Mine was longer than NF’s but NF had a much shorter distance so his long ass commute was more rage inducing. This drink is a mystery for me but we only have so many left, and this one is CRIMSON RED and smells of cherry, so I’m assuming this is the Ghost Energy WARHEADS Sour Black Cherry.

That’s a bold flavor with just the slightest hint of sour to it. SOUR LEMONS???? IT’S BLUEBERRY LEMONADE. Boy am I all kinds of fucked up. This isn’t a sweet and fun blueberry, it’s a mature blueberry. It’s not bad, but when I see blueberry flavored drinks this isn’t what I’m really going for. It’s kind of good even. Just not one I’m really gonna ever have again. Thumbs in the middle? Yeah thumbs in the middle. I got nothing else to say about it. It’s a bold blueberry taste. I did finish.
nf:
I brought Matt a cookie home so I hope he feels better about his stinky commute. This looks like wine and smells like berry.

Kinda tastes like wine too. Which I guess makes a little sense, as grapes are similar to BLUEBERRIES!!!!! I thought Matt would either be on the fence about which this was or think it was Blueberry Lemonade outright. I did not count on him being 100% positive it was Sour Black Cherry! Anyway this isn’t great, it tastes kinda bitter without enough sweetness to balance it. Almost a semi-alcoholic flavor. You can definitely detect lemon and blueberry flavor, but the bitterness is too strong to allow you to enjoy said flavors. Not a fan.

name: Mountain Dew Kickstart Black Cherry
msl:
NF when acquiring this mystery drink: “did we like yesterdays? Oh yeah we did.” So I’m expecting he’s pouring one he doesn’t think he’ll be too crazy about. This one is the OPPOSITE OF A CLEAR DRINK. DARK. I think this is Mountain Dew Black Cherry, but I can barely smell anything.

Tastes kinda flat tbh. Not what you’d want in a Black Cherry Drink. Black Cherry is what I would call my FAVORITE SODA FLAVOR, which is why I have cans still that have been sitting around for months. Waiting for a rainy day. Waiting for me to need them. Definitely, that’s the reason. But with that said: this really doesn’t hit on the BLACK CHERRY strong flavor you’d hope for. There’s definitely some type of flavor here, but it’s not what you’d expect from a Dr. Browns. It’s not what you’d expect from a Sprechers. It’s not what you’d expect from anything. This is pretty much just a thumbs down from me. Just tastes kinda like nothing. Mountain Dew may have helped recent vibes by getting rid of “MTN” in the logo, but this drink does not help them at all. MID.
nf:
This shit looks like wine or something.

There is definitely a black cherry taste there, but it almost tastes like a fruit punch drink. Now, to be clear, the folks at Mountain Dew Kickstart have branded their drink a “flavored juice drink,” as it does have a whopping 5% juice, but we know better. But it does explain the texture, if you will. This is definitely closer to a juice than a carbonated energy drink. The taste is fairly mediocre, though. Like I said, it does not really taste a lot like black cherry, and there’s some good - even damn good - black cherry energy drinks that we have reviewed. I can only recommend this if you prefer a more juice-like drink without carbonation.

name: Lucky F*ck Tropical Thrill
msl:
Another mystery for NF. This is clear but it’s got kind of a shade to it. More dark than piss colored. Unhealthy piss? Normally when we do this we have a list of just what it is that we have in the fridge - but it’s blank right now. So NF will really be struggling to figure this out.

Ummmm. This is kinda medicinal and not at all what I expected. YIKES. The can has a Pineapple and Orange on it that looks like it was generated by AI, and I don’t at all get the flavor of tropical drink here. I get the taste of…a medicine? Doing the slosh test and OK, I think I get more tropical fruit flavor, but maybe it’s more pomegranate? There’s also definitely a hit of sour to this drink, probably moreso than the sour ropes we had yesterday. But I’m not super crazy about it. Taking one more big swig to give it the ol college try, and OK. It’s better than the first sip I had. But it’s not that appetizing. Big aftertaste on this one also that won’t go away. I’ll be feeling this on the roof of my mouth for the next 10-15.

Thumbs in the middle leaning down. DNF..
nf:
This smells odd. Cannot put my finger on what I’m smelling here.

That is vaguely sour, vaguely fruity. It tastes closer to sparkling water than a flavored drink. A little chemical flavoring at the base. I figured this was Lucky F*ck, although that was more based on the fact we have mostly that brand in our fridge right now. Most of the drinks by that brand have been closer to terrible than good (the fruit punch being the outlier and IIRC I was not a huge fan), but this doesn’t even raise any kind of emotion in me at all. It is liquid “meh.” Just drink some water instead.

name: REDCON1 Freedom Frost
msl:
So this is a mystery drink for me. Completely clear and a lot of liquid - and the smell is extremely light. I’m thinking somewhat red flavor here? It’s either the Wylin Watermelon or the Freedom Frost, and I’m gonna assume it’s Wylin Watermelon.

I’ve been informed this is Freedom Frost on the first sip. When I see FREEDOM FROST my initial thought is “rocket pop!” but that’s not what this is. This kind of has a candy flavor to me. Like you get the sense that some sort of NERDS flavor was thrown in there, but it’s so so so light and you don’t get really hit with any sour. As I do the slosh test, yeah, I’m not getting the feeling of a Bomb/Rocket Pop at all here. Just a very watered down version of NERDS. Not very strong. I wouldn’t say this is bad, but it’s also pretty unremarkable. I don’t have much desire to continue to drink it or finish it - though I think it’s inoffensive and I could do so pretty easily. This is a thumbs in the middle, somewhat leaning down from me I think. It’s just there, and doesn’t really hit the flavor it’s going for.
nf:
I almost grabbed the final (and I do mean FINAL) Huel, but I ultimately wanted something with a chance to be decent today.

That’s a pile of flavors. I assume this has to be intended to be a bomb pop flavor, but it definitely is a misfire. The flavors aren’t really distinct past a little bit of tartness from what I assume is blue raspberry. It’s not terrible, but it ain’t da bomb either. It’s just kind of a mush drink. A little sweet, no real identity. Bog standard average ass drink here. There’s much better bomb pop options. It was at least decent like I hoped!

name: Bloom Sparkling Energy Juicy Orange
msl:
Another mystery for me, yet another one where I think I know what it is right away. Thinking this is some 3D Lemonade. It’s a piss yellow drink. There’s an off chance it can be Iced Tea Lemonade… but I think no matter what it’s lemon. Watch it be like Juicy Orange now.

IT WAS JUICY ORANGE. And boy is this not the orange taste I expected. It has the slight hint of an orange taste after swallowing, but boy is this flavor not strong at all. It’s kind of like if I gave you an orange soda but forgot to dump in the orange soda flavoring…but you felt like you just took a sip of orange soda afterwards with that slight little aftertaste. I gotta say while the drink itself feels refreshing after some sips, I don’t get any true satisfying feeling from this one. It’s a whole lot of nothing with a barely orange aftertaste. Unsatisfying. Easy to finish my half. Not offensive. But I do not at all feel like I just had a nice juicy orange. And I feel like on principal I need to give this a thumbs down.
nf:
Yellow and citrus. Yellow and citrus. I will see yellow and citrus in my pre-death vision. It’s all yellow and citrus.

So this is Juicy Orange. That’s what it says on the can. And Bloom isn’t advertising maxxx flavor as you’d get in like a C4 or some other gymbro/YouTuber edgelord drink. With that said, there’s almost no orange here. It does remind me a bit of Orangina, but it’s been so long since I’ve had that drink that I’m not sure it isn’t a false memory/psychosis. There’s just a little bit of citrus flavor in here, enough that you know you aren’t just drinking seltzer, but not enough to know what the fuck the flavor is sight unseen. I was looking forward to this, as we’ve had some great orange drinks and Bloom has surprised us before, but this is a total nothing. It fails to be an orange drink. So…despite not tasting bad (Oh yeah I guess I should have mentioned that, it’s not bad tasting), I can’t recommend it at all. There’s excellent orange drinks, there’s OK drinks that at least taste like what it says on the can, and there’s this. Orange you glad you didn’t drink this?

name: ZOA Energy Frosted Grape
msl:
This is a mystery for NF but one look at the glass and he started laughing and saying “I WONDER WHAT THIS IS” Purple drink. Grape smell. DO YOU SMELL WHAT ZOA IS COOKING? This is our first exposure to the Dwayne Drink. I will say my initial smell of the drink seemed a bit medicinal. But I have hopes it will taste better than that.

It’s a grape drink but it almost tastes kind of flat in the flavor department. You know how when you’re having gum sometimes the flavor just goes away so quick and you try to keep it going by just shoveling more and more gum into your mouth? This is that except no matter how much more of the drink goes into your mouth the flavor isn’t really sticking. Tastes closer to a grape juice flavor than a grape soda flavor, but again - the flavor just isn’t strong enough. There is a hint of a medicinal aftertaste, to go along with my initial smell. Honestly this isn’t offensive, but it’s not anything I ever really want to drink again either. I can finish this, but I don’t really want to either. I feel like I want to just have a pepsi instead.

Thumbs in the middle, leaning down.
nf:
A real Sherlock Holmes-ass mystery today, an unsolvable cold case. What we have here is a purple drink that smells like grape. Grape has been hit or miss for us so we’ll see how Dwayne’s drink does.

Mmmm…not a huge fan. Tastes kinda like bad wine. There’s a hint of carbonation in there, but it’s both not enough to make a difference and too much to be just a little. It’s a half measure, either go with carbonation or none. The grape taste is weird, it’s like imitation grape, or if an alien tried to recreate grape from memory. Which I suppose tracks with the current iteration of Dwayne Johnson, who is a founder of the Zoa company. He is more an alien created by a PR and marketing team these days than a human being. The Zoa site says these drinks have Big Dwayne Energy and boy do they ever. This did not cause goosebumps on my forearms, to say the least.

name: GOAT Fuel Gummy Bear
msl:
PISS COLORED DRINK. I wouldn’t really be able to figure out the flavor of this one from the smell had I not looked at the can and poured it myself. It smells like citrus though.

Yeah well, it’s OK I guess. Given this is a gummy flavor drink, I think they try to lean more Pineapple in smell/taste, but I don’t think one really hits that much at all. It honestly just tastes a little weird. I have been sloshing it around my mouth for a bit, and I don’t think it’s BAD or anything but… I’m having such a hard time really placing if I like it or not. It was very easy for me to finish, because there wasn’t a lot of liquid in my half, but…I don’t really think I do? I feel like if you offered me this can as the only option, sure I’d TAKE it but… egh. It just kinda disappoints me. I dunno. This one was a struggle for me to review. It’s a citrus drink that has a weird mouth feel. Thumbs in the middle leaning down.
nf:
Is this Mountain Dew???? No, but it sure looks like it. It smells like citrus. I’m going to guess a GOAT Fuel, specifically Blueberry Lemonade.

As disgraced Eagles YouTuber/meme EDP445 once said, “I mean, it’s alright.” It tastes fruity, some citrus flavoring, but it’s all just there and unspectacular. Everything is like a 5 or 6/10 from sweetness to tartness. It’s oh so perfectly fine, certainly not the GOAT of anything or the Muhammad Ali of drinks, but it’ll at least go all 12 rounds. One thing it is definitely missing is any sort of “gummy” mouthfeel sensation that I know can be done. Gatorade Rain had it years ago and I’m pretty sure at least one drink we’ve had has achieved it.

Post-review note: There was a minor crisis of confidence because GOAT Fuel has wiped all evidence of Ali Gummy Bear from their site, making me wonder if this was actually Watermelon Fruit Punch. But I found another site that showed they did indeed make Ali-branded versions of Gummy Bear and Pineapple Cream Soda. False alarm!

name: REDCON1 Sour Peach Rings
msl:
NF has given me a glass filled to the brim!!! Hot damn. It’s a clear drink with a strong smell. What the smell is, I can’t really identify. My guess before he handed it would have been the Sour Peach Rings, and this one has a unique smell - but it also doesn’t so much smell like peach. So who is to say? Let’s give it a shot.
