OK. There is definitely the taste of peach - so this has to be the peach rings. But it’s WEIRD. It’s got this kinda, honestly medicinal taste when it hits your mouth. Only after you swallow do you really start to get that peach-core type flavor.

SLOSH TEST: Eugh! I mean. I don’t know how to describe it, but when this thing first enters your mouth it’s just nasty. Fucking rotten almost, before it completely settles down and tastes significantly better. I’m a fan of the second half of the taste, not so much a fan of the first.

COLLEGE TRY BIG SWIG: Better than the slosh test. Tasted much more like heavily caffeinated peach flavoring.

Overall though I’m not the biggest fan of this one. One more sip for the road: … yeah confirmed. This is a thumbs in the middle leaning down for me. Rough.
nf:
It snowed today. It was supposed to be a lot, but it ended up being just some slush. School was canceled anyway. What this has to do with today’s drink is nothing. Perhaps a sign that if anyone has high expectations for this flavor, maybe it will disappoint. Or vice versa! Likely neither. It’s a clear drink and even though I know what it is I don’t think I would be able to guess based on smell alone.

OH! That is weird. You get a sweet taste - I dunno if I’d call it peach - and then BAM! After a second a strong, slightly sour flavor kicks in and overwhelms everything. It’s very odd, like a time release flavor. Subsequent sips are more of a mix of the two. It’s a perfectly fine sweet and sour mix, but it’s also not really what it says on the can nor is it particularly memorable. It’s a sweet and sour John Doe, perfectly cromulent but ultimately just there. Take it if offered, but do not seek it out.

name: Monster Energy
msl:
It’s honestly insane we haven’t tried this yet. Are we fucking stupid? We might be. It looks like dark piss (like dark pit, from smash bros) and it smells like oil. Or whatever the Monster Energy smell is. I’m not really looking forward to this tbh. But I feel like it’s insane we haven’t tried it. So it’s time to do it RIGHT NOW.

Yeah it’s very medicinal. It’s the patented ENERGY DRINK FLAVOR. And to me, that is not very appetizing. Call me a little baby boy who needs his sweetened flavors. I’m not shy about what I like. I don’t care. This isn’t my thing.

BUT We must give it the old college try. SLOSH TEST: Hey you know what, it’s not as bad when you’re assaulting every little bit of your mouth with it. But it’s still not great.

BIG SWIG TEST: - Wait, have I ever defined the Big Swig? It’s basically just me taking big ass gulps in succession. At least 3. Not small little sips. BIG FUCKING GULPS. Not 7/11 Big Gulps though. Anyway let’s go: You know what? I downed the whole thing there. And this may actually be a grower. I’m still not crazy about it, but I absolutely don’t think it’s a thumbs down. I’m trying to figure out what type of flavor it is. Bitter? Citrus? I dunno. It’s more bitter than sweet. It makes me wanna purse my lips. This review is all over the place. I apologize this took over a year to get to. I finished. Out of pure respect for the history, I’ll say Thumbs in the Middle.
nf:
This appears for all the world to be either apple juice, piss, or a little of both. The smell is unmistakable - energy drink BULLSHIT. This almost has to be plain old Monster Energy, which Matt just confirmed for me. I had remembered we had Red Bull Sugar Free, but any mystery was removed for me. Either way, it’s a trip back to when energy drinks were purely a tool to wake you the fuck up and not a fruity “lifestyle drink.”

Alright, stay with me here. Is this kinda medicinal and gross? Yes. Is it terrible, facescrunch-inducing sludge? No. Maybe I’m just getting old and my palette ist getting plain, but this wasn’t so bad. It’s got some sweetness to it on top of the medicinal flavor that makes it tolerable. NOW…would I drink this again? No. Do I think it’s a good drink? No. But if I had to drink this to wake me up in the mornings, I’d take it over coffee. Not Horrible! But people that buy this regularly should realize there’s better options these days.

name: Lucky F*ck OG Luck
msl:
Newww drink. NF surprised me with this one. No discussion at all, just brought a large glass in for me to drink. We’ve long established by now that I really struggle with identifying flavors (both of us, really) when it’s a mystery. It’s a clear drink, but it has a slight tint to it. Part of me is leaning towards Gummy Bear. It’s either that, or…orange cream? Those are my two guesses.

NF accidentally showed me the flavor on FT and it was neither of those lmfao. OG Luck. Oof…That’s a lip purser. Not a fan of it. I really couldn’t identify it but apparently this is like… Apple-ish? Maybe a granny smith, which kinda stink tbh. Giving it the slosh test - I do get more of a candy vibe in my mouth more than anything else. When I take THE BIG SWIG it’s…ok I guess it’s not awful but I’m just not a fan of it. I think they did a good job of making the taste fucking intense, but the flavor just isn’t for me. It leaves an unpleasant aftertaste for me.

One more college try sip: Yeah. I’m gonna have to say this is a thumbs in the middle leaning down. Just not for me. Probably not the worst Lucky Fuck we’ve had, but isn’t gonna place anyplace high.

Did not finish.
nf:
I only got a fleeting glimpse of the liquid before handing it off to Matt and bolting but I think it had a faint piss color. Like you’ve had just a bit less water than your body wants.

Accidentally showed Matt the can so hey! Fuck it!

An odd duck, that is. It doesn’t taste bad. It doesn’t taste great. It doesn’t really taste like much of anything, just some flavor I can’t put my finger on. The Lucky Fuck site says “The classic energy boost you know and love--amped up with a crisp apple kick and a hint of cotton candy smoothness.” So uh I guess it’s apple with some cotton candy which I guess I can buy. It’s not a great taste like I said, but I’m also not dying to pour this down the drain. Immense praise, surely. This isn’t bad but I just cannot recommend it when C4, Ryse, and Bucked Up have really great apple drinks and this is just there, existing, being the median energy drink. As I often said in college, Cs get degrees. Also, our 200th drink! Yay!

name: NOS GT Grape
msl:
The smell of this is strong enough and the color is dark enough that I feel like this has to be Juneberry Red Bull. But I guess we’ll see!

OK well. It’s actually kinda closer to grape, now that I take a sip. Is this NOS? I think it’s NOS. I really should have turned on a light to see that this was purple, and not just super dyed red bull color. This is much better than the Monster Ultra Violet we had a few days ago, but I have to be honest, still not amazing. The taste of grape is there, but it’s like, leaning closer to a grape juice than a grape soda. I initially typed “wine” but there’s no way that is right.

As I continue to sip, this really isn’t bad. I think pretty much every grape flavored energy drink has not hit in the way I have wanted it to. This isn’t the best one we’ve had, and most certainly not the worst. It was very easy to finish my sample. Would I go for this again? Probably not. But I think it could hit just fine for someone else. It’s bold, strong flavor in every sip. It’s OK!
nf:
This purple drink had a very strong grape smell in my opinion. The actual drink going down does not have as strong a grape flavor. It has that classic OG energy drink chemical taste with a sheen of grape over it. Better than NOS? Certainly. Better than other grape drinks we’ve had? Probably not. I could absolutely see this being somewhat of a revelation if it were released back when your choices for energy drink were just the original style, but I cannot find when this flavor was released. As it is, there’s better, stronger grape drinks out there, even if you want a light touch of flavor. I agree with Matt that it seems to veer closer to grape juice than grape soda or an attempt to mimic artificial grape flavors you’d find in popsicles and such. That might be a plus for some of the true authenticity sickos out there, but I cannot imagine it’s a big one. The newer(?) kids on the block are just better crowd pleasers.

EDIT: ChatGPT alleges that GT Grape was released in 2011.

name: C4 Mango Foxtrot
msl: I went into this not really knowing what the flavor of Mango really tasted like - because I’ve never had a Mango.  But this was pleasant.  Very flavorful and sweet.  I wouldn’t say it’s my favorite flavor but it is strongish.  Reminds me a bit of iced tea - so maybe I have had the flavor before and didn’t know.  Don’t know if I’d get this one again, but if it was given to me I certainly wouldn’t turn it down.  Nothing on this list has been outright bad yet.  Everything’s been good.
nf: Fruity, which I’d say is ironic because it’s for the troops but the military is woke now so maybe not. It is missing that something extra imo to rate it among the best but I dig it. Can’t put my finger on what exactly the flavor is, but it’s not bad.

name: Monster Energy JUICE Pacific Punch
msl: The drink is very red and it definitely smells like what the name says. It also definitely tastes like Fruit Punch - though maybe a little watered down?  I don’t notice that “ENERGY DRINK!” flavor.  But I also think this is our first MONSTER drink ever.  So - wow.  (EDIT: I’m wrong). It is definitely not PACKED with flavor but it also is just as advertised.  A nice little fruit punchy juicy drink. Nothing more, nothing less.
nf: Reeedd reeeddd driiiiiink/Mystery driiiiiink - There’s two candidates for what this is and we’ll see. Either way it’s almost certainly punched fruit. I thought this was going to be Rockstar Punched, because it gave me that kind of vibe from the first gulp. Almost a jungle juice vibe in that it tastes like fruit punch that’s been watered down by alcohol with none of the cool ass benefits. Monster is a relic from the days of the original energy drink wars of the aughts and despite being the theoretically kinder, gentler JUICE variety, it gives me memories of those drinks. A little sweet, but too bitter to enjoy. Again I must ask why the Pacific Punch flavor is regular fruit punch and the Pipeline Punch is tropical!

name: Bloom Sparkling Energy Cherry Lime
msl:
This is light green/yellow. Has a nice smell to it. This is our first BLOOM SPARKLING ENERGY. Hopefully they don’t fuck it up!

You know that’s interesting. The flavor is there, but light, and somehow gets even lighter on the way down. It’s very mellow. It’s not trying to punch you in the face with its flavoring, but it’s not flavorless either. It feels like they had the right flavor combination here, but then watered it down significantly - but not significantly enough to where I would say “this is bad”. I don’t know if Flat is the word. I’ve had regular colas from restaurants that felt “flat” - and I don’t think I’d say this is that. But “watered down” does feel like the right wording to use. Slight aftertaste, but not a gross one. For my tastes, I would like if they tried to give you some more PUNCH. But this isn’t bad. I think the Cherry/Lime flavor works well together, I just wish it had more of it.
nf:
This looks like Mountain Dew. Well, the drink does. The can looks like “energy drinks: now for women.” The site looks like that too, with the female founder and female reviewers being highlighted. Personally I don’t have an issue with female-focused products (I am using the Degree that is clearly aimed at women right now for deodorant), but I do worry this could mean the flavors are too light. Onward.

First sip ain’t bad. It is indeed not very strong, but it’s also not weak like some of the Celsius drinks and others in its ranking area. I’d say it was 66% cherry, 33% lime. Second sip isn’t as good as the first. There’s definitely some chemical flavoring that’s coming out now, but not severely. Not much else to say about this. Probably better than Celsius, but still probably lower half stuff especially thanks to the chemical flavoring.

I went back to the site’s front page and there is a slide that says “Introducing CREATINE: Because women need it too.”

name: bang Energy Black Cherry Vanilla
msl: So this is a clear drink.  The smell is not STRONG but it is there.  If I didn’t know what this is, I would think it might be a red flavor, but I honestly can’t really discern it.  Wow this is an interesting flavor.  You can instantly get the taste of VANILLA - though I’m not necessarily sure that I feel BLACK CHERRY.  Second sip, when searching for it, I can kinda taste it, but I think the Vanilla flavor kind of overwhelms it to where it might just not be all that noticeable.  The flavor - again is just…very interesting.  I don’t think it’s BAD - but I don’t necessarily think it’s amazingly tasty either.  I’m a huge Black Cherry guy - I’d say it’s my favorite flavor Soda.  But this just really doesn’t get the flavor that I’m looking for.  As I continue to take more sips, I’m starting to psyche myself out a little and think “Maybe this is what black cherry overflowed with Vanilla would taste like…” - but it’s just not for me!  I didn’t really get the Sour Sensation that NF is getting at all. It occurs to me I should have chosen Bombsicle on todays date.  Silly me!
nf: This smells sour. No clues based on the color, which is clear. I have a guess based on HM’s opinion of our latest haul, and maybe on the smell, but he could throw a curveball. We have so many on deck that it is hard to guess, so I will have to dive in…OK, I thought it was Bombsicle based on the sour, but another sip does in fact reveal the black cherry flavor. Crazy how the mind works. But also…it IS sour! That’s not exactly the kind of sensation I’m looking for in a “Black Cherry Vanilla” flavor. It’s more like a sour berry vanilla flavor. It’s tasty, but I would not be able to recommend this based on what it says on the can. There’s better black cherry vanilla drinks and there’s better sour drinks.

name: GHOST Energy EDC Electric Limeade
msl: Another one that smells like what it says to me.  Mystery for NF.  IT’S SPRITE…BUT THEN NOT???   So when you smell it - it immediately smells like Sprite to me.  Just a Lemon/Lime drink.  I don’t know if this has lemon in it though, but the overwhelming smell of lime.  When you are sipping it genuinely tastes like Sprite at first, before the overwhelming sensation of just LIME takes over.  I have to be honest, Lime by itself is just not my favorite.  It’s very sour.  If you really fucking love limes, I think you will like this drink, but for my palette, I don’t really know if I’ll finish it.  One more big sip and gulp for the road:  Yeah.  What this is accomplishing is making me really want a Sprite.  I don’t think GHOST did a bad job making a lime flavored Energy Drink.  I do think I would not want this again though, lmao.
nf: Another vaguely piss-colored drink. Smells  of citrus, I think? I have like three contenders for what it could be. I tried to sniff again and I lost the flavor. Possible COVID infection…This is the rave drink, one of the ones I figured it could be. It tastes like lime. That’s about all I can say. It’s a branded lime drink. Tastes like you’d expect, properly sweet, neither my thing or not. I could see a lime fan REALLY digging this, but as it is it’s just OK. It may also improve if you are half-naked and rolling E.

name: C4 Starburst Lemon
msl:
THE FINAL STARBURST. Starburst Lemon. I’ve liked all of them, but this one is the one I was least excited about. We’ll see!

Honestly, doesn’t really taste like much of…anything? I’m a little surprised by how flat this one tastes. Sloshing it around the mouth I’m definitely hit with more of a flavor, but I almost want to go pop another can just to see if it tastes any fresher. There is a hint of lemon as I take more sips, but it’s not overwhelming. I feel like you get more Lemon Flavor from an actual Lemon Starburst, whereas with like Cherry and Strawberry I think PUNCH YOU IN THE FACE and Orange is just right. This doesn’t taste BAD at all but was surprisingly just pretty disappointing. I’ll finish it - but it’s just kind of an “Eh!” Unfortunate end to the Starburst Story, but I appreciate C4 for sending me this flavor for free. (Note: the final big gulp was the best sip).
nf:
Today we both chose the drink, so no trickery, mind games, or tomfoolery today. Aside from the stuff that was already happening. This smells lemony.

Tastes kinda like a flat lemonade. You can detect the lemon, and it does remind me a little bit of Lemon Starburst, but what I keep thinking is “not enough.” Not enough flavor, not enough sweetness. It’s boring. Lemon Starburst is often the runt of the Starburst litter, but it still is really quite enjoyable, especially in contrast to the super sweet strawberry and cherry flavors. This is certainly different than the C4 variants of those, but it overshoots the mark in anonymity and blandness. This deserved to be discontinued.

name: Lucky F*ck Bodacious Berry
msl:
I think this one might be obvious just based on the sheer volume, but then again some of these are deceptively big. It’s a mystery for NF. DARK RED DRINK with a nice sweet smell.

It’s been revealed, and after the first sip: Yeah that’s a mix of berry flavor, if I’ve ever had one. I can’t say I really know which type of berry is winning out here, but I feel like maybe some blueberry is here for sure. Apparently the other two are RASPBERRY and HUCKLEBERRY. I can’t say I’ve ever had a Huckleberry, so I apologize to the people reading this review. I dunno. These 3 are definitely making some type of flavor that isn’t really bad or anything, but it also isn’t really lighting my palette on fire either. With some of our drinks, I feel like they feel light and airy and refreshing going down, this has a bit of a bolder taste but it’s also like…not IMMENSELY packed with delicious flavors. It’s just kind of a completely run of the mill berry flavored drink. Not much more I can say than that. No shitty aftertaste. It’s just fine!

Something I will say about LUCKY FUCK - they give you a lot. That’s for damn sure. 2 glasses filled right to the brim were split with this one. I don’t think I’ll finish this, but not so much because of the taste - but because I just do not want to drink this much ENERGY DRINK.
nf:
Well M, I made it. DESPITE your directions. This is dark red like wine. I don’t think it’s wine as we do not have a wine or even grape flavor. Our list is so big now that it is not worth guessing, but I’ll take a shot in the dark at Bodacious Berry.

That is very slight flavor. Veeeeery slight. It’s definitely a mixed berry, and I’m pretty sure I detect blueberry in there. Maybe a little raspberry. The Lucky website says it’s a mix of blueberry, raspberry, and of all things huckleberry. It’s not offensive or anything, but there’s really not enough flavor here to even be offensive, much less great. It reminds me of a Celsius where they are afraid to be too flavorful, lest it offend their client base. Which would make sense for Celsius, but a drink called Lucky Fuck? I know they’re not quite the same in your face gym bro aesthetic as some of the other brands, but they’re still pretty in your face. It’s competent, but dull and a bit lifeless. Great portion size, though.

name: G FUEL Mega Man Blue Bomber Slushee
msl:
It’s another mystery drink for me, and just in time also because I was ready to lay down and doze off for an hour. This should keep me up. It’s a clear drink, and it smells nice. I’m assuming it’s Liberty Pop.

It’s got a blue raspberry taste! In honor of GFuel “Logging off” we have the Blue Bomber Slushee. The flavor isn’t bad but it’s one of those blue raspberry flavors where it feels like it is has been diluted and the flavor is tapering off. Not a heavy flavor at all. Just a very sweet blue raspberry candy that maybe isn’t as packed with as much flavor as you want. I initially wrote here “there’s a little bit of an aftertaste” - but I’m wrong. There’s a lot a bit of an aftertaste. A SWEET aftertaste. Too sweet. But also, hey. I finished it. I feel like this could have been a lot better. But I also don’t hate it and think it’s kinda good - Thumbs leaning up but not all the way there.
nf:
Matt was sleeping in his computer chair but is too embarrassed to admit it. I find this odd because there is nothing to be ashamed of. This drink smells very sweet. It’s completely clear.

That’s a very sweet, very strong blue raspberry taste. It’s like a 9/10 on the sweetness meter. I say strong, but I mean that only in flavor, not flavor plus quality like our last drink.. It’s simply too sweet, peaking all of the sweetness tastebuds before bottoming out into a kinda bitter aftertaste. Blue Raspberry is an inherently fake flavor, but you can imagine it being real, or at least an approximation. You would not be doing so here. This even tastes a little like cotton candy at points. Pure sugar. One note, no character, nothing interesting. It’s not TERRIBLE like the Pac-Man drink was, and at first you might think “Oh this isn’t so bad.” But then your brain kicks in and you remember you are not 4 and this level of sweetness ain’t your thing anymore. This is a drink that’s largely unpleasant but also mostly inoffensive, one that could have been better by turning it down a notch and adding some sour or something.

name: Gorilla Mind Blue Raspberry
msl:
No mystery for either of us today. A brand new Gorilla Mind! I have some really high expectations going into this, because 1. I really like the Gorilla Mind brand - and 2. I really like Blue Raspberry. Cracking open the can, and it actually smells more like sour candy flavor, which isn’t what I was expecting.

Drink is clear with the slightest yellowish tint. Let’s get this party started: It *is* more like a sour candy but then tapers off with this weird aftertaste. Wow, ok. This is unfortunate as it is not the flavor I hoped for. Doing a bit of a slosh test, oooo yeah that’s sour. Not as INTENSE as other Gorilla Mind drinks. I feel the need to scrunch my face like 10 seconds after swallowing, though. I don’t think this is bad, it’s got a nice sour candy flavor if that’s what you’re looking for - but I just didn’t think that’s what this was going to be! But with that said, it also isn’t as good as other sour candy drinks we’ve had. It feels like it needed a much heavier blue raspberry punch. The actual target flavor of the drink just kind of drifts away and is replaced by the feeling of SOUR. But with all that said, I liked it enough to finish it. Thumbs in the middle? Thumbs in the middle.
nf:
On the day that Hulk Hogan died, one might think we’d do the red white and blue drink. Well fuck him and fuck that. This has been sitting in our fridge for a bit with fairly lofty expectations between the flavor and the brand. This is gonna either rock or be a big disappointment. It looks like champagne which is not different from other Gorilla Mind drinks, but maybe they could start adding some color. Color is nice!

Oh that’s VERY tart. Very sour. What the hell? This is the kind of sour flavor I expected from the GHOST Warheads drinks. I’m not quite sucking in my lips and cheeks like the Warheads man, but the flavor is almost totally overwhelmed here. The best blue raspberries we’ve had have been sour, but as a yang to the yin of the big sweetness. The sweet to sour ratio here is totally off, like someone accidentally sat on the SOUR button at the factory in a humorous commercial for Super Sour Gorilla Mind Oops All Sour! OSHA should look into that and fix this damn drink. Disappointing and now I’M the one that’s blue.

name: Mountain Dew Amp
msl: Well.  Here we go.  Of all the ones left, this is prob the one I wanted to try the least, but I’m excited about the ones to come so here we go.  It’s a piss yellow tint.  And it goes all the way to the tippy top of our glasses. You know what?  It’s very citrus-y but not as bad as I thought it was gonna be.  But also not maybe as appetizing as I thought.  On the second sip, yeah.  Citrusy.  It has a weird…coming down taste after you swallow.  The sip is good but then as everything starts dissolving in your mouth, it kinda just tastes a little nasty.  Not great.  Sloshing it around the mouth is fine.  I can’t get over the taste a couple of seconds *after* I swallow though.  This might end up near the bottom rung for me, though I don’t really think it’s a bad drink at all.  I just don’t think it’s anything special either.  I took it near the end and took one last big gulp, but I couldn’t finish it!  So it goes.
nf: I am 99% sure what this is and it’s an old “friend” from college. I am still not 100% sure why I bought this but the Science demands it. SURE looks like Mountain Dew! Well that is not the dirt worst, so it’s already ahead. Tastes a bit like a Diet Mountain Dew with some energy drink crap thrown in. I was expecting to maybe kinda scrunch my face, but while this isn’t an excellent drink it’s not by any means horrible. It’s kinda neutral, reminiscent of the Celsius drinks. Except Celisus markets itself as less of an energy drink and more a carbonated drink that happens to have energy, whereas this is called AMP. The new packaging is at least less bro-ish and threatening than it used to be, but still. “AMP!” Anyway uh this is fine, probably will never get it again, but it’s a win for Dew Nation and PepsiCo that it’s not terrible.

name: Mountain Dew Kickstart Orange Citrus
msl:
Damn this drink smells ORANGE as hell. It’s gotta be the Kickstart Orange Citrus. The only thing it can possibly be is the Rockstar PUNCHED Pineapple but I mostly smell ORANGE. So I’m going with that. The drink is YELLOWISH/ORANGE.

I need to describe to you how this looked to me. We did our countdown, and we both took a sip, and once NF swallowed, he kind of just did a silent gag. It was very funny. Anyway, when this hits your lips you get the light taste of a carbonated orange, but then it just completely vanishes on the way down. Doing the slosh test it’s actually kinda crazy how quickly the flavor just dissipates. You feel it, you get the carbonation taking over, and then it’s just gone. An orange flavor is definitely there, but the flavor of orange juice, or orange soda, or whatever it is it wants to go for isn’t strong enough that I could really ever recommend this to anyone. It’s not BAD to me. It’s just not particularly great either. It’s a big nothingburger. You can find much juicier, and much more flavorful orange drinks. Thumbs in the middle leaning down from me, and I will not finish.
nf:
I have selected this drink today and it is orange as fuck. For Matt it likely narrows it down to 2-3, but if we’re being likely it’s more like 1, maybe 2.

So I’m gonna be honest, I saw this drink, I saw the name, I smelled it, and for some reason I was like “this shit is gonna taste like orange juice I can’t wait.” And then I took a big sip and…and…AND!!!! It did not. “Orange Citrus” is indeed an accurate name, as it turns out. The dominant taste here is certainly orange, but it’s not super strong like you’d get in orange juice. It’s like the head of a citrus committee where other citrus flavors get a say, but the decision ultimately rests with Mr. Naranja. The flavor does leave a tad quicker than I’d like, but it doesn’t do the Grandpa Simpson at the burlesque house gif like the recent Dr. Buzz we had. I have never had an Orangina but I bet it’s kinda like this. OK for what it is, but I’d rather have a RYSE Sunny D.

name: BUM Energy Champion Mentality
msl:
New Day, New Bum. BUM “X” ENERGY. I’m thinking this is Peach Mango from the smell. Clear like the rest of them.

I dunno what this is. It’s juicy. It’s fruity. But it’s not in fact Peach Mango or Lemonade. Looking into it - and I see now that it’s a GRAPEFRUIT and that makes sense. I actually kinda do dig this, but like I’ve said about so many other drinks, it’s just not my first choice of flavor. There’s nothing really wrong with it. I think it’s kinda tasty. But it’s not really blowing me away. It’s just a nice, refreshing, juicy energy drink. Will never really seek this one out again, but if you hand me a can and say it’s the last thing you have, I’ll have it sure. Easy finish, though very unremarkable.
nf:
BUM Week continues with today’s flavor. I had to drag Matt out of bed to do this one. Doesn’t smell great.

Well that is…something. It’s slightly fruity, kinda citrus-y…not much to speak of. A bit more tame than what I’d expect out of CHAMPION MENTALITY, a name that suggests bravado and swagger. This has none of that. I’m not gonna say it’s bad, but it is dull. A quick Google says this is “citrus grapefruit,” and that the reviewer thinks it tastes like the white Monster. I assume most of these white drinks are some kind of garden variety citrus, and this one is definitely that. Gorilla Mind’s Arctic White destroys this. Go for that if you want some white power in your life. Wait, hold on, I mea-

name: Red Bull The Winter Edition: Iced Vanilla Berry
msl:
This drink is a mystery to me and IT’S BLUE. My immediate thought was the Blue Raspberry Jolly Rancher but now that I think about it, it’s probably the Red Bull, because they dye every drink. It has a very nice smell to it. Looking forward to this sip.

It does not taste as good as it smells. The Vanilla is for sure there. The berry, I’m not sure what kind. There’s a slight sweetness to it that I can’t quite put my finger on but it has that bold RED BULL flavor aftertaste that settles in your mouth. I wouldn’t say this really has a candy flavor to it. It’s just kinda Vanilla Red Bull to me. As I keep drinking it and taking much bigger sips, the taste of the actual drink is BETTER… so maybe I spoke too soon in thinking it’s just Vanilla Red Bull. But there’s just something about all these drinks that has a medicinal background to them, that keeps me from thinking they are truly great flavors.

Maybe one of the better Red Bull flavors we’ve had. I finished it pretty easily. But not great.
nf:
We got a blue one today, folks. I think it smells kinda like what it says on the tin.

So this tastes like two things at once. The first is cotton candy, which I guess isn’t too surprising. Otherwise it tastes like what it says on the tin: vanilla berry. And it isn’t really mixed that well, it’s like I’m drinking from a glass of vanilla and a glass of berry. The berry is unclear, maybe blueberry? It’s pretty tart and sour. The creaminess of the vanilla and the tartness of the berry should mix together better, but it doesn’t. The tartness is just too strong and overpowers everything else. They’re onto something here, but didn’t quite nail it.

name: Alani Nu Watermelon Wave
msl:
So this one has a sweet smell to it. Almost like candy. Clear color, a little hazy though. Mystery to NF.

There is somewhat… of a bitter twinge to this one when it hits your tastebuds. Which is not something I expected. Sour. It took NF 5 tries to guess what the flavor was, and his immediate reaction was saying “What the fuck?!”. And I can see where he’s coming from. Sour and bitter is not really the expectation when you are having something that’s Watermelon flavored. I can’t really say I dislike this one at all, but this does nothing to make me feel like I’m taking a nice refreshing bite of a watermelon. It makes me wonder if this is more trying to replicate a sour candy that is watermelon flavored, than trying to replicate actual watermelon. Sour patch? Warheads? I’m not really sure. And if THAT is what this is going for, I think I can understand and enjoy it a lot more. But if it’s trying to be WATERMELON… I dunno what they were thinking. Based on the initial smell, I’m going to play devil’s advocate and am going to keep reviewing as if it was the former, and say that, hey, that flavor is definitely a bit there. But again, refreshing is not really the term I would use. It isn’t bad. But just kinda like… ok that was fun to try. Where’s the next one? Would I have this again? Probably not. Was it bad enough that I didn’t finish it? No. Finished it pretty quick. So it’s not in the gutter. But it’s not going to be one of our HIGH ranking drinks.
nf:
Glum day today, hopefully this doesn’t suck. That would be regrettable!

Sour, that’s what this seems like. Sour WHAT though…not sure. I guess I can detect a hint of watermelon in there?? I thought this was gonna be pretty definitively watermelon tasting. It isn’t. It’s just mostly sour. Four sips in and it’s just mostly sour tasting without much else to note. I’m not retching or anything, just more…confused., I suppose. Weird!!! Can’t recommend this one.

name: Red Bull The Coconut Edition: Coconut Berry
msl:
The smell is…I dunno dude. My immediate thought is Sour Strips. But this might be Witch’s Brew. The drink is BRIGHT BLUE. We’ll see. (it’s a mystery to me)

Oooh. Uhhh. Yeeeww…. I dunno. I’m honestly both stunned to learn that this is THE COCONUT RED BULL and not at the same time. In the few Red Bulls i’ve had, it has a dominant flavor that really overtakes what I am generally thinking. But now that I know exactly what I’m drinking, I can kind of get the taste for it. The Coconut taste is honestly not very noticeable on the way down for me in my first few sips, but after I put the drink down, and just let my mouth settle for a bit, I definitely get the feel of coconut in my mouth. Sloshing it around my mouth for a bit, it’s honestly not so bad, and I feel like I’m enjoying it more and more with each sip. Not knowing what this was, and seeing the color BLUE I was really thinking a sour or razz type flavor, and that fucked with me.

This is honestly kind of nice, and I am wondering if I am just getting used to the Red Bull flavor, because as we’ve reached out a little more, I feel like I’m enjoying the flavors a lot more. This one isn’t perfect. It probably doesn’t hit like, the top 50 or anything. I actually do think this might be something I’d be willing to drink again though. It’s surprising.

Thumbs in the middle leaning up? That’s what I think I’m going with.
nf:
This is a bright, light blue drink. Basically the same color as my beloved Gatorade Glacier Freeze. I don’t know if I expect anything like that flavor in this drink, though. Interesting smell.

Well that tastes…I guess like what it says on the can. I can definitely detect hints of coconut and blueberry as advertised. So a good job by Red Bull for nailing the flavor profile. Is it a good flavor profile? Ehhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh…not really. It’s got a sour kick that goes in the wrong direction and the sweetness seems to clash with it instead of creating an opposites attract sensation like you get in other sweet & sour combos. It’s almost like a piercing scream of a flavor, where you admire the craft and skill, but don’t really want anything to do with it. As with most Red Bulls, I’m not ready to powerwash my mouth, but I’m also not prepared to ever book a return engagement. I can picture a market for this, but it ain’t me.

name: Rockstar PURE ZERO: Fruit Punch
msl:
THE DRINK IS PINK. Smells like fruit punch. TASTES like fruit punch - but SODA fruit punch. Rooty, tooty, fizzy and fruity. I think this is very good - but I also think I’ve come to enjoy the “energy drink” flavor over the last month or so. The flavor of fruit punch is not massive, and I feel maybe nothing may ever compare to the first drink we ever have in terms of insane flavor - but this isn’t bad. Not sure I’d go out of my way for it again though.

Post notes edit: It is true. I would say normal fruit punch IS better. But does that just make this a “worse fruit punch???” it’s an interesting question…. Also - the more I keep drinking it, the more I think it just isn’t as good as that initial first sip.
nf: The Hello Kitty girls are gonna love this. It’s pink and tastes like fruit punch with some energy drink bullshit and carbonation added to it. Not as good as just straight fruit punch. It’s very sweet but the energy drink stuff in the background just kinda makes me wish it were just regular fruit punch. When you take a sip, there’s an initial fruit punch flavor that makes you go “oh nice!” before the bitterness of the EDB appears. Wasted potential. I want some fruit punch now.

name: C4 Popsicle Grape
msl: This got that real grape soda feel.  It’s not as intensely flavorful as the Starburst Cherry - but also nothing has been yet.  But I love me some grape.  It legit just tastes like what you think a Grape Soda would taste like.  It’s good stuff.
nf: Good, not great. Definitely tasted like a melted grape popsicle, but almost feels like flat grape soda. Missing the sour-ish punch the better ones have.

name: Red Bull The Red Edition: Watermelon
msl:
I gotta say, so many of the drinks that we try are a clear color. I honestly respect when one of them says FUCK THAT and just dyes the shit out of it. This thing is DARK FUCKING RED and it has a really sweet smell to it. Like candy, almost. I know what it is, but NF does not.

OK that is definitely what it tastes like, but if I can be terribly honest, it’s not very BOLD. The watermelon taste is there, don’t get me wrong, but it just kind of dissipates immediately. I feel like a lot of the WATERMELON related flavors we have had have been misses, but maybe we haven’t had that many and I just don’t remember very well (Outside of Strawberry Watermelon ICE!). Gorilla Mind was disappointing. This one is kind of disappointing, but if I can be honest? There is a chance I actually think I like this more than the other 2 Red Bulls we’ve had. The flavor is there. It doesn’t make me scrunch. I don’t fuckin hate it. But it’s also not… amazingly flavorful or notable. With that said, this was an extremely easy drink to finish. I just would like a little more flavor packed into it. Not bad. Not great. Just kinda there. If you were prescribed by a doctor to drink a Red Bull every day, sure. You can do this one maybe. But I think I’d want to try other flavors before it.
nf:
This looks like cranapple or something. “Raspberry Breeze” they’d call it.

As I expected based on Matt’s somewhat resigned attitude towards this drink, it is Red Bull. The first taste I get is classic Red Bull (he says as someone that only had it straight for the first time recently). It’s got that medicinal, kinda bitter, Energy Drink taste. In the background it develops hints of watermelon that make it recognizable as said flavor, but not overwhelmingly so. This is not like watermelon candy, which teabags you and screams in your face that it is watermelon. This is like if Red Bull were driving a motorcycle with watermelon in the sidecar. It’s inoffensive but also uninteresting. It’s likely the best of the three Red Bulls we’ve had, as the flavoring is the strongest of the three, albeit still faint in general. Probably goes well with alcohol while watching some ridiculous boxcar downhill jam or whatever.

name: Beaver Buzz Energy Citrus
msl:
The true original Beaver Buzz - Citrus. And boy oh boy it smells like citrus alright. More like the tropical type of citrus. It could be lime. I am not 100%. We will find out though. This shit is PISSSSS YELLOW and there’s a lot of it.

It’s sweet and very tropical. The flavor is pretty strong when it hits your mouth and doesn’t linger the second you swallow it. I wouldn’t say it’s the most pleasant citrus flavored drink in the world, but it isn’t so bad. The longer it sits in my mouth the more intense it really is. Kind of makes my lips pucker a bit. I’m not exactly sure what the key flavor is here, but it’s not what I had hoped (Pineapple lol. Or orange.) Despite how disappointed I’ve been by these overall, I’ve managed to finish every single one. Perhaps it’s what happens when you pay to have them shipped.

This one isn’t “BAD” but it really isn’t my thing. Would not get again. Thumbs in the middle leaning down. Leaves some aftertaste. Hopefully ROOT BEER will save this brand.
nf:
By now I think it’s clear that despite the loud bravado on the can and in the name, “Beaver Buzz Energy” is closer to Red Bull and Celsius than it is a C4 or BANG. Even if we’ve only had one truly terrible one (and it was for bad execution and not bad taste), it is still a disappointment for us. Along comes Citrus, which before we started this I expected to be a Sprite or Mountain Dew-like in the vein of GHOST Energy Citrus or Faze Up. This looks and smells like a boring tropical drink and I expect it to taste as such. Onward!

As I said. One sip of this and it’s”Original” with a citrus/tropical twang. Really not much more to say here than what I covered at the beginning. It does edge a little bit towards a Mountain Dew-like taste, but it’s just got too much of that Original energy drink taste holding it back like an anchor. Beaver Buzz has not been a disaster thus far. I’d certainly take any of these, even Doctor Buzz, over most Huels or NOOB Energy flavors. In the words of Joe Biden, those drinks were like fifteen 9/11s in my mouth. But they’ve all been disappointments. The best thing I can say about them is that they have all tasted pretty bad on first sip and then subsequent sips improved, albeit not that much. With the popularity of Red Bull, regular Monster, etc., I’m sure there is a market out there for “that, but it also kinda tastes like Mountain Dew.” Not in this apartment, though.

name: Beaver Buzz Energy Original
msl:
IT’S BEAVER WEEK here at the Studio Apartment. I really felt like we needed a new brand to play off of, and I had heard about this one months ago. Only now was able to find a place that would ship it to me for a reasonable price. Certain flavors are not available anymore that I wanted to try (Canadian Punch, specifically) but we have every single one of the current lineup available that we’ll be trying this week. Starting with the ORIGINAL. THE BASE FLAVOR. (EDIT AFTER THE FACT: MAYBE IT ISN’T???)

And it is BROWN and smells kinda like Red Bull. At least I think it does, I don’t have enough Red Bull’s to really remember if it’s that close. But it smells like bold energy drink flavor. So I hope it’s good. Guess we’ll find out. NF actually spun a wheel to figure out which one of these we’d try first, and this was the one it landed on. Appropriate, I guess.

It…tastes like Red Bull. I think so. I don’t know if I’ve adapted to the flavor of Red Bull and enjoy that specific base more, or I just specifically like this version of it more. There’s a subtle difference though I can’t quite put my hand onto just what it is. More of a soda-syrup when I swallow I think? It’s hard to really put my finger on it. As I drink more of it, I can say confidently that this is just a tweaked Red Bull. And I think I actually really do like it more. Is it something that is blowing me away and I wanna instantly buy a whole case of them? No. Is it something that would be in the upper echelon of drinks for me? No. But it’s not bad. If you like RB give this one a try. No real shitty aftertaste. I did finish.
nf:
Welcome to BEAVER WEEK. No we are not suddenly turning into Penthouse, but rather Matt went nuts and bought some cans of Canadian drink Beaver Buzz from some online candy store. He has been looking for it for ages so I am happy we can try it. Hopefully it meets his expectations. This is Original flavor, which likely means either something like Red Bull or Mountain Dew Amp OR something like the white Monster. It has a brown Listerine look to it so I am guessing the former.

Yeah that’s basically Red Bull. Probably Red Bull: but worse if I’m being honest. It’s considerably more bitter. For a second there made part of my mouth feel heavy, like it had just been numbed. When you first sip on it, there is some citrus sweetness there, but it mostly goes away. I’m liking it more on subsequent sips, but it’s still not great. It’s just the typical Energy Drink with slight citrus taste that tastes closer to medicine than an enjoyable drink. There’s people out there that down regular Monster and Red Bull on the regular. I don’t get those people, but they exist and they’d probably love some Original Beaver. As for me, I prefer other kinds of liquid that comes out of a phallic object.

name: bang Energy Sour Heads
msl:
Nice clear drink. This one is a mystery to NF. But I think it smells pretty clear, between at least a couple of them.

Ooo. Ok. So, the sour flavor does hit upon the first sip, but it’s not like OHHHH SUPER SOUR or anything. It’s just a hint of it. Even the babiest of mouths will probably not purse their lips at how faint it is. WEIRD taste on the way down also. I can’t quite get what kind of Sour Warhead or whatever it’s going for. But I also haven’t had a ton of Warheads in my life. The can is greenish. I initially thought “oh maybe a granny smith apple” just based on the appearance, but it doesn’t really taste like that at all. It *might* be a slight watermelon taste, but even then I don’t really get that either. It just tastes like generic fruit candy.

The more I sip it, the less I feel like I am enjoying it to be honest. This isn’t offensive in any way, but the flavor just isn’t hitting me. The Slosh Test makes me think maybe it is going for watermelon a little more, but didn’t really get there all the way.

This is just OK. Not bad. I don’t particularly dig it though. Don’t really wanna finish it. Review over.
nf:
Smells like something sour and fruity. There’s like 4 or 5 candidates, so I’m not gonna plant my flag. Cowardly, I know. Give me a break, I have a blister on my foot!

I can’t immediately tell what this is. After another sip I’m gonna say sour watermelon. It’s bang Sour Heads, but it does seem to have a sour watermelon flavor. It’s a subtle flavor, like the Red Bulls and Celsius drinks, but that’s not exactly what you’re looking for from a brand called “bang” is it? This isn’t the first time I feel like bang has gone too conservative with a flavor. Nobody is looking for a slight sour watermelon taste with a drink called fucking “bang,” they’re looking to feel like they got shot in the face with sour watermelon flavor! Doesn’t taste bad, but totally unremarkable. A bit of nothing.

name: Lucky F*ck Orange Drizzle
msl:
This smells like I’m in Florida with the Oranges. Orange drink.

It tastes like an Orange Soda. I think. Maybe not as intense. Letting it sit in my mouth for a bit and that Orange flavor is still there, but when I swallow it - i mean. It doesn’t taste like I’m drinking a glass of CRUSH or whatever other orange soda brands there are. This one doesn’t really set the world on fire for me. It’s…it’s orange soda. That’s what I think about it. Just OK Orange Soda. I guess that’s where the DRIZZLE comes in - it’s not as intense as your normal carbonated Orange Soda. How many times can I say Orange Soda? Not too many, because I’m going to stop there. This is fine. Shrug. Not great not bad.
nf:
Orange ass drink today, in both smell and look.

Well that is an odd duck. Starts with the taste of orange - not quite orange soda but just about - and then just kinda gets bitter. Yeah, ew. Not great. A second sip confirms this and the orange flavor lasted an even shorter duration. Unbelievably, this is apparently supposed to be a creamsicle flavor?! The Lucky website says it has “notes of citrusy orange and subtle vanilla.” I don’t detect any vanilla, and the can doesn’t indicate any vanilla either. I don’t get it. Granted, it also says “this flavor is sure to leave you satisfied and wanting more” which is also false. I don’t want any more of this! There’s really good orange and orange cream options out there, so don’t waste your time with this one.

name: BUCKED UP Blood Razz
msl:
This one is a mystery for NF. I don’t think it smells like Cherry or Watermelon so I’ve gotta assume it’s a Raspberry flavor or something like that. Which is disappointing to me! Clear drink.

I gotta tell you that while I can not immediately identify the flavor this is going for, the sip was pretty refreshing. It’s not a bad flavor, but it also doesn’t taste much like…any of the fruits I expected. Not Cherry. Not Watermelon. Not Strawberry. Not Raspberry. By now, anyone reading this has probably parsed that I don’t have a million fruits. So if you know what this is and are yelling at your screen: LOOK I’M SORRY. But as far as taste goes, this isn’t something all that amazing, but it’s not bad either. I’m enjoying each sip. It’s just…not like “Oh yeah! I gotta have this again!” A bit of an aftertaste, but not one that’s making me gag. It’s a thumbs in the middle drink for me. It’s fine. Won’t ever have it again, I don’t think. Chugged and finished it.

THOUGHTS AFTER READING NF’S REVIEW: I think “dull” is a great word for it. Even though I liked it more than NF did clearly.
nf:
I got a handful of new drinks today, but my guess is it’s one of the two we had left. I can’t really tell what the scent is. Smells chemical.

My first words: “What the fuck is that?” As I expected, it’s BLOOD RAZ, but uh…it doesn’t taste like I expected. I expected either blue raspberry that was just renamed for Halloween, or some sort of raspberry drink. I dunno if this is either. Research seems to be inconclusive, with one guy saying raspberry, and another pulling the “well it could be ANYTHING your mind puts it to!” shtick because he didn’t know either. It’s probably just raspberry, and I think it stinks. It’s not that sweet, it’s not sour, it’s not much of anything. It’s dull. As I noticed during the initial sniff, it’s got a very chemical taste to it. These were on clearance if I recall correctly, which is the perfect place for them.

name: Red Bull The Summer Edition: Curuba Elderflower
msl:
Dark brown pissy colored drink so this is either a red bull or NF has decided to attack me with an oxyshred. It smells like apple juice. Wait no. It smells sweet. I dunno what. I am literally half asleep/awake lmfao this is gonna be weird af. Maybe a cotton candy type one.

This appears to be Caruba Elderflower. There is… man. This is a weird one. There does feel like something of an apple in here but it fades away and turns into something else. It’s sweet, and then that sweetness turns into something more tart, and more like the base red bull flavor. I did every test I could do with this thing and I’m ultra focused on just trying to figure out my feelings here, but I’m struggling. It’s not a flavor that I think is bad, but noe one that I like either. Like a tart apple that doesn’t have a strong enough flavor. You’re eating it too soon. Leaves you unsatisfied.

Thumbs in the middle. Not terrible and I did finish. But eh. I don’t really want it again..
nf:
Wake up, sleepyheads! It’s almost time to go to school! This won’t make sense as early as an hour after I write this, and all the better for it. This has a piss/apple juice look to it and no discernable scent.

Damn that’s bitter. Like some sort of terrible alcoholic cider that doesn’t even get you drunk. It starts off with a vague fruity sweetness before falling off a cliff into bitterness. Not even like “sweet with bitterness in the back,” it just loses all sense of decent flavor. I will say that it’s not bitter enough to make me scrunch my face in disgust, it’s more an anonymous bitter that just washes away the flavor. One last sip and the best I can explain is it’s kind of like if you get a really big whiff of flowery cologne. It’s here and light and then gone. So it’s not an F. But higher than D might be a tall ask. Not recommended.

name: Gorilla Mind Tiger's Blood
msl: Smells real good.  If I had to guess off first sniff I think I’m gonna go with…Berry Burst?  Or Rainbow Sherbet.  I dunno.  It just smells good.  Woah.  That was strong.  TIGER’S BLOOD from Gorilla Mind I’m being told this is.  It honestly kind of reminds me a little bit of a… I don’t want to say a Pina Colada, but I can definitely taste that?  Just no alcohol, and not as light and refreshing.  There is a STRONG punch of flavor in every sip, honestly kind of overwhelming, but I don’t dislike it at all.  But I also can’t say I particularly think it’s utterly amazing either.  Like all the previous Gorilla Mind’s, each drink you have is just so fucking STRONG that if you aren’t immediately crazy about the flavor, it’s probably not gonna be one of your favorites.  I do LIKE this one, and I’ve never said this before with any of our flavors before, if the PUNCH this one packed was a little bit LESS?  I think I would like it more.  I think it would go down a lot smoother.  I don’t think this is going to be one for the WINNERS pile but not the LOSER either.  I think it’s an interesting flavor.  I enjoy what I’m having, but I don’t want too much more.  Middle of the pack.
nf: It’s a Mystery for Matt today. Smells like…something? Can’t put my finger on what it is. Tropicalish, which I guess is unsurprising…OK. Hm. It’s a bunch of fruits smushed together. I have never had a drink or shave ice or what have you that was Tiger’s Blood flavored, so this is my first experience with it. I get a bit of watermelon in there, maybe strawberry, but to me it just kinda comes together as a bit of anonymous blob. It doesn’t taste awful, but I’m not particularly a fan of this. Research says that Tiger’s Blood is “strawberry, watermelon, and a smaller amount of coconut,” which mostly sounds right. I was about to say I’m not sure I taste coconut, but the next sip I may have. May be placebo, but I think it was the weird flavor I couldn’t really put my finger on that I think was kinda holding this back. I generally like coconut, but I don’t think it works here.  I think Gorilla Mind could do a very nice Strawberry Watermelon like C4, but the coconut really ain’t doing it for me.

name: RYSE Fuel Tiger's Blood
msl:
REALLY good smell from this one. I am going to say this one is GT Grape. I thought it might be Watermelon but with some context clues, I don’t think it is. The first sip I said out loud: “...is this Lychee Bomb?!?!” But no! AHHHH!!! TIGERS BLOOD.

This one definitely has the same similar taste as the last tigers blood. I don’t know if it’s as strong, but I also don’t know if it is any better. It’s like, that hint of Coconut just does NOT do well with the flavor like you’d hope. It makes sense now why I thought this might be Watermelon at first sniff, because I’m pretty sure Tigers Blood is Coconut and Watermelon and I think a little Strawberry? And just like the Gorilla Mind version, you definitely get the COCONUT and a hint of the Strawberry, but I dunno so much about the watermelon. It’s really hard to describe the taste of this thing when you clash these flavors together. It like…also feels weird going down the throat. It’s not terrible, but it’s not the most appetizing. Did I finish it? Yes. Would I ever buy one again? No. Would I ever TRY one again? Honestly, I’d have to be really really really thirsty and no other options would have to exist. It’s just not great to me. Not much different than Gorillas though.
nf:
Meh smell from this one.

Tastes like the other Tiger’s Blood drinks we’ve had, which is to say: not my thing. This one has a light Jello-like consistency to it that I’m not a fan of here. It has a can with red white and blue like it’s a bomb pop flavor which absolutely STINKS because bomb pops are way better than Tiger’s Blood, both the flavor and actual substance. Anyway like the other one it just tastes like cough syrup, which I’d be fine with if I were sick and taking cough syrup. For a recreational beverage I am not a fan. I don’t think this would escape the bottom 10 for me currently, but as with last time a debate and compromise can and will be made.

name: GOAT Fuel Black Cherry Ginger Ale
nf:
NF has brought me a dark red mystery drink and I can only assume this is BLOOD RAZZ. What flavor it is, I can’t say. I assume it’s one of Strawberry, Watermelon, or Raspberry.

Boy I took a sip of that and I don’t really know what that was. Whatever it is, the flavor was completely watered down. Second bigger taste: OK so I was going to describe the flavor, or do my best to - and I was gonna say it’s actually probably Cherry — but right as I was about to it has been revealed to me that this is GOAT FUEL BLACK CHERRY GINGER ALE and boy was I shocked. THE CAN IS GREEN! WHY IS THIS DRINK BLOOD RED?! I’VE BEEN HOODWINKED!

But yeah, I can definitely get watered down hints of Black Cherry here. Now that I’m really trying to focus on the “Ginger Ale” part - I don’t really know if I can taste it at all. It’s weird. It’s not a bad flavor. It’s just weird and kind of… OK. I don’t hate it. But I don’t particularly like it very much either. Good enough to finish. Not good enough that I ever really wanna seek out again. Odd aftertaste. Thumbs in the middle - MSL.

This kinda smells like the flavor? Assuming I know what the flavor is, anyway

I told Matt what the flavor was, and he didn’t believe me for a little bit. Funky is how I’d describe this. It’s all over the place in a weird, borderline bad way like a poor imitation of Jackson Pollock I tried to do in the 6th grade. It is funny that we ended up with blue, red, and green choices, and I went with the green. No omens today! Anyway I find it very hard to describe the taste, as it tastes like nothing. A mishmash of flavors that clash. A little sweetness, a little bitterness, a little tart. Nothing really good. If you concentrate hard enough, there’s something in there, but it slips away pretty quickly. Rough! More goat than GOAT here.

name: Gorilla Mind Tropic Storm
msl: This one is a mystery to me.  It smells cit-ussy, to the point that I think this might be another Gorilla - and might be Tropical Storm.  I’m just getting kind of a pineapple smell here I think.  Or mango.  I’m not sure.  But we’ll see. Oh mn.  I’m trying to think of the taste.  I’m trying to think of the fruit that this OVERWHELMINGLY atastes like, but I can’t think of it for some reason.  It definitely has a bitter flavor, and I don’t think this is anything close to my personal favorite flavor, but I don’t dislike it at all.  I think it might actually be Mango.  Peach.  Something.  The strong flavor might actually be peach.  As I take more sips I actually kind of like it a little more.  But just because I prefer more RED or BLUE flavors I don’t think I would get it again.  If you really slosh it in your mouth you kinda get a little bit of that ENERGY DRINK flavor flare.  Much like yesterdays, I think I like this a lot more than NF.  Though I think this one is definitely BETTER than yesterdays.  Sorry NF!!!  We’ll get you tomorrow.
nf: Smells like I thought it would…tastes about what I thought, maybe worse. Has a bitterness surrounding it that sucks, no other way to say it. Just flat out sucks. There’s what I think is a pineapple flavor underneath it, but I’m not the biggest pineapple guy so it’s not really a saving grace. The fruits on the can look like they are kiwi and peach, and yeah I guess I can see that somewhere. Dunno if this ever had a great chance with me, but even by those standards this falls short. Apparently this, Lucky Lemon, and Sour Watermelon Candy are Vitamin Shoppe exclusives, which puts a lot of pressure on the upcoming SMC test.

name: Celsius Sparkling Peach Vibe
msl: Pungent - smells just like what it is though.  Also piss yellow.  You know it actually does just kinda taste like a peach.  I was really sweating this one but that wasn’t exactly an unpleasant sip.  I took a bigger sip the second time - and I like peach.  But I dunno if I really like it *this* much.  You don’t really get that fizzy overwhelming energy taste.  It’s just…peach.  Each sip I take after the first one I kinda like it a little less.  But I’m gonna finish it.  Yeah.  That was alright.  Don’t think I would ever go for it again willingly, but it wasn’t bad.  Just a peach drink.
nf: Looks like piss. Tastes like peach. That’s really all I have to say. Tastes like peach! I’m not a peach guy, but if you are, you’ll like it! Peach! “Here we goooo!” But it is a subtle peach, not a blaring flavor. Matches the brand, which as previously discussed is like an energy drink for people that don’t want energy drinks.

name: C4 Creamsicle
msl: THIS SMELLS MUCH BETTER.  I am excited.  IT…Tastes sorta like creamsicle but honestly isn’t amazing???  A little watered down.  Second sip has more of the creamsicle taste.  This is kinda wild because I expected that patented C4 ENERGY DRINK flavor to be all over this one, but I just don’t taste it at all.  It’s just a weird, watery, creamsicle taste.  Not amazing.  Would not get it again probably.  But not terrible either.
nf: First ever two energy drink day, albeit with the last one being two sips instead of half a can like usual. The taste of that may be influencing this, but I dunno. It’s good. It’s more orange than cream much like the Ghost, but this is probably a little better. It does not have the sour kick that the best C4s have, which I didn’t expect but is never a bad thing. This is not bad, but I have yet to run into an orange creamsicle energy drink I was head over heels for, which is a shame because it’s one of my favorite flavors.

name: Red Bull The Blue Edition: Blueberry
msl:
So, Red Bull does NOT give a shit about food coloring. This shit is PURPLE. DEEP PURPLE. It has a grape like smell more than blueberry, I feel like. But it’s close enough to the smell of the original Red Bull that I’m actually kinda nervous that these might suck? I guess we’ll find out. OK so here’s the thing - I can still get the hint of that original Red Bull taste, but it’s not as intense as the original. I am not really getting the overwhelming flavor of Blueberry here. Unfortunately, I also am not sure I exactly LIKE it much either. I will say, It’s definitely BETTER than the original to me, which made me scrunch my face up and hit my desk in exaggerated fashion a few times. But it’s not GREAT. As I continue to sip it, this actually feels like something I can finish. So in that instance, it’s a win. But I can’t say I’d go out of my way for another one of these. When I think of Blueberry Flavored Energy Drinks, this really isn’t the flavor that comes to my mind. But then again, now that I really, really think about it, I think I was more expecting a blue raspberry flavoring and that’s why I’m so disappointed here. Shit. That actually may be the case. I was expecting a razzleberry and not just a Blueberry.

So that’s unfortunate. But now that I’m realizing this, it makes me not dislike this flavor as much. I still don’t think I’d get it again, I think I prefer something a lot more sweet than this, but the hint of blueberry IS there. It does what it sets out to do. It’s just not my favorite drink. Mid tier/lower end, probably.
nf:
They went fucking crazy with the food coloring on this one. They wanted you to think this came from actual energized blueberries. This smells mostly like “energy drink” with the slightest hint of blueberry, which could be an omen for how it tastes.

I am neither happy nor sad to report that Red Bull: The Blue Edition Blueberry tastes like a less abrasive normal Red Bull. There is just the absolute tiniest hint of blueberry flavor. I feel like the neutral race of aliens from Futurama in that my face is unmoved, with no feelings on the matter. It’s a slightly better Red Bull. It’s got a slightly more berry mood to it with the slightly bitter/medicinal Energy Drink stuff surrounding it. I’d get this over normal Red Bull, but I wouldn’t ever get Red Bull outside of being handed one at some Red Bull-sponsored event in Europe. Research indicates we actually just missed one of the American ones in Philly a week ago!

name: Red Bull Sugarfree
msl:
The Golden Pissdrink. It smells of Red Bull. Let’s get started.

This is… not as strong as I would have thought. I don’t know what it is. It’s like… a sweet taste that dissipates immediately. Ok yes a lot more intense when you slosh it around the mouth and more reminiscent of that red bull flavor that I wasn’t super crazy about when we last had it - but there’s also this sweetener in it. I dunno what it is. Is it OK? Yes. Do I LIKE it? Ehhh… It’s not terrible? Like I think I can finish this thing very easily and am going to, given I need a BURST OF ENERGY. But it’s just completely middling. Not very inspiring. Not very flavorful. Thumbs in the middle, leaning down? I dunno. Did finish.
nf:
Today is some sort of Red Bull, but which kind is a mystery to me. It has the look of a regular Red Bull/Monster/Amp. That is to say, it looks like a glass full of gasoline. The smell is neutral bordering on non-existent. Gonna take a wild shot and say this is Red Bull Sugar Free.

That is a drink that exists. It has some sort of faint flavor. Much like Monster Energy, this seems less like an enjoyable drink and more like a tool. “We made some non-coffee stimulant that won’t taste like total shit, but it won’t have an appealing or even recognizable taste.” It’s a watered down Red Bull, which itself wasn’t as bad as expected but just there. Google’s little AI disaster summary thing says “The core Red Bull Sugarfree has a slightly sweet-tart, slightly medicinal taste.” which, sure. That sounds right. It’s a tool for the job that’s been outclassed by better ones, even in the sugar free department.

name: Red Bull
msl: Well.  Here we go.  A first time for everything.  This will be my first ever Red Bull.  I have no idea what it tastes like.  I have no idea what to expect because it’s just… “Red Bull”.  No flavor.  Just Red Bull.  I wonder if it’ll be like that C4 energy drink flavor?  I truly don’t know.  It’s brown.  Like a cream soda almost.  Has a nice…ish?  But strong smell.  I dunno how to describe it.  OK.  I took a sip, and I gotta be honest, I do not think I like that very much at all.  Hahaha.  It’s kind of…medicinal.  But given this is my first, I really need to give it the full college try.  So now we have the SLOSH TEST: Man.  I just… I don’t know man.  It tastes like fuckin ACID.  It doesn’t feel bad in my mouth, but I dunno man.  This shit is supposed to give me WINGS???  I’m taking a deep breath as I’m gonna do the big 3 gulps now.  BOY am I struggling with this one!!!  I just…I can’t.  Chat is this real?  It’s not horrifyingly bad or anything but there is so much of it, and it’s strong.  I don’t know if it’s like a citrus or what.  It feels just weird.  I’m sorry all, I don’t know what else to say about this one.  I’m looking forward to having versions of this that are actually flavored…. But as of right now?  No more original Red Bull for me.  I’m cutting myself off.  It was an odd first experience, leaving a bitter feeling in my mouth.  I’m done, Gus.
nf:
Me when Matt handed me the glass: “Smells like blue raspberry…is it rainbow sherbet?” Reader, I am aware that these are conflicting points but I must add that I am stupid.

This is RED BULL, baby! Original ass Red Bull without gimmicks. And…it doesn’t taste GREAT, but I’m not wincing. My only prior experience with Red Bull was in a Jagerbomb which was both my first and last. I like this more than the Jagerbomb. If you told me this was some citrus flavor I’d believe you, because it does have a citrus aura about it, which is nice. It also tastes like medicine, which is not so nice. The only other “original” we’ve had is Mountain Dew AMP, and I liked that way more. Still: I expected to really dislike this and I only kinda dislike it. Overachieving! I would drink this if I needed a kick in the ass and this was the only option, which is actually a semi-realistic scenario compared to something like “I guess I’d drink Celsius Sparkling Peach Vibe if it were shoved in my face.”

name: Alani Nu Hawaiian Shaved Ice
msl: I dunno what this will taste like but it has a nice smell.  It does smell like Peach though.  Yeah - it definitely has a bit of a Peach hint.  A somewhat strong aftertaste is there also.  I’ve never really associated Hawaii with Peach.  ALANI NU says this is “Splashes of Strawberry and Watermelon” but I really don’t get that vibe much at all.  Maybe because yesterday we basically had that with Coconut.  It’s hard to come up with words to say about this one.  Sloshing it around the mouth, it’s… It’s OK.  Even after reading “Strawberry and Watermelon” I can’t really shake the vibe that it tastes more like Peach than anything else.  It’s not a strong peach, it’s kind of more on the medium end.  It’s nothing like those drinks we’ve had in the past that just kinda taste like nothing.  Alani Nu’s aren’t the biggest and I’ve already finished my sample, but what I had wasn’t BAD.  I just don’t think the flavor is right for me, as I am sure I’ve said on every review that leaned more towards Peach flavors. Just…interesting.  Yeah.
nf: This is very pink and smells like peach? Very interesting. Have my guesses as to the identity of the drink (Matt’s choice today) but we’ll see…Well it does have somewhat of a peach taste. Some bitterness too. It’s not terrible, but it’s not extremely pleasant either. Second sip was a little better. I figured this was an Alani Nu drink as Gorilla Mind doesn’t color their drinks to my recollection. Doing my research, this is actually another Tiger’s Blood, AND there is a new can design we didn’t get that “features more splashes of strawberry and watermelon.” Well I guess I’d hope so because I didn’t really taste either in this, much less coconut. It’s in a weird place for me because I think it’s a more pleasing taste than the Gorilla Mind Tiger’s Blood we had yesterday, but it does not really taste like anything resembling strawberry, watermelon, or coconut. Weird!

name: Huel Energy+ Pineapple & Mango
msl:
Huel has an odor that is just undeniable in every can I’ve opened, but at least in this one we also have a tropical smell to it as well. I do not have high hopes for this one, and I have gotten the both of us some chasers just in case we fucking detest it like the others. I’m doing this for YOU ALL, so we can be CHAMPIONS of THIS SPACE.

I pinched my nose to take a first sip, and that’s an overwhelming mango flavor. When you don’t pinch your nose, it’s less delightful because again - the odor, but this one has to be better than the actual other 2 flavors we’ve had. Truly wish they could do something about the disgusting smell, because it’s really hard to rate it objectively when it’s got such a stench. And maybe someone out there reading this actually really likes it? I dunno.

This is a fine mango flavor, with hints of pineapple there. I don’t hate it. Honestly feeling very thumbs in the middle about it. Not really compelled to have another. But for the first time, I was actually able to finish one of these.

Almost forgot to do the slosh test btw - not a good idea with these drinks.
nf:
Well it was going to happen eventually. There are no sunk costs in this business until we take some sips. At that point, sure, we’ll toss 90%. The tropical smell is very strong. I can smell it even though it’s just sitting on my desk to my left. I can also smell the disgusting Huel flavoring as well. Outlook: grim.

So the smell is there. The disgusting, awful Huel smell is absolutely there. And I’m not a big fan of tropical flavors. But uh…that isn’t so bad? Granted, I’m coming from expecting an F minus minus, absolute fucking diarrhea-tier drink. But I’ve taken two sips and it’s really quite ok. Now is it GOOD? No, definitely not. It’s a mediocre tropical energy drink with an absolutely vile odor to it, and there’s wildly better options. This reminds me of Oxyshred Guava Paradise, another mid drink that might as well have been C4 Starburst Cherry given what I was expecting. So in a vacuum, this isn’t worth getting at all. But compared to the other Huel flavors this is wildly better.

name: Red Bull The Amber Edition: Strawberry Apricot
msl:
Alright. It’s Strawberry Apricot Red Bull. The one color red bull I don’t think we’ve had. Amber. It’s a red drink, and it smells delish. I hope it tastes as good as it smells. If it does it just might be my favorite flavor Red Bull has ever done.

It unfortunately does not taste as good as it smells. The smell deceives you into thinking it will be a strong strawberry flavor, but the taste…is not. You get some hints of it, but it’s overtaken by Red Bulls base and what I presume is Apricot. After swallowing the roof of my mouth is kind of hit with this…bitter flavor. It’s a little medicinal. I will say on the next few sips I don’t really dislike it, but I gotta tell you I don’t really like it either. The kind of thing I would be just fine pouring a glass of if we were at a birthday party as kids and for some reason it was the only drink available, but would never buy myself. I will say, when I took a big swig at the end, the flavor sitting in my mouth did have a stronger strawberry taste…but it dissolved pretty quickly into that bitter flavor I am not so crazy about. I was able to finish it. But I do think this may be just a thumbs in the middle, probably leaning down for my tastebuds.
nf:
Red Bull, you call this “The Amber Edition” despite the fact it is obviously red. Smells mostly like strawberry. Hoping it tastes good.

It! It! IT!!! Doesn’t really. It’s kinda wack. There’s a strawberry flavor in there somewhere but the rest tastes medicinal. It’s like I’m five years old in the 90s having just been prescribed Ritalin and Lexapro, but my parents have to crush up the pills and put them in strawberry juice for me to able to consume them because I can’t swallow whole yet. Haha, what a weird scenario that DEFINITELY did not happen to me. Ah, they tried their best with the data they had. This stinks, though. I will say it’s better if you chug in instead of sipping it, which I did with the rest of it. So points for that.

name: JOLT Cola
msl:
I can’t put one past NF on this mystery drink. We know what it is. It doesn’t have a strong smell but it looks if you poured coke into a glass, so let’s get this going. I hope it’s good! Apparently REDCON1 makes this. Never had a JOLT before, so I unfortunately will not be able to tell you how it compares to the original. Only if it’s good or bad.

It tastes like a COLA VARIANT but it’s not a strong flavor AT ALL. It’s actually kinda shocking how much little flavor is in this thingi. Is it just FLAT? I have a Diet Pepsi right next to me that has a much more lingering flavor when I sip it. Really disappointing honestly, just drink some Coke or Pepsi. The Jolt has nothing to really offer above that. It’s not bad, just tastes like fucking nothing so if you want 200mg of Caffeine that tastes like nothing, goes for this one I guess. I finished my glass.
nf:
I was thinking if I chose the next drink it would be Jolt. I think Matt was thinking the same thing based on the color of this drink (cola brown) and him fighting a smirk when I said I think I know what this is. Oh there he’s gone and confirmed it. Anyway, as the nineties rememberer I must admit I never had the original one of this, and frankly even if I had I likely wouldn’t remember the taste anyway.

So I remember as a kid seeing a “Super Jolt” with 4x the caffeine. I rarely have these Mandela effect thingies, but based on my research it is likely either one of those or a dream I had. What I probably saw was Electric Blue Jolt and just assumed it was 2x on top of Jolt’s standard 2x. I will not totally declare defeat, however. If I one day see evidence of Super Jolt’s existence, I will be thrilled. Anyway this drink. It’s flat diet cola. Much like the other cola energy drinks we’ve had. It has the lack of carbonation that a Diet Coke that’s been open for a day or two has. The flavor is “blink and you miss it” like one of those. It doesn’t taste bad, and in fact I detect a tiny hint of spice/kick in there to add a bit of variety, but this is just another boring wet fart of a cola energy drink. I’m starting to think the concept might not have legs, folks!

name: Bum Energy Cola
msl:
OK we need to catch up on some stuff, and we both decided that BUM Energy Cola is probably going to be the one we care about the least, because seemingly all of these are just “mediocre cokes”.  But hey, BUM has had some good stuff and maybe they will surprise us.  I am not judging before having it!!!  OK.  Maybe I am a little.  But I have an open mind it’ll be good!

This drink is CLEAR and that surprises me.  Who makes a CLEAR cola???  I guess BUM does.  This has been in the fridge for a while but it’s definitely still good.  No real smell.  Bottoms up!

Yeah about what I expected.  It’s a light cola.  Not bad, but not amazing either.  Better than some of the other cola variants maybe?  Yeah.  It’s just too light of a Cola taste for my liking.  I don’t think this is bad, but dude - just get a Coke.  Get a freaking Pepsi even.  In fact, I was about to have a Diet Pepsi before I decided we should do a drink.  And even though this is an easily finish-able drink to me, I just don’t think I’m gonna do it.  

My review might come off harsh here.  It’s not THAT bad.  But I dunno.  Don’t come at the king and then miss with these pitiful attempts.
nf:
Matt and I stood at the fridge, trying to decide which drink to pick next, and we solemnly resigned ourselves to our fate. The Science and our journalistic integrity demands that we do this, but we don’t have to be thrilled. Not that I expect it to be disgusting, I just know what to expect with these energy drink colas by now. It’s clear, which even if this is your first cola energy drink is a major party foul and indication that something may be up. 

My expectations were low and Bum somehow landed below that. I see carbonation in my glass, but I sure as shit don’t detect it. That greatly blows the flavor profile up, as you’re left with a pale imitation of diet cola. If I had to guess why these companies keep trying to make an energy drink cola, the only thing I can think of is that there’s health nuts and crunchy types out there that miss their Diet Coke but won’t drink it because of toxins and GMOs and whatever insane shit the MAHA crowd is into these days. But maybe they’ll be open to something sold in GNC or The Vitamin Shoppe? I dunno, do they drink caffeine? Anyway, this sucks, just get Coke Zero or Diet Pepsi if you want a caffeinated diet cola.

name: OxyShred Ultra Energy Guava Paradise
msl:
OK. Very interesting smell. I can’t really tell what it is, but my brain is telling me “This might be the cali cola!!!” so that’s what I’m going to officially predict.

This isn’t superb but it also isn’t bad either on the first sip. Honestly surprised to see this is “Guava Paradise”. There isn’t a ton of flavor here, but it immediately puts its previous entries to shame and instantly becomes “THE BEST OXYSHRED WE HAVE EVER HAD.” The both of us have avoided this brand like the plague since the Ghostbusters Flavors we tried, and they have sat comfortably at the bottom of our list ever since they were added. There is definitely a hint of fruity flavor if you let it sit and slosh around in your mouth for a bit before swallowing, but as hinted at before, it’s not exactly overwhelming. There is no bullshit ENERGY DRINK flavor aftertaste either. It tastes slightly refreshing, but doesn’t really inspire any strong feelings from me. If you offered me a drink, and handed me this, I would thank you, drink it all, but then absolutely ask for something else the second time around.
