This is fine. It’s not great. It’s maybe not even “good”? Well. I kinda like it when it rests in my mouth for a few seconds. But could stand to be stronger. Either way, congrats on being the BEST OXYSHRED WE’VE EVER HAD!!!

After Ranking Note: I did not get the same “sour” or “bitter” feeling that NF did when drinking this. It was just bland juice flavor to me.
nf:
My only question for Matt when picking this was “Do I pick one I think we’ll like or one I’m unsure of.” I am definitely unsure of this one.

Well that wasn’t great but it wasn’t the dirt worst like the previous Oxyshreds we tried. The smell was awful but the taste was better, so points for Team Oxyshred in not making another Double F Minus drink. With that said, the taste is sour but bitter and kinda unpleasant. There’s a hint of sweetness to it , but it’s overpowered by the bitterness. A quantum leap over the other Oxyshreds, but still not recommended.

name: NOS Energy Original
msl:
OOOOO that SMELL… It’s yellow. Like Orange Juice. But it smells like.. I don’t know what. It’s like PINEAPPLE and SOMETHING ELSE?

Yeah you know it’s kinda juicy but it also just doesn’t taste too great going down. You know I like citrusy drinks, I swear. I like Orange. I like Pineapple. I like Peach. But I can’t really identify what the heck this is. A TROPICAL MIX is probably the correct answer. It does kinda have a medicinal taste to it, though the aftertaste isn’t all that strong. Doing the SLOSH TEST that I do with the drinks that I feel I need to truly give the college try, "towards": Eh. Honestly it’s not so bad. The mouth feel brings no joy though. A cup of juice mixed with a cup of disappointment!!! That might be a little too much of a put down from me honestly. This isn’t like complete garbage or anything, it’s just not something I would ever want to drink again for the rest of my life. Completely mediocre. Juice/fruity flavors gotta do better. I will not finish this one.
nf:
This looks like orange juice and smells like tropical punch, so if this turns out to be Birthday Cake Bash, I’ll be VERY surprised.

Tastes like a Red Bull! Unsurprising, giving that it is another standard, classic energy drink without any of the flavoring to hide the dark, seedy underbelly. It’s acidic, citrusy, a little bitter. It tastes like Energy Drink, the way I remember it when I was a young boy trying to survive a mid-day crash in Philosophy 101. My taste palette has evolved, so I merely “don’t like” this instead of outright “wanting to die.” We live in an era where you do not have to drink what looks and tastes like piss any longer. NOS will likely escape the bottom 10, at least. A feather in the old man’s cap.

name: GHOST Energy Citrus
msl: This smell…. This drink… let’s get it over with.  Smell kinda reminds me of Dew tbh but I don’t drink dew.  I took a gigantic gulp and by doing that, it really wasn’t so bad.  But this is, in fact. CITRUS. Sloshing it around, the SLOSH TEST.  We need to come up with a name for that, it’s actually not too bad.  It reminds me of a …citrusy drink.  Though the flavor, I can’t quite place. It’s not really Pineapple.  Or orange.  Or lemon.  Or lime.  Though the more I think about it it might be more Lemon/Lime than anything else.  It has a strong aftertaste that kinda lingers underneath your tongue.  A little bitter.  I actually think I’ll be able to finish this one, but I also think I’ll immediately want to have a drink of water to wash out the aftertaste, because it is NOT actually leaving me.  Yeah this isn’t terrible, but it is not something I’d really get again.  If it was the only thing that I had left to drink, sure.  I guess i’d drink it.  But I’d prefer water.  Not as bad as I thought.  But not really good.
nf: Matt says he is sorry about this. I can only assume this is either Alani Nu Tropisicle or more likely GHOST Citrus. Smell is…mostly nothing, maybe a bit medicinal…Squarely in the “don’t love it, don’t hate it” camp. Guilty of the crime of not being really much of anything. Not death penalty worthy, but the taste is so weak that if you told me this was water I might think it was, albeit with a funky taste. Carbonation is nowhere to be found. Brings to mind the sips of my mom’s Crystal Light that I used to take as a kid, where I’d be curious and then very quickly incurious. I guess if you’re looking for a very mild citrus drink, this could be your answer, but I have to imagine there are better products out there with a touch more flavor and identity. A solid MEH.

name: Gorilla Mind Lucky Lemon
msl: Sniffing the hell out of this one.  It’s clear-ish.  The smell almost reminds me of sprite.  If I had to guess I would think this is Lucky Lemon, but I am not certain.  That is….lemony!  I think?!  It is!  This is very much a lemon tasting drink.  Personally, I like fizzy lemon flavors but I know that my partner in crime probably will not.  SURE WONDER WHAT IT’D TASTE LIKE IF YOU THREW A LITTLE LIME IN THERE… There is a weird after taste after swallowing that hangs in your mouth, and it’s not the most pleasant, but the actual drink itself does just seem to me like a Sprite that is missing the Lime.  Swirling it around the mouth, there are no real flavors I’m missing here.  It’s just lemon!  Taking a much bigger gulp… it tingles.  I gotta tell ya it really tingles my upper lip.  I don’t remember if I grabbed this one, or if NF grabbed this one - but something tells me this will be the *lowest* Gorilla we’ve had.  I don’t really think anything is wrong with it though, outside of that aftertaste.  If you like Lemon, this one is fine.  But just get a Sprite imo.  Would I personally have this one again?  …No.  I don’t think I would.  But I did finish it.
nf: Smells like what you’d expect. I think? Part of me disagrees. We’ll see what the Scientific Sip tells us…Well it tastes like lemon. Not particularly a great tasting lemon, not very sour, not very sweet, not much of anything, but it’s definitely lemon. Not feeling very lucky at the moment. Yeah I’m not crazy about this. It’s like drinking a Sprite where you get the initial lemon and then it trails off. I’m not SURPRISED by that as it is not advertised as lemon lime or some cheeky “haha it’s Sprite but we can’t say” name, it’s LEMON. It has a slight aftertaste that’s just terrible, too. Bitter. Gorilla Mind’s first miss.

name: Rockstar RECOVERY Berryade
msl:
This drink has color so I immediately assumed it was the Red Bull, but then I saw what we had on the dropdown and I wonder if it’s the Watermelon Grape. The drink is PURPLE and Red Bulls generally don’t give a crap about food coloring or w/e. It honestly kinda smells a little like cotton candy. I dunno. We’ll see what we have here.

Wow ok that’s ultra sweet. I’m being told this is ROCKSTAR BERRYADE - which makes sense. It’s a crazy sweet berry flavor. It’s kinda interesting, it has the SWEET flavoring and you expect something else to come to balance it out - but that just never comes. I don’t think I’m crazy about it. Sloshing it around the mouth is actually a really unpleasant feeling with this one. It’s just cold and sweet. Giving it the old college try with a bigger swig and… yeah there is a berry flavor there, but this just isn’t doing it for me. I should stress, it’s not like it’s “disgustingly sweet” - like TOO sweet for me, but it just kind of feels like that is all there is. Like I’m expecting another ingredient to punch in that just doesn’t. And I’m not really a fan. One more sip for the road and yeah, this is a thumbs down for me. I don’t like it. Did not finish.
nf:
Today’s drink is of a lightish purple hue. I think Matt will guess what this is, but I’ve thought that before and been proven wrong. I won’t read his guess until we’re done so he very well could have guessed it already. The scent is not particularly strong.

Well the scent was very light for a reason: the flavor is very light. The flavor that is there is, paradoxically, very strong when it is there. It very much tastes like what it says on the can: Berryade. Berry lemonade. It’s got the piercing hit of lemonade, but it’s…how do I put this, it’s almost like it’s under a layer of non-flavor. I detect the flavor, like it’s screaming I’M HERE in a high pitched tone, but you can only just hear the screams under a very loud white noise. The flavor hits the sides of my tongue, but when I swallow it’s like I just took a swig of water. Rockstar “RECOVERY” is apparently non-carbonated by design, so I imagine it is intended to come off more like juice than a carbonated energy drink. But I think in this case that is for the worse, as to me it’s more flat than anything else. Carbonation would have kicked this up a bit. Not terrible, but a weird one and a bit of a missed opportunity.

name: RYSE Fuel Country Time Lemonade
msl:
This is a mystery for NF again. This is one of those flavors that I’m not so much looking forward to when I look at the flavor but then I think about how it should taste and I am completely in on it again. The drink is completely clear. Citrus smell.

OK Well. It doesn’t in fact taste like what I had hoped, but I don’t think it’s bad at all. NF made an audible “Auuugh….” sound after taking his first sip. This is LEMONADE and I was hoping it’d be more of a Sprite/7-Up flavor haha. Like hey, you know what? You can taste the lemon. That much is true. It’s not nearly as BOLD and PUNCH YOU IN THE FACE as the Gorilla Lemon flavor, but the flavor is there. And if you don’t like Lemon flavor in your soda, you probably aren’t gonna like this one. I don’t really know how to describe the weird taste of this one, I guess it’s just what a RYSE FUEL would taste like if you chucked some damn lemons in? It doesn’t taste like lemonade, that's for sure. It’s sweet. It’s got some…bitterness but not too much. I dunno. This just is kind of fine to me. I don’t hate it. It’s got this weird aftertaste that isn’t too crazy but it lingers on the roof of your mouth. This is a drink I think I would finish if the can was like half the size, but because I have so much I am gonna tap out. 100+ of these and I’m still a little skeeved out on the idea of drinking too much.

On the scale of: Is this a good flavor? I’d say yeah kinda.

On the scale of: Would you drink it again? I’d say probably only if it was the only thing available.

Middle of the pack drink, imo.
nf:
M got a bunch of new drinks so I have no clue what this could be. It’s clear. Cannot particularly say what the smell is.

OK, first impressions are a face scrunch but I’m gonna try and keep an open mind because I wasn’t expecting that kind of taste. Second sip is not as bad, but knowing what this is now has me disappointed. I was looking forward to this and it tastes more in line with a lemon-flavored drink than lemonade. The big hit of sweetness you get in lemonade is just not there at all. It’s like Country Time Sugar Free, except they didn’t put the artificial sweetener in there at all. Big miss from Ryse here.

name: bang Energy Birthday Cake Bash
msl:
Back in the swing of things. Hopefully this drink is better than yesterdays. OH! This one smells…SWEET. And I’m really scared it’s the Birthday Cake one that is expired. It’s a clear drink and smells like a sugar cookie.

OK. I’ve been informed that’s what this is. It smells GREAT. But I am extremely worried here. We are going to do this though. FOR SCIENCE.

OK. So. Right off the bat, it definitely hits that BIRTHDAY CAKE flavor. It’s very sweet. But…it has this immediately, pretty grody aftertaste after it settles in your mouth. The both of us were literally pumping ourselves up for this one, expecting the worst, and I don’t even think this will be in our bottom 3. Doing the MOUTH SLOSH TEST ON IT:

Oh my god. Oh my god. I spit it out. Oh my god. I nearly gagged. Holy shit. Do not do the slosh test with this drink. It feels disgusting when you do. I literally spit it back out into the cup. Jesus christ. I have never had that experience.

I managed to sneak a few more sips even after that. Even though I had such a violent reaction to sloshing it around my mouth, I do NOT…think it’s the worst thing we’ve ever tasted. It’s extremely sweet, and it…hits what it’s going for. I will say though, I’m not very crazy about it. Eugh! Did not finish.

Edit: It’s been over 15 minutes since I took my last sip and the aftertaste is still there, as is the smell.
nf:
This smells funny in all senses of the word. I have been very very much looking forward to this for comedic reasons. I am not expecting anything good here. I have seen many Reddit posts saying this is the worst drink they’ve ever had.

That is weird. You get the very artificial sensation of…I guess I’d say sprinkles. Somewhere in the cake & sugar cookie realm. Honestly a bit disappointed because I was expecting to retch, but I’m not! It’s a fun gimmick that I don’t really recommend more than once, especially if the sell by date was two years ago. Not a great drink, but devilishly fun.

name: C4 Orange Slice
msl: Today we are doing something different, in that the drink is poured for me and I am going to figure out what it is.  It is CLEAR so I think it is a C4.  I am not sure which one though.  Giving it a smell - I’m not immediately sure what this could be.  Bottoms up.  HEAVY energy drink taste.  Moreso than flavor.  I think this might be the Orange Slice, but I am not sure.  Trying again.  No - I really am not sure if this is Orange Slice, but knowing what we have in the fridge that’s all I can imagine it might be.  This is not a strong ORANGE taste.  Honestly a bit disappointing how little flavor it is.  It isn’t BAD - because again, I like the C4 taste.  But this one isn’t anything special.  As I kept drinking, the orange flavor did become more apparent.  Add some more of that Orange Flavor and this would be near the top - but as it is, I’m just kinda like “Good - wouldn’t buy again”.  Oh well!
nf: I know something Matt doesn’t knooooow~~~ Because I poured it. Even knowing what this is I did not taste what it is advertised as being. Maybe because I just had the DOUBLE CHUNK CHOWCLAT COOKIE FROM CAWSTCO. The only orange I detect is in the aftertaste. When I drink it, it’s a pleasing but completely anonymous fruit flavor. Mystery Meat, or government cheese or something. I don’t dislike it, but I’d have really preferred a stronger orange flavor.

name: C4 Popsicle Hawaiian Pineapple
msl: We are back to C4 and we are back to a Clear Drink.  I love Pineapple - so I’m hoping this is good.  Bottoms up: The first sip I get a very strong pineapple taste.  It seemed very similar to pineapple juice?  I didn’t even really get the soda flavor.  On the second sip, it feels a little more flat than the first - but it’s more of the same.  As I keep taking more sips - the flavor seems to be less and less strong, reminding me a bit of the Rockstar Fruit Punch - but Pineapple is Pineapple and it’s very overwhelming.  I really like this one I think.  Though I don’t think I would race to choose it over any of the top tier flavors.  Yeah.  OK.  This is just pineapple for me.  A maybe not as strong pineapple with fizzzz instead of any pulp.
nf: Smells: Good! The Popsicle drinks have been a mixed bag for me personally, so let’s see how this goes…Medicinal Pineapple would have been a better name. Has a weird metallic, bitter flavor alongside a very nice pineapple taste. Subsequent sips have less of it, but it might just be my tastebuds are adapting. Wouldn’t put this in the dreaded F tier, but probably on the lower half of the list for me.

name: GHOST Energy Warheads Sour Green Apple
msl: This drink has a slight tint to it.  The smell isn’t very strong, but I think it is leaning something…citrus-y.  Either that our Sour Green Apple.  So here we go.  OH.  Oh.  That’s BITTER.  Definitely bitter.  Second sip - OOF.  I dunno man.  This definitely hits the GREEN SOUR APPLE flavor but BOY is it not my thing.  Face SCRUNCHED up on the first sip.  For science I must pull through.  Sloshing it around the mouth, it really has that sour, bitter apple flavor.  It’s there.  100%  But I have to be honest here, my body is FLAILING with each sip I take.  This is ROUGH.  To give it the old college try, I’m gonna take a big 3 gulp swig now:  Honestly, that was easier than I thought it would be, but this is one of those times where I have a drink and I think I’m going to have to have a palette cleanser after.  I can tell you right now: I respect this flavor - I just do not think it is for me, and I would not in fact ever get it again.  It almost reminds me of the Oxyshreds in terms of flavor, but the texture is a whole lot better and more refreshing than that.  This is a WILL NOT FINISH drink for me.
nf: Smells like the name. Vaguely piss colored. Interested to see how it goes…Well it tastes about what I thought it would. Sour Green Apple, like it says on the can. Not a huge fan of this, but I don’t hate it either. Kind of reminds me abstractly of hard cider, where I love the regular version but am kinda ehhhhhhhhhhh on the altered one. It tastes like a sour green apple juice with carbonation added (already kinda eh on that) plus it’s no sugar, which is always kinda not great with apple drinks. Despite this, I think it nails what it is going for and does not really taste bad, per se. It’s just an easy one and done that I won’t probably book a return engagement for.

name: BUCKED UP Blue Raz
msl:
Clear drink! Quite fizzy! Absolutely smells like what it is. Mystery for NF, 3rd drink in a row.

This definitely has the blue raspberry flavor, but something about it makes it seem really watered down. I dunno if there’s a version of this WITH SUGAR but that is instantly what is making my mind think “this is what is wrong with it!” It isn’t a bad flavor, but it definitely feels like a little too much of…something is fucking with it. And I’m not really sure what that is. Bitterness? Sourness? Something of a mix in the two. It’s not really BAD, but I’ve come to really really enjoy the Blue Raspberry flavor, and there is just a lingering weird taste that makes this kind of disappointing. With that said, again, the flavor isn’t god awful/terrible. It’s just not… really tasty either. It’s a blue raspberry energy drink. Albeit, one that I don’t think I would really go out of my way for ever again.

The more I drink it, the more I think “Blue Raspberry with Piss” kinda fits the bill. Don’t think I’ll finish it!
nf:
Smells like blue raspberry.

Tastes kinda like blue raspberry. But also kinda with piss. Ah it’s the redneck aesthetic drink BUCKED UP. Well I would say that is an apt description of this drink: Bucked Up Blue Raspberry. It’s like raspberry that’s been fucked with by a deer. You get the blue raspberry flavor which gives way to a gross taste. The BR taste isn’t even great before heading out. Have to check the list, but I imagine this will end up as our lowest ranked blue raspberry flavor.

name: Celsius Sparkling Tropical Vibe
msl: This is yellow and pineapple-y. OK.  I love pineapple but the Pineapple flavored stuff hasn’t hit as much… and this has starfruit.  So let’s see.  I mean.  It’s ALLLLRIIIIIGHT?  Like those tiktoks where you see EDP go “I MEAN IT’S ALLLLRIIIIGHT”.  Second sip…OVERRATED AS FUCK, IN MY OPINION.  OK.  This is just OK.  It’s not great.  But it is something that I think I can actually finish without dumping out the rest of it.  It just isn’t very inspiring to me.  Sloshing it around the mouth, it’s just…worse.  OK maybe I won’t finish it lmao.  Not terrible but not my favorite.  THAT’S FOR DAMN SURE
nf: I got a nasty canker sore so we’ll see if that influences the score. The smell is…artificial. All of these are artificial, but some do a better job at seeming less plastic than others. The taste is inoffensive, but kind of anonymous. As stated in the past, the Celsius flavors seem very appropriate for their market, which to me is women shopping at Whole Foods looking for a non-coffee pick me up that doesn’t come off as exclusively for assholes that yell at people at the gym or rave sex pests. It’s subtle, non-offensive, has a little tropical-ish flavor, isn’t bad but isn’t gonna win any awards from us.

name: GHOST Energy Tropical Mango
msl: I think this might be Tropical Mango.  It has a VERY strong smell.  Slight tint to the clear drink.  Not very appetizing.  But we will see!  That taste is strong.  It’s not the flavor I’m most crazy about, but it’s strong.  By now anyone reading this knows my fav flavors are RED and BLUE.  This just doesn’t hit as well for me.  But the taste is very much there, and it’s not unpleasant.  I wish I could really give a strong review but I don’t really eat Mangos on my spare time.  I just know the smell of them.  If Mango is like your FAVORITE FRUIT though I can absolutely see someone really liking this.  It’s refreshing and very juicy.  If you offered me one and said it was all we had, I’d take it no problem.  But this would never be in my first… 10 choices.  Maybe more.
nf: This is VERY pungent. I was able to smell it without putting my nose up to it in the kitchen after spilling a little bit. The smell has faded since, but it smells like what you’d expect…No sir, I do not like it. I had been avoiding buying this because it’s not my thing, but I had hoped I would be surprised at least a bit. But it’s just kinda gross. Tastes almost like a hard drink without any of the drunkenness to come. If tropical mango is your thing, I can see this hitting, but it doesn’t remotely do a thing for me. More like a Tropical Depression.

name: Mountain Dew Kickstart Strawberry Start-Up
msl: AS IF WE WERE ABSOLUTELY FREAKIN SICK OF IT… I think this is the Mountain Dew Strawberry.  Looking way more forward to this one than the last flavor.  It has a nice smell! Also it’s pink. This was not nearly as flavorful as I had hoped.  It tastes like a flat punch drink.  I dunno about this one.  Second sip - I think if you slosh it around your mouth for a bit you get more of the flavor, but it’s really not what I’d hope for with a Strawberry drink.  I want something deeper.  This kind of tastes like just a… not juicy berry.  It’s not stellar!  Like biting into a fruit that isn’t fresh and ripe.  Hasn’t developed all its flavor yet.  Not sure I’m gonna finish this one, just unimpressive.
nf: Pink drink today. Pinkish. A little pink…Ehhhh. Ehhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh. That tastes like a whole bunch of nothing. Maybe a hint of real strawberry but that might be placebo. Second and third sips there’s some flavor in the depths of the drink if you really focus, but otherwise it’s hard to really taste anything unique. Not great.

name: C4 Arctic Snow Cone
msl: Sour!  Can’t really say the flavor is me biting into a snowcone that I got from the carnival or anything like that.  Definitely a bit citrusy.  I don’t really know what I think of it at first glance, like it isn’t bad?  It’s pretty good.  I just don’t know what it is.  If you put one in front of me I wouldn’t say “no” to it by any means, but this isn’t really my preferred flavor.
nf: This isn’t by any means bad, but it’s kinda just there. Feels like if they mashed together every flavor we’ve had so far. It’s sweet with a bit of sour. No distinct flavor, I guess I’d say lemony/citrusy. It’s not bad, it’s just kinda odd. If someone handed me this I’d happily take it, but I wouldn’t go out of my way for it. I don’t really associate this kind of flavor with snow cones, but then again we’ve had those flavors already in cherry and blue raspberry. Anonymous is how I’d describe this

name: Celsius Sparkling Cherry Cola
msl:
Today’s the day…!!! I LOVE Cherry Cola… but this? I’m not optimistic about this one. The regular cola wasn’t exactly great. Maybe CHERRY saves it.

Well there’s definitely a cherry taste here. It tastes like the COLA part is flat, but the Cherry is there. That’s the aftertaste that sticks with you after you swallow. Cherry Flavoring. It’s a really weird feeling. It reminds me of when you go to a restaurant, and you know that something is up with the fountain soda that is making it taste weird, but you don’t really know what. But what you do know is that paying \$3 to \$4 for a fountain soda wasn’t worth it because it’s gonna be unremarkable your entire dinner. Taking a big swig and doing the slosh, you can get more of that COLA feeling. But small sips are overwhelmed by the cherry and flat soda. Just a boring flavor. But not one that I can’t finish.

With that said, I’m not going to.
nf:
Well, strap the fuck in. Praying that…you know what, I’m just Praying. Don’t even have to specify what about.

The good news? It’s better than the regular Celsius Sparkling Cola, which was prettay, prettay bad. The bad news is that it’s still bad. It’s mostly just a bad artificial cherry flavor. Frequent readers of our reviews know that we love a good cherry. In fact, I don’t know offhand if there’s a cherry flavor that’s hit the bottom third. But this will be the first. The cherry is just so FAKE. It’s got a bad chemical backend to it that makes it feel like I’m drinking cough syrup. There’s artificial cherry flavoring, and there’s whatever this is. I don’t even really taste the cola part, or even the sparkling part. It’s just shitty fake cherry all the way down.

name: Celsius Sparkling Cola
msl:
Not a fan of the smell tbh. Looks like soda. Smells like funky soda. This is sparkling cola. After the experience we had with OxyShred, I feel like this can’t be any worse, and yet I find myself expecting it (though OxyShred’s problem was it SMELLED LIKE SHIT. This one just smells… not amazing).

Tastes worse than flat cola. Might actually prefer the taste of the Oxy to this but this one not having nearly as rough a smell kinda saves it. Medicinal almost. Not a fan. Giving it the old college try by sloshing it: Yeah there is just this weird flavor that I don’t like over the taste of “extremely flat soda”. Not worth it. I think Diet Coke tastes like absolutely nothing and I would suggest that over this. Get normal soda. Thumbs down. Will not finish.
nf:
OK, well this one was obvious from the second Matt put the glass down. It smells like a weird diet cola. We recently had Oreo Coke Zero and Coke Zero Oreos. We were OK with the former and really did not like the latter. I am guessing we will be somewhere in the middle with this one, but it must be done in the name of The Science.

Meh. It’s not diabolical or anything, but it’s just a flat diet cola. Despite being called “sparkling,” there is no carbonation to speak of here. It is simply a flat as fuck diet cola. There’s a funky taste here, and one could say that is additional, but that is actually par for the course as someone who accidentally took a sip of some flat diet cola recently. I’ve had worse drinks, but I’m not sure there’s another drink out there that has less of a need to exist than this. Just buy your favorite diet cola and let it sit if you must have this flavor. Even better, drink it when you open it!

name: Beaver Buzz Energy Dr. Buzz
msl:
Today it is as hot as fucking hell. I need some refreshments.

This is my wheelhouse. I’m a Dr. Pepper guy. Well - a Diet Dr. Pepper guy. I think Diet is significantly better than regular. But I’ve also had variants that I’ve liked before like “Dr. Sprecher” that I thought were pretty good. It looks like Dr. Pepper. It smells like Dr. Pepper. Let’s see if it TASTES like Dr. Pepper.

Gotta say it doesn’t really taste like Dr. Pepper at all lol. If it does, it’s a flat Dr. Pepper. Taking another big sip and sloshing it around the mouth it’s like OK…MORE FLAVOR…. But Dr. Pepper has a very DISTINCT flavor and that is NOT what this is. It tastes more akin to a flat cola than a Dr. Pepper. I’m chugging more sips of this thing and I may or may not be tricking myself into thinking it might be closer to the Pepper flavor, but no. I think this is just “cola”. Disappointing! Not bad. Not terrible aftertaste. But kind of a failure in hitting the same flavor and uninspiring. If you like the taste of cane sugar though, you’re definitely getting some of that. I finished the drink because it was pretty easy to. But I don’t think I would give this one another chance unless it was to test if they’re all this flat.

Thumbs in the middle leaning down? Thumbs down? One of those.
nf:
What a Wednesday. Zohran won the primary last night, it’s hot as FUCK out, and we’re taking a trip to the doctor. I am not a fan of Dr. Pepper, but I’m also not a hater. It’s just not for me. So there is a possibility I could like this. I guess there’s a possibility I could like every drink though so what the fuck. Time for our appointment!

OK so lemme try and explain what I just tasted. For a split second I think there was something approximating Diet Dr. Pepper. I think it was mostly from the smell. Very light. Kinda tastes like a mix between Diet Dr. Pepper and Original Beaver Buzz. All of a sudden the taste just vanishes and it’s like I’m drinking water. There is, of course, no carbonation here. No cola energy drink seems to have it. Flat doesn’t seem to be enough of a description of this, because it doesn’t even evoke the feeling it ever aspired to have carbonation, much less have it accompany it on its trip to my mouth. This is the first drink to make me chortle after a first sip. “Get a fuckin load of this guy” is what I was thinking. While it doesn’t disgust my palette, it disgusts me as an enthusiast. A pathetic attempt at a drink of any kind.

name: OxyShred Ultra Energy Cali Cola
msl:
NF poured this one. I’m thinking it’s Cali Cola because of the color. PUNGENT smell. I dunno, it’s makin me a little nervous.

Honestly it’s got a cola taste, but I kinda held my nose to it as I was taking that sip. I haven’t had a sip of SODA STREAM cola in a long time but this might taste exactly like what this is. It’d be like if you asked for a Coke and you got that offbrand shit. Look, the more I smell it - I have to say straight up - THIS SMELLS LIKE SHIT. I hate the way it smells. It actively makes the drink worse, when the drink itself is honestly like completely fine. It’s trying to go for a Coke/Pepsi flavor, you can tell that’s what they’re going for. It tastes a little weird. But it’s not bad. But jesus christ, this smell. It’s making me think of the first Oxyshreds we drank. Maybe Oxyshred just normally smells like shit, I dunno. Anyway, don’t think I like this better than the last Oxy we drank but this one is just a “Eh!”. Not in the top 20, to say the least.
nf:
Ugly smell. Weird look. Let’s go.

Hm. Well. Not great. It tastes like cola but flat and if there were something wrong about it that I couldn’t identify. You get that awful whiff as you’re bringing it to your mouth, too, which sucks. Oxyshred has really got to work on their fucking smells. Yeah this just kinda sucks, which is even worse because it’s CLOSE to tasting just like diet cola. But then again…I’d just buy a Pepsi or a Coke? This thing is totally pointless. Boo this drink.

name: Red Bull The Yellow Edition: Tropical
msl:
THIS HAS TO BE THE RED BULL. TROPICAL SMELL. PUNGENT. PISS COLORED. THE YELLOW EDITION.

You know it’s got that Red Bull flavor and almost kinda seems like there’s some Peaches thrown in there maybe? That’s my initial thought, but that doesn’t really sound correct either. It’s probably more like a Mango if anything else, a fruit that I have never really eaten on its own. It has a juicy taste to it, and Mangos are definitely a Tropical flavor.

This isn’t BAD…. no matter what though, I don’t think I’m really fully IN on the base flavor of Red Bull, and that’s overwhelming in all of these. I’m slowly getting used to it, but it’s one of those drinks that doesn’t rank super high in my head. Probably would not get this one again. Unremarkable. But I did finish.
nf:
This looks and smells like what it is.

Well that tastes like gasoline. Red Bull on its own is not great. Not as bad as I thought it’d be, but not great. This tastes like what I thought Red Bull would taste like. Just terrible. Really bitter and artificial. Just an unpleasant time to be had by all. There’s a little bit of tropical taste in there, but the entire package just stinks too much otherwise to care. Bad! Avoid!

name: G Fuel Power Pellet
msl: Not sure what the flavor is here.  Smells very…berry.  Not sure if Blue or Red.  Definitely one.  There is a sweet taste here but I’m not totally sure.  I am thinking it’s… I dunno.  Maybe a flat cherry.  WHICH IS…WHERE I MAKE AN ADMISSION TO NF……. that I needed to pour this one TWICE because it looked like some weird little white flakes were at the bottom of the glass.  Apparently this is a thing.  I don’t know if I fucked with it by doing this.  But I tried to be very careful.  But yeah.  Flat cherry.  I don’t know if this is a DUD review bc of me.  But I drank everything in my glass.  Not really what you want out of a Cherry flavored drink.  It needs to be a whole lot stronger.  There is nothing NASTY about this drink or anything that makes me scrunch up like yesterdays.  But it also just…isn’t very flavorful and I would pass if offered again.
nf: This smells very sweet, maybe strawberry? Pretty sure I know what this is though. OK well it’s sweet but there doesn’t seem to be any carbonation? Maybe I’m crazy? OK yeah I don’t really sense much carbonation. It’s very sweet but that’s about it. It’s just SWEET.  This needs carbonation pretty badly. I suppose it’s possible Matt caused an issue with his pouring, but I don’t think that would remove carbonation. It’s got this gooey texture to it too that I don’t like. Not recommended. G Fuel has shamed Pac-Man. I do recommend their powder though, that wasn’t bad as a 3pm pick-me-up at work a few years ago. Just make sure you only put a little bit in a big thing of water. This was a G Fail though.

name: Oxyshred Ultra Energy Cotton Candy
msl:
Cracked open this can and immediately started laughing when I smelled it. It’s unavoidable. This shit smells awful. It smells like fucking dog food. I’m not even joking. I have no clue who the hell craves this. But anyway - this is COTTON CANDY. It’s a clear drink. Not nearly as much liquid as the Beaver Buzz. Hopefully the flavor here is significantly better than the smell. I’ve yet to decide if I’m gonna pinch my nose for the first sip or not. I feel like doing so will be better. WHICH I MEAN. SHOULD YOU NEED TO DO THAT WHEN WANTING TO POP BACK A NICE REFRESHING ENERGY DRINK? PERSONALLY I DON’T THINK SO!!!

OH BOY NF HAS GAGGED. I was CLOSE to gagging. I took a couple of sips and swallowed and the Cotton Candy flavor hits you AFTER the fact. I legitimately can not drink this thing without pinching my nose. I’m going to give it the old college try though. A slosh and a swig - oh my god. It does taste like Dog Food when it first hits you, then it melds into a more normal cotton candy flavor. What the fuck is this garbage? I’m gonna take a third sip for science but This I WILL NOT FINISH this drink. When the flavor turns around and hits you - you do get this sweet aftertaste that would be pleasant if it was just that on its own. But it doesn’t do that. It gives you a rush of dogshit first for a couple of seconds. If it was just the secondary aftertaste - I might go thumbs up on something like this. But this is squarely thumbs down, and I am dumping the drink immediately.

Fix your shit, Oxyshred. For the love of god.
nf:
We meet again, Oxyshred. Once the flagbearer of the absolute worst the energy drink industry has to offer, we’ve had some surprising drinks from them that I wouldn’t declare war crimes. That’s not to say they were excellent, but they’re better than their worst. With that said, this is an INTERESTING flavor concept that has been all over the place before whether or not it said “Cotton Candy” on the can. I started all of this by giving some backhanded praise to Oxyshred, which leads me to the scent. This smells like fucking dog or cat food. It is absolutely going to influence the final decision, because how could it not? Let’s see where the fuck this takes us.

So lemme lay this down on y’all. This tastes like liquid dog food with a bunch of sickly sweet artificial flavoring on top. It. Is. Guh-ross. You don’t immediately taste the dog food, it’s mostly just the Benadryl-like sweet flavor. But then the Alpo kicks in and I’m ready to blow chunks. Rotten. Nothing more to add. Fuck Oxyshred. I take everything positive back.

name: Bum Energy Dr. Bum
msl:
Another clear drink!  Taking a sniff of this one and it has a is VERY strong fruity smell.  This one is a mystery for me and I am terrible at identifying stuff by smell.  I’m gonna say like… Raspberry Lemon or Wild Orchard.  I dunno.  Maybe even Peach Mango.

Wow OK this is Dr. Bum.  What if we made Dr. Pepper a little worse?  That’s what this is.  I wish you all could have seen NF’s face after his sip, you can see it scrunch up in some form of disgust.  Yeah, I gave this one the slosh, and I gave this one the big swig, and the rest of it is kinda just going in the drain.  I don’t think it’s worth the caffeine.  I’m a guy who really likes Diet Dr. Pepper over Dr. Pepper, but I could tolerate Dr. Pepper.  This is not as good as either.  And for that, I dunno man.  I’m not gonna drink it again.  Thuuuuumbs doooown.

Honestly, Thumbs down might come off a little harsh as this wasn’t like i’m gagging and disgusting or anything, but when a popular Cola variant performs like this, I just am not interested in drinking any more of it.  So it goes.  I obviously did not finish.
nf:
I was plunging my toilet when Matt called me and asked if I wanted to review a drink. One second, I said, as I washed the plunger. A little awkwardness and time later, here we are with a drink I have selected. It’s another color coward, giving us NOTHING in the looks department. No visual whimsy here, folks! It smells like what it is. Matt has no idea what that is yet but he will quite soon. 

Well it’s named appropriately, that’s for damn sure. Not because it tastes like Dr. Pepper - which it only kind of does - but because it tastes like medicine. Now, I’m not a huge fan of the drink this takes after, but it’s more a “eh not for me” and not “Get this shit AWAY from me omfg.” You can detect the attempt here, but if they were aiming for a bulls’ eye, they missed the dart board entirely. It’s got a terrible, bitter, medicine-like taste that makes you want to curse the entire bloodline of everyone that worked on it. Matt *likes* Dr. Pepper and I wouldn’t even recommend this as a joke. No time for love, Dr. Bum!

name: Huel Energy+ Watermelon
msl:
This one is a mystery for NF but I also brought in a side of Mountain Dew for him. So the tell is pretty strong. I don’t really know what to say. It’s a Huel Energy Watermelon and yet it smells kind of like Rotten Apple Juice. This is the first time I have ever poured out a 3rd of a can before giving it to either of us, or tasting. The smell was THAT traumatizing. Oh well. Here we go.

Pinching my nose on the first taste, I actually do get the full watermelon flavoring here. When I take it like that, this honestly really isn’t that bad. But if I take the sip without pinching my nose, the unpleasant smell really just takes over and it can’t help but completely mask the honestly OK flavoring here. From a pure taste perspective, it’s not as bad as the last one. I think though if I have to pinch my nose before drinking what you’ve got, it’s just not great. I would apologize to HUEL, but tbh, I think they need to be apologizing to us. Not the worst drink we’ve ever had tbh. But this is ranking at the bottom. I gave it the slosh and the college try swigs - but I’m still not finishing. Sorry.
nf:
WELLLLLLLLLLLL…we probably got a Huel here. Gotta get em done some time. It smells pretty bad. I’m gonna say Pineapple and Mango is my guess but really who cares.

Yeah, terrible. Has this almost “spoiled” taste to it that some of the worst drinks have had. I will say the fruitiness is definitely noticeable here, but it’s not stronger than the terrible taste alongside it. So while this is still probably F tier, I think it’s probably better than most of its contemporaries due to the fact there is a drinkable flavor in there. Too bad it’s only 50% of the drink and not 80-100%. This could have been a decent C, Huel!

name: NOOB Energy Sweet Tooth
msl:
Think drink is pink and a mystery to me, but it should be the other NOOB Energy. I smelled it and laughed. How do I even describe it? It smells very very SWEET. Almost too sweet. I am trying so hard not to laugh as I can hear NF’s clear disdain for the sip he’s about to take.

OK well, this one doesn’t immediately have the same chemical rot as the last one did to me. I feel like this has a hint of strawberry to it. But it’s lighter than that. As I take bigger and bigger sips I do feel like I’ve got some more energy chemical flavor going on, but at the same time this one just tastes better than yesterdays to me. Do I really want to finish it? No. Each sip I take is bigger than the last and I kind of like it a little less each time. But I stand by what I said at the start, it’s definitely better than yesterday’s drink. But not something I necessarily ever want to drink again either. Going to cut it here, will not finish.
nf:
Well, here we go. Matt is playing hooky a second day in a row after swearing he can’t just take days off, so he should be prepared. Smell is…better than yesterday. But not much. If there were any pretenses that this wasn’t aimed at gamers, they have a little thing that looks like an ESRB rating box to indicate it has 0, yes ZERO calories.

Yep, dogshit again. Slightly less than yesterday, but just total dogshit. Maybe a little sweeter than Citrus Burst, but just bitter and chemical. Medicinal, plastic, whatever word you wanna use, it’s a good one to describe this. How in the WORLD do you fuck up strawberries and cream this bad? That’s the best Creme Saver flavor!!! It’s a good fucking combo! I had strawberries and Cool Whip as a kid, and yeah, that’s not real whipped cream, and yeah, I would have preferred something like ice cream, but IT WAS FUCKING GOOD and THIS ISN’T! I hope Trump deports these people to Mars.

name: Monster Energy ULTRA Violet
msl:
IT’S PURPLE. And it smells like Grape. But what flavor could it possibly be? That is a mystery to NF.

It is a grape drink that doesn’t feel very sugary. Which is pretty much exactly what I expected. You don’t even really get that satisfying GRAPE SODA flavor. It’s just the tiniest little hint of grape flavoring, clashing with the MONSTER energy. And that doesn’t taste too great! I’m not sure if this flavor exists WITH sugar, but if it does, that is not the flavor we are ranking today. And this one is just kinda bleh. If you slosh it around the mouth you get a little bit more of that GRAPE flavor they were going for, but you are quickly hit with large flashes of a not-very-good aftertaste. I don’t think this will be one I finish, but I don’t know if I’d say this is DDF tier. But it’s not much higher up, either. (Edit: It is DDF tier).
nf:
We got a purple drank today after a bit of a layoff. Don’t have to be a flavorist to know what drink this is.

Bleh. Barely tastes like grape. Almost champagne-ish. I forgot we had this, so NOS: GT Grape survives another day. Monster has yet to really impress me. I liked Ultra Sunrise, but not a ton, and Matt disliked it quite a bit. Monster says this is “Inspired by the hazy purple funk and kaleidoscopes of the 70's, Ultra Violet has 10 calories, zero sugar, and a light citrus and grape flavor.” First of all, fuck off with the flowery inspiration bullshit. You were not high on LSD listening to Jefferson Airplane when you came up with this, some people on an email and meeting chain decided on a grape-ish flavor. Second, you’re damn right it’s a LIGHT flavor. This stinks. Fuck Monster.

name: Gorilla Mind Sour Watermelon Candy
msl: This one does not have a strong smell at all.  There is a slight tint to it.  I can’t for the life of me figure out what it is just based on appearance and smell.  So we must taste.  WHAT THE HELLLLL IS THAT?  SOUR WATERMELON CANDY?!  Oh boy.  I don’t even know what to say about this one.  It’s got a very bitter flavor and my immediate thought is like… is this a liquid red jolly rancher?  Something?  It’s very interesting but it’s not extremely appetizing.  The first sip kind of really threw me for a loop.  The second and third were better, but I think after how amazing the other CANDY flavored Gorilla Mind was, this one unfortunately is not going to be in our top 10.  I kinda feel like it might be in the exact opposite.  I’m really not sure.  I will say - I’m actually continuing to drink and might actually finish this, so that says SOMETHING, but with how high my expectations were for this, it’s pretty damn disappointing.
nf: I thought this would have a very identifiable smell and give up the game immediately, but it did not…Euggghhhh…not sure about this one. I am not the biggest watermelon guy around, but Gorilla Mind generally has a high floor and I expected this to actually be pretty good. It’s…not. I can just barely taste watermelon in the background of a bitter sludge. I am pretty shocked and wonder if we got a bad can or something. Reddit says they think it tastes like a watermelon gummy and I guess I could agree if it were a gummy that fell on a road and was run over. Gorilla Mind missed big on this one, which is a shame, but it does go to show that no brand is safe from a shitty flavor.

name: Alani Nu Breezeberry
msl: I dunno what this is today.  It’s very… cloudy looking.  Oh it smells SWEET though.  I’m guessing Gorilla Mind Strawberry.  OK, that's very strong.  Soury.  And I don’t know if I think it’s all that pleasant.  Maybe too soury for me.  Oh I’m being told this is the BREEZEBERRY and that is very disappointing!  I don’t really get the hint of blue drink here.  Or blue raspberry.  It’s just very…sour.  Sloshing it around the mouth on my next sip - maybe just maybe I can get a hint of that blue flavor, but it’s really not hitting hard.  That’s not to say this is flavorless.  Whatever it is - it’s very STRONG.  It’s just not anything that I would expect.  I finished the drink already, because they’re not super big.  Not exactly my favorite.  Not sure I would go out of my way to have this one again.  But I also don’t know if it’s bad.  I just think it’s a little too much for me.  I need something a lot smoother next time!
nf:
I have an inkling of what this might taste like, but I’m not 100% sure…I cannot really put my finger on the taste here even knowing what it is. I was expecting blue raspberry, but it’s this anonymously sour tasting thing. A cursory search has a guy on Reddit saying blueberry lemonade. I…guess you could say that if you squint. Another says “breezeberry like a Raspberry with some lemon juice, both delicious,” which I find to be two dubious claims. Anyway, a disappointing product from Alani Nu, who really pleasantly surprised us with the first go around.

*~*~*~* BONUS *~*~*~*~

A WWE BERRY POWERBOMB REVISIT

I don’t remember this flavor at all, but I can instantly see why it was the lower of the two we did. - WAIT IT’S IN THE TOP 10? Oh man… I dunno. This could just be a flatter version but I feel like something horribly wrong has happened!!! The flavor is not bad mind you. It’s just not what I expected. What the heck . . . . I can’t believe Seth “Freaking” Rollins did this. The final sip was really good tho. I’m seeing now our drink in March I stated this had color - but this one did not have any color. I wonder if they changed something. MSL

This does not taste as good as I remember, but the leftover flavoring of the Alani Nu might be influencing it. It’s got a rough energy drink flavoring to it that I have no recollection of. Might be the remnants of their new ad campaign with Seth “Fucking” Rollings influencing it. Bummer summer, dude!

name: Monster Energy JUICE Aussie Style Lemonade
msl: This looks and smells like what it is. As far as the taste… it is… woof.  OK.  Let’s try it again.  Yeahhh this just isn’t very appetizing.  Like, I get the hint of lemonade here.  I get that “juice” feeling.  But am I not excited to take a third sip.  It’s just not great.  Imagine you had a lemonade that just didn’t have a strong taste of lemons, but you also poured it in a cup that had a little bit of soda still left in it.  That’s what this is.  Not very flavorful.  RIP.  I don’t even think I’ll finish it lol. Not looking forward to the next Lemonade…but we’ll see.
nf: This looks like Mountain Dew! Let’s see what the duck it is.  Well I figured it’s the Aussie (Style) Lemonade and hoo boy it tastes crappy. You can kinda detect the hints of lemonade flavoring, but it’s mostly just metallic citrus. I dunno if the Aussies make it like that or if it’s just Monster fucking up but this stunk. Subsequent sips are admittedly better, but this is definitely gonna be in the lower third of the list. Kinda tastes like Mountain Dew, but worse.  Just get some Minute Maid or Country Time lemonade. Or make your own. Avoid the Aussies.

name: Huel Energy+ Blue Raspberry
msl:
I went from enthusiastic and wanting to try a new drink to immediately regretting this decision once I smelled this can when opened. Awful pungent smell. Darkish piss yellow. This might be a nose pincher. I’ll be sure to give this the real college try though. I will say right away - this does NOT smell anything like the flavor. It’s a mystery for NF.

The taste is interesting. Sweet. Almost makes me think of apple juice. The problem is this isn’t apple flavored. It’s Blue Raspberry. Honestly, this isn’t so bad, but much like the Oxyshred Cali Cola, it has a smell to it that makes me actively not want to drink it at all. It’s a juicy little flavor, I know I just said it reminds me of apple, but you can definitely get some berry flavor. Just not the usual BLUE RASPBERRY flavor you may be thinking. It has a hint of an aftertaste, though I don’t know if it’s as overwhelming as some of the other drinks we’ve had. I can probably finish this one, but I’m opting not to. Well. OK. Wait. Let’s give it the slosh and big swig at least: Ohhhh the slosh doesn’t feel good at all. Ohhhh lord. That was a mistake. Much more of an aftertaste there.

Yeah. Still for some reason thinking more “apple” than “raspberry”. Don’t know why. My brain might be fucked up. Then again, I did just have a BAGEL with APPLE CINNAMON cream cheese. Maybe that’s still lingering? Don’t think so though. Thumbs in the middle leaning down. Straight down when you factor in the gross smell. Will not finish.
nf:
The smell of this is atrocious. It’s piss yellow. I have to assume it’s a Huel, but we’ll see if it’s not one of the old ass bang Energy flavors. Hopefully it manages a comeback from first impressions.

Tastes a little better than the smell, but you smell it coming in anyway, which taints the flavor. It’s got a little sweetness - I’m gonna assume this is Huel Blue Raspberry as it also has a slight tartness I detect, which Matt has now confirmed - but it can’t really fight through the other putrid taste that we were smelling. I took a swig while holding my breath on intake and it still tastes like garbage. This is the best flavor on paper that Huel has to offer, which kind of terrifies me about what the other two will be like. More like Gruel, am I right?

name: NOOB Energy Citrus Burst
msl:
This drink is freaking BLUE. It definitely has a smell, though I’m not sure what that smell is. CHEMICALS? We’ll find out.

That made me feel like I needed to clear a tonsil stone out immediately. Uhhh… I’m not really sure what it is this is going for. Tastes more chemically than Citrussy.

I’m trying to parse it, is it lemon that’s in here? I have to assume it’s a take on like Sprite or Dew based on the coloring but I really don’t know. Either way, not very appetizing, and I don’t really think it’s like SPIT THIS OUT bad, but it’s not good either. There isn’t a lot here when you split it between 2 glasses, and yet I still don’t think I’m going to finish it. I think I CAN…but I don’t think I will.

Did one BIGGER CHUG just to give it the old college try, and yeah. Nothing to write home about with this one. Better in a large dosage, but still nothing that I feel like I need or really want to consume. A thumbs down first impression from N00B.
nf:
Catch the buzz!! This is clearly YJ Stinger ENRAGED Raspberry, based on the light blue color!!!! 20 year old references aside I think this is probably N00b Citrus Burst.

Eughhhhh. Tastes bad, man. It tastes like bitter chemicals with a hint of citrus…somewhere. I may just be telling myself that. This is really bad, no other way to say it. It’s almost completely chemical in taste, very bitter, no fruity, sweet, sour, any good kinda taste anywhere. It’s just shitty. The can made it look like they were doing a Sprite kinda thing. This tastes more like a 40 year old can of a Sprite clone that Yugoslavia tried to reverse engineer from the real thing. F tier for sure. Seems like “NOOB” was actually describing the people behind the drink and not just trying to choose a gamer word to appeal to gamers.

Post-ranking one liner: “Impressively bad!” - Matt & N

name: EBOOST SUPER FUEL Sparkling Strawberry Lemonade
msl: RED DRINK. Almost looks like a pulpy type of juice. I gotta figure this is Sparkling Strawberry Lemonade, and our first ever EBOOST. Smells slightly berry…ish. Oh ok. This tastes more like a sparkling drink than an in your face kind of energy drink. It’s like seltzer with a hint of orange cream on top. Wouldn’t offend the most insulated church mom. I like what flavor exists, it definitely IDs as orange cream, but there’s just so little of it! There’s stronger options out there I’d recommend over this.
nf: Smells like it’s gonna be citrusy. Not clear at all. Tastes more like orange cream than strawberry lemonade? Not very sweet. Tastes like a very natural orange cream soda with very little carbonation. I don’t dislike it but I also don’t think I’d recommend it.

name: OxyShred Ultra Energy Frosty Big Apple
msl: We have been putting this one off for a while.  This is the first time we cracked it open by the sink because we were both just so unsure of it.  Cracked it open and I stole the first smell.  WOOF.  I then had a drink.  It was BETTER THAN THE LAST ONE but it just has this GOOEY texture and I don’t like it.  We are immediately going to have a palette cleanser with a C4 after this one, because I think we need it.
nf:
Well, the dreaded day has come, the day we have to try the other fucking OxyShred. The last one was so awful that we have been avoiding this one. But we must try it in the name of scientific research and bringing the world forward.

What positive words I will say is that it is better than the previous OxyShred, probably by a lot. The downside is it’s still much worse than any other drink we’ve had. It has a gooey, very artificial apple flavor that is what I would term “not ideal.” Gun to my head vs. the other OxyShred I take this, but I might consider asking them to take the shot for a moment.

name: OxyShred Ultra Energy Proton Plasma
msl:
This smells PUNGENT… I DUNNO IF I LIKE. BOTTOMS UP. WOAH. What was that taste? I don’t really think I dislike it at all. It’s actually pretty citrus-y. I don’t know what the hell the flavor is though. It definitely lives up to that ghostbusters pulasuuuumaaaahhhhh. It tastes gooey. I don’t think this is amazing, but I also don’t dislike it. In fact, I like it. It smells like complete shit though. Change that smell immediately.

EXTRA NOTE - I will say this is much better in small dosages than one big sip. My final gulp was the biggest one and I was like “Oof.” Still think it was good though.
nf:
This didn't smell great. It tasted better, but not much. The website says it has “fresh notes of pineapple, passionfruit & sweet strawberry.” I can definitely taste the strawberry, but it has a weird aftertaste that reminds of the shitty energy drinks I partook of in college that drove me away from these things. There seems to be a very quick three stages to every sip - “this is bad,” “oh? Maybe it’s not so bad?” and finally, “no, it’s bad.” I would go two stars on this if it were a match.

NOTE FOR THE FUTURE - NF immediately yelled “EUGH!!! NOT GOOD!!!” upon drinking - and this drink pretty squarely went to Number 13 on the list, which at the time, was the very last place entry. MSL Agreed on the last place.

name: EBOOST SUPER FUEL Sparkling Blue Raspberry
msl:
This drink is a mystery to me, but since the drink is BLOOD RED and there’s a lot of it I’m assuming it is BUCKED UP CHERRY CANDY. We bought 2 BANG’s recently, both of them being red flavors though, so I’m not 100% sure. It smells kinda…watered down whatever this is. My second guess will be Wylin Watermelon if not Cherry Candy.

Yeah that’s just kind of nothing. I think it’s going for a Jolly Rancher thing? WOW HOLY SHIT THIS IS BLUE RASPBERRY? I’M COMPLETELY FLOORED. WHY IS IT RED? I didn’t have the same reaction as NF at first, but I just did a big swig and Slosh Test and now I get that VILE flavor that he mentioned. I’m gonna take one more big college try sip and… Yeah. This is not great. Not finishing. This is a straight thumbs down. Aftertaste that is taking a bit to go away. This is our second EBOOST and I very honestly may have more respect for OXYSHRED than this. Woof. Will not finish.

Post dumping of the drink: It’s been about 7-8 minutes and I’m actively drinking water and the aftertaste still hasn’t gone away. Something I want to add is I think they completely whiffed on the flavor here also. Just real bad.
nf:
We got a darkish red drink with no discernable scent. I know what we are drinking and I wouldn’t be confident in what to expect if I weren’t.

Oh that is fucking VILE. Tastes like death. Incredibly bitter, 100% medicinal. The smallest, slightest hint of berry.

My parents, god bless them, they tried with me a lot growing up and got some advice that probably wasn’t great. But it was the mid 90s and medicating kids was all the rage. And they wanted to help me, so they listened to the advice. So at 5 years old I was taking Ritalin and Prozac. This is probably bad enough, but I couldn’t swallow them whole. So I would have to chew the Ritalin, and they’d break down the Prozac capsules and put the powder in a glass of Diet Coke. I’m recalling this very personal story to say that this is what EBOOST’s attempt at a Blue Raspberry energy drink tasted like. The only difference is that I doubt there will be any possible benefit to this demonic concoction. Minus five stars.
